jobs.title: Heat Pump Product Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
jobs.body: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you! Scope of Position This motivated and detail-oriented individual, as part of the Marketing and Product Management team, will be responsible for developing technical training materials and supporting product improvement initiatives that enhance customer understanding of heat pump and water heating systems. The Heat Pump Product Engineering Intern will gain hands-on experience in technical communication, refrigeration design, and applied HVAC technology while collaborating with Product Management, Engineering, and New Product Development teams to create instructional resources, support troubleshooting activities, and evaluate potential product improvements. This position reports to the Product Manager. This role is onsite and is based in Fort Worth, TX. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to identify common product startup challenges, troubleshooting procedures, and technical support needs. Develop technical training materials, including instructional manuals, presentations, videos, and online training modules to support field startup and troubleshooting activities. Research existing industry training materials and best practices to ensure instructional resources align with applicable technical standards and customer needs. Assist with the development and organization of training content for online learning platforms to improve accessibility and usability for customers and field personnel. Work with Product Management and Engineering teams to identify commonly failing components and evaluate potential replacement solutions. Support product improvement initiatives by reviewing cost analysis findings, testing results, and technical recommendations. Develop testing plans to evaluate the functionality, reliability, and durability of selected replacement components through functional and stress testing. Collaborate with Engineering and New Product Development teams to gain an understanding of refrigeration design, heat pump systems, and applied HVAC/water heating technologies. Assist with documenting technical findings, testing procedures, and product performance observations to support troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives. Utilize Microsoft Office and relevant technical tools to develop training documentation, presentations, and project reports. Participate in internship development activities, networking opportunities, and cross-functional learning experiences. Summarize and present internship project outcomes, technical findings, and recommendations to leadership at the conclusion of the internship. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the Training Manager, Product Manager, or Company management. Demonstrate integrity, accountability, continuous improvement, and transparency by maintaining accurate technical documentation, following established safety and testing procedures, identifying opportunities for product improvements, and effectively communicating project findings. Required Qualifications Current student (junior or senior status). Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Systems, HVAC Technology, Communications, or a related technical or media field. GPA of 3.0 or higher. Strong interest in technical training, renewable energy, and/or HVAC and water heating systems. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to participate in hands-on demonstrations and technical activities under supervision. Demonstrated initiative, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Completion of junior- or senior-level coursework in a relevant field. Familiarity with computer-aided design (CAD), diagramming, or graphic design tools such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Visio, or Adobe Illustrator. Interest in technical documentation, instructional content development, or product training. Interest in refrigeration systems, heat pump technology, or HVAC equipment. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions While performing the job duties, you will be working on-site at the Fort Worth, TX location in both an office and manufacturing environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Physical Requirements: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to: Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials. Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks. Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls. Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers. Ability to stand for long periods of time. Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Ability to push and pull up to 25 pounds. Ability to physically move around manufacturing floor. Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers. Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses. Pay Range: $22-26 The expected hourly range for this position is $22–$26 hourly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. What's In It for You People-First Culture – Enriching and caring for people is at the core of who we are; this includes executing our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategy, and providing you with meaningful career growth opportunities, a positive and safe work environment, and affirmation that you are heard, valued, and respected. Flexible PTO Policy – Work-life balance is important at Watts and our interns receive one (1) hour of flexible PTO for every thirty (30) hours worked. Your flexible PTO can be utilized for any type of absence. Paid Holidays – Celebrate the holidays with your loved ones and still get paid! You will receive the following paid holidays off during your time as an Intern with Watts. Where a holiday falls during the weekend, it will be observed on an adjacent weekday. Lunch and Learns – Throughout your internship, there will be opportunities for you to sign up to learn and network with some of the key strategic leaders and thought partners within our core operating model! Sustainability – For five years in a row, Watts has been named one of "America's Most Responsible Companies" by Newsweek. Join our journey as we continue to distinguish Watts as a responsible and committed corporate citizen. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. #LI (Onsite) Watts in it for you : Please note that the following benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles. Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ How we work: At Watts, our culture is team-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Watts is committed to equal employment opportunity. We follow a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic disposition or carrier status, marital status, military or veteran status, minorities, or any other category protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Any employee who needs a reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Weather Perception
jobs.body: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. The Weather and Degraded Roads Perception team builds features that enable the Waymo driver to behave safely and comfortably in the presence of rain, fog, snow, ice, potholes, unpaved roads, trenches, and construction sites. In collaboration with the planner and control teams, we think broadly about how we want the vehicle to behave in these conditions and make every effort to accomplish our goals. Most of the team's work consists of designing new perception features, developing and retraining ML models, and building hybrid onboard/offboard systems to coordinate fleetwide behaviors. We also work with Vision Language Models (VLMs) to enable appropriate driving behavior in long-tail situations. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! You will: Research and implement novel ML perception solutions for Waymo’s self driving stack Develop applied research solutions to data-scarse challenges in Waymo’s weather space. Cross functional discussion and development within the Waymo onboard SW team You have: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics or equivalent Experience with machine learning applications, including transformer applications and ML evaluation techniques Experience with Python programming Experience with reading and implementing ML algorithms from academic papers Familiarity with Tensorflow or Pytorch or JAX We prefer: Classical computer vision or computational geometry experience Submissions in relevant robotics, ML, or Computer Vision Conferences (ICML, RSS, IROS, CORL, CVPR) Experience in real time robotic systems Experience in C++ programming Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in. jobs.title: Intern - Data Analytics
jobs.body: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. The Data Analytics / Computer Science Intern will join Western Digital's Head Backend Business Unit for a structured 3-6 month internship at the Philippines site (PHO). This role sits within the Engineering organization and is designed to introduce data-savvy students to the world of manufacturing analytics in a precision technology environment. The intern will support analytics and digitalization initiatives within slider processing and HGA assembly operations, helping build tools, reports, and visualizations that support engineering and operations decision-making. High-performing interns will be considered for conversion to the ECT -- under the BEST Program. Key responsibilities include: Supporting development of operational dashboards and engineering reports Assisting in data extraction, cleaning, and exploratory analysis of manufacturing datasets Writing scripts or queries to automate manual reporting tasks (Python, SQL, Power BI) Collaborating with engineers to understand data needs and translate them into analytical outputs Completing a defined analytics internship project with a final presentation Participating in structured learning and check-in sessions throughout the program REQUIRED: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Engineering with a strong analytics/programming focus, or a related field. Minimum 3rd-year standing. Proficiency in Python and/or SQL. Demonstrated experience in data analysis or data visualization through academic projects, competitions, personal projects, or similar experience. Available for a 3–6 month internship. The internship is intended for students whose academic program requires or allows an internship for academic credit. PREFERRED : Coursework in machine learning, data mining, or statistical modeling. Portfolio of data-related projects, such as GitHub, Kaggle, or similar platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent data visualization tools. Exposure to manufacturing, operations, or engineering data is a plus but not required. SKILLS Hands-on experience with Python and/or SQL programming. Data visualization and dashboard development skills. Analytical curiosity and the ability to ask questions and explore data independently. Good communication skills, with the ability to explain data insights clearly and effectively. Collaborative, proactive, and willing-to-learn mindset. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. TARGET ONBOARDING DATES Candidates should be available to start their internship on one of the following target dates: January 11/12, 2027 April 1, 2027 May 24/25,2027 WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. jobs.title: Nuclear Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: About Us At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space. The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy. ABOUT THE SUMMER INTERNSHIP PROGRAM Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater. Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else. We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer. We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules: Cohort #1 Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13 Cohort #2 Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10 All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements. Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package. About the Team As a Nuclear Engineering Intern, you will work directly on the design and analysis of Antares reactors. You will contribute to reactor design efforts while helping develop and validate the computational physics capabilities used to inform engineering decisions. Interns will be tasked with small starter projects, and then quickly tasked with a long-duration project that will culminate in a technical deliverable and presentation. You will be integrated and evaluated as if you are a first-year junior engineer, not just an “intern”. The bar for success here is high, and the expectation is that you’re able to smartly use your mentor and the resources around you to execute on your project and identify more issues and opportunities for improvement. Roles and Responsibilities: - Drive reactor design work by performing nuclear engineering analyses that inform design decisions. - Develop and validate computational physics capabilities used to analyze and evaluate reactor designs. Basic Qualifications: - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies. - 6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience) Preferred Skills & Experience: - GPA of 3.5 or above. - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred. - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.). - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams. - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements. - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively. Location - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. Culture At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful: - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done” - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption Equal Opportunity Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. ITAR REQUIREMENTS To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. As an intern, you'll contribute directly to the design, testing, and integration of advanced defense technologies all within a fast-paced, collaborative startup environment where your work has immediate impact. Document design processes, test results, and project progress, contributing to the continuous improvement of our systems. Attend technical reviews, design meetings, and team briefings to stay engaged with project developments and learn from industry experts. Learning Opportunities: Gain hands-on experience in aerospace engineering, working on cutting-edge hypersonic missile systems. Develop your technical skills by working with high-performance teams and state-of-the-art tools. Learn about the full lifecycle of missile development, from design and prototyping to testing and final integration. Receive mentorship from experienced engineers and leaders in the aerospace and defense industry. Be a part of a fast-paced startup culture where innovation, teamwork, and rapid development are at the forefront. Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Rising junior, senior, or graduate-level student preferred. Strong academic record with relevant coursework in areas such as mechanical design, propulsion, power systems, or related fields Hands-on experience through lab work, projects, or internships is a plus. Passion for aerospace, defense technology, and innovative engineering solutions. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with hardware design, testing, data acquisition, and analysis. Familiarity with missile systems, defense technology, or aerospace components. Strong interest in working in a startup environment with high-impact projects. jobs.title: Quality Engineering Co-op
jobs.body: The Quality Engineering Co-op will support the Quality team in maintaining and improving product and process quality across manufacturing operations. This role provides hands-on experience in quality assurance, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and regulatory compliance while working closely with cross-functional teams. The co-op will gain exposure to industry-standard quality tools and methodologies and contribute to initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities: Support quality assurance activities by assisting in the development and execution of quality control plans, inspection procedures, and quality monitoring processes. Participate in audits and inspections of manufacturing processes and finished products to ensure compliance with quality standards and customer requirements. Assist in investigating customer-reported quality concerns and nonconformances, utilizing problem-solving tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA). Support the implementation, tracking, and verification of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to address root causes and prevent recurrence. Collect, analyze, and interpret quality data to identify trends, process deviations, and opportunities for improvement. Apply statistical methods to evaluate process capability, product performance, and overall quality effectiveness. Maintain accurate documentation of inspections, nonconformances, corrective actions, and other quality records. Prepare reports, presentations, and quality metrics for internal reviews, management updates, and customer communications. Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to improve processes, reduce defects, and enhance product quality. Participate in Lean, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement initiatives to drive operational excellence. Support compliance with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, customer specifications, and internal quality procedures. Assist with internal audits and help prepare the organization for external audits and regulatory assessments. Attend training sessions on quality systems, industry standards, and company procedures while developing technical and professional skills. Shadow experienced quality professionals to gain practical knowledge of quality engineering principles, manufacturing processes, and problem-solving techniques. Qualifications: Pursuing a degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Familiarity with quality tools, statistical analysis, Lean principles, or Six Sigma methodologies is preferred. jobs.title: Global Transition Planner Intern
jobs.body: Global Transition Planner Internship What gives Dell Technologies our competitive advantage? It’s our ability to achieve cost savings as we operate at the cutting edge of technology. Working in an environment that’s as complex as it is critical, our Materials and Procurement team manages a group of indirect categories, such as real estate, marketing material, supplies or software. We use our in-depth knowledge and experience to develop strategic relationships with external suppliers as well as with key stakeholders. Our role also includes leading contract negotiations, managing risk, driving cost-saving initiatives, and implementing strategic sourcing best practices. What you’ll achieve: As a Global Transition Planner intern , you will drive end-to-end planning for New Product Introductions (NPI) and platform transitions by providing early visibility into supply, demand, and potential liability risks to enable timely executive decision-making. Optimize material inventory levels to minimize financial liability and excess inventory while protecting backlog fulfillment , ensuring supply continuity, and maximizing sales velocity. Partner across Procurement, Planning, Product Group, Engineering, Finance, IT, and Strategy to deliver data-driven insights, automate planning processes, and enable scalable business solutions. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an Internship program on our Demand Planning team. Responsibilities You will: Support global Product Lifecycle and Supply Planning transitions, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective execution and governance of product launches, transitions, and end-of-life activities. Program Manage a Project in BMS transformation and AOP planning processes by leveraging automation, AI-driven analytics & visualization, and process improvement methodologies. jobs.body: Job Title: R&D Intern Job Description: R&D Intern - Summer 2027 Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Franklin, MA is seeking an R&D Intern to join our team for the Summer 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 12-14 weeks in duration. Our site in Franklin, MA is seeking an R&D Co-Op to join our team for the Summer 2027 season. In this role, you will support the development and characterization of advanced adsorbent materials used in filtration, purification, and chemical separation applications. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in material characterization, adsorption testing, product development, and laboratory-scale experimentation while working closely with experienced scientists and engineers. What You’ll Do: Characterize adsorbent materials and help develop a database for the lab. Conduct adsorption capacity studies for various chemicals and contaminants, including sample preparation, experimentation, and documentation. Support the development and optimization of new adsorbent media through experimental design, testing, and performance assessment. Collaborate with R&D teams on product development activities, technical reporting, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining safe laboratory practices. What We Seek: Pursuing Bachelors’ or master's in below mentioned areas Strong laboratory and data analysis skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and scientific data analysis. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Desired Major(s) & Graduation Year: Chemical Engineering or Materials Engineering/ Science. jobs.body: Systems Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027 Salary : £25,420 Dynamic working: Up to 5 days per week on-site dependant on workload and/or classification Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. This also offers a great opportunity to engage with internal and external customers. This role is suited to those that enjoy the creativity and practicality of working with problems to arrive at logical solutions. Our Systems Design function will support you to become a fully integrated member of the team with the opportunity to assume an increasing level of responsibility. We offer varied roles with scope to choose placements based on interests and skills. Our people are adaptable and the role is varied and fast paced – Innovation is a company value that we practice the most. Systems Engineers work with people across all engineering fields and business teams, meeting suppliers and customers and engaging with international MBDA colleagues. There is also Opportunity to travel both within the UK and potentially internationally. What we’re looking for from you: Current undergraduate studying for a degree in Physics, Mathematical Sciences, Engineering, Physical Sciences, Chemistry, Technology or Computing discipline. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: About the role Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules. Internship is full-time and on-site in San Jose, California. The Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) team at Muon is responsible for the assembly, integration, and validation of spacecraft hardware through unit acceptance testing as well as spacecraft-level integration and testing. As an Industrial Engineering Intern, you will support the development and improvement of the processes, tools, and systems that enable Muon to efficiently build and test spacecraft at scale. You will work closely with AIT, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Test Engineering teams to analyze production data, improve workflows, identify bottlenecks, develop capacity models, and implement process improvements. This is a hands-on opportunity to apply industrial engineering principles in a fast-growing spacecraft manufacturing environment and directly contribute to increasing production efficiency and throughput. Muon is a small and fast growing startup which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. As an intern, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry. We're committed to offering an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success. Responsibilities Analyze spacecraft assembly, integration, and test processes to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, throughput, and scalability. Develop and maintain process maps, standard work, work instructions, and other manufacturing documentation. Collect and analyze production data to identify trends, bottlenecks, constraints, and opportunities for improvement. Support development of production capacity and resource planning models for spacecraft assembly and test operations. Assist with production scheduling, workflow optimization, and resource allocation across AIT operations. Conduct time studies and process observations to establish baseline cycle times, labor requirements, and process performance. Support development and implementation of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve material flow, kitting, tooling, workstation layout, and overall factory/lab utilization. Develop dashboards, reports, and other data-driven tools to provide visibility into production performance and operational metrics. Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions for production constraints, process inefficiencies, and recurring issues. Partner with technicians and engineers to identify practical improvements to spacecraft assembly and test processes. Support implementation and validation of process improvements on the production floor. Assist with developing scalable processes and systems to support increasing spacecraft production volume. Document process improvements and communicate findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders. Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, or a related technical field. Strong understanding of engineering, manufacturing, and/or operations fundamentals. Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify process improvements. Experience with Excel or similar tools for data analysis, modeling, and visualization. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment. Ability to work hands-on in a production, laboratory, or engineering environment. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to approach complex operational challenges from a first-principles perspective. Nice-to-have Skills Previous internship, co-op, research, or project experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing, operations, or production environments. Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value-stream mapping, or other continuous improvement methodologies. Experience conducting time studies, capacity analysis, line balancing, or process optimization. Experience with production planning, scheduling, or resource capacity modeling. Experience with data visualization or analytics tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar. Experience with CAD or facility/workstation layout tools. Experience developing automated spreadsheets, dashboards, or other operational tools. Previous experience on technical project teams such as a CubeSat, rocketry, Formula SAE, Solar Car, or other hardware-focused engineering project. Familiarity with manufacturing, assembly, integration, or test processes for complex electromechanical hardware. Experience working in a cleanroom, laboratory, or aerospace manufacturing environment. Pay range Bachelor's students $40/hour Master's $45/hour PhD $50/hour About Muon Space Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world. Taking Care of Our Team At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave. Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know. jobs.body: About Oshkosh Delivery, an Oshkosh company Oshkosh Delivery is dedicated to redefining the future of last-mile and commercial delivery. Built on Oshkosh Corporation’s legacy of engineering excellence and innovation, we design and manufacture advanced delivery vehicles that are durable, efficient, and sustainable. With a focus on reliability, driver experience, and cutting-edge technology, Oshkosh Delivery empowers fleets and businesses to move goods smarter, safer, and with confidence, today and for the road ahead. As a Supplier Quality Engineer Intern, you will have the opportunity to support the NGDV (Next Generation Delivery Vehicle) Supplier Quality Engineering team, working directly with high-impact suppliers to ensure flawless execution of our supply base. *This position has a Spring/Summer 2027 start date. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. About As a Digital Product Design Intern, you will support the design and development of digital experiences across Polaris products. This includes in-vehicle displays, companion mobile applications, and web experiences. You will work closely with product designers, engineers, researchers, and product owners. The role involves participation in user testing and rider research to help ensure our digital products are intuitive, usable, and built for real riders in real environments. This internship is a hands-on opportunity to gain experience in end-to-end digital product design, from early concepts and wireframes through testing, iteration, and handoff. ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: Support the design of vehicle display interfaces, including infotainment, controls, and system UI. Opportunities to assist with design work for mobile apps and web experiences that complement vehicle systems. Create wireframes, user flows, interaction concepts, and high-fidelity UI designs. Help maintain and apply design systems, components, and UI standards. Prepare design assets, specs, and documentation for engineering handoff. Participate and organize usability tests, user interviews, and rider testing research events. Assist with research synthesis, insights, and design recommendations. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and researchers in design reviews and critiques. Iterate on designs based on feedback, testing results, and technical constraints. Support general design tasks like: asset creation, file organization, and design updates. SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EDUCATION: Currently pursuing a BS/BA in Digital Product Design, UX/UI Design, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, HCI, or a related field. jobs.title: Research & Development Scientist/Engineer Intern Summer 2027 - Freshmen, Sophomores, and Juniors
jobs.body: Job Location Mason Job Description At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise. Your first step towards an amazing career in Research and Development (R&D) at Procter and Gamble (P&G) starts with applying to this internship. Within an R&D internship, you’ll be actively involved in creating, reimagining and launching new innovations which improve our consumers lives… all around the world. As a company, P&G believes that ‘innovation is our lifeblood’. As such, we invest to ensure that our products best serve the current and future needs of our more than 5 billion consumers worldwide across our 65 iconic, trusted brands. From Day 1 you’ll be equipped with cutting edge innovation tools, you’ll be encouraged to dive into the innovation process, and you’ll be tasked to advance real needs for our business. To enable your success, you’ll collaborate with talented technologists and mentors to strengthen your skillsets and develop new areas of mastery. The environments you’ll work in are creative workspaces where new ideas flourish and where your technical mastery is recognized and rewarded. Ultimately, our investment in you is equally an investment in the development of our future R&D talent and in advancing our lofty innovation goals. What will I do? Our Associate Scientist Interns are constantly learning, growing in service of improving how our products perform. In this role, you will find new ways to innovate, develop and manufacture consumer products. Since we’re a highly collaborative company, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest technical and commercial partners. We strive to match your skills, qualifications, and interests with a role that works best for you and have a number of areas in R&D where you could work as an intern, including: Products Research: Deeply understand s our consumers and their needs in order to inform product design parameters for new or improved products. Product Formulation & Design : Translates the consumer’s needs into the development of delightful finished-products which use the best available technologies/chemicals/materials. Packaging & Device Development: Creates and improves packages and devices that delight consumers and retailers. Packaging and Device technologists lead the development of packages of superior function and premium design. In addition to ensuring the product functions well once the consumer has brought it home, we place a premium in ensuring that our packages and devices are responsibly developed with sustainability in mind. Process Development & Pilot Plant Operations: Translates ideas, concepts, and technologies into the design and scale-up of commercially feasible, state of the art, chemical and mechanical manufacturing processes. Material Development: Start by developing 'new to the world' raw material technologies so we can meet our customer's needs with the highest quality, best performing materials. Modeling and Simulation (M&S): M&S development is a powerful capability which increasingly underpins the work across all our R&D functions. Our M&S experts are developing new to the world mathematical models which speed the pace and impact of our innovations. Data Science: C ommunicate s complex data or algorithms into simple conclusions that will empower others to drive action based on the insights you derive. As a Data Scientist, you will transform the business to enable better decision-making through the use of advanced analytics. Job Qualifications We're looking for Freshmen, Sophomores, and Juniors to intern with us! You must be available for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027, from mid/late May through early August. ​Working toward a BS or MS in engineering, life or physical science field such as Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Analytical and Measurement Science, Microbiology, Packaging Science, Psychology, or a related field. We offer a wide range of roles for Chemical, Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering. Increasingly, we have roles suited for Data Science/Analytics, Electrical Engineering or other related engineering fields. Overall G.P.A. of 3.0 or above on a 4.0 scale. Have strong communication skills Have both critical thinking and active listening Have the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment Positions are located in both Boston and Cincinnati As an intern, you'll receive an internship allowance. At P&G, Intern sessions are considered temporary employment, with a predicted ending point. No full-time employment commitments are made. However, depending on satisfactory completion of certain criteria, you may be considered for a full-time position upon graduation. What we offer: Responsibilities as of Day 1 – you will feel the ownership of your project from the beginning, and you will be given specific projects and responsibilities. Continuous mentorship – you will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager. A dynamic and encouraging environment - working over a diverse array of interesting problems. Agility and work/life balance for employees, we value every individual and support initiatives. True support for work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being. A competitive salary and benefits' package. Just So You Know: At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise. Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits. Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process. If you have a disability that affects your ability to complete our online application process, please visit our Disability Accommodation Page . jobs.title: Computer Science | Engineering internship: performance data platform
jobs.body: Introduction At ASML’s Delft office, we are developing a multi-beam electron microscope used to inspect semiconductor wafers during production. As part of the development process, we continuously collect and analyze data from multiple systems operating under a wide range of conditions. Storing this data in a structured, reliable, and future-proof way, while making it easily accessible for querying, analysis, performance tracking, and reporting, is essential to our work. This internship focuses on developing a data platform that supports these activities and helps engineers gain valuable insights from complex datasets. You will contribute to a solution with a direct impact on the development of advanced semiconductor technology. Your assignment As an intern, you will work with our design team to develop a data platform for measurement and performance data. You will investigate the data generated by our systems and determine how it can best be structured, stored, and accessed to support current and future querying, analysis, performance tracking, and reporting needs. You will have the opportunity to design and implement the solution from the ground up, with the freedom to explore suitable technologies and approaches that best support our engineering needs. Your main responsibilities will be: Analyze measurement and performance data generated by our systems; Define an effective structure for storing and organizing data; Explore suitable data-storage technologies and database architectures; Design and implement a scalable data platform and database solution; Enable efficient querying and access to data for analysis and reporting; Support the use of measurement and performance data to monitor system performance over time; Collaborate with engineers to ensure the solution meets current and future requirements. This is a master thesis or non-thesis internship for minimum 5 months, 5 days per week (2 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February or March 2027. jobs.title: Physics | Engineering internship: Multi-beam SEM performance optimization
jobs.body: Introduction At ASML Delft, we are developing a next-generation multi-beam scanning electron microscope (SEM) for semiconductor wafer inspection. This internship focuses on improving the imaging performance of advanced inspection systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. Due to the microscope's large field of view and shallow depth of focus, wafer surface variations can affect image quality and inspection efficiency. During this internship, you will help develop methods to better understand these effects and improve system performance. This internship offers the opportunity to combine physics, data analysis, and engineering in a highly innovative environment. Your assignment As an intern, you will contribute to the optimization of multi-beam SEM performance through calibration measurements, data analysis, and performance evaluation. You will work closely with specialists from different engineering disciplines to gain insight into electron-optical system behavior and identify opportunities for improvement. Your work will support the development of more robust inspection strategies and improved imaging performance. Your main responsibilities will be: Design and execute calibration and characterization measurements; Analyze measurement data to evaluate imaging and system performance; Assess beam positioning, focus behavior, and alignment accuracy; Develop data-analysis workflows, visualizations, and performance metrics; Investigate the impact of wafer topography on imaging quality and throughput; Support automation of data processing and reporting activities; Collaborate with software, physics, and systems engineers to improve calibration methods. Depending on your interests and progress, the project may also include statistical modeling, algorithm development, and optimization of inspection strategies. This is a master's non-thesis internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 5 days per week (2 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February/March 2027. Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are currently enrolled in a master's degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, and have completed a bachelor's degree; Have a strong foundation in physics and mathematics; Have experience with Python for scientific programming and data analysis; Are analytical and able to interpret complex datasets; Are proactive and comfortable working both independently and within multidisciplinary teams. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon. jobs.title: MBA Technical Strategy and Operations Intern
jobs.body: Who we are Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress. Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that. Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive. This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale. We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life. If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us. About the role We are looking for a graduate student intern with a vehicle or mobility background to support technical strategy and operations for our vehicle engineering team. You will own a defined workstream within one of our programs: the plan, the milestones, the dependencies, the risks, and the weekly readout to engineering leadership. Depending on the workstream, you may also support issue tracking, manufacturing during vehicle builds, and analysis for engineering decisions. The role is hands-on. Expect regular time in the garage, and on the production floor with the engineers and technicians doing the work. What you’ll do Own the plan for a defined workstream, such as a build, a bench, a supplier transition, a fleet readiness milestone, or a process rollout. Maintain milestones, dependencies, risks, and open actions. Publish a weekly status readout to engineering leadership with progress, blockers, decisions needed, and a recommendation for each escalation. Keep the issue record current. Prepare the weekly triage, chase owners for updates, and roll the results into the weekly readout. Support vehicle builds as needed, including build readiness, parts and kitting status, work instructions, and issue capture on the floor while a build is in progress. Pull the quotes, lead times, cost data, and fleet data the program needs, and build the comparisons the engineering owner uses to decide. Work with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, fleet operations, and finance to move your workstream forward. Identify what is slowing your workstream down, propose a fix, implement it, and measure the result. What we’re looking for Current graduate student in an MBA, an engineering master's (mechanical, electrical, industrial, systems, automotive, or similar), or a related master's program such as engineering management, operations, or supply chain. Prior background in vehicles or mobility, including automotive, EV, autonomous vehicles, commercial vehicles, fleet operations, mobility services, off-highway or heavy equipment. Comfortable with technical material, including build plans, test reports, and BOMs. Experience owning a deliverable through to completion against a schedule. Comfortable in a garage and on a production floor. Able to commit 15-20 hours per week during the academic term on a consistent schedule, with regular onsite days in San Francisco. Why join us At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow. What else you need to know This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base starting rate for this role is $56.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others? #LI-Onsite

Laboratory Maintenance • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized laboratory environment. • Ensure test equipment is properly stored, calibrated, and maintained. • Help manage components, spare parts, and development kits inventory. • Follow laboratory safety procedures and engineering best practices. Documentation • Maintain build records, test reports, and engineering documentation. • Update procedures, assembly instructions, and technical records as required. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027 and continue participating in the program until June–July 2027 . Data Quality Systems Intern HP’s Take Back organization supports the responsible collection, recovery, and recycling of products at the end of their useful life. Reliable product data is essential to this mission, enabling accurate regulatory reporting, effective operational decisions, and strong collaboration with internal teams and external partners. We are looking for a motivated student to join our team and help improve the quality, completeness, and consistency of product information across our databases. The intern will contribute to validating master data, identifying gaps or discrepancies, supporting corrective actions with stakeholders, and exploring automated solutions that make data checks more efficient and scalable. This internship offers the opportunity to combine analytical thinking, technology, and sustainability in an international environment. The successful candidate will gain practical experience with data collection processes, databases, and automation while helping the Take Back organization strengthen data reliability and audit readiness. If you are curious, structured, and eager to solve real business challenges, we invite you to join us. Key responsibilities: Develop data science and IT tools to extract information from product data documents and connect it with our databases. Use data analysis techniques to validate master data, monitor quality, identify gaps, and request updates from stakeholders. Build automated controls using Python, SQL, and AI to verify document accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness. Requirements: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Basic knowledge of Agentic AI, SQL, and Python. Analytical, curious, structured, organized, and team-oriented. Fluent in written and spoken English Experience our benefits : Paid internship within a global, technology driven company. Join an international work environment, with opportunities for learning, professional development, and networking across teams. Flexible working schedule, with options for part-time agreements (4 hours/day) or full-time (8 hours/day). The length of the internship ranges from 4 to 12 months. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Our team owns end-to-end hardware validation, working across the full product lifecycle from early silicon bring-up through system-level qualification. Automated monitoring workflows and dashboards that improve visibility into manufacturing performance indicators. Analytical models or methodologies that provide meaningful insight into yield, quality, reliability, or performance trends. Increase visibility into key drivers affecting product yield, quality, reliability, and performance. Enable data-driven engineering decisions through advanced analytics and AI-Generated insights. jobs.title: Research Intern - Algorithms Group: Generative Modeling
jobs.body: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally-recognized scientists and engineers, who pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. The Algorithms group at MSR Redmond is looking for Research Interns to advance research in generative modeling. Opportunities include fundamental algorithmic innovation to enhance the efficiency and generation quality of existing models (e.g., diffusion models, image auto-regressive models, language models) and the design of next-generation generative modeling techniques (see examples below). Latent Zoning Network: A Unified Principle for Generative Modeling, Representation Learning, and Classification (NeurIPS 2025) Distilled Decoding 1: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Flow Matching (ICLR 2025) Distilled Decoding 2: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Conditional Score Distillation (NeurIPS 2025) Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation Can LLMs Learn by Teaching for Better Reasoning? A Preliminary Study (NeurIPS 2024) Our researchers and Research Interns have been conducting influential research published in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR. For more details on our research group and projects, please see: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/group/algorithms-redmond/ For the fullest consideration, please apply by January 1, 2027. Responsibilities Research Interns put inquiry and theory into practice. Alongside fellow doctoral candidates and some of the world’s best researchers, Research Interns learn, collaborate, and network for life. Research Interns not only advance their own careers, but they also contribute to exciting research and development strides. During the 12-week internship, Research Interns are paired with mentors and expected to collaborate with other Research Interns and researchers, present findings, and contribute to the vibrant life of the community. Research internships are available in all areas of research, and are offered year-round, though they typically begin in the summer. Qualifications Required Qualifications Currently enrolled in a master's degree program in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field. Other Requirements Research Interns are expected to be physically located in their manager’s Microsoft worksite location for the duration of their internship. In addition to the qualifications below, you’ll need to submit a minimum of two reference letters for this position as well as a cover letter and any relevant work or research samples. After you submit your application, a request for letters may be sent to your list of references on your behalf. Note that reference letters cannot be requested until after you have submitted your application, and furthermore, that they might not be automatically requested for all candidates. You may wish to alert your letter writers in advance, so they will be ready to submit your letter. Preferred Qualifications Currently enrolled in a Doctorate Degree program in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related STEM field. Publications at top theoretical CS or ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) or top journals. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch. Experience with training large foundation models such as diffusion models, image auto-regressive models, and large language models. jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineer Intern

Today, visual computing plays a central role in how people interact with technology. Our team encourages people with strong interests in computer graphics or improving gameplay with edge inference. jobs.title: Electro Optics Student
jobs.body: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Join our team and explore the opportunities to compose a meaningful global influence. Take part in realizing the next generation of on-chip optical communication platforms for data centers! NVIDIA's electro optics group is looking for a motivated student to join our experimental lab in Yokneam, where we develop, test and characterize Silicon Photonics based high-speed optical communication devices. You will work side by side with experienced electro optics engineers on real projects, from basic component-level measurements up to link-level high-speed characterization and post-silicon testing. What you'll be doing: Assist in the characterization of electro-optical components and subsystems in their development stage. Help build and operate electro-optical experimental setups, from the basic component level to link-level measurements. Support the bring-up of NVIDIA’s next switches and transceivers in their early stages. Work with high-speed testing equipment (scopes, PPG, AWG, BERT) under the guidance of senior engineers. Passion for experimental work and for observing physical phenomena first hand. Strong capability for learning and entering new fields quickly. Good collaborative and interpersonal skills; willingness to take ownership of well-defined tasks. Programming skills in MATLAB or Python. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Hands-on experience in an optics, photonics or electronics lab (academic projects count). Coursework or project experience in photonics, optical communication, RF / high-speed electronics or communication systems. Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, network analyzers or optical power meters. Deep curiosity and a passion for what you do. jobs.title: Architecture Energy Modeling Engineering Intern - 2027
jobs.body: At NVIDIA, we pride ourselves in having energy efficient products. We believe that continuing to maintain our products' energy efficiency compared to the competition is key to our continued success. Our team is responsible for researching, developing, and deploying methodologies to help NVIDIA's products become more energy efficient; and is responsible for building energy models that integrate into architectural simulators, RTL simulation, and emulation platforms. Key responsibilities include developing techniques to model, analyze, and reduce the power consumption of NVIDIA GPUs. As a member of the Power Modeling, Methodology, and Analysis Team, you will collaborate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement energy modeling techniques for NVIDIA's next-generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Your contributions will help us gain early insight into the energy consumption of graphics and artificial intelligence workloads, and will allow us to influence architectural, design, and power management improvements. What you’ll be doing: Work with architects and performance architects to develop an energy-efficient GPU. Develop methodologies and workflows to select and run a wide variety of workloads to train models using ML and/or statistical techniques. Develop methodologies to improve the accuracy of energy models under various constraints, such as, process, timing, floorplan and layout. Correlate the predicted energy from models created at different stages of the design cycle, with the goal of bridging early estimates to silicon. Develop tools to debug energy inefficiencies observed in various workloads run on silicon, RTL and architectural simulators. Work with architects to fix the identified energy inefficiencies. Work with performance, verification and emulation methodology and infrastructure development teams to integrate energy models into their platforms. Prototype new architectural features, create an energy model, and analyze the system impact. What we need to see: Pursuing MS degree Strong coding skills, preferably in Python, C++. Background in machine learning, AI, and/or statistical modeling. Interest in computer architecture and energy-efficient GPU designs. Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles is a plus. Ability to formulate and analyze algorithms, and comment on their runtime and memory complexities. Desire to bring quantitative decision-making and analytics to improve the energy efficiency of our products. Good verbal/written English and interpersonal skills. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. jobs.body: About Pierce, an Oshkosh company At Pierce Manufacturing, we build trucks that protect people and communities around the world. To our team, there is no room for anything less than providing the absolute best. Since 1913, building truck bodies on Model T Ford chassis in an old converted church has evolved to creating highly customized, carefully designed and engineering pumpers, aerials, tankers and rescue units that have no equal.
