jobs.title: HITL Engineering Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a HITL Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Long Beach, CA, you will have the opportunity to support the team with hands-on interaction with real hardware, incomplete specifications, and failures that require structured debugging and engineering judgment. The HITL team is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and operating Hardware In The Loop (HITL) systems and automation tools. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an engineering, physics or math discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship GPA of 3.0 or above 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE GPA of 3.5 or above 6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) Knowledge of Systems Engineering Knowledge of Mechatronics Python Experience ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027 COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS Pay rate CA: $28.00 USD Hourly You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts. Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion. Hourly Pay Range (CA Only) $28 — $28 USD WHAT TO EXPECT We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. Important information: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a Manufacturing Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Middle River, Maryland, you will have the opportunity to support the Manufacturing Team in manufacturing the stages for Neutron. Rocket Lab’s Manufacturing team are the builders and the doers who work with our advanced machinery across our global manufacturing sites to get our satellites, satellite components, and rockets out the door. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. jobs.title: Intern, Engineering (Independent Cart Technology)
jobs.location: Chelmsford, Massachusetts, United States; East Setauket, New York, United States
jobs.body: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description The Commercial Engineering Intern (Independent Cart Technology) will support Rockwell Automation's Independent Cart Technology (ICT) Commercial Engineering team in developing customer solutions, testing and validating system configurations, creating technical documentation, and supporting product demonstrations and training activities. You will have hands-on exposure to advanced linear transport technologies including iTRAK®, MagneMover®, and related motion control platforms used in manufacturing and automation applications. You will work with Commercial Engineers, Application Engineers, Product Specialists, and Technical Support personnel to gain real-world experience in industrial automation and smart manufacturing technologies. Your Responsibilities: Engineering Support: Help with the setup, testing, and validation of ICT systems in laboratory environments. Support engineering evaluations of customer applications and system configurations. Participate in troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities. Help document test results and engineering observations. Documentation and Training: Develop and update technical documentation, application notes, and work instructions. Create training materials, user guides, and presentation content. Support the development of customer-facing demonstrations and proof-of-concept systems. Assist with engineering change documentation and knowledge management activities. Product and Application Development: Support analysis of customer requirements and application data. Assist with system sizing, performance calculations, and solution comparisons. Participate in product validation and technology assessments. Gather and summarize technical data for engineering reports and presentations. Data Analysis and Continuous Improvement: Analyze engineering, testing, and operational data. Identify opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work with Commercial Engineering, Product Management, Technical Support, and Field Service teams. Attend project meetings and contribute engineering insights. Present internship accomplishments to leadership at the conclusion of the internship. The Essentials - You Will Have: Must be pursuing a bachelor's or advanced degree from an accredited college or university Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, electrical engineering, or similar Prior intern or co-op with Rockwell Automation Expected graduation date is December 2027 or beyond Met on campus, national recruiting events, a Rockwell Automation-hosted event or a targeted recruiting campaign Knowledge of automation systems, controls, robotics, or industrial equipment. Familiarity with PLCs, motion control, or industrial networks. Experience with laboratory testing, engineering projects, or technical research. Participation in engineering clubs, robotics teams, or similar extracurricular activities What We Offer: Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision Paid holidays off To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www. raquickfind.com . At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $22-40/hourly. Our benefits for the US can be found here . Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience. #LI-CS1 #LI-DNI #LI-Hybrid We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: 2027 Undergraduate Validation Engineering Internships – Mexico
jobs.body: Join a multibillion-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the #1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible. Solidigm is seeking talented and motivated students for our Validation Engineering Internships in Mexico. This evergreen posting supports multiple internship opportunities focused on electrical and hardware validation, troubleshooting, and testing for Solidigm's data center SSD products. As an intern, you will work on real engineering challenges supporting hardware and electrical validation, test execution, and debug workflows for SSD and storage-related technologies. This internship is ideal for students who enjoy hands-on problem solving, working with hardware and test equipment, and applying troubleshooting and analytical skills to real-world validation challenges. Key Responsibilities Interns may be assigned one or more of the following responsibilities based on project needs, team priorities, and individual strengths: Support validation and testing of SSD hardware, components, and electrical interfaces. Execute test plans, collect data, and troubleshoot issues to verify electrical and functional requirements. Assist with debug and root-cause analysis of hardware or system-level issues. Use lab equipment and test environments to reproduce issues and support validation activities. Work in Linux-based environments to support test execution and data collection. Work closely with cross-functional teams including hardware, firmware, and validation engineering. Create clear documentation for test methods, results, and debug findings. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Returning to school following the internship. Foundational knowledge of electronics, circuits, or hardware systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with Linux-based environments. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a technical team environment. Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn. This role is not eligible for candidates requiring VISA sponsorship. Preferred Qualifications Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, or other test instrumentation. Familiarity with SSDs, storage systems, or electronic/data center hardware. Coursework or project experience in circuit analysis, signal testing, or hardware validation. Exposure to scripting or automation to support data collection or testing. Strong interest in data center storage, electronics, or hardware validation. What You'll Gain As a Solidigm intern, you will have the opportunity to: Work on meaningful projects tied to real data center SSD products and engineering priorities. Gain hands-on experience with hardware validation, electrical testing, and troubleshooting. Collaborate with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams. Develop practical skills in test execution, debugging, and technical communication. Present your work, receive feedback, and contribute to solutions that may influence future products. Grow your professional network through mentorship, team engagement, and intern program activities. Additional Information Work location is Mexico, based on business need and internship assignment. Internship availability and project scope may vary by team, degree level, and business requirements. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. jobs.title: Intern- Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.body: Who we are With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. Intern- Manufacturing Engineer Term: Summer (May-Aug) At Symbotic, early career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment. Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements. Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! What we need Symbotic is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer Intern to join our External Manufacturing team within our Manufacturing organization. Your job will be to support external manufacturing partners and internal engineering teams by helping improve manufacturing processes, prepare products for production, and support manufacturing readiness for our automated systems. This is a cross-functional internship for a student interested in gaining hands-on experience across mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and process engineering. What we do The External Manufacturing team sits within the External Manufacturing organization and partners with external manufacturers and internal engineering teams to support the production of Symbotic's automated solutions. Since manufacturing is performed through external partners, the team works closely with suppliers and cross-functional teams to establish manufacturing processes, support production readiness, manage engineering changes, and help ensure products can be manufactured efficiently and reliably. What you'll do Support senior engineers and external manufacturing partners on manufacturing readiness, production support, and continuous improvement activities. Partner with Engineering and Quality teams to prepare manufacturing readiness documentation, support engineering changes, and help maintain standard manufacturing processes and procedures. Work across mechanical and electrical systems, including reviewing drawings, manufacturing requirements, and production-related technical documentation. Support Design for Manufacturability activities and help identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, quality, efficiency, and scalability. Assist with troubleshooting manufacturing and design challenges and collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify practical solutions. Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including opportunities to use dashboards, data, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve team efficiency. Travel to external manufacturing partner locations as needed to gain hands-on exposure to manufacturing operations and support production activities. What you'll need Currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Academic project, lab, internship, co-op, or other hands-on exposure to manufacturing, automation, prototyping, or engineering processes. Ability to interpret and work with mechanical or electrical engineering documentation, with an interest in developing experience across both disciplines. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with an interest in process improvement and learning how products move from engineering into manufacturing. Interest in using data, dashboards, automation, or emerging tools to improve manufacturing and engineering processes. Our Environment Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ. Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. #LI-KK1 About Symbotic Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com . We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $29.00 - $37.95 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Summer Internship - Plasma Diagnostics
jobs.body: Join us in our mission to commercialize fusion energy ⚡️ About Type One Energy Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. Established in 2019 and venture-backed in 2023, the company is led by a team of globally recognized fusion scientists with a strong track record of building state-of-the-art stellarator fusion machines, together with veteran business leaders experienced in scaling companies and commercializing energy technologies. If you are searching for the best new ideas and share our vision, join us as a Plasma Diagnostics Summer Intern. This is what you need to know: Location: Knoxville, TN Salary: $25-$35/hour, 40 hours per week Contract: 12-week internship, Summer 2027 (May 24th start date) Reporting to: Sr. Diagnostic Scientist Your role in the mission: Type One Energy Group, Inc. is seeking a summer intern in Plasma Diagnostic to apply your education and experience in the design and development of plasma diagnostics for a new fusion energy device. This role requires a self-motivated learner who loves being challenged and gaining new skills. The ideal candidate will have experience in physics, specifically plasma physics and fusion energy, but a broad background including physical laboratory, mathematical/computational, engineering, and software is more important. Key responsibilities could include: Apply physical models and numerical analysis tools to guide the requirements for plasma diagnostics. Collaborate with computational physicists, experimental physicists, and engineers to develop the conceptual design for plasma diagnostics. Develop the data analysis workflow and algorithms to extract physical information from raw instrument data. Build and test physical diagnostic hardware including optical systems and electronic circuits. What you'll need: Senior-level student pursuing a degree in physics, engineering physics, optics, electrical engineering, data science, astrophysics, or a related field. Rising juniors, seniors, graduate, and PhD students are encouraged to apply. Experience with data analysis in python is required. Additional software skills including numerical simulations, optical system design, thermal modeling, electrical schematic/PCB design, SPICE circuit simulation, version control, LINUX, and databases are desirable. Experience with plasma physics, fusion energy, or remote sensing will be a bonus. Hands-on experience working with scientific instruments, microwave/RF systems, optics, lasers, vacuum systems, and/or electronic circuits will be a bonus. Ability to receive guidance, work independently, and contribute to a team. For questions about this position, please reach out to internships@typeoneenergy.com Type One Energy applies proven advanced manufacturing methods, modern computational physics and high-field superconducting magnets to develop its optimized stellarator fusion energy system. Our FusionDirect development program pursues the lowest-risk, shortest-schedule path to a fusion power plant over the coming decade, using a partner-intensive and capital-efficient strategy. Type One Energy is committed to community engagement in the development and deployment of its clean energy technology. For more information, visit www.typeoneenergy.com or follow us on LinkedIn. jobs.title: Technical Support Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. About the Role As a Technical Support Engineering Intern, you won't be grabbing coffee or shadowing others. Our interns are at the forefront of our team, tackling real-world challenges alongside our full-time engineers. Based at our San Mateo HQ, you'll work with cutting-edge, cloud-managed IoT technology, helping our enterprise clients with everything from troubleshooting to system design. This internship is your chance to make a real impact, build valuable technical skills, and jumpstart your career in a dynamic, high-tech environment. What You'll Do Hands-on Troubleshooting: Dive into complex network, hardware, and software problems on Verkada's platform Level Up Fast: Become the go-to expert customers trust for smart system design and integration advice Communicate with Impact: Translate heavy technical concepts into clear, sharp advice on phone calls, live chat, and emails Own It, End to End: Take full ownership of customer issues from "we have a problem" to "problem solved" Team Up with Tech Leaders: Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams to test new gear and hunt down bugs before anyone else Share Knowledge: Write Knowledge Base content that helps thousands of users What You Bring Available for a full-time (40 hours per week) in-person internship for Summer 2027 in San Mateo, CA A third or fourth-year student in a Bachelor's degree program from an accredited university, with a focus on a related technical field like Networking, Telecommunications, Systems Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Cybersecurity You have coursework experience with computer networking, Linux, and computer systems You're a problem-solver with a keen eye for detail You can clearly and confidently communicate complex technical information You thrive in a team environment Industry certifications (like CCNP, CCNA, or Network+) are a bonus, but not required! Intern Perks & Benefits At Verkada, we believe that internships should be as rewarding, supportive, and fun as they are impactful! That’s why we’re committed to providing a world-class experience that supports both your personal well-being and professional growth. Here are just a few of the perks and benefits you can expect as a Verkada Technical Support Engineering intern: Monthly housing stipend for those relocating to the area, in addition to a competitive hourly wage Daily lunch catered onsite, complimentary barista-made drinks, and fully stocked snacks to keep you fueled Intern-exclusive events and mixers, allowing you to connect with other interns across different teams Cross-functional collaboration opportunities, giving you real exposure to how teams work together Meetings with company executives so you can hear directly from leaders and gain insight into building a successful career 333 program: you can go out with your fellow interns after work and expense $30 off a meal Friendly tournaments involving Super Smash Bros, Magic, and other games Intern exclusive bingo cards that allow you to explore the Bay Area and win fun swag! And more! From team-building activities to mentorship opportunities, we’re here to support your growth every step of the way Don't just take it from us, hear directly from some of our current and past interns on their experience: “A benefit of being a TSE at Verkada is about being a part of a fast-growing company. You learn about the latest products deeply and learn how to effectively communicate what you have learned in an easy-to-understand way for customers: ‘If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.’ Albert Einstein” - Daniel, TSE Intern, London “After training (which feels a lot like university lectures) you spend time in queue, which is basically being on-call for the next chat/call/email that comes in. When a customer needs something, whether that’s information about a product, how to set up that product, or that product having a bit of a moment, you are the one who gets to be the source of truth for that person. Being able to communicate this to them in a reasonable amount of time is paramount to doing well in this role” - Tedrick, TSE Intern, HQ “This internship has given me a lot to think about in terms of career goals. I would say in particular this internship is a great way to build your connections for the Silicon Valley area if your goal is to work in the Tech space. It’s also given me a unique perspective and understanding of enterprise equipment. It serves as a great launching point for your career.” - Thomas, TSE Intern, HQ Additional Information We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate’s skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity . This estimate can vary based on the factors described above, so the actual starting base pay may be above or below this range. Base pay is also just one component of Verkada’s total rewards package. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Who We Are Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business. Work Shift 1 - First Shift Job Summary Are you energized by solving problems and improving how things are made? As a Manufacturing Engineer Intern at Vermeer, you’ll support real-world projects that enhance production processes and drive operational excellence. This internship offers hands-on experience in lean manufacturing, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration—preparing you for a full-time engineering role upon graduation. What You’ll Do 1. Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements that enhance quality, efficiency, and sustainability across production areas. 2. Support new product introductions and manufacturing improvement initiatives by collaborating with engineering, welding, assembly, and machining teams. 3. Apply lean manufacturing principles—including Just-In-Time (JIT) production and Kaizen events—to reduce waste and improve flow. 4. Document and analyze current and future state processes using tools such as value stream mapping and standard work documentation. 5. Help design and optimize tooling and fixtures, and gain exposure to digital work instruction platforms. 6. Contribute to documentation and change management using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Engineering Change Notification (ECN) systems such as Teamcenter or Windchill. 7. Participate in data-driven decision-making using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, Power BI dashboards, and Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled process monitoring tools. What We’re Looking For - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or a related field. - Foundational understanding of lean manufacturing concepts, tooling design, and process improvement techniques. - Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic schematics. - Familiarity with JIT manufacturing, statistical process variation, and digital manufacturing tools is a plus. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a growth mindset. - Willingness to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Travel - Occasional travel is expected of this position. Work Location ONSITE: A team member’s day-to-day work is best done on a Vermeer campus. If work content can be occasionally completed at an offsite location, discuss potential arrangements with your manager. jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Research, VLM Harnesses for AV Planning
jobs.body: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! You will: Design and implement scenario preprocessors (e.g., visual rendering, scene representations, and multimodal prompting) to effectively present driving scenarios to state-of-the-art VLMs Develop postprocessors that translate VLM outputs into feasible, safe trajectories for closed-loop vehicle control Evaluate VLM driving harnesses in closed-loop autonomous driving simulation and iterate on representations based on driving metrics Communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences regarding research motivations and research findings Conduct cutting-edge research and potentially communicate research findings to the wider academic community via technical reports and/or publications You have: Currently enrolled in a PhD program in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, physics, or a related technical field of study Familiarity with major ML Frameworks (JAX, Pytorch) Experience using coding agents for auto-research 3+ years of experience with Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative Models (such as VLMs/LLMs) We prefer: Publications at top-tier conferences such as CVPR/ICCV/ECCV/ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS/IROS/CoRL etc. Substantial involvement in and contributions to high impact industry AI projects Experience with Vision-Language Models (VLMs), multimodal prompting/reasoning, or autonomous driving simulation and planning Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in. The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements. Hourly PhD Pay $85 — $85 USD

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering | Systems Engineering internship: strategic utility master plan
jobs.body: Introduction You will join the Process Technology team in Veldhoven, where engineering, data, and long-term infrastructure planning come together. As ASML continues to grow, utility infrastructure must be planned years ahead to support future manufacturing demand. This internship focuses on transforming an existing framework into a practical and scalable planning and decision-support system. Together with another intern, you will help shape the next stage of ASML’s Five-Year Utility Master Plan. This internship offers the opportunity to create lasting impact on future infrastructure, capacity, and investment decisions. Your assignment During this Mechanical Engineering | Systems Engineering internship: strategic utility master plan, you will work as part of a two-person project team to develop a working prototype of ASML’s Five-Year Utility Master Plan. Building on the foundation created by previous interns, you will analyze current infrastructure, evaluate future demand scenarios, and translate insights into clear recommendations. You will collaborate with subject matter experts, challenge assumptions, and help create an evidence-based approach for future planning. Your main responsibilities will be: Translate growth scenarios into future utility demand forecasts Assess current utility infrastructure, performance, and available capacity Identify capacity gaps, constraints, and decision trigger points Develop future infrastructure scenarios and spatial planning concepts Evaluate investment needs, sustainability considerations, and total cost of ownership Enhance and further develop the existing utility dashboard and reporting structure Present data-driven recommendations for future capacity and infrastructure decisions This is a master’s internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027. Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are pursuing a master’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, industrial engineering, data science, or a related technical field Experience with Python, Power BI and other similar tools Have strong analytical skills and enjoy solving complex, open-ended challenges Demonstrate proactive behavior and take ownership of your work Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and work collaboratively in a team environment Can translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and actions. This internship is particularly suited to students who enjoy combining engineering, data analysis, scenario planning, and business decision-making. You will work closely with another intern throughout the project, making teamwork, stakeholder communication, and collaboration essential for success. Through this internship, you will contribute to a scalable planning approach that helps ASML anticipate future utility infrastructure needs rather than react to them. Your work will support informed decisions on capacity, space reservations, technology choices, and future investments. Other requirements you need to meet: You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. Inclusion and diversity ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Detailed description of the mission Reporting to the Spares Engineering Support team within the Customer Support Department, you will join a dynamic and welcoming team of passionate engineers and technicians, recognized for their expertise and commitment. As part of this project, you will be responsible for collecting, structuring, and classifying standard parts data related to technical inquiries raised by both internal customers (Procurement, Supply Chain, Inventory Management, etc.) and external customers (Aircraft Operators). jobs.title: Welding Engineer Intern
jobs.body: > At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. H eadquartered in Lynchburg, Va., BWXT provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for national security, clean energy, environmental remediation, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With approximately 7,400 employees, BWXT has 12 major operating sites in the U.S. and Canada. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental remediation and nuclear operations management at more than a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. Follow us on Twitter at @BWXTech and learn more at www.bwxt.com . BWXT is currently seeking a Welding Engineering Intern for its Barberton, Ohio facility. We are looking for motivated college students to join our highly-skilled team of engineers for an exciting summer internship in Barberton, Ohio. At BWXT, our interns perform challenging tasks in their field of study while developing and delivering unique solutions for use in a nuclear environment. Our interns work collaboratively as part of our manufacturing and operational teams and will tackle various projects and tasks relating directly to fabrication and engineering challenges. A BWXT internship not only provides valuable on the job training but allows you to be a part of something bigger! jobs.body: Job Title: Production Planning Intern Job Description: Production Planning Intern - Summer 2027 Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Danbury, CT is seeking a Production Planning Intern to join our team for the Summer 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 12-14 weeks in duration. We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Production Planning Intern to join our Supply Chain team. This role provides hands-on experience supporting production planning, inventory management, scheduling, and data analysis in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. The intern will work closely with Production Planning, Operations, Procurement, Engineering, Logistics, and Quality to help improve planning visibility and execution. The internship is designed to build practical experience with ERP systems, supply chain analytics, manufacturing operations, and continuous improvement while contributing to a meaningful business project. Monitor inventory, planned orders, production orders, and work order status to identify potential supply risks. Analyze planning and manufacturing data and prepare reports that support timely business decisions. Support SAP ERP and master data maintenance, including MRP parameters, lead times, lot sizes, and planning settings. Participate in daily and weekly planning meetings, document action items, and track follow-up activities. Collaborate with Operations, Procurement, Engineering, Logistics, and Quality to address material and scheduling issues. Support capacity planning, schedule adherence analysis, and root-cause reviews for performance gaps. Use Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to improve dashboards, metrics, and reporting visibility. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, data accuracy, and manual workflows. Complete and present an internship project with findings and recommendations to Supply Chain and Operations leadership. What We Seek: Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills. jobs.body: We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us? At Generac, we are accelerating the transformation of the electric grid through advanced microgrid technologies, distributed energy resources (DERs), and intelligent control systems. We are seeking a highly motivated Microgrid Controls Engineering Intern to join our Industrial Microgrid Controls Team in Fort Collins, Colorado for the summer of 2027. This position offers a unique opportunity to apply advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence, and power systems engineering to improve the performance, reliability, and operation of real-world microgrid deployments. Working alongside experienced controls, software, and power systems engineers, you will analyze operational data from fielded systems, identify performance improvement opportunities, develop predictive insights, validate next-generation control strategies through Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, and contribute to the future of intelligent energy systems. Unlike traditional engineering internships, this role provides direct exposure to operational microgrid assets and customer applications, where your work may directly influence future products, system architectures, and customer outcomes. Major Responsibilities Data Analytics & System Intelligence Analyze large data sets from deployed microgrid, energy storage, and distributed energy resource systems to identify trends, anomalies, reliability concerns, and optimization opportunities. Transform this operational data into actionable engineering recommendations. Develop advanced analytics, dashboards, and visualization tools to improve customer value, operational performance, and fleet-wide system insights. Infer from the above analysis what statistical, machine learning, and AI-based approaches may support predictive maintenance, fault detection, and root cause analysis efforts going forward. Next-Generation Controls Validation Design and conduct off-nominal, fault, and edge-case testing scenarios to evaluate system robustness and reliability through model in the loop (MIL) and hardware in the loop (HIL) setups. Support verification and validation efforts for advanced microgrid control architectures. AI & Engineering Productivity Develop AI agents and automation tools to enhance sales applications engineering, technical support, and internal engineering workflows. Investigate emerging AI technologies and their application to power systems, controls engineering, and customer support. Systems Engineering & Innovation Support development of engineering standards, analytics processes, and best practices. Engage with Generac's academic and national laboratory partners to investigate emerging technologies and evolving industry challenges. undefined Minimum Requirements Education Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer, Energy Systems Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math or related technical discipline. Strong interest in data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or large-scale technical data analysis . Ability to clean, analyze, visualize, and interpret complex data sets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. “We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”

jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Intern (May-Dec 2027)
jobs.body: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com . Internship Program Overview: Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. Summary of Role: GlobalFoundries Singapore is seeking curious, motivated Process & Equipment Engineering interns to join our wafer fabrication operations. Every chip starts as a bare silicon substrate and moves through hundreds of precisely controlled steps — as an intern, you will work alongside an assigned engineer to help monitor those critical steps, catch abnormalities early, and drive improvements that protect wafer quality and yield. Essential Responsibilities & Project may include: In your role as an Engineering Intern, you will be paired with an assigned Engineer to: Support equipment preventive maintenance — execute scheduled maintenance and troubleshooting on time in support of production, protecting uptime, quality and cost Assist with tool installation, modification and hardware repair to improve capacity, throughput and overall tool efficiency Reduce variability in process recovery procedures and standardize processes across equipment Review, analyze and respond to inline process control charts to meet quality, cost and productivity goals Improve early problem detection, including enhancements to limits of detection (LOD), and strengthen process performance measurement techniques Execute actions to optimize production moves, qualify new processes, and reduce the cost of chemicals and/or qualification wafers Participate in quality improvement and cross-functional team projects, offering constant feedback on areas of improvement Lead an improvement project end-to-end and present your results What You’ll Gain: Hands-on exposure at a semiconductor manufacturing company, shadowing experts and supporting real production work A working understanding of the wafer fabrication process and your assigned process module Roundtable sessions with local leadership and cross-department networking opportunities A capstone presentation at the end of the internship covering your project results, learnings and recommendations for improvement Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications: Education – Actively pursuing a Bachelors degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. Must be in good academic standing. Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship. Available for a 16–24 week credit-bearing internship commencing Jun/Jul 2027. Preferred Qualifications: Prior related internship or co-op experience Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. An inquisitive mindset and a positive, proactive learning attitude *Please indicate your internship period clearly in your CV / resume / cover letter* #InternshipProgramSGP #InternshipProgram GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. What You Will Do at Graco Provide general production support for machining and/or assembly areas by participating in hands-on troubleshooting issues and providing technical assistance Assist in evaluating the need for machine and/or assembly area upgrades Participate in capital equipment justification as needed Review and analyze standards and operational layouts to suggest improvements Assist in the selection and implementation of tooling and fixtures for machining and/or assembly jobs Participate in cost of quality improvements, root cause analysis and corrective action React to changing priorities in a timely manner Report man-hour estimates What You Will Bring to Graco Currently enrolled and pursing a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering or comparable Engineering program Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills Ability to work independently and as an effective team member Mechanical aptitude and desire for hands on work Accelerators Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD Experience with 3D printers Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H-1B, TN, F-1 OPT). At Graco, you truly make a difference. Your unique talents contribute to our organizational growth and future. Not only do you make a difference, but Graco’s culture empowers employees to create their own career path. Whether you choose to advance within your current department or explore new opportunities in different divisions, you have the ability to build your future. Our managers are here to provide support and guidance as you continue to grow within your career. Graco has excellent opportunities available to individuals who want to be part of a fast-moving, growing company that is committed to quality, innovation and solving fluid handling problems for our customers. Graco is proud to be named a Best Place to Work by Fortune Magazine in 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021 & 2022. Graco offers attractive compensation, benefits and career development opportunities. Graco’s comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, stock purchase plan, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and more. Our company uses E-Verify to confirm the employment and eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify . jobs.title: Technical Intern (R&D)
jobs.body: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Responsibilities: Support novel laser optical design and setting up state-of-the-art test stations in cleanroom Develop SW for automatic testing and processing Data collection and analysis Support engineering and production, and write report Requirements: Pursuing a bachelor's degree from a recognized university Available from Jan-May/June 2027 (preferably semester Intern, commitment of 5 to 6 months) Track record of outstanding academic performance Willingness to learn attitude and interest in technology Strong knowledge or skills in optics and photonics, physics and programming languages (LabVIEW, MatLab, Python, machine learning, etc.), or good at data interpretation and matrix mathematics would be an advantage Strong hands-on experience, and analytical and problem-solving skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills Flexibility and willingness to work on different tasks if required Minimum Qualifications Requires less than 1 year of related experience About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of AI Statement At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Complex Warheads: Lethality Engineer - Undergraduate Placement  2027
jobs.body: Complex Warheads: Lethality Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027 Are you interested in modelling the lethal performance of MBDA's Complex Weapon Systems? We are seeking an undergraduate to join our niche group of engineers, enabling MBDA to provide world leading defence capabilities for our home Nations and Allies. Salary : £25,420 Dynamic working : To introduce you to the business and the role you’ll play we aim for 3-4+ days on site to begin with, and as you gain confidence and experience we will seek to accommodate a blended approach to on-site and remote working. If preferential, full time on site working is also an option. Security clearance : British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes. What we can offer you: 1 year placement: starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies Company bonus : based on company performance and will vary year to year Pension : maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14% Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday Flexi Leave: up to 15 additional days Facilities : fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more. Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more. The opportunity: The Complex Warheads Centre of Excellence is a coordinated team situated across sites in Stevenage, Bolton and Paris and their role is to: Act as the company’s design authority for warheads. Predict the lethal performance of various types of missile systems. Provide knowledge in the skill areas of warheads, explosives, target detection and weapon lethality. The Lethality team in Stevenage primarily undertakes modelling of the missile terminal engagement, the target detection, warhead detonation and lethal performance prediction. This is an outstanding opportunity to learn from a niche group of engineers with mixed expertise, involved in assessing the lethal performance of various missile systems. The skills we utilise are not typical in academia and so joining the team presents an opportunity for you to develop knowledge in numerous aspects of missile lethality that you would not develop anywhere else! With support and mentorship from the team’s Engineers, you'll be involved in applying a custom set of modelling tools to evaluate and investigate the lethal performance of developing and future missile systems against a range of targets. Our in-house tools are principally fast running evaluation models written in MATLAB; however, other tools ranging from CAD design software to complex finite element style hydrocodes see occasional use. This placement will build your knowledge and enable you to apply an understanding of fuzing techniques, warhead technologies, lethal effects and lethality assessment modelling methods to various types of missile systems in development by MBDA. You will be encouraged to work on your own or in a small team, with some supervision, as required, on short tasks (typically a few weeks to a few months in duration). Some projects may include collaboration with other MBDA departments around Europe. What we’re looking for from you: Current undergraduate studying for a degree in an Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computing or Applied Science discipline. Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more. We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

jobs.title: Test Solutions Engineering Intern - Bachelor's Degree
jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact Test Solutions Engineering (TSE) plays a central role at Marvell, ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our Custom silicon products. This role requires deep technical ownership from early in the design process through high-volume manufacturing (HVM) readiness — developing ATE (Automated Test Equipment) production test solutions that ensure our products meet the exacting standards of our hyperscaler customers. What You Can Expect Develop ATE (Automated Test Equipment) Test Solutions : Own test architecture and bring‑up activities - creating detailed test plans, define experiments, and performing in-depth analyses to validate the yield, performance, and reliability of custom products. Ensure Quality and Performance : Develop test screening methods based on product application conditions, IP capabilities, design timing margins, and process technology specifications — all optimized for test time efficiency. Continuously refine these solutions through extensive ATE characterization and customer system feedback. Identify and Address Faults : Utilize a product’s DFT (Design for Test) solution to explore and bound the operating space, characterize silicon variations, and drive failure root-cause analysis. Establish robust test margins to protect product yields and improve quality. Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with design teams and customers to define DFT requirements and test strategy. Work closely with customers, design, DFT, operations, and reliability teams to ensure test solutions meet coverage, quality, and schedule requirements throughout the product lifecycle. What We're Looking For Preferred Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a track record of driving root-cause analysis and engineering decisions under ambiguity. Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python, Perl, or R within a Linux environment; experience applying AI and machine learning tools to accelerate data analysis, test optimization, or yield learning. Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact The Engineering Applications team in Marvell IT builds and runs the platforms Marvell's engineers use every day — DevOps and CI/CD infrastructure, custom engineering applications, and the AI layer that ties them together. We build and operate Marvell's governed AI platform, which answers questions and takes action across multiple engineering systems, and an agentic SDLC platform that carries a feature from requirements through to deployment with humans approving every decision. Day to day we design, build, deploy and support these services on AWS with modern CI/CD, and we partner directly with engineering teams to replace manual, multi-tool handoffs with automated, governed workflows. As an intern on this team you will ship production software that engineers across Marvell use — applying agentic AI to the real software development lifecycle, not a sandbox. What You Can Expect Build and ship one feature end-to-end on our agentic AI platform for the software development lifecycle, from design through production deployment. Develop integrations and MCP-based tooling that connect AI agents to real engineering systems such as Jira, GitHub, Jenkins, Confluence and AWS. Automate build, test and deployment workflows using CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and containerized deployments on Kubernetes/EKS. Write and review code alongside senior engineers using AI-assisted development tools including Cursor and Claude Code, held to the team's normal quality and review standards. Instrument and measure the impact of what you build — adoption, performance and engineering time saved — and present the results back to the team. Collaborate with engineers, program managers and IT partners to scope the project, gather requirements and pilot the feature with real users. What We're Looking For Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028 Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, C#, Java or TypeScript/JavaScript, with the ability to write and debug production-quality code. Working knowledge of Linux and Git-based version control, including branching, pull requests and code review workflows. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar) and with containerization using Docker or Kubernetes. Hands-on exposure to LLM or agentic AI development — prompt design, model APIs/SDKs, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or Copilot. Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem to a working result independently, communicate progress clearly and present technical outcomes to an audience. Preferred: Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, or multi-agent workflow design. Preferred: Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL or PostgreSQL) and with front-end frameworks such as React. Expected Base Pay Range (USD) 27 - 54, $ per hour. jobs.title: Intern - HVM Area Manufacturing Engineer (AME)
jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The high-volume manufacturing engineering team plays a key role in keeping Micron’s wafer fabs running safely, efficiently, and at scale. We work at the center of manufacturing execution, balancing capacity, risk, and performance to support both development and high-volume production goals. If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges in a fast-paced environment, this is the place to make an impact! As an intern in the Area Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team, you will focus on strengthening area industrial engineering performance by reducing operational risk and building stable, predictable capacity. Working closely with Manufacturing, Process Development, Industrial Engineering, and Operations, you will lead improving cycle time, throughput, and redundancy while supporting ambitious program timelines. This focus directly influences fab performance and development success. Responsibilities Identify and resolve systemic area issues affecting throughput, cycle time, capacity, and operational risk, including supporting capacity planning and modeling. Analyze operational data and performance metrics to identify trends, assess risks, recommend improvement opportunities, and inform capital and capacity decisions. Partner with Industrial Engineering, Process Development, Manufacturing, and Operations to evaluate capacity scenarios, develop mitigation plans, and drive cross-functional projects. Lead and support strategic meetings and capacity-management activities, clearly communicating performance, risks, priorities, and recommended actions to stakeholders. Support safety and quality initiatives, including audits, good catches, and human QDR follow-up. Experience using Tableau or comparable visualization tools to analyze data and communicate trends and results. Experience using Generative AI tools to support data analysis, problem-solving, engineering productivity, or technical communication. Demonstrated ability through academic, project, or work experience to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience applying industrial engineering methods to capacity planning, cycle-time improvement, throughput optimization, operational risk reduction, or manufacturing systems. Experience analyzing semiconductor manufacturing, high-volume manufacturing, or other complex operational datasets. Experience developing data-driven capacity scenarios, risk assessments, dashboards, or recommendations using SQL, Python, Tableau, or Generative AI . Demonstrated leadership experience through academic projects, internships, research, student organizations, or other team-based activities.
