jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Co-op (May - December 2027)
jobs.body: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. Job Purpose: To support the Strategic Business Unit and the Manufacturing Cell and apply coursework to real-world applications as a Manufacturing Engineer Intern. Position involves providing ideas, inputs and analysis as a project team member. What You Will Do at Graco Provide general production support for machining and/or assembly areas by participating in hands-on troubleshooting issues and providing technical assistance Assist in evaluating the need for machine and/or assembly area upgrades Participate in capital equipment justification as needed Review and analyze standards and operational layouts to suggest improvements Assist in the selection and implementation of tooling and fixtures for machining and/or assembly jobs Participate in cost of quality improvements, root cause analysis and corrective action React to changing priorities in a timely manner Report man-hour estimates What You Will Bring to Graco Currently enrolled and pursing a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering or comparable Engineering program Minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills Ability to work independently and as an effective team member Mechanical aptitude and desire for hands on work Accelerators Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD Experience with 3D printers Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H-1B, TN, F-1 OPT). At Graco, you truly make a difference. Your unique talents contribute to our organizational growth and future. Not only do you make a difference, but Graco’s culture empowers employees to create their own career path. Whether you choose to advance within your current department or explore new opportunities in different divisions, you have the ability to build your future. Our managers are here to provide support and guidance as you continue to grow within your career. Graco has excellent opportunities available to individuals who want to be part of a fast-moving, growing company that is committed to quality, innovation and solving fluid handling problems for our customers. Graco is proud to be named a Best Place to Work by Fortune Magazine in 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021 & 2022. Graco offers attractive compensation, benefits and career development opportunities. Graco’s comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, stock purchase plan, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and more. Our company uses E-Verify to confirm the employment and eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify . The base pay range for this position is listed below, exclusive of fringe benefits or other compensation. If you are hired, your final base hourly rate will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, competencies, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we will also consider internal equity of our current employees. Please keep in mind that the range provided is the full base salary range for the role. Hiring at or near the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. $21.00 - $28.00

jobs.body: As part of the team, you’ll have opportunities to: Design and prototype customer-support experiences across web, chat, conversational, and AI-assisted interfaces. jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) is part of the Corporate Quality & Reliability organization and is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and continuity of supplied materials and services. The SQE team works closely with wafer foundries, OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) providers, and EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) partners to deliver high-quality products that meet customers and business expectations. In collaboration with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, SQE drives excellence across the following key areas: 1. Supply Assurance – Ensuring a stable and reliable supply chain through proactive quality oversight and risk management. 2. Compliance – Maintaining adherence to regulatory, customer, industry, and corporate quality requirements. 3. Risk Assessment & Mitigation – Identifying, evaluating, and mitigating potential quality, reliability, and supply chain risks. 4. Material Disposition – Managing nonconforming material assessments and disposition decisions to protect product quality and customer satisfaction. 5. Continuous Improvement – Driving supplier quality improvements, process optimization, and operational excellence through data-driven initiatives and collaboration. This partnership-oriented approach enables SQE to safeguard product quality, strengthen supplier performance, and support business growth. What You Can Expect Successful candidate will have opportunities in: Expose to supplier quality management activities. Participate in process and quality audits at supplier manufacturing sites. Manage manufacturing non-conformance events including containment actions, material disposition, drive corrective and improvement actions. Acquire auditing skills such as VDA 6.3 and 8D problem solving methodology Support Safe Launch activities for new product introductions (NPI) to ensure quality during production ramp. Learn and Manage Change Control. Work on continuous improvement projects. As an intern, you'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. jobs.title: Applied Research Intern, Robotics - 2027
jobs.body: As a research intern on the embodied AI projects, you will help build the advanced robotic policies with humanoid robots for the challenging clinical environment scenes — enabling sim-first development, real-world deployment, and continuous learning to make them smarter over time. The ideal candidate will have strong research skills for robotics. What You Will Be Doing: Bring the latest advancements in embodied AI to simulated and real humanoid robots, successfully apply research in the challenging clinical environment scenes. Upstream research results — into Isaac for Healthcare where they are clinical, and into Isaac and GR00T where they generalize. Build sim-first robot policies with SimReady digital twin and minimize the sim2real gap. Collaborate across team boundaries to integrate NVIDIA robotics products such as Jetson Thor, Isaac GR00T, Cosmos, and Isaac Sim/Lab into the research work. Take on a variety of challenges, solve practical research topics. Deploy and test the developed software on real humanoid robots. What we need to see: Master's degree or above in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Skilled at robotic policy development workflow, from lab to launch: teleoperation, synthetic data generation, domain randomization, VLA and RL post-training, sim2real transfer, deployment with edge AI platforms. Familiar with the latest research work in VLA and RL algorithms. Proficiency in Python, PyTorch. Willingness to learn new languages and robot SDK tools as needed. Ability to adapt to fast-paced development lifecycles, multi-functional organizations, new technologies and platforms. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to determine the best approach to complex challenges. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to working effectively with diverse teams. Ways to Stand out from The Crowd: Familiarity with the latest embodied AI research work. Experience with VLA / Reinforcement Learning. Experience with humanoid robots. Familiarity with NVIDIA robotics products such as Jetson, Isaac GR00T, Cosmos, and Isaac Sim/Lab.

jobs.title: Intern, Manufacturing Project Lead
jobs.body: Let’s talk about the Team The Manufacturing Project Lead (MPL) team works across Product Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and other functions to support the successful introduction of new products into manufacturing. Our role is highly collaborative. We help bring the right people together, keep manufacturing activities moving, identify and communicate risks, and support teams in preparing for key project milestones and product launch. As an MPL Intern, you’ll get exposure to how new products move from development into manufacturing and learn how different teams work together to deliver a project. Let’s talk about the Role As an MPL Intern, you will work alongside experienced Manufacturing Project Leads and support the coordination and delivery of New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. This internship is an opportunity to develop practical project management and stakeholder engagement skills in a real manufacturing environment. You’ll attend cross-functional project meetings, help track actions and timelines, support project documentation and learn how manufacturing risks and readiness are managed throughout a project. You won’t be expected to know everything from day one. We’re looking for someone who is curious, organised, comfortable working with different people and willing to ask questions and learn. Let’s talk about Responsibilities As part of the MPL team, you may: Support Manufacturing Project Leads with day-to-day project coordination and follow-up. Participate in cross-functional project meetings and help capture actions, decisions and key updates. Help maintain project plans, action trackers, risks and other project information. Follow up with team members on agreed actions and help keep activities moving. Support the preparation of project updates, presentations and documentation. Work with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Development and other teams. Assist with manufacturing readiness and NPI activities under the guidance of an experienced MPL. Support smaller, defined pieces of project work as your knowledge and confidence develop. Learn how project risks, timelines, priorities and changes are managed in a regulated manufacturing environment. Contribute ideas and look for opportunities to improve the way the team works. Let’s talk about Qualifications and Experience To apply as a student intern: You should be studying towards a relevant university degree, such as Engineering, Science, Business, Project Management or a related discipline. You enjoy working with people and are comfortable communicating with different teams. You are organised and able to keep track of multiple actions and priorities. You are curious and willing to ask questions when you don’t understand something. You are comfortable learning in an environment where things can change and not every answer is immediately known. You are a team player who is willing to contribute, try new things and learn from mistakes. You can communicate clearly in both written and verbal formats. Previous manufacturing or project management experience is not required — this internship is an opportunity to learn. Working with us is not just an opportunity to help millions of people live healthier, higher-quality lives. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and gain first-hand experience in how new products are brought into manufacturing. So join us and help us shape the future! *Do note that the internship will commence on 11 January 2027 and it will last for 20 weeks. #LI-APAC Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Undergraduate Placement Year 2027 – Government Industry & Standards Intern
jobs.body: We’re the nation’s favourite heating brand, here to warm up people’s homes, lives, and futures. From boilers, hybrids and heat pumps to solar thermal and smart controls, we’re giving our customers plenty of choice. With cutting-edge tech and research, we’re right in the thick of the drive for a better future of home heating. It’s not all tools and tech. People are the real heart of our company. We connect with our customers to deliver genuinely helpful support, and we care about our employees and give them enriching careers. We work hard, we work together, and we work with a cause – delivering brilliant customer support and exceptional engineering. As an organisation of more than 1,600 employees, we also take our role in the communities we serve seriously. From giving away free heating systems for community spaces, to our charity, education, and volunteer work – we’re no strangers to rolling our sleeves up, getting stuck in, and helping out. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, we’d love to meet you. Come and work #LikeABosch at Worcester Bosch. Join us for your placement year in summer 2027! Our internships are designed to give you an insight into what it's like to work for a world-renowned brand with a culture of support and community. OVERVIEW OF THE DEPARTMENT The Government, Industry bodies and Standards Department primary purpose is to protect Worcester Bosch from being disadvantaged in the marketplace from proposed short, medium, or long-term changes in product related regulations. We work alongside internal departments on proposed changes in regulations and/or standards which would influence the design and direction that future appliances and technologies. We coordinate and lobby responses to European Law, UK Law, Voluntary standards such as Codes of Practice on UK Building Regulations, Standards for Product Design, and Installation Standards which relate to products sold by Worcester Bosch. The department represents the interests of Worcester Bosch on industry bodies concerning regulations, standards for Product Design, Installation & Training and Codes of Practice by: Preventing unfavourable political and legal conditions for the industry Fair performance comparison between technologies and products Clear and concise regulations and standards Sustained incentives to promote the market Contributing to the Carbon Reduction, Sustainability & Material Efficiency targets Aiming to be the “Authoritative Voice in the industry” built on a firm foundation from the Bosch Values of responsibility, openness, trust, fairness, reliability, credibility, and legality. In this role, you will be responsible for: You will assist the Head of Government Regulations, Industry Bodies & Standards and team in protecting Worcester Bosch products from being disadvantaged in the marketplace by forthcoming changes in legislation or standards. By reporting to internal departments on new or proposed changes in both regulations and standards which would influence the design and direction that future appliances and technologies should take. Role Responsibilities during the 13-month placement: Researching, processing and recording proposed changes to product related standards and legislation to assist the Head of Government Regulations, Industry Bodies & Standards. Communicating proposed changes in product related standards and legislation to a cross-functional team of experts (both internal and external). Taking a proactive part in departmental briefing / meetings with a range of audiences in the business. Providing feedback on proposed product related standards and legislation changes to external parties such as Trade Associations, Standards Committees and Government Departments. Tracking the progress of changes to standards legislation. Task ownership of the Early Warning database which includes tracking, providing training and updating about proposed changes in product related standards and legislation. Administrative support to the Head of Government Regulations, Industry Bodies & Standards. Interested? Upload your CV and a Cover Letter today Please note that to be eligible for this role, you must be an undergraduate student seeking a placement year as part of your degree - if you do not meet these criteria please consider applying for other positions. Our ideal candidate must have: Good administrative and organisational skills. Excellent communication and analytical skills. Self-motivated and enthusiastic. Comfortable to work without immediate supervision during periods of absence of Manager. Computer Literacy; good understanding of Excel and power point. Studying a degree from one of many disciplines is generally accepted. jobs.body: The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes. We combine engineering excellence and automation expertise to improve safety and efficiency in airbag development. We are looking for a passionate intern to support our Calibration Automation and AI Tool Calibration Tool. You will work at the intersection of software automation engineering, AI/ML, and calibration engineering. Key Responsibilities 1. Automation Tool Development Develop and enhance Python-based tools to support calibration workflow (data processing, batch automation, reporting, visualization, etc.). Maintain existing calibration utilities (GUI tools, batch job tools, file parsers). Implement process improvements to reduce manual process Make documentation, user guides, and best practices for tool usage. 2. Tool Maintenance & Enhancement (Boosting Model) You will directly support the existing AI Calibration Quality Tool, which uses a Boosting-based ML model to detect abnormal airbag sensor signals Maintain and update the Python AI tool used for signal anomaly detection. Improve feature extraction logic for sensor and crash signals. Analyze false positives/false negatives and propose model refinements. Retrain the Boosting model with new datasets under engineer supervision. Implement automatic reporting of detected anomalies for calibration engineers. Integrate the AI module with existing calibration automation tools. Ensure tool stability, accuracy, and performance. 3. Calibration Engineering Support Process and prepare crash test data from vehicle/lab tests. Undergraduate students in Computer Science, IT, Electrical/Automotive Engineering, or related field. Strong Python, C\C++ programming skills. Official university recommendation letter with stamp (mandatory) Commitment: full-time or at least 4 days/week, duration 6 months Basic knowledge of: Machine Learning fundamentals Signal processing concepts Data structures & algorithms Logical thinking, curiosity, and willingness to learn automotive systems. Good English communication and teamwork skills. Nice to Have Experience with Boosting models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost). Familiarity with sensor data, time-series, or anomaly detection. Basic understanding of MATLAB/Simulink. GUI development experience (Tkinter, PyQt, PySimpleGUI). Experience with data automation / scripting / tool development. Knowledge of vehicle dynamics or physics. Monthly Internship allowance + Meal & Parking allowance 1 day of paid leave per month Good benefits of Trade Union activities, team building and company trip. Opportunity to work in global projects of fast developing company and being a part of innovation team contributing initiative ideas to the hi-tech world. Engage in our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professional skills

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Industrial Hygienist & Ergonomist Intern
jobs.body: The future of aerospace and defense starts here. Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands. Position Summary The Industrial Hygienist & Ergonomist intern will work closely with the environmental, health, and safety team by identifying, evaluating, and controlling workplace health and comfort risks, with a focus on chemical, physical, and biological exposures as well as ergonomic risk factors for new processes associated with the Galeton expansion project. This role partners with operations, facilities, HR, and safety teams to develop and implement programs that prevent occupational illness and injury, improve employee well ‑ being, and support regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Industrial Hygiene Conduct qualitative and quantitative exposure assessments for chemical, physical (noise, radiation, temperature), and biological hazards in production, laboratory, office, and field environments. Develop and execute industrial hygiene sampling plans using appropriate equipment (e.g., air sampling pumps, dosimeters, direct ‑ reading instruments). Analyze sampling data, interpret results against regulatory and consensus standards (e.g., OSHA PELs, ACGIH TLVs), and recommend control measures. Recommend engineering, administrative, and personal protective equipment (PPE) controls to reduce exposures. Maintain industrial hygiene records, reports, sampling logs, and calibration documentation. Support development and review of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) usage, chemical inventories, and hazard communication programs. Develop and deliver training related to industrial hygiene topics (e.g., respiratory protection, noise/hearing conservation, chemical hygiene). Ergonomics Conduct ergonomic assessments for manufacturing workstations, material handling tasks, laboratory setups, office environments, and remote workstations. Identify ergonomic risk factors (e.g., force, repetition, awkward postures, contact stress, vibration) using recognized assessment tools and methods. Recommend and help implement ergonomic design improvements, equipment, tools, and work practice changes. Collaborate with engineering and operations on the design and review of new processes, workstations, and tools to ensure ergonomic principles are integrated upfront. Support job task analysis and physical demand descriptions. Develop and deliver ergonomic training and awareness programs for employees and supervisors. Program Management & Collaboration Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of comprehensive Industrial Hygiene and Ergonomics programs. Work cross ‑ functionally with EHS, Operations, Engineering, Facilities, HR, and Occupational Health to align health and ergonomics initiatives with business objectives. Prepare clear, data ‑ driven reports and presentations for leadership, documenting findings, risk levels, and recommended actions. Qualifications Education Perusing a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Hygiene, Occupational Health & Safety, Ergonomics, Environmental Health, Safety Engineering, or related field required. Technical Skills Knowledge of OSHA, NIOSH, ACGIH, ANSI and other applicable occupational health and safety standards. Ability to analyze data, interpret exposure results, and communicate risk clearly. Competent with standard office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and EHS management systems. Competencies Strong analytical and problem ‑ solving skills with a practical, solutions ‑ oriented mindset. Ability to influence and collaborate at all levels of the organization. jobs.title: Statistical method | Internship: Bayesian methods for system-level qualification
jobs.body: Introduction Within ASML, you will join a team focused on solving complex business challenges through data-driven insights and quantitative analysis. The team supports decision-making by transforming data into actionable recommendations that improve processes and performance. During this internship, you will contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced statistical and mathematical models that help address real business questions. You will work together with experienced professionals in an innovative and international environment while applying your academic knowledge to real-world challenges. This internship offers an excellent opportunity to develop your analytical skills and create meaningful impact. Your assignment In this internship, you will support the team in analyzing complex datasets and developing quantitative models to improve decision-making. You will investigate statistical relationships, evaluate model performance, and translate findings into practical recommendations. The core of this assignment is to develop a proof of concept for applying Bayesian statistics to system-level overlay qualification and determine whether the approach provides sufficient practical benefit for use in our daily engineering work. The internship provides an opportunity to apply advanced analytical techniques while working on business-relevant challenges. Your main responsibilities will be: Familiarize yourself with overlay measurement data, performance metrics, machine populations, and current pre/post-change analysis practices; Develop and validate a proof-of-concept Bayesian statistical model for system-level overlay qualification. Evaluate the proposed approach using real measurement data, simulated data, or a combination of both; Compare the proposed methodology with current methods and translate the results into clear guidance for engineering decisions; Adequately document the underlying statistical methodology and provide recommendations for future use and developments; Implement and deliver validated tooling, which must work on multiple representative overlay datasets, to be selected during the assignment, rather than being optimized for one specific case. Develop the tooling in MATLAB, or provide MATLAB bindings if a different implementation is supported by sufficient technical justification This is a master internship for 6 months, 5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027. Your Profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are pursuing a master's degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics, Data Science, or another closely related quantitative field. Have experience with Python, R, C/C++, Julia, Rust or MATLAB and applying statistical modelling techniques. Have knowledge of mathematical modelling and quantitative analysis methods. Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable communicating in English. Working at ASML means contributing to technology that enables innovation across industries worldwide. During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience, collaborate with diverse teams, and further develop your technical and professional skills. Other requirements you need to meet: You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship; You are located in the Netherlands for the duration of your internship. If you currently live or study outside the Netherlands, your CV or motivation letter must state your willingness to relocate; If you are a non-EU citizen studying in the Netherlands, your university must be willing to sign the documents required for the internship (i.e., the Nuffic agreement). This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. Inclusion and diversity ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

jobs.title: ATR - Internship 2027 - Impact of input errors on takeoff performance and prototyping of an algorithm for detection
jobs.body: Job Description: Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Blagnac In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship. What we will do together: Being an apprentice at ATR means being integrated into a team as a full member with a real scope of intervention and responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills and experience within a market leading company! Detailed description of the mission The flight physics “Aircraft performance and weight” department is in charge of, among other things, the generation of performance data (low and high speed) for all ATR aircrafts. In the context of the TOPAAS project (Take-Off Performance Awareness and Alerting System), ATR is developing a system to reinforce take-off operations safety. This work is done in the frame of the future EASA regulation about take-off performance events prevention and implementation of TOPMS (Take-Off Performance Monitoring System)-like functionalities. This internship objective is to analyze the impact of the main input errors on take-off performance and to deduce an algorithm able to anticipate these errors. The internship will take place in 2 big steps: 1. Study of input errors impacts on take-off performance At first, the intern will perform an analysis of the different events considered in EASA’s TOPMS to evaluate their impact on aircraft performance for ATR aircrafts. This activity will include non-exhaustively: The comprehension of the regulatory and operational context of the TOPMS events, The identification of the different input errors which can affect take-off performance (weight, atmospheric conditions, etc.), The evaluation of these errors impact on take-off distances for key parameters. 2. Development of TOPMS aircraft performance algorithm first blocks In a second time, the intern will participate in the development of the first blocks of a model which can estimate expected take-off performance from aircraft and environmental parameters. This activity will include non-exhaustively: The definition of parameters and data necessary for the computation, The implementation of algorithm to detect delta between expected and real performance, The completion of first computations on representative cases. To complete this activity, the intern will work in the Aircraft Performance and Weight team in closed collaboration with Aircraft and Engine Models Development and Aircraft Systems teams. This internship is designed for you Engineering student or equivalent education with specialization in aeronautics Final year internship Knowledge of aircraft performance and flight mechanics Knowledge in model and data analysis Knowledge in Python will be highly appreciated Analytical mind, scientific rigor and autonomy Capacity to work in a multidisciplinary team French and/or English fluent Calendar Starting date: First quarter of 2027 Duration of 6 months How does the recruitment process work? The recruitment process takes place in two stages after receiving your application: Analysis of your resume Technical interview with your internship supervisor: Last step of the process you are almost there! Etienne Carof will contact you for a validation interview. Envie de rejoindre l'aventure ATR ? Une offre de stage vient de s'ouvrir sur notre site à Blagnac ! En 2025, ATR est labellisée Happy Trainees. 94.3% des étudiants recommandent notre entreprise à l’issue de leur alternance ou de leur stage. Ce que nous allons faire ensemble : Être stagiaire chez ATR, c’est être intégré au sein d’une équipe comme un membre à part entière avec un véritable périmètre d’intervention et des responsabilités. Descriptif des missions proposées Le département "Aircraft Performance and Weight" est en charge entre autres de la génération des données de performance (basse et haute vitesse) pour tous les avions ATR. Dans le cadre du projet TOPAAS (Take-Off Performance Awareness and Alerting System), ATR développe un système visant à renforcer la sécurité des opérations au décollage. Ces travaux s'inscrivent dans le cadre d’une future réglementation de l'EASA concernant la prévention des événements liés aux performances au décollage et la mise en œuvre de fonctionnalités de type TOPMS (Take-Off Performance Monitoring System). L'objectif de ce stage est d'analyser l'impact des principales sources d'erreur sur les performances au décollage et d’en déduire un algorithme capable d’anticiper ces erreurs. Le stage se déroulera en deux grandes étapes : 1. Étude de l'impact des erreurs d'entrée sur les performances au décollage Dans un premier temps, le stage portera sur une analyse des différents événements considérés dans les études TOPMS de l'EASA afin d'évaluer leur impact sur la performance au décollage des avions ATR. Cette activité comprendra notamment : La compréhension du contexte réglementaire et opérationnel des événements TOPMS, L'identification des différentes erreurs ou écarts de saisie pouvant affecter les performances de décollage (masse, conditions atmosphériques, etc.), L'évaluation de l'impact de ces erreurs sur les distances de décollage pour les paramètres clés. 2. Développement des premières briques d'un algorithme de performance avion TOPMS La seconde partie du stage sera consacrée au développement des premières briques d'un modèle permettant d'estimer les performances attendues au décollage à partir des principaux paramètres avion et environnementaux. Cette activité comprendra notamment : La définition des données et paramètres nécessaires au calcul, La mise en œuvre d'algorithmes simples de détection d'écarts entre performances attendues et observées, La réalisation de premiers calculs sur des cas représentatifs. Pour réaliser cette activité, vous travaillerez dans l’équipe Aircraft Performance and Weight en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Aircraft and Engine Models Development et les équipes chargées de la partie système. jobs.title: Enterprise Data Analyst Intern, Power BI & Data Quality (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Axiom Space is a human space exploration company, building era-defining space infrastructure and delivering technology-driven solutions that will empower civilization to transcend Earth. Beginning with Axiom Station, successor to the International Space Station, the company is pioneering a next-generation orbital settlement that will foster groundbreaking innovation and research in microgravity and drive the global space economy of tomorrow. Today, guided by the vision of leading humanity's expansion off planet, Axiom Space is the principal provider of commercial human spaceflight services and developer of advanced spacesuits for the Moon and beyond. For more information about Axiom Space, visit www.axiomspace.com . Axiom Space fosters a work environment inclusive of all perspectives. We are the pioneers of commercial space, leading the transformation of low-Earth orbit into a global space marketplace. Our mission-driven team is seeking a bold and dynamic Data Analyst Intern who is fueled by high accountability, execution horsepower, and driven to understand our world, science/technology, and life itself, for the benefit of all on Earth and beyond. POSITION SUMMARY Since Axiom Space is a very complex work environment, we are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Data Analyst Intern who enjoys finding the story in the numbers and making sure the numbers can be trusted. The Digital Integration team builds and maintains the enterprise analytics environment that gives leadership and program teams visibility into KPIs across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering. This internship offers hands-on experience with a production analytics platform during an active modernization of our data pipelines. Reporting to the Manager of Digital Integration, you will work alongside our Data Analyst and Data Engineer on bounded projects with clear deliverables. This is a learning role: you will be mentored, your work will be reviewed, and you will finish with a portfolio of real work. The internship will be onsite at Axiom Space in Houston, Texas from June 1 to August 20. Interns are responsible for arranging their own transportation and accommodations. KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Supports validation of data as pipelines are modernized, comparing outputs between existing and new sources (row counts, totals, and key metrics) and documenting discrepancies Tests Power BI reports after dataset changes to confirm figures remain accurate, and logs results Documents KPI definitions, business logic, and DAX measures in a central reference to support a governed, single-source-of-truth metrics layer Builds and maintains a data dictionary covering tables, fields, grain, and source mappings Reviews data quality exception reports, identifies recurring patterns, and summarizes findings for the team Develops Power BI dashboards or report pages for internal stakeholders using approved data models, under review by a senior team member Supports user acceptance testing by writing test cases and coordinating feedback from business users Presents a summary of work to the team and IT leadership at the end of the internship Perform additional job duties as assigned WHAT YOU’LL GAIN Hands-on experience with a production analytics platform during an active data pipeline modernization Mentorship from the Digital Integration team, with your work reviewed by senior team members A portfolio of real work you can speak to in future interviews The opportunity to present your work to the team and IT leadership QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. jobs.body: Join T&M Emerson's Engineering Internship Program and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic R&D environment. Opportunities are available in Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Test Development, and RF Engineering. Participate in design, development, prototyping, testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities. jobs.title: Test Engineering Intern
jobs.body: 测试助理实习生（Test Engineering Intern） 工作地点：上海 工作时间：每周保证公司工作时间32小时，具体时间可灵活安排 岗位概述 我们正在寻找一名积极主动、逻辑清晰且对工程测试和数据分析感兴趣的实习生，加入产品与工程团队。 该岗位将参与产品验证、性能测试、可靠性测试及认证相关测试工作，协助工程团队完成测试数据收集、整理、分析和测试平台搭建。实习生将接触工业仪器产品全生命周期中的测试与验证流程，包括测试方案执行、实验记录管理、数据处理和测试报告整理。 该职位适合理工科背景、动手能力较强，同时希望了解产品研发、工程验证及测试体系建设的同学。 主要职责 测试执行与支持 根据测试计划协助执行产品验证测试。 协助完成功能测试、性能测试和可靠性测试。 搭建和维护基础测试环境及测试工装。 记录测试过程和测试结果，确保数据准确完整。 协助排查测试过程中发现的问题并跟踪整改情况。 数据处理与分析 负责测试数据收集、整理和归档。 使用Excel等工具进行数据分析和结果统计。 生成测试结果图表和分析报告。 协助工程师发现异常趋势并整理分析结论。 建立和维护测试数据库及测试记录。 测试项目搭建 协助搭建简单测试项目和实验验证平台。 连接测试设备、传感器及数据采集系统。 协助进行测试设备调试和维护。 支持实验室设备管理及测试资源管理。 撰写测试指导文件和操作说明。 工程文档与报告支持 整理测试报告及验证记录。 维护测试相关技术文件和项目资料。 协助编制测试总结报告。 支持产品认证和质量体系相关文档准备工作。 AI工具与效率提升 运用AI工具协助数据分析和测试报告整理。 探索自动化测试和数据处理工具应用。 协助优化测试流程和工作效率。 任职要求 基本要求 硕士在读。 每周可保证4天及以上出勤。 实习期不少于4个月。 优先专业 电子工程 自动化 测控技术 机械工程 仪器科学 计算机科学 数据科学 工业工程 相关理工科专业 核心能力要求 数据处理能力 熟练使用Excel进行数据处理与分析。 能够制作统计图表并整理测试数据。 有MATLAB、Python或Power BI经验者优先。 动手实践能力 具备一定实验室操作经验。 愿意进行设备连接、调试及测试环境搭建。 对仪器设备和工程测试工作有浓厚兴趣。 逻辑分析能力 能够发现数据异常并进行初步分析。 具备良好的问题分析能力和学习能力。 做事认真细致，关注数据准确性。 协作能力 良好的沟通能力和团队合作精神。 能够与工程师、产品经理及质量团队有效协作。 加分项 以下经验将显著加分： 参与实验室测试项目经验 数据分析项目经验 Python编程经验 Power BI或Tableau经验 LabVIEW经验 Arduino、树莓派等硬件项目经验 自动化测试经验 英文技术文档阅读能力 AI工具应用经验（Copilot、ChatGPT等） 岗位亮点 参与真实产品研发与验证 直接参与工业仪器产品的测试和验证工作，接触产品开发全过程。 获得工程实践经验 学习测试方法、实验设计、数据分析及问题排查技能。 培养数据分析能力 提升工程数据处理及可视化分析能力。 接触国际化项目 参与全球产品验证及认证项目，了解国际标准和测试要求。 职业发展方向 实习结束后可向以下方向发展： 测试工程师（Test Engineer） 产品验证工程师（Validation Engineer） 认证工程师（Certification Engineer） 质量工程师（Quality Engineer） 数据分析工程师（Data Analyst） 产品工程师（Product Engineer） Fortive Corporation Overview Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare. We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care. We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact. At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference. At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone. At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating. Fortive: For you, for us, for growth. About Industrial Scientific Industrial Scientific designs and manufactures gas detection products and solutions that protect workers from hazardous conditions around the world. Since our beginnings in 1985, we have pioneered numerous technologies, including the first 3-gas detector, 6-gas detector, wireless gas detector, and even the first gas detector to be included on a NASA space shuttle.Today, we continue to innovate and expand our hardware and software offerings to equip the connected workers of the future. Our latest solutions make it possible to see and respond to hazards in real time, bringing us one step closer to our vision of ending death on the job by 2050. We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Architectural Engineering
jobs.body: About the company General Matter enriches uranium. We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US. In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive. Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way. Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society. We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency. Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable. About the Role General Matter is seeking an Architectural Engineering Intern to join our Buildings team in Los Angeles. This role offers a unique opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and project teams delivering large-scale industrial and nuclear infrastructure projects, including our flagship uranium enrichment facility. You will gain hands-on experience supporting integrated building systems design, multidisciplinary coordination, and construction planning for complex facilities. This role is ideal for a student or graduate who enjoys the intersection of structural, mechanical, and architectural disciplines within the AEC industry. What You’ll Do Support facility structural and mechanical design work for large-scale industrial infrastructure projects. Assist with the preparation of integrated structural and mechanical drawings and technical documentation. Collaborate closely with architectural, civil, electrical, and construction teams to ensure holistic building performance. Help coordinate complex structural and mechanical layouts within the building envelope to optimize space and functionality. Participate in engineering design reviews and project coordination meetings to track progress and resolve technical interface issues. Support high-fidelity BIM modeling using Revit to integrate multidisciplinary designs. Assist engineering teams with constructability reviews and design updates to streamline the transition from theory to field. Help address field design questions and Requests for Information (RFIs) during the construction phase when applicable. What You’ll Bring Current enrollment (Junior or Senior standing) or recent completion of a Bachelor’s degree in Architectural Engineering. Strong interest in industrial infrastructure, energy, or large-scale, high-complexity construction projects. Proficiency in Revit is required; experience with AutoCAD or other BIM/rendering tools is a plus. A multidisciplinary mindset with a foundational understanding of how structural and mechanical systems interact within a facility. Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills tailored for a fast-paced engineering environment. Interest and/or experience in visual programming (Dynamo, Grasshopper) or coding (Python) to support workflow automation. Bonus Qualifications Internship or academic project experience related to industrial building design or heavy construction. Exposure to facility planning for infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, or power-intensive sites. Interest in nuclear energy, sustainable industrial design, or critical infrastructure resilience. Familiarity with building codes and standards relevant to large-scale facility design. Additional Requirements Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary. Equal Opportunity Employer General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Compensation and Benefits The hourly pay range for this internship is $28–$40 per hour, depending on the candidate’s current standing in school (i.e. sophomore, senior). Interns will receive a monthly housing stipend and are eligible for overtime pay. Please note that the stated hourly range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors.

jobs.title: Data Quality Intern
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Valles, Barcelona, Spain
jobs.body: Data Quality Intern Description - Before applying , please note that, to be eligible for this position, you must be currently enrolled at a university in Spain, remain enrolled until the end of the internship, and be eligible to sign an internship agreement with your university. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027 and continue participating in the program until September 2027. About the role: We are looking for a final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field to join our Digital Acceleration team on a part-time basis. The primary focus of this role is end-to-end data quality assurance . The selected candidate will help ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable across sources, pipelines, transformations, and final outputs . The role will also provide occasional support for selected digital solutions, including maintaining our workstation environment and developing small scripts or utilities when needed. Responsibilities Perform end-to-end validation of data solutions, from source data through pipelines and transformations to reports, dashboards, or other final outputs. Define and execute data quality checks covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and expected business rules. Support data quality investigations under the guidance of experienced team members, helping document findings, perform data validation activities, and contribute to root cause analysis and resolution follow-up. Develop and maintain reusable SQL queries, Python scripts, and automated checks for data validation and monitoring. Validate changes to data pipelines and outputs, helping ensure that updates do not introduce regressions or unexpected results. Maintain clear documentation of test cases, validation results, known issues, and resolution status. Contribute on an occasional basis to other Digital Acceleration activities, such as maintaining the team workstation environment and developing small scripts or utilities for internal tools. What success looks like: Success in this role means building confidence in the data used by our teams: detecting issues early, making validation repeatable, and helping ensure that data solutions remain reliable over time. The ideal candidate is not expected to master every technology from day one. We value analytical thinking, attention to detail, learning agility, ownership, and a proactive approach to problem solving. Preferred Background and Skills We are looking for a solid technical foundation, an analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. Experience in all areas is not required, but exposure to some of the following would be highly valued: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or a related field Python for data validation, automation, and scripting. SQL for querying, comparing, and validating data. Databricks or similar data and analytics platforms. Data flows beyond Databricks, including Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Query. Data analysis, profiling, reconciliation, and anomaly detection. ETL processes, data pipelines, jobs, and database fundamentals. Data quality principles, testing methods, and root cause analysis. Modern development environments and structured project practices. Version control and collaborative development using GitHub. English: minimum C1 , with the ability to participate in meetings, understand technical documentation, and collaborate in an international environment. Spanish and/or Catalan are valued. Academic projects, internships, research activities, hackathons, or other practical experience related to data quality, data engineering, software development, or automation are highly appreciated. We are particularly interested in candidates who: Demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset. Are enthusiastic about exploring new technologies and ways of working. Can progress independently on assigned tasks while asking for support when needed. Enjoy collaborating within multidisciplinary teams. Are comfortable interacting with different stakeholders. Show initiative, organization, and a results-oriented approach. Experience our benefits : Paid internship within a global, technology driven company. Join an international work environment, with opportunities for learning, professional development, and networking across teams. Flexible working schedule, with options for part-time agreements (4 hours/day) or full-time (8 hours/day). The length of the internship ranges from 4 to 12 months. Access to our intern community, including career development workshops, learning sessions, and social activities that help you grow professionally and connect with other interns. Mentor assigned. Opportunity to join the HP Graduate Program following the placement. Lunch at reduced prices at our canteen. Access to our on‑site sports center, including: Gym facilities Squash, tennis, and basketball courts 25+ organized sports and wellness activities, such as HIIT training, squash, basketball, and yoga Participation in the NextGen Employee Network, offering regular events and opportunities to connect with other early‑career professionals. On‑site medical services, including access to a doctor, nutrition support, physiotherapy, and general healthcare. Free printing access and hands‑on workshops using the latest HP technologies — from large‑format prints to 3D‑printed models. Easy commuting: Free parking available or excellent access via nearby train services. Women Network initiatives: Networking events, STEM promotion, business acumen talks, work–life balance sessions, and future‑skills development. Sounds like you? Please apply and let’s talk! jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Undergraduate Intern
jobs.body: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact As a Manufacturing Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the development and optimization of automation and AI-driven solutions for package failure analysis. Your contributions will include scripting and automation on LYA and FA tools, developing AI models for data interpretation and defect detection, and preparing inspection datasets such as CSAM, iTDR and IR images. By assisting with model training, validation, and benchmarking, your work will directly enhance analysis efficiency, reduce manual inspection time, improve throughput, and ensure scalable failure analysis capabilities. Business Group Intel Foundry focuses on strengthening Intel's manufacturing capabilities and operational excellence to deliver high-quality products and solutions. As part of the Penang Package FA LYA team, you'll collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support process innovation and efficiency improvements that align with Intel's broader business objectives. This group fosters a dynamic, collaborative environment aimed at driving technological advancements and maintaining Intel's leadership in the industry. Key Responsibilities - Contribute to the development of automation scripting for package failure analysis processes. - Develop semi or automated data collection methods on both LYA and FA tools to speed up dataturn - Assist in AI model development and validation for defect detection. - Prepare inspection datasets, including CSAM and infrared laser scanning confocal images, for analysis. - Support benchmarking workflows and compare AI-driven analysis against manual methods. - Document workflows, results, and observations to ensure traceability and consistency in processes. - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to enhance production efficiency and product quality. - Adhere to safety protocols and data governance requirements. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications - Actively pursuing a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, a cross-disciplinary blend of Materials Science, Computer Science, or a related field. - Proficiency in data analysis tools or programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or similar. - Familiarity with AI methodologies, automation processes, or failure analysis techniques. - Demonstrated aptitude for problem-solving and attention to detail through academic projects, internships, coursework, or hands-on training. - Strong collaboration and communication skills demonstrated through team-based projects or internships. - Able to commit to a minimum internship period of 3 to 6 months, subject to university/college internship requirements and academic calendar. Your contributions will support Intel's commitment to innovation and excellence while providing valuable learning experiences through hands-on projects. Apply today to explore a future with Intel and make an impact in advancing manufacturing engineering solutions. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. The High Frequency Technology Center (HFTC) in Santa Rosa, CA is seeking an intern to join our Industrial Engineering team. This role offers hands-on experience in a high-frequency semiconductor manufacturing environment and the opportunity to learn the principles behind running an efficient, healthy factory. Working alongside industrial engineers, automation engineers, process engineers, operations personnel, and maintenance/equipment engineering teams, you will help drive major process improvement and capacity expansion efforts. You will take a deep, hands-on dive into specific manufacturing areas — gathering data and observations to own and drive Lean process improvements — and work with the team to develop and improve models and simulations of the factory to increase throughput, reduce turn-around-time, and improve efficiency. This is a full-time, onsite summer internship in Santa Rosa, CA, with a strong possibility of extension for up to a year. We believe internships should be more than a summer job. You will be assigned a defined project with clear objectives, ownership, and measurable outcomes, and work closely with experienced engineers throughout. Our goal is that you finish with a tangible improvement delivered to the organization — a meaningful accomplishment you can put on a resume, discuss in future interviews, and build a career on. We encourage curiosity, welcome questions, and support continuous learning. Responsibilities Conduct time studies, value stream mapping, and structured process observations on the manufacturing floor Use SQL, Excel, and Power BI to analyze manufacturing data and uncover gaps in existing data sets Own capacity modeling for a designated manufacturing area, building models that reflect real factory behavior Support automation efforts by developing a working understanding of the underlying manufacturing processes Document and standardize inventory, MES, and ERP transactions to make them repeatable and reliable Support day-to-day operations escalations as a path to learning the floor and its constraints Own and present an end-to-end project drawing on several of the above Qualifications Required Rising junior or senior pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills Ability to take ownership of a task and follow it through to completion Willingness to spend time on the manufacturing floor observing and working directly with processes and equipment Preferred Advanced coursework relevant to industrial engineering, manufacturing systems, operations research, and/or data analysis Experience with SQL and relational databases Experience with discrete-event simulation software (Simul8, Simio, AnyLogic, or Arena) Advanced Excel or data analysis skills; exposure to Power BI Prior experience in a manufacturing or production environment Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodology Personal, academic, or internship projects that demonstrate initiative and technical curiosity Engineering Mindset Successful candidates typically demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn, attention to detail, strong time management, the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a desire to understand the people and processes behind a problem — not just its technical requirements. jobs.title: Systems Administration Intern
jobs.location: Arlington, VA; Washington, DC; Camp Springs, MD
jobs.body: Are you looking to bridge your classroom coursework in computer science, systems administration, or cybersecurity with real-world national defense technology? At Leidos, we don’t just offer internships - we offer career acceleration. Join Leidos’ mission-focused Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR) IT Services team supporting senior defense leaders and national-level command functions. It's a fast-paced, high-stakes environment where the work directly supports national defense operations where uptime is mission-essential. As a Systems Administration Intern you will work side-by-side with experienced enterprise technicians and system administrators. You will gain direct, hands-on experience troubleshooting computer systems, setting up hardware, configuring mobile devices, and delivering first-class customer support to personnel in a professional government environment. As an intern, you will work alongside seasoned systems administrators and defense engineers. This internship is designed to bridge the gap between classroom theory and enterprise IT operations, giving you real-world technical skills in enterprise networking, system administration, and Defense IT practices. Primary Responsibilities: Systems & Hardware Operations (Hands-On Learning): Shadow senior systems administrators during the setup, testing, and deployment of enterprise servers, workstations, and peripheral equipment. Assist in physical hardware relocations, cable management, hardware diagnostics, and component upgrades. Software Installation & System Maintenance: Learn and assist with the deployment and configuration of GCCS client and server software operating on Windows platforms within Active Directory and DNS environments. Observe and assist in executing routine system audits, pre-deployment checklists, and daily health-monitoring scripts. Automation & Administration Fundamentals: Gain practical exposure to PowerShell scripting and automation tools used to configure workstations and pull system reports. Observe Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DHCP configuration, and identity management within an enterprise Active Directory domain. Cybersecurity & Vulnerability Management: Learn how DoD patch management and vulnerability remediation processes work in a secured environment. Shadow the application of software patches and security updates to maintain system readiness. Data Protection & Disaster Recovery Support: Assist in running routine system backup procedures and learn how contingency and disaster recovery (COOP) plans are structured for high-availability military command systems. Required Qualifications: Currently enrolled in an accredited undergraduate program pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Systems Administration, or a closely related field. Must be in good academic standing (Rising Sophomores, Juniors, or Seniors considered). U.S. Citizenship is required. Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance (or possess an active clearance). Leidos will guide you through this process. Foundational understanding of Windows operating systems and fundamental PC hardware architecture. Basic understanding of networking fundamentals (IP addresses, subnets, DNS, default gateways). Classroom familiarity or personal interest in scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or Python). Strong intellectual curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn specialized defense software. Solid written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor. Preferred Qualifications: Current CompTIA Security+ certification (or actively preparing to take the exam for DoD 8140/8570 compliance). Experience with virtual machines (VirtualBox, VMware, Hyper-V) or home-lab system administration. Familiarity with PowerShell commands or basic administrative scripts. Prior experience in IT support, help desk, campus technology labs, or student computing centers. Exposure to basic command-line utilities, Active Directory concepts, or relational databases. undefined You’ll thrive in this role if you are Curious and adaptive—comfortable learning new domains and asking good questions Organized and self-directed, while still highly collaborative Confident communicating your needs and working as an active team member Work location and schedule National Capital Region (Pentagon / Joint Base Andrews / Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling area) FT or PT, core business hours 8am-4pm, 10-12 week internship, target start early June 2027 Limited public transportation options Why Leidos? What This Internship Offers You Real-World Impact: Hands-on exposure to mission-critical systems that support top senior leaders and joint military defense operations. Direct Mentorship: Daily guidance from senior systems engineers who are invested in your technical growth and professional development. Defense Tech Foundation: Clear pathways toward post-graduation full-time employment, government security clearance attainment, and DoD 8140 compliance. Skill Advancement: Transform academic theory into tangible experience spanning Windows Server environments, PowerShell automation, enterprise cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Pay Range: Pay Range $48,100.00 - $86,950.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Location F10 Singapore, 1 North Coast Drive Department Advanced Device Technology and Systems, Process and Equipment Engineering, Wet Process Project Title Wet Process Defectivity and Etch Rate Stability Improvement Project Description This internship project focuses on evaluating process conditions and equipment parameters to identify optimal solutions for reducing manufacturing defects, improving material etching uniformity, and enhancing process robustness within wet etch operations. The project involves structured characterization studies to develop an understanding of process and equipment behavior and evaluate techniques for reducing defectivity and process variation. Through data analysis, guided experimentation, and AI-Enabled learning, the intern will develop foundational knowledge of wet processes, equipment architecture, and semiconductor manufacturing. Objective of the Project Identify process and equipment factors that influence defectivity, etch rate uniformity, and process stability. Evaluate potential process and equipment improvements through structured characterization and data analysis. Develop recommendations that improve process robustness and minimize sources of variation. Explore the use of Artificial Intelligence and AI-Enabled tools to accelerate data interpretation and engineering learning. Opportunities for Full Time Employment High-performing interns who demonstrate strong technical capability, learning agility, and successful project outcomes may be considered for future internship or full-time employment opportunities, subject to business needs and hiring requirements. Project Scope Study wet process principles, including chemical interactions with different film types and process conditions. Evaluate process recipe and equipment parameters to understand their influence on structural and performance outcomes. Analyze process data to identify defect trends, etch rate behavior, and sources of variation. Develop qualification plans, success criteria, and project timelines for selected process or equipment improvements. Participate in structured technical discussions to learn process characterization and experimental design methodologies. Learning Opportunities Develop foundational knowledge of wet processes and equipment architecture. Gain exposure to process characterization, qualification, and engineering evaluation techniques. Apply statistical thinking and data-based decision-making to semiconductor process challenges. Strengthen cross-functional collaboration and technical communication skills. Explore AI Assistants and AI-Enabled workflows for data analysis, knowledge retrieval, and technical documentation. Deliverables Technical summary of wet process fundamentals and equipment architecture. Documented evaluation results for selected defectivity and etch rate uniformity improvement approaches. Structured report outlining key findings, observations, and engineering recommendations. Final presentation summarizing project outcomes, learning, and potential impact. Impact of the Project Improve understanding of the process and equipment factors affecting defectivity and etch rate stability. Identify data-driven opportunities to enhance etching uniformity and process robustness. Establish a structured methodology for evaluating process and equipment improvement opportunities. Skillsets Required Curiosity and strong interest in semiconductor manufacturing and process engineering. Foundational engineering knowledge gained through academic coursework. Logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to interpret technical data. Strong learning agility and willingness to engage in structured project work. Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence tools, AI Assistants, or AI-Enabled workflows is advantageous. At Micron's Boise R&D site, the DRAM Technology Development organization drives innovation in next-generation memory solutions. The team develops advanced DRAM cell architectures, access devices, materials systems, and integration technologies that enable future scaling, improved performance, enhanced reliability, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers work across device, materials, process integration, modeling, design, and product engineering teams to bring groundbreaking memory technologies from concept to production. As an intern in the Advanced DRAM Device & Cell Technology team, you will contribute to the development and characterization of future DRAM cell and access device technologies through experimental studies, data analysis, and collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams. This position combines semiconductor device physics, materials engineering, silicon experimentation, electrical characterization, and data-driven decision making to improve cell performance, density, retention, reliability, and manufacturability. The successful candidate will collaborate with multi-functional teams to evaluate novel materials, device architectures, and integration schemes supporting future memory technology development. Responsibilities Support the evaluation of DRAM access devices, capacitors, and cell stack elements through characterization, data analysis, and assessment of new device architectures, materials systems, and integration schemes. Design and implement silicon experiments; perform electrical, physical, and materials characterization along with statistical analysis to find opportunities for device, process, and design improvements. Analyze device- and array-level behavior including sensing margins, activation characteristics, disturb mechanisms, retention performance, leakage behavior, and read/write operation interactions. Collaborate with modeling, design, process integration, and manufacturing teams to understand device behavior, support technology optimization, and contribute to technology development activities. Apply AI-Assisted and Generative AI tools, where appropriate, to enhance data analysis, workflow efficiency, and technical decision-making. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field. Cannot graduate prior to September 2027. Demonstrated understanding of semiconductor fundamentals, including device physics, materials science, characterization techniques, and concepts relevant to advanced memory technologies. Experience with electrical characterization, device testing, statistical analysis, and interpretation of experimental or simulation data sets. Familiarity with DRAM operational concepts, including activation, sensing, retention, and disturb mechanisms. Proficiency with data analysis and scripting tools such as Python, MATLAB, JMP, or similar platforms, along with familiarity with AI-assisted engineering and data analysis tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience in DRAM or NAND device development, characterization, or technology research. Hands-on experience with semiconductor materials characterization, process development, thin film engineering, interface engineering, TCAD simulation, and/or advanced memory technology research. Knowledge of semiconductor fabrication processes, advanced BEOL integration, reliability mechanisms, and device variation analysis. Experience conducting independent research projects and effectively communicating technical results to diverse audiences. Experience using AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI-enabled analytics, or AI-supported engineering workflows to improve research productivity and technical insights. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. jobs.title: Internship in the field of Lean Manufacturing
jobs.body: Robert Bosch Produktie N.V., located in Tienen, Belgium, is within the Bosch Group the lead plant and worldwide center of competence for development, engineering and manufacturing of wiper arms. Customers are both original equipment automotive car manufactures and aftermarket customers. As part of the Bosch strategy, we offer students the opportunity to participate in an internship at our location. Safety, Cost efficiency and quality are our main focus points, and to maintain the excellent position we are at, we strive for: continuous improvement of our equipment efficiency, proactive work on process understanding and root cause analysis, introduction of new process and process automatisation to reduce manufacturing cost and introduction of new products to improve customer satisfaction. If you look for a position where you can take initiative, learn and bring added value in an industrial environment, you’re the student we are looking for. The internship will ideally last 3-6 months and can be either full-time or part-time (let us know your availability, and we’ll work something out). At present, you can work remotely. Depending on your study program the internship may contain the following main points: Support the design of new production machines and processes. Participation in Bosch Production System projects: continuous improvement work on existing production and/or logistic processes the fields of Safety, Quality, Cost & Delivery. Standardization and improvement of production and/or logistics processes. Definition & implementation of lean standards: value stream planning, standardized work, pull production, leveling, quick changeover, … I4.0 and digitalization. Preferred start date:February - March You must be enrolled as a student. Language: good knowledge of English is required. German and possibly Dutch is a plus. Fields of study: mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, production engineering, technical business economics. Completed basic study period. Good knowledge of MS-Office. You are able to communicate efficient & effective, you can work on your own and as a team player. Responsible, independent and reliable worker. Intercultural interest and understanding. An internship will be successful if you are inquisitive, active and ask for work. The main condition is that you are a European citizen and if not, you can only do an internship through a European exchange program. The internship requires that you have the nationality of a EU-country or that you are taking part in the Erasmus program. The personal experience of the interns is usually the following: The company employs 10-15 interns all year round from various countries. Therefore this is also a great opportunity to enhance your social and language skills. The interns live mostly in Tienen or in Leuven, known as a multicultural university city. You receive 800 € as expense reimbursement per month.
