jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a Manufacturing Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Wallops Island, Virginia, you will have the opportunity to support the developing processes, as well as identifying and design build of necessary equipment for receipt and final integration and launch of the Neutron Launch Vehicle. You’ll work closely the Neutron Vehicle Integration Engineer and other key team members who are responsible for the integration, test and launch of the Neutron launch vehicle. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program in an engineering, physics or math discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship GPA of 3.0 or above 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE GPA of 3.5 or above 6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) Basic coding proficiency (Python, SQL, or automation scripting) Solid Modelling experience Computer-aided design and manufacturing (CAD/CAM) experience Strong interest in identifying and driving process improvement opportunities ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027 COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS Pay Range MD: $25.00 USD Hourly You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs WHAT TO EXPECT We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. jobs.title: 2027 Power Systems Engineering Graduate Intern
jobs.body: The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space. At the Mission Payloads Division (MPD), we are pioneers in remote sensing systems that guide our country’s space enterprise. Our talented and dynamic people create and flourish in electronics, sensors, radar, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced data network domains. We boldly advance technology through our research and development and then forward to demonstration and integration. With innovative laboratories and prototyping, MPD delivers groundbreaking results. We guide our Department of Defense, intelligence community, and civil clients to enhance national productivity and security and tackle the most critical missions. Bring your intelligence and creative spirit and join us at MPD! The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in El Segundo, CA. What You’ll Be Doing Provide Power Systems Engineering technical support. Apply academic technical skills to create satellite energy balance and / or launch vehicle energy depletion analysis models, while working under the guidance and support of industry experts. Work with experienced Power Systems Engineering staff to increase knowledge and understanding of major satellite subsystem elements that operate on the spacecraft and / or launch vehicle power bus. Utilize and/or develop system level modeling tools and resources that facilitate hardware performance characterization. Learn how satellites operate through launch and initialization. Gain an understanding of how other spacecraft subsystems and related focus areas like Thermal Control, Attitude Control, Flight Mechanics, and Communications work concurrently to generate data products for vehicle level assessments. Gain exposure to power electronics modeling, simulation, and testing in a laboratory environment. Write clear and concise reports that document your work. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed. Training and mentorship will be provided. jobs.title: Manufacturing Production Documentation Co-Op
jobs.body: Job Title: Manufacturing Production Documentation Co-Op Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Chaska, MN is seeking a Manufacturing Production Documentation Co-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration. This role will be focused on improving, standardizing, and aligning manufacturing documentation—especially for injection molding processes. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams (quality, molding, machining, operators) to identify gaps, resolve inconsistencies, and update technical documents such as SOPs, work instructions, mold setup sheets, process parameter records, and validation protocols. The role blends technical writing, process understanding, and operator-focused clarity, helping ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, and easy for production teams to use. What You’ll Do: Document Review — They audit existing molding documents (SOPs, work instructions, setup sheets, process parameters) to find outdated, unclear, or inconsistent content. Process Mapping — They observe molding operations on the floor, map out steps, and ensure documentation matches real‑world practice. Template Standardization — They help build or refine templates, so all documents look and read the same across molding, machining, and quality. Cross‑Functional Collaboration — They work with engineers, technicians, operators, and quality teams to clarify instructions and resolve discrepancies. Mold Setup Documentation — They update mold setup sheets, ensuring correct part numbers, tooling, parameters, and photos are included. Process Parameter Alignment — They verify that documented molding parameters match validated settings and update records when needed. Operator‑Friendly Simplification — They rewrite complex technical language into clear, step‑by‑step instructions operators can easily follow. Part Family Organization — They help group similar molded parts and align documentation across families to reduce redundancy. jobs.title: Warheads Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027
jobs.body: Warheads Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027 The Complex Warheads Centre of Excellence is a coordinated team and the company’s design authority for Warheads. We support Warhead development throughout the product lifecycle; starting with concept design, design definitions, assessment, technical specification, test equipment and maturity of concepts, into manufacture. Salary : £25,420 Dynamic working : 3-4 days per week on-site due to workload classification Security clearance : British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship. Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes. What we can offer you: 1 year placement: Starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year Company bonus : Based on company performance and will vary year to year Pension : Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14% Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days Facilities : Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more… Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more. The opportunity: The team develops, designs and tests Warheads for MBDA missiles. We predict the lethal performance of various types of missile systems through modelling of missile terminal engagement, target detection, Warhead detonation and lethal performance prediction. We provide expertise in the skill areas of Warheads, energetic materials, target detection and weapon lethality. Through this placement you'll: Work closely with the team in a variety of stages within the product lifecycle Learn how to produce detailed design definitions, carry out concept assessment using modelling simulations Support the team to analyse and assess performance data collected during trials Support the design and planning for trials. This is an outstanding opportunity to join a niche group of engineers with specialised expertise. The skills we utilise are not typical in academia and so joining the team presents an opportunity for you to develop knowledge in numerous aspects of Warhead development that you would not acquire anywhere else! Joining us will build your knowledge and enable you to apply an understanding of Warhead technologies and their lethal effects to various types of missile systems in development and in service. You may be encouraged to work independently, with limited supervision, or part of a small to medium team, as required. Some projects may include collaboration with other MBDA departments across the UK and Europe and therefore this role may require you to travel. What we're looking for from you: Working towards a degree in an Engineering, Mathematical or Applied Science subject area such as Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical or Systems Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or Mathematics discipline. Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more… We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process. Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

jobs.title: Intern - SMAI TD AI Engineering Team
jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The Smart Manufacturing & AI (SMAI) organization develops AI-enabled solutions that drive business value, operational efficiency, and innovation across Micron. By combining software engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, and data-driven decision-making, the team delivers scalable technologies that improve productivity and accelerate digital transformation throughout the enterprise. As an AI Engineering Intern, you will design, develop, and support AI-enabled software solutions that address real-world business challenges across Micron. You will work on full stack applications, AI agents, LLM integrations, and modern software systems while gaining hands-on experience with production-grade AI technologies, cloud-native architectures, and AI-assisted software development practices. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and support AI-enabled software applications using modern programming languages, web technologies, databases, APIs, and cloud-based architectures. Build and integrate AI capabilities such as large language models (LLMs), AI agents, retrieval systems, and intelligent automation solutions into enterprise applications. Collaborate with engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Utilize AI-assisted development tools, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices to improve software quality, productivity, and delivery efficiency. Research, evaluate, and prototype emerging AI technologies while contributing to software documentation, testing, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives. Minimum Qualifications 0-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research projects, coursework, academic projects, hackathons, or software development experience in artificial intelligence, software engineering, data science, or related technical fields. Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. Expected graduation date of September 2027 or later. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming concepts. Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies. Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL database technologies. Understanding of software architecture principles and modern application development practices. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools and large language models (LLMs) such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies to improve productivity, software development, learning, and problem-solving. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of large language models (LLMs), AI agents, generative AI, and modern AI application architectures. Familiarity with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic workflows. Basic understanding of machine learning concepts, including model training, inference, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning. Experience with AI-assisted software development tools, coding assistants, or intelligent automation technologies. Experience building web applications using modern full stack frameworks and development practices. Familiarity with REST APIs, cloud platforms, containerization technologies, DevOps tools, or CI/CD methodologies. Experience using source control systems such as Git and participating in collaborative software development workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts effectively. Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and passion for learning emerging AI technologies and solving complex technical challenges. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . jobs.title: Performance Engineering Intern, Deep Learning and HPC - 2027
jobs.body: We are now looking for a Performance Engineer Intern to support our growing investments in performance testing of various NVIDIA‘s datacenter products and applications. Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPUs, CPUs, interconnects and software together act as the brains of the AI factories that power it. You will be part of the global Performance Lab team, improving our capacity to expertly and accurately benchmark state-of-the-art AI applications and products. We also work to develop infrastructures and solutions that enhance the team’s ability to gather data through automation and designing efficient processes for testing a wide variety of applications and hardware. The data that we collect drives marketing/sales collaterals as well as engineering studies for future products. You will have the opportunity to work with multi-functional teams and in a dynamic environment where multiple projects will be active at once and priorities may shift frequently. What you’ll be doing: Benchmark, profile, and analyze AI and HPC workloads on NVIDIA supercomputers and distributed systems - LLM and VLM training and inference, agentic workloads, world models, and Physical AI for robotics. Aggregate and produce written reports with the testing data for internal sales, marketing, SW, and HW teams. Build benchmark automation with AI agents and agentic coding tools. Ensure the whole process and results are reliable and reproducible. Collaborate with internal teams to debug and resolve performance issues. Set up and configure systems with appropriate hardware and software to run benchmarks. What we need to see: Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Experienced in programming and debugging with scripting languages such as Python or Unix shell. Hands-on experience with Linux based systems. Familiarity using a container platform such as Docker. Fluent with AI coding assistants and agentic workflows, with the judgment to verify what they produce rather than defer to them. Hands-on experience with inference frameworks such as TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, or SGLang. Or experience in AI model inference deployment and training. Strong data analysis skills and the ability to summarize findings in a written report. Strong English verbal and written skills to improve collaboration with coworkers. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices. Familiar with cloud provisioning and scheduling tools (Kubernetes, Slurm). Experience building agent workflows, MCP tools, or reusable agent skills that other people use. Curiosity about GPUs, TPUs, cloud and performance benchmarking. Background in system-level problem solving. We have some of the most forward thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. Strong communication skills for collaboration with engineering teams and operations. Work Environment: On-site in our Philadelphia, PA facility. jobs.title: AI Application Development Intern
jobs.body: AI Application Development Intern / AI 应用开发实习生 岗位职责： 你将负责 系统运营与项目协调 业务需求管理与项目进度跟踪 低代码应用日常运维与持续优化 AI 应用及 Prototype 开发 根据明确的业务需求，结合 Low-code 和 Coding 方式完成 AI Application 、 AI Agent 、 Workflow 等应用的 Prototype 开发、测试与迭代。随着能力提升，优秀实习生将有机会 独立负责一个小型 AI Application 从需求到交付的完整过程 。 AI 培训及项目材料准备 负责协助准备 AI 相关培训材料、 Demo 、技术文档，以及 AI 项目的进度汇报、案例总结等内容，并持续沉淀可复用的知识和最佳实践。 参与并协助完成现有数字化系统及应用的日常运营工作，包括收集和整理变更需求、维护项目文档、整理会议记录、跟踪行动计划及后续事项等。在实际工作中主动发现问题、推动事项落地，并逐步熟悉业务流程、系统应用及相关协作团队。 以周为单位收集、整理和归类业务需求，维护和完善需求文档；主动与业务部门及相关职能团队沟通，跟踪数字化及 AI 项目的进展、反馈和后续行动，协助推动项目按计划落地。 负责团队现有 Power Platform 等低代码应用的日常运营和维护，包括用户反馈收集、问题排查、功能调整、测试及文档更新，保障应用稳定运行，并根据实际业务需求持续推动应用优化。 你将参与 企业 AI Application / Agent 的设计与开发 参与真实业务场景下 AI Application 、 AI Agent 和智能自动化解决方案的需求分析、方案设计、开发、测试和部署，理解从业务问题到技术解决方案的完整过程。 AI Agent 与 Workflow 开发 参与通过 Low-code + Coding 的混合方式搭建 AI Agent 及自动化 Workflow ，并探索 AI 与 Microsoft 365 、 SharePoint 、 Power Platform 及其他企业系统的集成。 业务需求与 AI Use Case 分析 与业务团队沟通实际痛点，协助将业务需求拆解为可落地的 AI Use Case ，并通过快速原型验证技术可行性和业务价值。 AI 应用测试与持续优化 参与 Prompt 、 Agent 行为、应用功能和用户体验的测试与评估，通过用户反馈和测试结果持续优化解决方案。 任职要求 我们希望你 计算机科学、软件工程、人工智能、数据科学、信息管理、自动化等相关专业，本科或硕士在校生； 具备一定的编程基础，熟悉 Python 、 JavaScript / TypeScript 中至少一种； 对 Generative AI 、 LLM 、 AI Agent 和 AI Application Development 有强烈兴趣，并有较强的主动学习能力； 了解基本的软件开发概念，例如 API 、数据库、 Git 等； 具备较强的问题分析和动手能力，愿意将模糊的问题快速转化为可以运行的 Prototype ； 具备良好的沟通、文档整理和团队协作能力； 每周可实习至少 3 天，连续实习至少 6 个月，可在上海 onsite 工作。 以下经验将成为加分项 如果你有以下一项或多项实践经验，我们会非常感兴趣： 使用过 GitHub Copilot 、 Cursor 、 Claude Code 等 AI Coding / Vibe Coding 工具，并能够借助 AI 快速完成 Prototype ； 有 Power Apps 、 Power Automate 、 Copilot Studio 等 Low-code / Agent 平台实践经验； 接触过 Azure AI Foundry 或其他企业级 AI 开发平台； 对 Prompt Engineering 、 RAG 、 Embedding 、 Vector Database 、 Tool Calling 、 MCP 、 Agentic Workflow 等概念有实践经验； 有个人 AI 项目、 Hackathon 、 GitHub Project 、课程项目或其他可以展示的 AI Application Demo 。 我们不要求你已经掌握所有 AI 技术。 相比工具清单，我们更看重扎实的基础、快速学习能力、 Hands-on 能力，以及能否真正把一个想法做成可运行的应用。 我们期待这样的你 Hands-on ：喜欢真正动手 Build ，而不仅仅停留在 AI 概念层面； Curious ：对快速变化的 AI 技术保持好奇，并愿意主动学习和尝试； Problem Solver ：能够从业务问题出发，思考如何用 AI 和数字化技术解决问题； Ownership ：愿意对自己的工作负责，并逐步具备独立 Owner 一个小型应用的能力； AI-native ：愿意把 AI Coding 、 Agent 等新方法真正融入自己的开发和工作方式。 你将获得 真实企业 AI Application 项目经验 不是单纯做 Demo ，而是参与真实业务需求，从需求理解、 Prototype 、开发测试到应用运营。 Low-code + Coding 的复合型开发经验 同时接触传统 Coding 、 Power Platform 、 AI Agent 和企业自动化场景，建立更加完整的 AI Application Development 能力。 现代 AI 技术栈的实践机会 有机会接触和使用 Copilot Studio 、 Azure AI Foundry 、 GitHub Copilot ，以及 LLM 、 RAG 、 Agent 、 MCP 等 AI Application Development 技术。 从 Developer 到 Application Owner 的成长机会 从具体开发和运营任务开始，优秀实习生将有机会逐步 独立 Owner 一个小型 AI Application ，真正体验从需求到交付的全过程。 AI-first 的工作方式 鼓励利用 AI Coding 、 Vibe Coding 和 Agentic Development 提升开发效率，用新的方式解决实际业务问题。 AI Application Development Intern Key Responsibilities What You Will Own 1. System Operations and Project Coordination Support the day-to-day operations of existing digital systems and applications, including collecting and organizing change requests, maintaining project documentation, capturing meeting notes, and tracking action items and follow-ups. Take initiative in identifying issues and driving actions to completion while developing a solid understanding of business processes, applications, and cross-functional stakeholders. 2. Business Requirements Management and Project Tracking Collect, organize, and categorize business requirements on a weekly basis, and maintain clear and structured requirement documentation. Proactively communicate with business teams and cross-functional stakeholders to track the progress, feedback, and next steps of digital and AI projects, helping ensure projects move forward as planned. 3. Low-code Application Operations and Continuous Improvement Take responsibility for the day-to-day operation and maintenance of the team’s existing low-code applications, including solutions built with Power Platform. Collect user feedback, troubleshoot issues, implement functional enhancements, conduct testing, and maintain documentation to ensure stable application performance and continuous improvement based on evolving business needs. 4. AI Application and Prototype Development Develop, test, and iterate prototypes for AI applications, AI agents, and automated workflows based on defined business requirements, using a combination of low-code platforms and traditional coding. As capabilities grow, high-performing interns will have the opportunity to independently own a small AI application end-to-end, from requirements analysis and solution design to development, testing, delivery, and ongoing operations. 5. AI Training and Project Materials Prepare and maintain AI-related training materials, demos, technical documentation, project updates, and use case summaries. Help capture reusable knowledge, templates, and best practices to support the team’s broader AI enablement efforts. 6. Emerging AI Technology Exploration and Rapid Validation Explore emerging technologies, tools, and development approaches in Generative AI, AI agents, Vibe Coding, and AI-assisted development. Conduct rapid experiments, build prototypes and demos, and evaluate their potential value in real-world business scenarios. What You Will Contribute To 1. Enterprise AI Application and Agent Design Contribute to the requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, and deployment of AI applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation solutions for real-world business scenarios. Gain hands-on experience in translating business problems into practical technical solutions. 2. AI Agent and Workflow Development Help build AI agents and automated workflows using a combination of low-code platforms and traditional coding. Explore integrations between AI solutions and Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and other enterprise systems. 3. Business Requirements and AI Use Case Analysis Work with business teams to understand their challenges and translate business requirements into actionable AI use cases. Use rapid prototyping to validate technical feasibility and potential business value. 4. AI Application Testing and Continuous Optimization Test and evaluate prompts, agent behavior, application functionality, and user experience. Continuously improve solutions based on user feedback, testing results, and application performance. Qualifications What We Are Looking For Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Management, Automation, or a related field. Foundational programming skills with proficiency in at least one language, preferably Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript . Strong interest in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI Application Development , with the ability and motivation to learn independently. Basic understanding of software development concepts and tools, such as APIs, databases, and Git . Strong problem-solving and hands-on skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous ideas or business problems into working prototypes. Good communication, documentation, and teamwork skills. Available to work onsite in Shanghai for at least 3 days per week, for a minimum internship duration of 6 months. Preferred Qualifications We would be particularly interested if you have practical experience in one or more of the following areas: Experience using AI Coding / Vibe Coding tools , such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code, to accelerate development and rapidly build prototypes. Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio , or other low-code / agent development platforms. Exposure to Azure AI Foundry or other enterprise AI development platforms. Practical knowledge of Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, Tool Calling, MCP, or Agentic Workflows . Personal AI projects, hackathon experience, GitHub projects, academic projects, or other demonstrable AI application prototypes. We do not expect you to have mastered every AI technology. More than a long list of tools, we value strong fundamentals, rapid learning, hands-on problem-solving, and the ability to turn an idea into a working application. What Success Looks Like Hands-on: You enjoy building functional solutions rather than limiting your exploration to AI concepts. Curious: You stay curious about rapidly evolving AI technologies and actively explore new tools and approaches. Problem Solver: You can start with a business problem and identify practical ways to address it using AI and digital technologies. Ownership: You take responsibility for your work and are motivated to grow into independently owning a small AI application. AI-native: You are willing to incorporate AI coding, agents, and other AI-native approaches into your daily development workflow. What You Will Gain Real-world Enterprise AI Application Experience Go beyond isolated demos by working on real business requirements across the application lifecycle, from problem definition and prototyping to development, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations. Low-code + Coding Experience Build experience across traditional coding, Power Platform, AI agents, and enterprise automation, developing a well-rounded AI application development skill set. Exposure to a Modern AI Technology Stack Gain opportunities to work with Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, GitHub Copilot, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, MCP, and other modern AI application development technologies. Growth from Developer to Application Owner Start with hands-on development and operational responsibilities, with the opportunity to progress toward independently owning a small AI application from requirements gathering through delivery. jobs.title: Process Engineering Intern (Baguio)
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking a Process Engineering Intern within the Analog Technology Development (ATD) Group. We work to define and develop the next generation process and device technologies for TI. The metal system is critical for achieving reliable, low resistance interconnects for power devices, for enabling area scaling and high process yields to drive cost leadership and to achieve high precision resistors and capacitor components. The interconnect process integration engineer is a key member of a team that defines and develops the processes and process flows to achieve the interconnect performance and reliability needs, whether it be low resistance with good electro-migration capability for the latest high current applications or high precision resistors for high performance amplifiers. The role includes activities such as: defining electrical test circuits to assess process capability versus design rule, characterizing and analyzing process yield data, assessing the reliability of the metal and dielectric of the interconnect system, and then working within the team to drive the necessary actions to meet the yield and reliability needs for the technology. Minimum requirements: Currently pursuing Masters degree or PhD in areas such as Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or related engineering degree. Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Strong materials background in metal and/or dielectrics Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results, influential relationships Good listener and excellent verbal and written communication skills

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Perception, Robotics
jobs.body: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. Within Perception, the Sensing Resilience team's job is to make sure that sensors "just work" for the entire self-driving car software stack. We make sure that all sensors are properly calibrated and consistently monitored at all times. We are often the firsts to algorithmically process data from next-generation sensors on next-generation vehicle platforms and work closely with both hardware and software teams to provide the best possible sensor data from our many sensors perfectly aligned to our upstream customers. To this end, we develop sensor data alignment and calibration algorithms, a growing sensor health backend, and deploy our systems both into the Waymo Driver and our log processing backend. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! You will: Help Waymo scale the sensor calibration algorithms to seamlessly support many different hardware architectures by developing the next-generation calibration system Develop, evaluate, and deploy new initiatives for the next-generation calibration system Evaluate and deploy ML-based calibration systems in new areas not yet covered in the literature Collaborate with highly experienced colleagues across hardware, software, and operations on deploying real world robotic system You have: Enrolled in a MS/PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, or a similar technical field of study Experience in C++ We prefer: Experience deploying software as part of a complex system Experience calibrating multi-sensor robotic systems Experience evaluating and deploying ML systems Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. jobs.title: Internship (d/f/m) within Digital-Twin Spacecraft Engineer
jobs.body: Job Description: In order to support the Data Processing & Analytics department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an Intern as a Digital-Twin Spacecraft Engineer (d/f/m) Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Digital-Twin Spacecraft Engineer? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Data Processing & Analytics department as an intern (d/f/m)! Location: Immenstaad Start: As soon as possible Duration: 3-6 months Your location At the Airbus site in Immenstaad on Lake Constance, you’ll work where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power takes shape. In an environment that offers vision, you will shape technological innovations across domains. Context You will join the Data Processing & Analytics department, a transnational department responsible for the development of digital engineering solutions for space missions and products with strong interactions with the engineering professions for space systems. The part of the organisation, where you will be working, has diverse profiles (aerospace engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, project managers, product managers, software developers, big data architects) which will help you onboard and understand the various aspects of digital engineering and data science for space applications. In addition, our team are working on various topics including: Realizing Digital Twin concept with overall architecture and use cases along end-to-end space mission lifecycle Formalization of system data in Knowledge Graphs, Time series anomaly detection, Realisation of surrogate models in relation to different space professions, Mathematical optimization (design optimization, architecture, etc.) Natural language processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLM). In this field, the team is working on several internal R&D projects and external initiatives in connection with innovative startups and space institutions, with the aim of meeting the internal needs of Airbus Defence and Space in terms of digital systems engineering and AI solutions. Your benefits Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime). A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department. International environment with the opportunity to network globally. Work with modern/diversified technologies. Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network. Your tasks and responsibilities Your tutor will support you identify your professional objectives and develop your skills You will contribute to the following activities: Support the use case for integrating CAD data and mechanical engineering processes into the overall space systems engineering knowledge base in Digital-Twin platform. Understanding user needs, and definition of needed building blocks to correctly build and evaluate models and automate the process. Preparation of knowledge base by designating and collecting data sources, and implementing pipelines. Processing and integration of mechanical engineering data into artefacts from thermal and functional engineering domains. Implementation of dashboards, user interfaces and prompts for presentation in-line with end-user requirements. Collection of all involved concepts in an Ontology, describing the relationships in between artefacts. Testing of the end-to-end solution with subject matter experts and successive iterations. Support development of Digital-Twin platform architecture & modules via the experience gained on the implemented use-case. Identify, propose and support other use-cases along the end-to-end space mission lifecycle. Desired skills and qualifications Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of aerospace engineering, systems engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, computer science, software engineering or an equivalent field of study. Enthusiasm and comprehension towards space business Curiosity, proactive, dedication to deliver Good presentation skills, ability to showcase work to various people (Aerospace engineers, technical experts, data scientists, managers, project managers etc.) Space systems engineering processes, methods and tools (e.g. CAD, mission & system analysis, MBSE, domain knowledge on mechanical/thermal/electrical/functional engineering etc.) Ontology Engineering and Data Modeling Manipulation and data analytics in python Software and big data platform architecture / RAG (vectorial databases, data security, user access, hardware etc.), agentic workflows. Deep learning and LLMs frameworks (tensorflow, pytorch, transformers, langchain, …) Fluent in English and German nice to have Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate. Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth. Take your career to a new level and apply online now! #MYCYM This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. jobs.body: Application close date: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth ! Club for the Future (Club) is Blue Origin's K-12 education nonprofit focused on inspiring and mobilizing future generations to pursue careers in Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math (STEAM). Club engages with external partners to host events, develops space-related online lessons for educators, enables and empowers employees to engage with students, and inspires the next generation through providing access to space. As an intern, you will play a hands-on role in shaping the educational resources, events, and systems that bring space to classrooms across the country. This internship is ideal for future educators, education-focused communicators, and tech-savvy problem-solvers who are excited to leverage tools like AI and automation to streamline processes and scale the impact of a small but mighty nonprofit team. During your internship, you can expect to: Gain hands - on, real -w orld experience in education program development and nonprofit operations. jobs.title: Working student / Werkstudent - Flight Deck / Systems Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.body: Working student / Werkstudent - Flight Deck / Systems Engineering (m/f/d) Company: Boeing Deutschland GmbH - BDG At Boeing, we are all innovators on a mission to connect, protect, explore and inspire. From the seabed to outer space, you'll learn and grow while contributing to work that shapes the world. Find your future with us! Our teams are currently hiring for a working student located in Neu-Isenburg who will join a Systems & Human Factors Engineering team that defines, builds, tests, and certifies the systems, flight deck functions, and avionics at the heart of Boeing Commercial Airplanes. We operate at the intersection where engineering meets software. In small, highly skilled, multi-national teams, we solve today's complex problems while keeping the future in mind. We work as integrated product teams: systems engineering defines what the airplane needs, software implements it, and systems engineering validates it, all in one place, close to the programs we support. At any given moment, tens of thousands of flight crews around the world are operating in the flight decks of Boeing-designed airplanes, and our deep flight deck domain knowledge, built over years of program delivery, shapes systems that pilots trust. The systems and functions you help shape will fly for decades and connect the entire globe. Come join a team of experts with outstanding knowledge in systems engineering, safety, human factors, flight operations, and software engineering. The successful working student has a passion for aviation and engineering, and enjoys working alongside engineers, human factors specialists, pilots, and customers who share it. Position Responsibilities: In our team you will perform a wide variety of dynamic and challenging work across existing and future systems and flight decks, including: Establishing and refining system requirements for new functions and improvements, and helping test and validate them from early concept through service life. Designing and evaluating the behavior, interfaces, and human-machine interaction of avionics systems and flight deck functions. Supporting the development of avionics functions and safety enhancements (e.g., surveillance and alerting), contributing across the lifecycle from requirements through certification. Prototyping and modeling systems, flight deck interfaces, and displays using commercial and company-unique tools, and validating them through analysis, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, and flight deck simulators. Collaborating with systems engineers, software engineers, human factors specialists, and pilots to ensure our systems and flight deck interfaces complement the cognitive, physical, sensory, and ergonomic capabilities of the crew. Building tools and processes (including agentic AI workflows) that make our engineering work faster and better. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Student Status Fluent in English Commitment to working 20 hours a week onsite in Neu-Isenburg Past internship or work experience related to this position considered beneficial International exposure from your studies and/or work experience beneficial You will be located in Neu-Isenburg, Germany and working with colleagues worldwide Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): Currently enrolled in a Bachelor/Master/PhD degree program in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Human Computer Interaction, Human Factors, or a related technical field Ability to work in a fast paced international team environment combined with strong verbal, written and social skills Work with internal and external customers to extract complex requirements Knowledge of human performance in aerospace or other safety relevant industries beneficial Aerospace regulatory awareness beneficial Employer willing to sponsor applicants for employment visa status. jobs.title: Analytical scientist Co-Op
jobs.body: Job Title: Analytical scientist Co-Op Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Billerica, MA is seeking an Analytical scientist Co-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration. Entegris, Inc. is a global leader in contamination control, specialty material handling and advanced process materials for the semi-conductor industry. We seek a motivated and talented engineering candidate to work with the Metrology team within the company’s Advanced Purity Solution (APS). The Metrology team at Entegris is tasked with providing reliable measurements to support internal R&D and external customers. Often these measurement requests require novel techniques in order to gain useful information and address challenges. This co-op position will focus on developing new retention methods necessary for evaluating new and existing filtration technologies to benefit semiconductor manufacturing. What You’ll Do: Develop new retention methods to evaluate current and next-generation products Study nanoparticle-membrane interaction mechanisms using analytical methods like fluorescence spectrophotometry, inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) and Gel permeation chromatography (GPC). Collect, interpret, and review experimental data regularly with the analytical team. Draw sound scientific conclusions based on data analysis. Use critical thinking and problem solving to determine project outlooks What We Seek: The candidate should be detail-oriented and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The candidate should have a basic understanding of the scientific process and data analysis. The candidate should be familiar with using Microsoft Excel to review collected data and draw sound conclusions. The candidate should have willingness to learn. Knowledge of analytical chemistry, nanoparticles, membrane-based separations, polymer, and/or ICP-MS is desired, but not required. Desired Major(s) & Graduation Year: Sophomore and above student in chemistry, material science, or chemical engineering. Eligibility: Must be a currently enrolled student Available to work 40 hours a week, M-F (8a-5p) beginning in January through June Must be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co-op program Entegris is not currently hiring candidates for co-ops/internships who will need, now or at any time in the future, Entegris sponsorship through the H1-B lottery. WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS? Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. WHAT WE OFFER Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Compensation: $20-$30/hour range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the role Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. jobs.title: Micro-Grid Systems Engineering Co-Op
jobs.body: We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us? At Generac, we are accelerating the transformation of the electric grid through advanced microgrid technologies, distributed energy resources (DERs), and intelligent control systems. We are seeking a highly motivated Microgrid Controls Engineering Co-Op starting January 2027 to join our Industrial Microgrid Controls Team in Fort Collins, Colorado. This position offers a unique opportunity to apply advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence, and power systems engineering to improve the performance, reliability, and operation of real-world microgrid deployments. Working alongside experienced controls, software, and power systems engineers, you will analyze operational data from fielded systems, identify performance improvement opportunities, develop predictive insights, validate next-generation control strategies through Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, and contribute to the future of intelligent energy systems. Unlike traditional engineering internships, this role provides direct exposure to operational microgrid assets and customer applications, where your work may directly influence future products, system architectures, and customer outcomes. Major Responsibilities Data Analytics & System Intelligence Analyze large data sets from deployed microgrid, energy storage, and distributed energy resource systems to identify trends, anomalies, reliability concerns, and optimization opportunities. Transform this operational data into actionable engineering recommendations. Develop advanced analytics, dashboards, and visualization tools to improve customer value, operational performance, and fleet-wide system insights. Infer from the above analysis what statistical, machine learning, and AI-based approaches may support predictive maintenance, fault detection, and root cause analysis efforts going forward. Next-Generation Controls Validation Design and conduct off-nominal, fault, and edge-case testing scenarios to evaluate system robustness and reliability through model in the loop (MIL) and hardware in the loop (HIL) setups. Support verification and validation efforts for advanced microgrid control architectures. AI & Engineering Productivity Develop AI agents and automation tools to enhance sales applications engineering, technical support, and internal engineering workflows. Investigate emerging AI technologies and their application to power systems, controls engineering, and customer support. Systems Engineering & Innovation Support development of engineering standards, analytics processes, and best practices. Engage with Generac's academic and national laboratory partners to investigate emerging technologies and evolving industry challenges. Requirements Education Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Mechanical, Electrical, or Computer, Energy Systems Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math or related technical discipline. Strong interest in data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or large-scale technical data analysis . Ability to clean, analyze, visualize, and interpret complex data sets. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. “We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.”

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern - Research and Development - Defense Lab Support
jobs.location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America
jobs.body: Job Description About the Job Join General Motors Research & Development as a Summer Research Intern supporting the Vehicle Defense Research group within the Safety, Engineering and Defense Research Lab. In this role, you will contribute to applied research involving military systems, defense technology, vehicle platforms, and emerging technologies. You will work with experienced research scientists and engineers to evaluate current and emerging defense capabilities, apply evidence-based analysis, and help translate research concepts into vehicle, system, and software applications for federal and defense customers. This internship is designed for a current undergraduate student who has a strong interest in defense technology and a demonstrated knowledge of, and passion for, military systems. The Role As a Summer Research Intern, you will support research planning and execution across defense-focused technical domains. You will collaborate with GM researchers, engineers, and external partners to conduct research, support technical analyses, document findings, and communicate recommendations. You may contribute to projects involving: Military systems and Soldier systems Ground vehicle platforms, mobility, and performance Emerging warfare concepts and defense technology trends Modeling, simulation, and experimentation Defense software and hardware systems Vehicle safety, testing, and assessment Human-machine interaction and user experience Autonomous systems and advanced vehicle technologies The specific project assignment will depend on business needs, your academic background, and your technical interests. What You’ll Do: Support research projects by gathering information, conducting analysis, and documenting methods and results. Research military systems, defense technologies, vehicle platforms, and emerging warfare trends. Assist with technical assessments of current and proposed R&D projects for defense applications. Support modeling, simulation, testing, experimentation, and evaluation activities as appropriate. Collaborate with research scientists, engineers, program managers, and other technical stakeholders. Prepare technical presentations, research summaries, reports, and project documentation. Participate in technical reviews and communicate research progress, findings, and recommendations. Help identify opportunities to apply research outcomes to future GM products, systems, and defense programs. Support university, government, national laboratory, and industry research partnerships as appropriate. Assist with identifying dual-use applications for technologies relevant to both civilian and military systems. Follow applicable requirements for classified information, export controls, intellectual property, and controlled unclassified information. Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and technically rigorous research environment. More About Who You Are Passionate about military systems, defense technology, and national security applications. Curious, analytical, and motivated to understand how complex systems operate in real-world environments. Interested in applied research and the transition of research findings into practical vehicle, system, or software capabilities. Comfortable learning new technical domains and working across multiple disciplines. Able to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Able to work independently while seeking guidance and collaborating effectively with a research team. Committed to responsible handling of sensitive, proprietary, and potentially classified information. Required Qualifications: U.S. Citizenship is required Pursuit of a Bachelor’s degree in one of the following areas: engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, military science, national security, or a related technical or defense-focused field. Must be a current student Able to work fulltime, 40 hours per week during the summer months Demonstrated knowledge of and passion for military systems, defense technology, military operations, or related subjects through coursework, research, projects, military experience, extracurricular activities, or personal study. Strong analytical, problem-solving, research, and technical writing skills. Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with scientists, engineers, military stakeholders, and program managers. Ability to work in a hybrid environment and meet project milestones during the summer internship. Preferred Qualifications: Currently pursuing, or planning to pursue, a master’s degree or Ph.D. in engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, military science, national security, or a related field. Prior research, coursework, project, internship, or military experience involving defense systems, military platforms, high performance ground vehicles, simulation, experimentation, testing, or assessment. Familiarity with vehicle systems, defense acquisition, systems engineering, requirements development, verification and validation, or technology transition. Experience with programming, data analysis, modeling, simulation, numerical methods, or technical visualization. Experience presenting technical work through publications, posters, conference presentations, project reviews, or competitions. Experience with one or more of the following: vehicle performance, autonomous systems, robotics, controls, human-machine interaction, defense software, advanced powertrain, electrification, or power systems. Experience with automotive research, testing, or development. Active U.S. Security Clearance as of the first day of work. This position requires eligibility to access classified information at the Secret U.S. Security Clearance level for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship . The successful candidate must have eligibility to obtain a security clearance at that level. GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). From our origins in a Palo Alto garage in 1939, to our current position as one of the world’s leading technology companies, HP has grown to become a leader in technology and corporate culture, inspiring innovators, and entrepreneurs around the globe. HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, and services to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries. The AI Applied Engineering Intern will support the optimization of HP’s Agentic AI ecosystem for edge devices. jobs.title: Nuclear Engineering Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.location: Alameda, CA, Albuquerque, NM, Oak Ridge, TN
jobs.body: Company Overview Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables. Please note: This is a pipeline posting for anticipated Summer 2027 internship opportunities. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis as internship positions are approved and hiring needs are identified. Job Summary Kairos Power is offering exciting opportunities for students to join our Nuclear Engineering organization for Summer 2027. This internship provides a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of the analytical tools, computational methods, and engineering infrastructure supporting the safety case for the Hermes Reactor and future commercial reactor fleet. Interns will work alongside experienced engineers and scientists on meaningful technical projects involving reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, structural materials, computational modeling, licensing, and nuclear safety analysis. Contributions from each intern play an important role in advancing Kairos Power's mission to deliver innovative nuclear technology that addresses climate change. Areas with potential internship opportunities: Core Design (Radiation Transport and Shielding Design, Radiation Detection, Reactor Physics (Neutronics and Thermal Hydraulics), and Fuel Cycle Analysis) Thermal and Safety Methods - KP-SAM Code Development Fuel Performance - KP-BISON Source Term Modeling Development Structural Materials Analysis Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) Methods and Analysis Nuclear Critical/Safety Analysis Licensing Engineering Overall Analysis support such as Piping and Layout Analysis and Thermal Design and Rapid Technology Development Analysis General Responsibilities Support the design, development, verification, and validation of analytical tools, computational models, and engineering methods supporting reactor safety and performance analyses. Perform engineering analyses and computational modeling related to assigned technical focus areas such as reactor physics, radiation transport, thermal hydraulics, structural mechanics, computational fluid dynamics, or nuclear safety. Assist with research and technology development projects focused on improving reactor safety, performance, efficiency, and commercialization. Support verification and validation of engineering models through comparison with experimental data, benchmark problems, or reference solutions. Analyze engineering data and prepare technical documentation supporting engineering decisions and technology development. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges and support project objectives. Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, presentations, and project documentation to communicate technical results and recommendations. Participate in technical reviews, team meetings, and cross-functional discussions to broaden understanding of multidisciplinary reactor engineering. Engage in training, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities to strengthen technical and professional development. Maintain accurate engineering documentation and organized project records supporting knowledge transfer and engineering quality. Follow established engineering practices, safety procedures, and quality requirements throughout assigned work. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Current student enrolled in and pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Nuclear Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Engineering Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field with an emphasis in nuclear reactor applications. Demonstrated application of technical skills outside of the classroom through laboratory work, research, extracurricular projects, personal projects, or prior internship/work experience is highly preferred. Familiarity with engineering analysis, computational modeling, or scientific computing tools. Experience with Python, MATLAB, or other programming languages is preferred. Exposure to physics-based modeling through coursework or research involving neutronics, thermal hydraulics, structural mechanics, CFD, or related technical areas. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.). Self-starter, critical thinking and problem-solving skills Proven team player with excellent verbal, written communication/presentation, and interpersonal skills Ability to work with highly collaborative team Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently Prioritizes and ensures safety of oneself and others Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges and issues Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Working knowledge of nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, or related engineering principles acquired through academic coursework, laboratory experience, research projects, or prior internship experience. Understanding of engineering fundamentals including reactor physics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, structural mechanics, radiation transport, or related engineering disciplines applicable to assigned work. Ability to apply analytical thinking and engineering fundamentals to solve technical problems with guidance from experienced engineers. Familiarity with scientific computing, computational modeling, numerical methods, and engineering simulation tools. Basic understanding of verification and validation principles for engineering analyses and computational models. Ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret engineering and experimental data to support technical decision-making. Ability to develop clear, accurate, and organized engineering documentation including technical reports, engineering calculations, and presentations. Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, C++, Fortran, or similar engineering software tools is desirable. Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, organized, and high-quality technical work. Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams. Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and willingness to learn new engineering concepts, computational methods, software tools, and reactor technologies. Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet project deadlines. Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced engineering and research environment. Commitment to safety, integrity, continuous learning, and professional development. Ability to proactively document, organize, and share technical knowledge with teammates and mentors. Physical Conditions Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods Communicating with others to exchange information Environmental Conditions General office environment Accessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced Safety and PPE Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes The hourly range for this position is $31-35 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, the market data for your work location, and a comparison to other employees already in the role. About our Benefits We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below: Competitive compensation packages Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents Paid Vacation 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA) Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. jobs.body: Overview Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities Want to be at the cutting edge of Research and Development in cellular Networks and AI? jobs.title: Engineering Intern 1
jobs.body: The group you’ll be a part of The Office of the CTO is where innovation takes center stage. We inspire our global technical community to take on grand challenges, understand emerging trends, identify the critical inflections, and drive our sustainability, Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices that will define the next generation of semiconductors and continued impact. The impact you’ll make We are looking for an internship candidate who wishes to strengthen their skills in Explainability and Interpretability for probabilistic / Bayesian surrogate models and Bayesian Optimization (BO). The internship will focus on Bayesian surrogate model interpretability and explainable Bayesian Optimization techniques over controlled synthetic functions and real semiconductor data. What you’ll do Explore the Explainable AI literature and come up with relevant methods suitable for interpreting Bayesian surrogate models Develop methods to interpret modeled correlations among model outputs and compare learned relationships with known synthetic function / real data properties Create post-hoc explanations for the recommended solution selected via BO, clarifying the model evidence and optimization logic that led to the selected recipe Implement reproducible experiments on synthetic test functions / real data, performing surrogate modeling, BO and explanation pipelines in Python Investigate interpretable representations of correlation, latent structure, and information sharing across outputs Develop local post-hoc explanation methods for BO recommended solutions such as feature/parameter attribution, counterfactual analysis, sensitivity analysis, or decomposition of predictive and acquisition quantities Define fidelity, stability, consistency, and usability criteria; validate explanations using known synthetic function properties or real data Create clear visualizations and concise technical documentation suitable for Data Scientists and process-development stakeholders Who we’re looking for Master or PhD students with strong interest and foundation in statistical machine learning, probabilistic modeling, explainable AI, and Bayesian Optimization Strong knowledge on Gaussian Processes, kernel methods, uncertainty quantification, and Bayesian Optimization Strong Python programming and debugging skills; experience with PyTorch, GPyTorch, BoTorch, NumPy, Pandas, and visualization libraries is preferred Knowledge on correlation analysis, feature attribution / importance, sensitivity analysis, predictive model explanations, and BO decision explanations Experience with synthetic benchmark functions, causal reasoning, spatial data, or structured outputs is advantageous Self-driven, collaborative, and able to communicate technical results clearly. jobs.title: System Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Standard Job Description As a Systems Engineer you will be working on mission critical software for the control and analytics of uncrewed vehicles and systems. Lockheed Martin Skunk Works Canada software is deployed globally in Small (SUAS), Medium (Shadow RQ-7), Large (Grey Eagle MQ-1C), and high altitude pseudo satellite (HAPS) systems as well as surface vehicles and target systems. As part of the Skunk Works team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting edge next generation ground control system platforms as well as computer vision and AI applications in the air and on the ground. We're looking for a systems engineering intern to play a critical role in engineering mission critical software for uncrewed vehicles. Primarily, system engineers support the development of these systems by developing the requirements, creating the system design, integrating completed components and testing against the original requirements. You will work tightly with developers to form a cohesive, cross functional team capable of bringing products from mission scenarios to a tested, polished, final product. Job Summary / Key Responsibilities: Assists in performing technical planning, system integration, verification and validation for total systems. Helps to capture the customer or product requirements for total systems and assists in defining the requirements that apply to Skunk Works Canada development. Defines and executes tests necessary to demonstrate compliance with the defined set of requirements Assists in integration of multiple components and systems for testing purposes Duties may also include: Opportunities to travel for on-site integration, training, flight trials Opportunities to participate in local (Calgary area) LM CDL flight testing operations Voluntary participation on LM CDL’s social committee Basic Qualifications Educational Credentials This is a 16-month internship position available engineering students who have completed their third year. This position will be of interest to students who are in: Computer Engineering; Geomatic Engineering; Avionics Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Electrical Engineering (with a Computer Minor program). Experience, Skills and Talents Ability to work within a dynamic and fast paced team. Enjoys working in a collaborative team environment Continually learn and improve based on focused feedback. Strong verbal and written communication skills Eligible for Canadian Controlled Goods clearance. Desired Skills Desired Skills: While not required to apply for this position, the following skills and experience align with Lockheed Martin Skunk Works' core business competencies and our future growth areas: Experience performing Systems Engineering activities associated with Model Based applications. Ability to present and communicate systems analyses and proposal in a professional manner for executive and customer review. Some familiarity with agile software development process and test driven software development
