jobs.title: Undergraduate Engineering Intern - Project Management
jobs.body: This undergraduate internship is a full-time position Summer-Fall 2027 (May or June through December) on site in Rochester, Minnesota. Some interns have been able to maintain an on-line evening college course, but accepting this position requires the intern to not pursue any significant coursework for the summer or fall of 2027. The Mayo Clinic Engineering team is looking for an intern to assist our full-time project managers. The primary purpose of the Engineering Internship is to provide students with relevant engineering experiences. The position offers a wide range of job responsibilities, including: implementing improved portfolio management processes; assisting project managers in developing and maintaining project schedules and budgets; communicating with stakeholders (including clinicians and researchers) and drafting project requirements; drafting product documentation (technical writing); gathering metrics to track progress toward strategic goals; helping develop and document best practices in product development; and creating custom reports related to the project portfolio to help make strategic decisions. Mentors will be assigned to provide instruction, guidance and to assess performance. The intern is responsible for learning the Engineering team’s procedures and processes. The intern will be given work assignments to reinforce the learning experience and to provide benefit to the work unit as well as providing an opportunity to present their work accomplishments in an end of term presentation. The assignments may include developing a project strategy, creating and managing project schedules, gathering user needs, requirements and specifications, evaluating commercial components, performing design verification and design validation, and participating in design reviews. Assignments are within the context of Engineering’s Quality Management System (including safety risk management) and are performed in a multi-disciplinary development engineering environment. The intern will be responsible for completing all internship-related assignments and reports for both Mayo Clinic and the participating educational facility (if applicable). The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; have strong technical writing skills and be able to author technical documents; demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams; work independently; have experience in new product development; have experience with project management tools (e.g. ClickUp, Microsoft Project); have proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Office, SharePoint, Teams, and Excel to manage data and create reports; and have a desire to learn about medical device development. The candidate will learn development processes and documentation requirements of medical device creation; gain experience conducting stakeholder interviews to elicit needs and requirements; lead meetings to gather content for product support documentation, verification, and validation; gain project hours that would provide experience needed for pursuing the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. The incumbent must be enrolled in an engineering, management information systems, or other technology-related degree program from an accredited college or university and have completed a minimum of four semesters – or the equivalent – of instruction toward their degree. ***To be considered for this position please attach the following to your application: 3.3 GPA or higher Undergraduate Transcript Resume or CV Applicants are strongly encouraged to include a Cover Letter

jobs.title: DRAM Layout engineer (Intern)
jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. SUMMARY: At Micron, we focus on developing groundbreaking silicon-to-systems solutions. We handle technology development, advanced memory builds, product development, system development, and validation to create world-class memory solutions. In this position, you will collaborate with Micron’s global design, layout, and verification teams to develop high-quality physical layouts for cutting-edge DRAM products. You will gain hands-on experience in semiconductor layout building, physical verification, and industry-standard Electronic Compose Automation (EDA) tools. RESPONSABILITIES: Design and Verify All Levels of Analog and Digital Layout Use computer aided design software (i.e. Cadence, Calibre, etc.) Work with Design Engineers to floor plan and design layout Understand and follow verification protocols Apply custom and/or automated layout techniques to design pitch, array, and peripheral layout for digital and analog circuits. Collaborate with build engineering to understand layout methodology. Possess basic understanding of circuit design and electronics. jobs.title: Chip Level Defect Localization and Failure Analysis Engineer - RDSS Intern
jobs.body: By submitting your resume, you’re expressing interest in our 2027 RDSS (Research and Development Substitute Services) program. Please confirm your eligibility with the local district office before applying for the role. Welcome to the world of NVIDIA, where innovation knows no bounds. We've been at the forefront of technology for over two decades, and our groundbreaking invention of the GPU in 1999 revolutionized not only an industry but also the very way we engage with computers, robots, and autonomous vehicles. Today, NVIDIA stands at the forefront of AI computing and is committed to continue pushing the limits of what is achievable. Join us on this remarkable journey as we shape the future every day. Today, visual computing is becoming increasingly central to how people interact with technology, and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team! We are looking for a skilled, creative, and highly motivated RDSS Intern in the field of Electrical Failure Analysis to join the electro-optical FA team in Hsinchu, TW. What you'll be doing: Your main job will be to perform electro-optical failure analysis including Photon-Emission, Laser-Voltage-Probing and Soft-Defect-Localization (aka SDL, LADA...) to support product development, design-debug, yield-ramp, reliability and customer return analysis of advanced flip chip devices manufactured in the most advanced CMOS technology. The work requires in-depth understanding of scan-chain based logical test. Based on production test results (e.g. error-logs, flop mapping and SW-diagnosis) you will narrow down the logically failing area with the goal of locating the one failing FET or cell out of the whole chip. Most analyses will require you to setup test-loops within our Advantest 93k tester SW. Additionally, you will use CAD layout tools for in-chip navigation and circuit simulation tools to aid your analysis. The goal is that our EFA results enable different Physical FA teams local and abroad to find the actual physical root-cause. Based on our work and the resulting PFA findings, our Foundry partners can improve their process technology and increase our product yield and reliability. You will need basic Unix skills because the CAD, circuit simulation tools and 93k tester SW are all run in a Unix environment. Design-debug and more complicated defect localizations will often require you working in multi-functional teams (e.g. with Design for Test, Test-Engineers and Product-Engineers, sometimes around the globe..) including presenting & explaining your results. To guide such team and PFA efforts you will need deep understanding of transistor physics, the CMOS fabrication processes and PFA tools/techniques such as SEM, TEM, FIB & AFM. Support Die Probe Package second-source development for A16 FA readiness. What we need to see: Master's or PhD degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or other related field Basic understanding of DFT for large-scale logical test (scan-chain based structural and at-speed testing and basics of test compression). Experience working in a lab, setting up and debugging test environments. / Functional knowledge of transistor device physics & advanced CMOS manufacturing processes. / Test bring-up in the Advantest 93k test environment. Knowledge of CAD layout tools, logic circuit simulation tools and Unix operating system. / Software languages that may be of use include PERL, TCL, C++, STYLE. Good written and verbal communication skills are critical.

jobs.title: Working Student in Packaging Logistics
jobs.body: For over a decade, the Bosch Cluj Plant has become a strategic hub for innovation and production, making a significant impact on the technological landscape in Romania. Through our constant commitment to excellence in quality and innovation, we develop a diverse range of modern products for the mobility industry, focusing on delivering cutting-edge solutions to our international customers. Inspired by passion for technology, we have consistently evolved, solidifying our position as the most desired employer in Cluj for the engineering and business candidates. We pay special attention to the development of our community, inspiring future generations and governing our impact on the environment. Our promise to our colleagues is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and inspire each other. Join us and see the difference. Work LikeABosch Support daily operational logistics tasks related to packaging processes and material flow; Assist in preparing and maintaining report s on packaging performance, inventory and testing results; Manage and update customer and supplier information in internal systems and documentation; Operate label printing systems and ensure accurate labeling of packaging materials; Handle packaging testing equipment to perform quality and durability assessments; Document test results and support analysis for packaging improvements and compliance; Coordinate with internal teams to ensure packaging standards and procedures are followed; Participate in packaging material audits and support corrective actions; Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in packaging logistics and testing workflows; Support administrative tasks such as data entry, filing and organizing packaging documentation. Education: Undergraduate Student / Master in Purchasing, Economics, Mechanical Engineering, Logistics ; Excellent computer operating skills: Microsoft Office ( Excel ), SAP; Good knowledge of English is mandatory. Personality: You are well organized , focused and able to meet strict deadlines; Your mindset is based on improvement and growth ; You bring positive attitude. LikeABosch Benefits: 25 days of annual leave – because your work-life balance is essential to us Annual performance bonus up to two salaries – we appreciate your contribution to the company’s success Annual salary review – we want you to feel fairly compensated for your hard work and dedication Gift tickets worth 300 RON for Christmas and Easter Flexible benefits – you will benefit from a monthly benefit budget that offers the possibility to customize the benefits package to suit your individual needs and preferences (You can opt for meal tickets worth 30 RON for every worked day or you can benefit from cultural tickets, gift tickets, or vacation vouchers, and discounts at restaurants, dentistry, shops, and many more) Referral bonus - we encourage you to refer new candidates and you will be rewarded for it Relocation package – we are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive work environment, so if you are recruited from another county, you will receive a special relocation bonus for 2 years which will help you to get settled in Cluj Lunch discount – we have two canteens within our plant where you can eat your lunch at subsidized price Flexible working hours – so that you can balance you work and personal obligations more effectively Ability to work from the satellite Bosch location in Cluj-Napoca when it’s more convenient for you to do so Home Office policy – you will benefit from a hybrid working model which takes into consideration the needs of each department in the plant and offers you the possibility to work from home when it is practical and convenient for you Private medical insurance because health is a priority to us Development Trainings - we have our own team of dedicated trainers that are providing specific trainings for personal and professional growth. jobs.title: Undergraduate Placement Year 2027 – Engineering Electrified Systems Intern
jobs.body: We’re the nation’s favourite heating brand, here to warm up people’s homes, lives, and futures. From boilers, hybrids and heat pumps to solar thermal and smart controls, we’re giving our customers plenty of choice. With cutting-edge tech and research, we’re right in the thick of the drive for a better future of home heating. It’s not all tools and tech. People are the real heart of our company. We connect with our customers to deliver genuinely helpful support, and we care about our employees and give them enriching careers. We work hard, we work together, and we work with a cause – delivering brilliant customer support and exceptional engineering. As an organisation of more than 1,600 employees, we also take our role in the communities we serve seriously. From giving away free heating systems for community spaces, to our charity, education, and volunteer work – we’re no strangers to rolling our sleeves up, getting stuck in, and helping out. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, we’d love to meet you. Come and work #LikeABosch at Worcester Bosch. Join us for your placement year in summer 2027! Our internships are designed to give you an insight into what it's like to work for a world-renowned brand with a culture of support and community. Sitting within the Research & Development department, this role is to support both the mechanical and electrical Engineer(s) in the Electrified Solutions team at Bosch Home Comfort UK Ltd. It is aimed at someone wanting to get an in-depth engineering experience In this role, you will be responsible for: Working within a project team to assist with various tasks such as drawings, CAD 3D models, ECR and BOMs to ensure the overall project goals are achieved. To support the development test team with test regimes of our future products. Update any reports on the design status on a regular basis. Using knowledge of both mechanical and electrical design to aid with topics ranging from drawing/modifying structures, testing performance of future products, to helping develop electrical harnesses, across a variety of projects. Employ sound problem-solving and analysis to help identify issues as well as options for mitigation of issues. Interested? Upload your CV and a Cover Letter today! Please note that to be eligible for this role, you must be an undergraduate student seeking a placement year as part of your degree - if you do not meet these criteria please consider applying for other positions. Our ideal candidate should have: Be a genuinely self-motivated individual. Be meticulous with an eye for detail. Be flexible and agile with their approach to completing tasks being able to swap between tasks with ease. Have the confidence to keep asking questions until they understand the task. Be curious and ask ‘what happens if we do this’. Have the confidence to raise their own ideas in the presence of others. Be able to take constructive feedback. Have perseverance and patience. Right To Work: please ensure you have a valid Right To Work in the UK status for the entirety of the placement year upon submitting an application. Deadline for Applications: 27/11/2026 Please note, we reserve the right to close this vacancy at any time so we encourage candidates to submit their applications as soon as possible. Expected Start Date: July 2027 Please note that this date is advisory and can be flexible within reason. Contract Duration: 1 year Working Hours: 39 hours per week – standard working pattern of 08:00 – 17:00 Monday to Thursday and 08:00 – 16:00 Friday with a 1-hour lunchbreak Working with us comes with the following benefits: 20 days annual leave per year plus bank holidays Access to the Perkbox Benefits platform Discounts on products from across the Bosch Group Enhanced pension contributions Access to Bosch Social Club membership offering you and up to 5 friends and family discounts on excursions and events Volunteering days Policy to support growing families Health & wellbeing support including: over 200 trained mental health first aid champions, free of charge employee assistance programme And more!

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a Systems Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Long Beach, California, you will have the opportunity to support the Space Systems Division in the development of the Assembly Integration and Test sequence. The Systems engineering team act as the main communication node for design development and issue resolution on Rocket Lab's satellites. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an engineering, physics or math discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship GPA of 3.0 or above 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE GPA of 3.5 or above 6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) Experience working with spacecraft hardware or test hardware Experience developing and running test scripts for space hardware Experience debugging hardware issues on development hardware ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027 COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS Pay Range CA: $28.00 USD Hourly You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts. Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion. Hourly Pay Range (CA Only) $28 — $28 USD WHAT TO EXPECT We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. Important information: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. jobs.title: Layout Design Intern-Dallas,TX
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is currently seeking a Layout Design Intern to join the team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a team that creates semiconductors that go into exciting and cutting-edge technologies like smart phones, cars, satellites, robotics, and numerous other applications. You will develop and prepare multi-dimensional layouts and detailed drawings of semiconductor devices from schematics and related geometry provided by design engineering. About the job This position will require the creation and management of integrated circuit (IC) layouts from start to finish. Using CAD software, you will floorplan, design, implement and verify analog integrated circuits. You will support the design engineers to reach goals in precision, speed, area, reliability, power and ESD requirements. You will also work with PE/Packaging engineers to assure reliable production capability and proper data preparation for fab hand-off, documentation, and archive. Some of your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to: Collaborating with Analog and Digital design teams and the global layout design community Understanding manufacturing rules and implementing layout to be robust and area-efficient Writing layout specifications, checking dimensions, and verifying completed art work Verifying that the layout is compliant with Design Rule Checks (DRCs) and Electrical Rule Checks (ERCs) Participating in layout design reviews Creating design flow automation Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position. Minimum requirements Currently pursuing an Associates or Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or related degree Minimum 3.0 out of 4.0 GPA Preferred qualifications: Working knowledge of electrical circuits such as resistance, capacitance, voltage and current Familiarity with Unix/Linux, Cadence Virtuoso, Assura LVS, DRC, or similar mixed signal EDA tools (Mentor, Synopsys) Basic proficiency in one or more coding languages such as Perl, Python, C, Cadence SKILL Familiarity with semiconductor device physics, analog circuits and their layout sensitivities Working knowledge of semiconductor processes and IC production flow including BJTs, Diodes, FETs, passive components, packaging and thermal design Working knowledge of layout-related matching techniques, on-chip parasitic sources and minimization, routing impedances and electromigration, and crosstalk Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery Put your talent to work with us as a Layout Design Intern– change the world, love your job!

jobs.body: Launch Your Career in Global HR Compliance: People eXperience Intern (Summer 2027) Step into the dynamic world of international human resources and make an impact on a global scale. As our People eXperience Compliance Intern, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple continents to navigate evolving labor standards, drive statutory reporting initiatives, and prepare our organization for next-generation compliance technology. About Us: Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress. For more information about Trimble (Nasdaq:TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com . What Makes This Role Great: In this role, you will gain hands-on international compliance experience by actively scoping legal and reporting requirements across our entire global footprint, covering every country where we employ talent. Key Exciting Responsibilities: Research and map statutory employment mandates and global reporting requirement directives across key international regions. Partner closely with regional People eXperience teams to identify requirement ownership, close compliance gaps, and streamline cross-border workflows. jobs.title: Summer Internship - Systems Engineer
jobs.body: Join us in our mission to commercialize fusion energy ⚡️ About Type One Energy Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. Established in 2019 and venture-backed in 2023, the company is led by a team of globally recognized fusion scientists with a strong track record of building state-of-the-art stellarator fusion machines, together with veteran business leaders experienced in scaling companies and commercializing energy technologies. If you are searching for the best new ideas and share our vision, join us as a Systems Engineering Summer Intern. This is what you need to know: Location: Knoxville, TN or Madison, WI Salary: $25-$30/hour, 40 hours per week Contract: 12-week contract, Summer 2027 (May 24th start date) Reporting to: Sr. Systems Engineer Your role in the mission: The Systems Engineering Intern will support the Systems Engineering team on a variety of projects that contribute to the development, documentation, and implementation of systems engineering processes and practices. This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with systems engineering tools, requirements, architecture, and day-to-day engineering activities. The intern may support one or more systems or projects depending on current business and engineering needs. This role is well suited for a student interested in learning how complex engineering systems are defined, organized, documented, and managed throughout their lifecycle. Key responsibilities could include: Support work in Cameo Systems Modeler on system requirements, functions, interfaces, and architecture. Assist with documenting and improving Systems Engineering processes, procedures, and workflows. Develop or enhance onboarding and training materials for Systems Engineering tools, practices, and processes. Provide day-to-day engineering support for an assigned system, subsystem, or project. Work with engineers and other technical stakeholders to gather and organize information needed to support systems engineering activities. Participate in team meetings, project discussions, and other activities to gain exposure to the broader engineering organization. What you'll need: Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in any engineering discipline or a master's degree in Systems Engineering or Industrial Engineering. Rising juniors, seniors, graduates, and graduate students are encouraged to apply. Interest in systems engineering, requirements management, system architecture, engineering processes, or complex technical systems. Ability to communicate technical information clearly through written documentation and presentations. Ability to work collaboratively with engineers and cross-functional team members. Willingness to learn new engineering tools, processes, and technical concepts. For questions about this position, please reach out to internships@typeoneenergy.com Type One Energy applies proven advanced manufacturing methods, modern computational physics and high-field superconducting magnets to develop its optimized stellarator fusion energy system. Our FusionDirect development program pursues the lowest-risk, shortest-schedule path to a fusion power plant over the coming decade, using a partner-intensive and capital-efficient strategy. Type One Energy is committed to community engagement in the development and deployment of its clean energy technology. For more information, visit www.typeoneenergy.com or follow us on LinkedIn. jobs.body: We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Summer Intern currently pursuing a degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering to join our Sustaining Engineering team. This internship provides a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in component analysis, product support, and engineering change management. The intern will assist in the evaluation of alternative components, support parts harvesting initiatives, and contribute to ongoing retrofit and obsolescence management projects. This internship provides a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in component analysis, product support, and engineering change management. The intern will assist in the evaluation of alternative components, support parts harvesting initiatives, and contribute to ongoing retrofit and obsolescence management projects. jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Perception Systems Engineering: Pedestrian Detection Precision
jobs.body: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. Waymo's Systems Engineering team works together to blend software and hardware systems in groundbreaking new ways. We set the high performance standards that ensure our vehicles run smoothly and keep passengers safe, then design and perform the tests that validate that performance. We're looking for talented teammates who’ll help us maintain strong teamwork and are passionate about driving results. Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship! You will: Determine and author requirements and verification items for detection models that cover pedestrians near the Waymo vehicle. Collect and analyze data from existing logs and/or structured tests to test these requirements and identify false-positive clusters. Run evaluations and triage results to track performance and identify release-over-release changes. Leverage the evaluation framework you build to highlight areas with headroom and help the Perception teams hillclimb. You have: Currently pursuing an Master's or PhD in a technical field, such as Engineering, Physics, CS, etc. Software engineering fundamentals Familiarity with systems engineering, particularly the logical flow of requirements to tests We prefer: Experience handling large data sets/queries (e.g., SQL, Python) and/or automating test flows Understanding of the fundamentals of an autonomous vehicle stack, including the data pipeline from sensors to Perception Existing knowledge/skills/experience related to the autonomous vehicle industry or other similar forms of automation Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in. The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements. Hourly PhD Pay $85 — $85 USD

jobs.title: Real Estate | Architecture Internship: NL Masterplan Development
jobs.body: Introduction The Corporate Real Estate (CRE) Business Partnership team develops long-term campus strategies that support ASML’s growth in the Netherlands. As part of this team, you will contribute to the NL Masterplan, a strategic document that guides the future development of ASML’s Dutch campuses. The campuses continue to evolve through business growth, new technologies, and changing workplace needs. This internship offers a unique opportunity to help shape future campus scenarios while working with multidisciplinary stakeholders. Your assignment During the internship, you will help maintain and further develop the NL Masterplan while exploring innovative ways to improve planning processes. You will work closely with stakeholders from different disciplines to collect insights, analyze future opportunities, and create clear, engaging content. You will also investigate how emerging technologies can support scenario development and decision-making. Your main responsibilities will be: Maintain and improve the NL Masterplan document, ensuring it is structured, accurate, and visually engaging. Gather, organize, and integrate information from stakeholders across the organization. Support the development and evaluation of future campus growth scenarios. Research opportunities to apply AI-enabled solutions to planning and analysis activities. Translate complex real estate and infrastructure information into clear, accessible content. Prepare materials that support stakeholder discussions and presentations. Contribute ideas that improve planning processes and long-term campus development. This is a master’s thesis/non-thesis internship for a minimum of 5 months, 5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027. Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are currently enrolled in a master’s degree in Real Estate, Architecture, Construction Management, Urban Planning, or a related engineering discipline. Have an interest in campus development, real estate strategy, and long-term planning. Are analytical and able to structure complex information into clear conclusions. Are collaborative and comfortable working with stakeholders from different backgrounds. Are proactive and take ownership of your work and deliverables. Have working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications; experience with Adobe InDesign is preferred. Have an interest in applying AI tools to improve analysis, reporting, or planning activities. The internship is suitable for students looking to apply academic knowledge in a real business environment. Whether you are completing a thesis project or gaining practical experience, you will have the opportunity to contribute to strategic decisions that will shape ASML’s campuses for years to come. Join us and help create future-ready work environments. Other requirements you need to meet: You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover I 2027/2028 - Starting date March 2027 until February 2028. We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating. The selection process will be during October 2026 until January 2027. What does this internship consists in ? Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future. You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant. jobs.body: > Requisition ID: 67866 Title: Technical Artist Intern Arthrex, Inc. is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. We are searching for an intern pursuing a degree in 3D Graphics, Engineering, Computer Science or Interactive Media to support the Medical Visualization team. A successful candidate will assist in the development of art processes, marketing content, upcoming products, and medical education. The individual will follow standards and guidelines for consistent corporate identity and follow pre-established process flows. Join our talented team at a global medical device company focused on Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™. This internship will run from January 2027 – April 2027. The ideal candidate will have the availability to work at least 25 hours per week at our Naples, FL facility. Create, refine, and optimize 3D assets, materials, textures, and shaders for products, anatomical structures, and virtual environments, including preparing and converting CAD models for real-time applications. Support AI-driven image and 3D asset generation workflows, content pipelines, and automation scripting efforts. Develop scripts and artist-facing tools to automate repetitive tasks, streamline 3D model preparation and asset processing, and improve artist workflows within real-time engines. Evaluate tools, plugins, and software development kits (SDKs) to support new features and document findings for team implementation. Design, prototype, and implement 2D and 3D user interfaces (UIs), motion graphics, and interactive visual elements for 3D environments, applying artistic skills to improve usability and visual quality. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Co-op Production Support
jobs.body: JOB DESCRIPTION Co-op Cycle: July 6th to December 18th Schedule: Monday- Friday 8: 00 am to 4: 3 0pm Location: Beverly, MA (Onsite ) * To support students commuting to our Beverly, MA facility, we offer a travel stipend . See the Commute section below. Ready to turn what you’re learning in the classroom into real -world impact? Axcelis is a global leader in ion implantation and semiconductor technology. Our co ‑ ops don ’ t just observe — they contribute . For more than four decades, we ’ ve been driving innovation in semiconductor manufacturing technology, working with the world ’ s leading chipmakers to power everything from smartphones to electric vehicles. As a co ‑ op, you ’ ll gain hands ‑ on experience , learn from industry experts, and make a real impact on projects that shape the future of technology . We are searching for o ur next group of engineering co-ops for a 6-month assignment at our Beverly, MA , facility. Our co- op program is designed to develop early career talent and build a strong pipeline of future engineers . Students gain hands-on exposure , work on real projects , and make meaningful contributions . Throughout the program, co- ops build technical skills , strengthen problem-solving abilities , and gain real-world experience that enhances both their academic learning and future career opportunities. About the Role As a Manufacturing Engineer Co -op (Production Support) , you’ll be exposed to the world of production operations that work with complex mechanical and electrical systems and strives to ensure we maintain efficient manufacturing processes. This position offers a strong learning environment for students eager to deepen their engineering skill set while contributing to real manufacturing solutions. What You’ll Do Support manufacturing systems for complex mechanical and electrical operations related to assembly of subassemblies, wire harnessing, robots, pneumatic, vacuum, cooling, and high-pressure systems, and module build and test Design and build of fixturing to aid in the assembly of complex products Develop or revise module and subassembly build procedures Originate corrections of BOMs and documentations to ensure fulfillment of Form, Fit, and Function while maintaining design intent Optimize the quality and productivity of a manufacturing cell by implementing lean principles, including but not limited to defining and documenting standard work via visual instructions (Kaizen, Six Sigma, etc.) Perform root cause analyses for quality defects and implement appropriate containment and corrective actions Drive prompt resolution of a diverse spectrum of product issues What We’re Looking For Applicants must be candidates for a Bachelor of Science degree in any of the following fields: Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering or similar programs. Experience with basic engineering tools such as Solidworks /Creo and AutoCAD Familiarity with mechanical and electrical equipment such as calipers, hand tools, DMMs, etc. Why Choose Axcelis for Your Co - op? Meaningful Work – Work on real projects that make a direct impact on our products, processes, and customers Leadership That Knows Your Name – Senior leaders are invested in our Co-ops’ growth and regularly engage with students throughout their assignment. Mentorship – Co-ops are matched with an experienced mentor to help them navigate the company, build connections, and succeed in their role. More Than a Co - op – Our co - op program is a key pipeline for full-time early career roles, giving you a strong starting point after graduation. Engaging Co - op Experience : Enjoy off-site co - op events, weekly c o - op m eetups, and company-hosted luncheons that help you learn, network, and feel part of the Axcelis team. Commute Information: To support students commuting to our facility, Axcelis provides a $1,000 travel stipend , paid as a lump sum in the first paycheck . Our headquarters in Beverly, MA , is located directly off Route 128 and just 10 minutes from the Beverly Train Station for those using public transportation. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT It is the policy of Axcelis to provide equal opportunity in all areas of employment for all persons free from discrimination based on race, sex, religion, age, color, national origin, disability status, medical condition (including pregnancy), veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Axcelis will provide reasonable accommodation necessary to enable a disabled candidate or employee to perform the essential functions of the position, unless the accommodation would create an undue hardship for the Company. U.S. BASE SALARY RANGE $20.42 - $35.70 This base salary range reflects the typical compensation for this role across U.S. locations. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level; individual pay is determined based on multiple factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, work location, and internal equity. The range provides the opportunity for growth and progression as you develop within the role. Base pay is one part of our U.S. total compensation package which includes eligibility in the Axcelis Team Incentive bonus plan, and comprehensive benefits package (for regular employees working 20+ hours a week).

jobs.body: University Internships: Manufacturing – 2027 opportunities Start date: May/June 2027 Duration : 12 weeks Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company? Join our innovative Internship Program The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students pursuing a Bachelors’ or Masters’ degree to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology. jobs.title: Manufacturing Process Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Job Title: Manufacturing Process Engineering Intern Job Description: Job Summary This internship provides hands-on experience in a chemical manufacturing plant producing functional materials in specialty chemical industry. The intern will support process engineering activities related to safety, manufacturing process control, quality management, and continuous improvement. This role offers practical exposure to industrial chemical processes and high-volume manufacturing environments. Key Responsibilities Support Operation team for daily manufacturing operations, including material preparation, mixing, process adjustment, and filtration. Collect, organize, and analyze process data and R&D samples. Assist in process optimization, productivity improvement, and cost-reduction initiatives. Support root-cause analysis for process deviations, defects, or operational issues (e.g., 5-Why, fishbone analysis). Assist with quality control testing and evaluation according to defined specifications at QC lab. Follow and promote EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) and quality standards within the plant. Support the preparation, review, and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and technical documentation and Quality control documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, QC lab, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and R&D. Requisite Criteria & Skills Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree or above in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Strong interest in chemical manufacturing processes and plant operations. Basic data organization and analysis skills (e.g., Excel, Minitab). High level of safety awareness and ability to follow established procedures. Preferred Knowledge of chemical processing or materials manufacturing. Experience with laboratory work, pilot-scale testing, or manufacturing environments. Basic understanding of statistical analysis or data-driven problem solving. Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English. Fluency in a second language (e.g., Japanese, Mandarin, Tamil) is a plus

jobs.title: Materials Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: MATERIALS ENGINEERING INTERN (SUMMER 2027) Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits. As a Materials Engineering Intern at Freeform, you will help establish and refine materials testing infrastructure and best practices for some of the world's most advanced metal 3D printing systems. You will work closely with experienced engineers to study material behavior within the printing process, building a foundational understanding of metals characterization and applying those insights to support materials testing and process improvement. You'll collaborate with process development, mechanical, and simulation engineers to analyze material property data and post-print characteristics, contributing to rapid iteration and continuous improvement of the printing technology. 3D printing experience is not required to be successful here, we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving hard problems and creating amazing technology! Responsibilities: Assist the Materials Engineering team in operating equipment to measure material properties such as tensile strength, surface roughness, and microstructure Support generation and tracking of quality metrics for printed customer parts such as dimensional accuracy, defect distribution, and surface roughness Organize, analyze, and help interpret materials data, and assist in presenting key findings Assist in developing and optimizing metallurgical sample preparation techniques such as cutting, grinding, polishing, acid etching, and optical microscopy Support the process development team in tying materials findings into upstream printing process improvements Help establish and refine procedures for measuring and quantifying material quality Basic Qualifications: Currently pursuing Bachelor's degree in materials science, materials engineering, metallurgy, mechanical engineering, or similar discipline Experience with experimental design and statistical data analysis Strong data analysis skills and ability to interpret important information from extremely large data sets Nice to Have: Undergraduate research experience in materials science, metallurgy, or mechanical engineering Exposure to metallurgical sample preparation such as cutting, grinding, polishing, acid etching, and optical microscopy Experience with metal additive manufacturing or laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) processes Experience operating materials characterization equipment (SEM, Instron, etc.) Experience with statistical data analysis software such as R, JMP, or Minitab Passion for improving the state of metal 3D printing Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and iterating quickly (comfortable building the plane as we fly it) Strong communicator who collaborates across disciplines and proactively seeks support when needed Willing to take ownership of tasks big and small, with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset Strong work ethic with a refuse-to-fail mindset Demonstrated indicators of excellence and/or achieving success against adversity (i.e. top academic performance, leadership in engineering clubs, first-generation college student, or other examples of resilience and achievement) Location: Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R&D, and production together under one roof. jobs.body: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. jobs.title: Hardware Summer Intern 2027
jobs.body: Location: Bristol, UK Duration: 12 weeks Salary: £2500 per month Start date: June 2027 Applications deadline: Midnight, 29 th November We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. The Internship Programme at Graphcore Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. What you’ll be doing Put your engineering foundations to work exploring the electronic hardware behind Graphcore’s AI compute platforms. Your internship could focus on Hardware Design, Signal Integrity or elements of both, depending on your interests, the available projects and how your strengths develop. You’ll contribute to a clearly scoped design, analysis, validation or debugging task, with guidance as you work towards a conclusion supported by evidence. In Hardware Design, your tasks could include schematic and circuit design, component evaluation, PCB development, board bring-up or laboratory testing. You could help check power rails and clocks, exercise interfaces, investigate faults or develop test and debug access. In Signal Integrity, you could explore high-speed links such as PCIe and Ethernet, DDR and other memory interfaces, or clocks and timing-critical signals. Tasks could include reviewing PCB layouts and routing, simulating interconnect behaviour or comparing laboratory measurements with analysis to understand design trade-offs. Your team and support Hardware Design and Signal Integrity engineers work closely with PCB layout, silicon, validation, firmware, mechanical and thermal engineering, manufacturing and system teams. You’ll see how different engineering perspectives come together to make complex boards work. Staff Hardware Engineers and Team Leads will support you with clearly scoped work and regular technical guidance. You can ask for help as you explore unfamiliar concepts, discuss your findings and use feedback to improve your approach. Decisions are shaped by simulation, measurement and engineering judgement. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, speak up and try out ideas early, with support from experienced engineers as you learn. How you’ll learn and grow Over the 12 weeks, you’ll connect your studies with how boards are designed, analysed, brought up and validated. Your project will help you develop a methodical approach to defining a problem, testing your thinking and explaining what the evidence shows. You’ll gain exposure to professional tools such as Mentor Expedition, Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS, as relevant to your work. Comparing simulations, design choices and laboratory results will help you understand how real hardware behaves and which areas of hardware engineering you’d like to explore further. Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated. What we're looking for Currently studying towards a degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a closely related technical discipline Strong electrical and electronic engineering foundations, with an interest in hardware design or signal integrity and how real electronic systems work A logical, first-principles approach to unfamiliar problems, with practical engineering experience from university projects, laboratory work, personal projects or activities such as Formula Student, robotics or engineering societies The ability to work with measurements or technical data and explain your conclusions clearly, with curiosity, willingness to take ownership and openness to feedback and collaboration Your interests might include schematic design, PCBs, component selection, bring-up, validation, test or fault finding; or transmission lines, impedance, reflections, crosstalk, simulation and electronic measurement. Previous industry experience and professional experience with the tools listed above are not required. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned. Benefits Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. Sponsorship Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities. Introduction to Graphcore At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. An internship at Graphcore gives you the chance to explore where your interests and skills could take you. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. Together, you’ll share ideas and solve challenging problems, building experience and confidence to help you decide what comes next. How to apply and what to expect To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring. Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern - Global Construction Engineering
jobs.body: Job Details: Job Description: Global Construction Engineering (GCE) supports the design and engineering of Intel's major manufacturing and cleanroom projects around the world. Join a collaborative team of architects and engineers working with factory, operations and supply chain partners to deliver complex facilities projects. As an intern, you will support experienced engineers, contribute to practical project activities and build your understanding of engineering design and construction. This multidisciplinary internship welcomes applicants from a range of engineering and built-environment disciplines. Depending on your background and project needs, you may support mechanical, electrical, civil and structural, chemical and process, automation and controls, or building information modelling (BIM) activities. You are not expected to have knowledge of every discipline. This position will be based in Malaysia. Responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Support preliminary studies and data collection for facilities improvement projects under the guidance of experienced engineers. Participate in supervised site walks and help document existing conditions and project requirements. Assist engineers with reviewing drawings, specifications and technical documents, and tracking questions for follow-up. Support coordination across design, construction, scheduling and estimating teams by preparing meeting notes and maintaining action trackers. Work with facilities operations partners and project teams to gather information and support assigned engineering tasks. Assist with basic calculations, data analysis, design documentation or model updates relevant to your discipline, with appropriate guidance and review. Help organize project cost and schedule information and prepare progress summaries for review. Learn and follow applicable safety requirements, engineering standards and document control processes; contribute ideas for improvement. Collaborate across disciplines and share project findings and lessons learned with the team. The successful candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits: Curiosity, willingness to learn and confidence to ask questions and seek guidance. Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach to working with people from different disciplines. Attention to detail, an organized approach and ownership of assigned tasks with appropriate support. Value for safety and a safe project environment. Qualifications: We welcome students from a broad range of disciplines who are interested in engineering and construction. Previous industry experience is not required. Preferred qualifications are helpful but are not requirements for applying. Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing a diploma or bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Electronic, Civil or Structural, Chemical, Mechatronics, Industrial, Environmental or other engineering disciplines; Architecture, Building Services, Construction Management, or a related technical or built-environment field. Applicants should have an interest in facilities design, construction or project delivery and a willingness to apply their academic learning in a multidisciplinary team. Preferred Qualifications: Coursework or academic projects related to engineering design, building systems, construction, manufacturing or sustainability. Basic ability to interpret technical drawings or analyse engineering information through coursework or projects. jobs.body: Overview Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities As an IC Test Engineering Summer Intern within the Keysight Labs/MMICs & Subsystems Organization at Keysight Technologies, you will contribute to the development, characterization, and validation of advanced monolithic millimeter-wave integrated circuits (MMICs), RF integrated circuits, and subsystems that enable next-generation electronic measurement solutions. Working alongside experienced IC test engineers, you will gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave measurement technologies. Key responsibilities include: Develop and execute RF, microwave, millimeter-wave, and DC characterization tests for MMICs, RFICs, and advanced semiconductor devices. Support design validation activities for leading-edge integrated circuits and subsystem technologies developed within Keysight Laboratories. Develop software tools, scripts, and automated test solutions to improve measurement efficiency, test coverage, and data quality. Analyze measurement data and prepare technical reports and presentations summarizing findings and recommendations. Collaborate with IC test engineers to define test requirements and verify circuit performance against design specifications. Troubleshoot measurement setups, instrumentation, test software, and hardware-related issues. Contribute to improvements in test methodologies, automation frameworks, and laboratory processes. Document test procedures, calibration methods, and engineering best practices. Present project results and technical conclusions to engineering teams at the completion of the internship. Qualifications Required Qualifications Currently pursuing a Master's (MS) or Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. Academic focus in one or more of the following areas: RF and microwave engineering Millimeter-wave systems Analog or mixed-signal integrated circuit design Electronic test and measurement Hands-on laboratory experience with electrical measurements and instrumentation. Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar engineering software environments. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary R&D environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with RF, microwave, or millimeter-wave measurements. Familiarity with test equipment such as Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Spectrum Analyzers, Signal Generators, Oscilloscopes, and Source Measure Units (SMUs). Experience developing automated test software or data analysis tools. Knowledge of semiconductor device physics and MMIC technologies. Familiarity with on-wafer probing, calibration techniques, and semiconductor characterization methods. Experience analyzing large measurement datasets using Python, MATLAB, JMP, or similar tools. Research or project experience involving MMICs, RFICs, III-V semiconductor technologies, high-frequency circuits, or advanced electronic measurement systems. jobs.body: Student Nurse Intern positions are available in Austin and Albert Lea. Interns may have the opportunity to rotate through multiple departments and locations, providing a diverse and well-rounded healthcare experience. More information will be provided at the time of offer. The Student Nurse Intern (SNI) performs delegated tasks of direct and indirect patient care with the supervision of a registered nurse (RN). The designated tasks are those which have been taught in the academic programs and/or orientation, and where the individual has demonstrated competence to a designated RN. Completion of two semesters in an Associate's in Nursing program, or completion of junior year in a Bachelor's in Nursing program required prior to start. Candidates must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Once accepted into the Summer Nursing Internship program, student interns will be required to enroll in a summer intern course at a university or college in Minnesota for the duration of the internship. Information will be provided to selected candidates upon offer acceptance. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association is required and must not expire during the internship. Reliable transportation is required. The internship will run for 10 weeks from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027. Applicants must be able to complete ten consecutive weeks of employment. The application deadline is December 31, 2026. Offers will begin going out the week of February 1, 2027. During the selection process you may participate in an OnDemand (pre-recorded) interview that you can complete at your convenience. During the OnDemand interview, a question will appear on your screen, and you will have time to consider each question before responding. You are interested in the relationship between user experience, technology, sustainability, materials and manufacturing. jobs.body: At Bosch Rexroth, everything revolves around movement and the success of our customers. With our networked drive and control technologies as well as digital solutions, their machines and systems work efficiently, safely and powerfully. We offer components, system solutions and services for mobile and industrial applications as well as for factory automation. In all areas, we value the know-how and commitment of our employees and enable dynamic careers in an international environment. Around 33,800 people in over 80 countries - and one corporate purpose: "We move industries to make our planet a better place." Do you want to make a difference? Then we look forward to receiving your application to Bosch Rexroth AG. Become part of the team and support us from the request for quotations to the final awarding of new business. During your internship, you will have the chance to support the preparation of and participation in annual price negotiations as well as contract creation. You will use your analytical skills creatively in procurement market research (scouting activities) and incorporate the results into the global parts family strategy. Additionally, you will be responsible for maintaining and updating data in our Supplier Relationship Management Tool or SAP. Finally, you will provide support within a supplier- or part-specific relocation project and gain experience in project management in an international environment. Education: studies in the field of Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Economics or comparable Experience and Knowledge: good skills in MS Office; initial experience in SAP desirable Personality and Working Practice: you are a strong communicator and team player who is highly motivated to learn new things while working independently Work Routine: your on-site presence is required Languages: very good in English and good in German beneficial Start: February 2027 Duration: 6 months (confirmation of mandatory internship required) Requirement for this internship is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, enrollment certificate, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit. jobs.body: The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology. Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting. jobs.title: Co-op, Warehouse Engineering
jobs.body: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description As an Engineering Co-op focused on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Warehouse Automation, you will be responsible for supporting AI-driven initiatives. These initiatives aim to improve warehouse productivity, operational efficiency, and process automation. You will work with warehouse team Leaders, and teams to identify opportunities, gather requirements, track project progress, and help implement solutions. Additionally, you will assist with data collection, process mapping, performance analysis, and the evaluation of automation opportunities. You will report directly to the Production Control Inventory Manager and will receive daily direction and operational input from Warehouse Team Leaders and important partners across the organisation. *Relocation assistance not provided for this role We are looking for full-time, traditional work hours for 8-12 months. Per Rockwell Automation policy, you must be located within 50 miles of this office. Location : On-site, Cambridge, Ontario, Canada. Your Responsibilities: Track project progress, maintain documentation, and communicate status updates, risks, and achievements to management and key stakeholders. Create process maps, standard work instructions, and project documentation to support successful implementation and sustainability of improvements. Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, IT, and Supply Chain teams to ensure project goals and requirements are met. Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations to measure project results, productivity improvements, and return on investment. Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to reduce manual tasks, improve data accuracy, and enhance warehouse processes. The Essentials - You Will Have: Actively pursuing a bachelors or advanced degree at an accredited college or university. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field. Interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, process improvement, and warehouse operations. Experience in Microsoft Office applications, Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with data analysis tools such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or similar technologies an asset. We will give preference to students with previous internship experience. Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, Power Automate, or similar tools. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement methodologies. Familiarity with SAP, ERP systems, or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). What We Offer: Health Insurance including Medical and Dental Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Paid holidays off This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. For this role, the hourly compensation is from $21-$32 CAD. Actual pay will be based on factors such as skills, knowledge, education, and experience. This posting is for a newly created position within our organization. At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. #LI-Onsite #DNI We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (519) 618-4899.
