jobs.title: Lab Operations Intern
jobs.body: About Etched Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across prefill and decode. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, we're redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. Job Summary Etched's lab keeps our hardware running 24/7. Our chips, modules, and racks are constantly being tested, and we need sharp, reliable hands to make it happen. You'll run test stations, assemble and rework hardware, cable racks, manage inventory, and own the day-to-day operations that turn raw silicon into working systems. You will see how a frontier AI chip goes from a tray of parts to a running rack, and reliable, curious interns take on engineering work over time. This role is for people genuinely excited about what we're building and willing to do real, often repetitive work with precision and care. Evening and weekend availability is a plus. This role is fully in-person in San Jose. You may be a good fit if you: - Have extreme attention to detail - Interested in both software and hardware - Are excited about learning how a hardware company works end to end - Are comfortable with hands-on work - Have evening or weekend availability - Curiosity and bias to action — see what needs doing and figure it out Strong candidates may also have: - Experience with software, mechanical engineering, or thermal systems - Understanding of accelerator hardware, or datacenter environments - Have owned or built hardware testing systems We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification. Program details - 12-week paid internship - Generous housing support for those relocating - Daily lunch and dinner in our office - Based at our office in San Jose, CA - Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers - Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time For any questions, contact internships@etched.com How we're different Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference. We are a fully in-person team in San Jose and Taipei, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Compiler Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Job Details: Job Description: Join Us in Shaping the Future At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities. The Team The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered. Position Overview We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on an engineering or research project that may involve compiler features, MLIR-based intermediate representations, Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), optimization, code generation, runtime or offload support, debug information, testing infrastructure, performance analysis, or developer tools. Projects may connect hardware capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for a graduate student who can apply deeper technical expertise to an ambiguous engineering or research problem, evaluate alternatives, and deliver a well-supported solution or prototype. Responsibilities • Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, or analysis of compiler and runtime technologies. • Develop and debug software in C or C++ within a large, collaborative codebase. • Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions. • Evaluate functional correctness, compile-time behavior, runtime performance, or code quality, as applicable to the project. • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and team members. • Document designs, experiments, results, and lessons learned, and present project outcomes to the team. • Contribute to open-source projects when aligned with the assigned work. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications • Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. • Graduate-level coursework, research, or project experience in compilers, programming languages, computer architecture, parallel computing, systems software, or a closely related area. • Experience programming in C or C++ and working with complex software systems. • Experience designing experiments, analyzing technical results, and communicating conclusions. Preferred Qualifications • Hands-on experience with LLVM or related compiler infrastructure, including front-end development, intermediate representations, optimization passes, code generation, runtimes, or debug information. • Research or development experience involving CPU/GPU architectures, heterogeneous computing, AI/ML compilation, HPC, parallel programming, or performance optimization. • Familiarity with LLVM, MLIR, Clang, Flang, SYCL/DPC++, Triton, OpenMP, CUDA, or another compiler or parallel-programming ecosystem. • Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. • Tile-base programming model knowledge • GPU Compute kernel writing experience • Experience contributing to open-source software or working in a large collaborative codebase. • Publications, technical reports, patents, open-source contributions, or other evidence of advanced technical work. Success in This Role • Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. • Clear written and verbal communication. • Ability to work independently on scoped tasks while seeking guidance when needed. • Collaborative mindset and commitment to high-quality engineering. Department Overview The Strategic Cost Management team supports Micron's global expansion by driving cost optimization, financial transparency, and supplier strategy across large-scale semiconductor construction projects. Through analytics, market intelligence, benchmarking, and AI-enabled solutions, the team helps ensure capital investments are delivered efficiently while supporting Micron's long-term growth objectives. You will work with Procurement, Construction, Finance, and Operations teams to evaluate cost performance, identify optimization opportunities, leverage AI-enabled tools, and provide data-driven insights that support strategic decision-making. Responsibilities Support construction cost planning, forecasting, benchmarking, and performance tracking activities across large capital projects. Analyze cost, supplier, market, and project data to identify trends, risks, savings opportunities, and improvement recommendations. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools that improve access to project costs, forecasts, and business performance. Collaborate with Procurement, Facilities Construction, Finance, and Operations teams to support decision-making, supplier analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Use AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve research, analysis, reporting, process efficiency, and operational effectiveness while promoting responsible AI use. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience using AI-enabled tools to support analysis, research, productivity, or decision-making. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, SharePoint, or similar platforms. Basic understanding of construction delivery models and contracting methods, including GMP, lump sum, unit price, and time-and-materials contracts. Familiarity with procurement systems, project management tools, or capital project execution methodologies. Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and interest in applying AI, automation, and continuous improvement practices to business processes and analytics. jobs.title: Relational Foundation Model Intern, Modern Data Stack – 2027
jobs.body: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join us! What you’ll be doing: Collaborate with researchers/engineers to enhance our Transformer and GNN-based models to operate seamlessly over any relational schema and heterogeneous graph. Gain hands-on experience with high-impact use cases such as forecasting, entity matching, customer retention and fraud detection – all built on top of a single, extensible foundation model. Apply your knowledge in ML and AI to address real challenges while contributing to scalable and adaptable solutions that push the boundaries of what’s possible. Work may span the full lifecycle of modern ML systems: from architecture design/training to post-training optimization and inference acceleration. What we need to see: Pursuing MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or equivalent program area Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch Coursework or research experience in crafting ML algorithm solutions Ways to stand out from the crowd: Familiarity with graph-based machine learning; publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, or similar NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Our internship pay is based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. Pay is pro-rated for the duration of the internship. The expected annual rates for this position are: Germany: 47,850 EUR – 82,940 EUR. France: 40,500 EUR – 70,200 EUR.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Safety Intern
jobs.body: About JLG, an Oshkosh company JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world. The Safety Intern will provide support to the JLG Safety department by working on a variety of safety related projects while gaining exposure to a variety of functional areas and business segments within the organization. YOUR IMPACT Conduct written program/procedure reviews and develop training curriculums based on these programs. Assist with accident investigations and follow-up with required corrective action. Develop and/or update safety and health training programs for various business units. Provide daily support to the safety department on a variety of safety projects. Assist and conduct internal compliance and injury reduction assessments to include follow through. Conduct ergonomic assessments and provide recommendations on potential improvements. Quantify and present safety & health statistics to the management team. Support and manage the Safety Management System (SMS) All other duties and projects as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Student working towards a Bachelor’s degree in Safety and Occupational Health or related field. STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS Ability to learn new programs quickly while working in a fast-paced work environment. Outstanding communication, organizational, and leadership skills are essential. Familiar with manufacturing and safety principles is a plus. Ability to work independently when necessary. Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. WORKING CONDITION The following represents general working conditions for this role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances. This role combines office-based administrative duties with physical activity in production environments. In the office setting, tasks may require extended computer use, sitting, and attending meetings. Field or floor work may involve walking across various terrains or shop floors, standing, moderate lifting (up to 50 pounds), climbing stairs, and exposure to varying temperatures or noise levels. Must be able to shift focus between detailed cognitive work and occasional physical tasks as needed. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities to support performance across both office and field responsibilities. Pay Range: $18.00 - $37.00 The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success. Oshkosh is committed to working with and offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. jobs.title: Human Resources Leadership Development Internship Program – Summer 2027
jobs.body: Job Description: Ignite your Career Journey with Pentair’s Leadership Development Internship Program! Are you ready to dive into a world of innovation and hands-on learning? Pentair invites ambitious and forward-thinking students to apply to join our summer internship program. 🚀 What Awaits You Embark on a 12-week experience where innovation, creativity and professionalism prosper. As an intern at Pentair, you will be provided with an immersive and collaborative career development experience guided by Pentair leaders who are invested in your growth. 🌎 Make a Difference Pentair’s interns are afforded the opportunity to explore their skillset hands-on while participating in a variety of professional development activities. Each intern will be assigned to a real-world, strategic business project that they will be immersed in for the summer. Interns will present their project objectives, processes, and overall results and impact to leadership at the conclusion of the internship program. 🌐 Professional Cohort Development In addition to a formal mentorship program, one-on-one coffee chats with Pentair leaders and weekly sessions with segment presidents, the entire intern cohort is flown to Minnesota for a professional development week. During the residency in Minnesota, interns will network with the Executive Leadership Team, volunteer as a cohort, and further develop their professional skills by participating in development sessions with the Learning & Development team, Pentair’s Business Resource Groups, the Culture & Inclusion team and many more. 💦 About Pentair: At Pentair, we believe the health of our world depends on reliable access to clean water. We design, manufacture, and deliver a comprehensive range of smart, sustainable water solutions to homes, business, and industries around the world. Whether it is improving, moving, or enjoying water, we help manage the world’s most precious resource. 👍 Pentair Will: Provide the opportunity to work with Human Resources leaders and teams in the areas of manufacturing operations, business unit or functional HR, HR Shared Services and HR Centers of Excellence (ie. Talent, L&D, Compensation, Culture). Provide the opportunity to complete meaningful projects as part of an HR team that benefit the site, business/function or COE you work with. Provide foundational HR experiences that help you build your HR acumen, advance your skills, and increase your understanding of HR’s impact on the organization Provide valuable business connections that extend beyond the HR function. Provide development and mentoring in line with Pentair’s development philosophy Pay competitively. Offer a variety of professional development, social, and volunteer events to help you make valuable connections throughout the summer months Provide the opportunity to deliver a professional presentation of your key learnings to the Pentair leadership team with the potential for a full-time position upon graduation Professional Development you can expect: Impactful Project-based assignments to hone your project and stakeholder management skills Build your network with colleagues and senior leaders in HR and throughout the organization Professional presentation skills to captive your audience and deliver an impactful message Deepen your skills in at least one core area of Human Resources Who we’re looking for: Self-starting individuals who possess the passion and drive to succeed Resilient and agile problem solvers Individuals with a sense of urgency and bias for action to operate in a fast-paced environment Proven leadership throughout your academic career Previous internship experience in is preferable Willing and able to relocate at time of hire and as your career progresses within the organization 📃 Minimum Qualifications: Be pursuing a Master’s Degree in Human Resources and Industrial Relations, Human Resources Management/Development or MBA from an accredited university Be enrolled as a first year Graduate student Have a strong interest in pursuing the Human Resources Leadership Development Program which will require at least one relocation over the three year program in locations throughout the United States upon graduation Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future ✅ Key Internship Information Key Information: 12-week internship program with two start date options: Session 1: Late May – Early August 2027 Session 2: Early June – Mid-August 2027 This position pays an hourly rate of $35.00/ hour . Interns work approximately 40-hours each week during the internship. Financial support may be offered to those relocating for Pentair’s Summer 2027 Internship Program. Posting End Date: March 1st, 2027 Equal Opportunity Employer Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

jobs.title: Process Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking a Process Engineering Intern within the Analog Technology Development (ATD) Group. We work to define and develop the next generation process and device technologies for TI. The metal system is critical for achieving reliable, low resistance interconnects for power devices, for enabling area scaling and high process yields to drive cost leadership and to achieve high precision resistors and capacitor components. The interconnect process integration engineer is a key member of a team that defines and develops the processes and process flows to achieve the interconnect performance and reliability needs, whether it be low resistance with good electro-migration capability for the latest high current applications or high precision resistors for high performance amplifiers. The role includes activities such as: defining electrical test circuits to assess process capability versus design rule, characterizing and analyzing process yield data, assessing the reliability of the metal and dielectric of the interconnect system, and then working within the team to drive the necessary actions to meet the yield and reliability needs for the technology. Minimum requirements: Currently pursuing PhD in areas such as Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or related engineering degree. Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Strong materials background in metal and/or dielectrics Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results, influential relationships Good listener and excellent verbal and written communication skills

jobs.body: Job Description: Feeling ready to spread your wings ? What if your adventure started with us ?! Whatever your dream job, we might have the internship for you ! Are you a student looking for an internship that will validate your degree and launch your career ? Imagine yourself at the heart of an internationally recognized company, established on every continent, and rich in diverse backgrounds, expertise, and cultures. Your mission : An internship opportunity titled Intern- Structures has just opened at Airbus India located in Bengaluru. You will join the Structures department. Ideally, this is a 6 months internship and it should start in Jan 2027 (date subject to flexibility). Internship Title: Continuum Damage Mechanics (CDM) based fatigue initiation prediction model integrated to Abaqus Brief: - Continuum Damage Mechanics (CDM) is a promising analysis methodology for better fatigue life prediction & currently has less maturity within Airbus - Objective to further mature the fatigue initiation prediction models developed previously for uniaxial and multiaxial models including aspects of plasticity and variable loading treatment. Job scope (core activities): Improve the finite element implementation of the previously developed models with required user inputs to integrate with Abaqus Adapt CDM models to higher complexity such as multiaxial loading, non-localization phenomenon, complex spectra, plasticity and analyze the results Validate the developed methods with PoC specimens and correlate with physical test results Summary of findings and preparation of report Pre-requisites: Sound knowledge of solid mechanics, finite element methods, plasticity and hardening principles Basic knowledge on structural fatigue Ability to derive broad conclusions from research articles Hands on experience with Abaqus along with experience with creating user subroutines preferably UMAT, USDFLD, UEXTERNALDB Good programming skills Good analytical and reasoning skills Tools: Abaqus, Fortran, Python Qualification: Graduate/Post graduate (Mechanical / Civil / Aerospace / Material Science / Applied Mechanics Engineering) Soft skills: Ability to work independently Good communication and interpersonal skills Flexibility & adaptability This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. jobs.body: Job Description The Role: We are seeking a highly motivated graduate or advanced undergraduate engineering student to support research and development activities focused on advanced ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation (NDE) technologies for next-generation manufacturing inspection systems. The intern will contribute to the development of next-generation in-line inspection technologies for manufacturing quality assurance and process monitoring through advanced sensing, modeling, and automation approaches. This position offers an opportunity to work on cutting-edge inspection technologies which may include wave propagation modeling, nonlinear acoustics, guided wave techniques, robotic inspection systems, and advanced data analytics. The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams spanning materials engineering, manufacturing, robotics, sensing technologies, and computational modeling. The intern will gain hands-on experience in: · Advanced NDE technologies in a manufacturing environment · Wave propagation modeling and simulation · Development and validation of manufacturing inspection technologies · Robotic inspection and sensor integration · Research execution, technical reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. · Application of advanced sensing and automation technologies to manufacturing quality challenges What You’ll Do: · Develop and validate models of wave propagation in engineering materials and manufacturing processes. · Support research involving advanced ultrasonic inspection methods, including: o Advanced ultrasonic techniques, e.g., nonlinear acoustics, guided wave testing, etc. o Advanced manufacturing inspection methodologies · Design and conduct laboratory experiments for nondestructive testing and evaluation · Analyze nondestructive measurement data and correlate results with manufacturing process conditions, material quality, and defect characteristics. · Assist in the development of in-line and automated inspection technologies for manufacturing environments · Support the integration of sensing technologies with inspection platforms · Participate in data analysis, visualization, and algorithm development for defect detection, characterization, and manufacturing process monitoring · Document research findings through technical reports, presentations, and experimental procedures · Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and technical specialists on advanced manufacturing and inspection technology projects. Required Qualifications: Pursuing a masters or PhD. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field from a leading university. Must be a current student Able to work fulltime, 40 hours per week during the summer months Strong academic and applied background in acoustics, with experience in nonlinear acoustics wave propagation, experiments, and modeling. Strong modeling skills (COMSOL or similar). Preferred Qualifications: Experience with: Guided waves Phased array ultrasound and beamforming laws Integrating quality systems into inline manufacturing processes Other nondestructive modalities, such as electromagnetic techniques Sensor fabrication Experience in industrial or automotive manufacturing environments Publication record in leading conferences (e.g., ASNT, ASA, QNDE, SPIE, etc. GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering - Summer 2027 Intern (US Person Required)
jobs.body: Honeywell Technologies: Build What Matters At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter, and more efficient. We are a global automation company focused on helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably, and efficiently, with about $17B in 2025 sales, 54,000 employees, roughly 600 sites, and headquarters in Charlotte, NC. Work on practical innovation. Honeywell Technologies is moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data, and domain expertise to help assets work harder, people work smarter, and processes run more efficiently. Grow with purpose. At Honeywell Technologies, you can grow your career and network by contributing to the company’s success. Join a customer obsessed culture built on respect, collaboration, diverse perspectives, continuous learning, individual well-being, and celebrating achievement. Be part of a culture that values people. Our people are at the heart of what we do, with an emphasis on impact, representing Honeywell with pride, bringing diverse perspectives, and solving problems with curiosity and resilience. Shape the future by making what matters better. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Mechanical Engineering Intern here at Honeywell Technologies, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience and contribute to cutting-edge projects in the field of mechanical engineering. You will work closely with our team of experienced engineers and professionals, learning from their expertise and applying your knowledge to real-world challenges. This internship will provide you with valuable insights into the industry and help you develop essential skills for your future career in mechanical engineering. In this role, you will have the opportunity to: Assist in the design and development of mechanical systems, components, and assemblies Conduct research and analysis to support engineering projects Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve technical problems and optimize designs Participate in testing and validation activities Gain exposure to industry-standard tools and software Location: This position is available in multiple locations across the United States. The exact worksite location will be selected based on business requirements and the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications. The hourly base range for this position is $24.00/hr - $45.00/hr. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university in Mechanical Engineering or similar field. Must graduate December 2027 or later Must continue enrollment in degree program upon completion of the internship Validated academic excellence (3.0 GPA and higher) Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status Honeywell Technologies is currently unable to consider applicants who would require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization for this position. Candidates must be authorized to legally work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements. WE VALUE: Previous internship or project experience in mechanical engineering Knowledge of industry standards and best practices Familiarity with product testing and validation processes Understanding of materials and manufacturing processes Interning at Honeywell Technologies provides hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, professional development, and mentorship within a global organization. Interns will receive relocation benefits and short-term housing if they are 50 miles or more from their assigned work location (excluding Puerto Rico and Canada). The application period for the intern position is estimated to be through the end of March 2027; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. #HoneywellURNAM

jobs.title: Weapon System Equipment Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027
jobs.body: Weapon System Equipment Engineer - Undergraduate Placement 2027 The Weapon System Equipment (WSE) team is responsible for managing groups of equipment and Weapon System sub-systems from the bidding stage, into the concept & requirements generation phase, through their development programme, and on to production & delivery and final integration onto the platform or launcher. Salary : £24,460 Dynamic (hybrid) working : 2-3 days per week on-site due to workload classification Security clearance : British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team. This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 4th January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes. What we can offer you: 1 year placement: Starting September 2027, that allows you to apply your university learning to real-world projects and technologies Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year Company bonus : Based on company performance and will vary year to year Pension : Maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14% Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days Facilities : Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more… Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more. The opportunity: The WSE team serves as the critical "conduit" of the business, a central point of contact bridging the gap between complex technical engineering and the customers who rely on our solutions. They work across various domains (Land, Naval, and Air) and across the product lifecycle—from early-stage "road mapping" of future ideas to the physical design and delivery of equipment. You’ll experience an environment where collaboration is the key to success. Working alongside colleagues in procurement, electronics, software, and other engineering disciplines, you will help ensure our products are fit for purpose, delivered on time, and built to the highest standards. Typical WSE activities include: Sub-System & Equipment Requirements generation and management Technical management of equipment development, production and delivery to meet Customer milestones Managing state-of-the-art equipment and hardware development trials Developing equipment policies and technical standards to improve capability This placement will give you: A supportive environment: Access to a dedicated support network and bi-weekly check-ins, ensuring you are never alone as you navigate your career. You'll be mentored by previous graduates who have walked the same path. High-visibility experience : The confidence to communicate across all levels of the business, from collaborating with software and safety experts to presenting solutions to chief engineers. Rotational versatility : The chance to move through diverse placements—such as solving technical queries for customers, owning the physical design of a subsystem with suppliers, or road-mapping the future of our capabilities. Opportunity for Travel: Work with internal and external stakeholders from visits to other MBDA sites in the UK and across Europe, to customer and supplier visits where required. Development opportunities: Access to training and placements to support development across the engineering spectrum, from mechanical to electrical and beyond, alongside business management skills. Professional ownership: If you are proactive and eager to go after things, you will be given the trust and space to take ownership of your projects. You do not need to come from a traditional engineering background to succeed in this role. Whether your degree is in Engineering, Physics or Maths we value the unique perspective and problem-solving skills you bring. What we're looking for from you: Current undergraduate working towards a degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science. Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom. We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more… We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process. Follow us on LinkedIn (MBDA), X (@MBDA_UK), Instagram (MBDA_UK) and Glassdoor or visit our MBDA Careers website for more information.

jobs.title: DSP & Systems Architecture Intern
jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. This is an existing vacancy. Your Team, Your Impact Our team is focused on Advanced Technologies within Central Engineering organization, providing the most advanced and key IPs to all businesses within Marvell. Our team makes an outsized impact not only for the organization but also to the technological arc of innovation for future generations of Marvell's high-speed wireline and optical products. What You Can Expect As our DSP & Systems Intern, you will work on systems-level problems that sit at the boundary of research and production — where the algorithms and architectures you develop have direct consequences for how AI infrastructure performs at scale. Specifically, you can expect to: Architect, model, and evaluate system-level designs for electrical/optical interconnects — developing analytical models and simulations that inform real silicon architecture decisions Develop and optimize DSP algorithms for high-speed electrical or optical links, including equalization adaptation, calibration, timing recovery, and signal integrity techniques for both electrical and optical links Collaborate with analog, digital, photonics, and firmware engineering teams to validate architectural assumptions against real hardware and silicon measurements Build behavioral models and simulations in MATLAB or Python to evaluate performance tradeoffs Present architectural proposals and algorithm results to engineering leadership and contribute to internal technical documentation and design reviews What We're Looking For Currently enrolled in a Ph.D. Or M.Sc. program in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with research focused on optical/electrical interconnects, digital signal processing, or communication systems. Strong foundation in signal processing, communication theory, control systems, optimization, or system architecture, with the ability to apply theoretical concepts to practical engineering problems. Research or project experience in one or more of the following areas: high-speed communications, DSP algorithm development, optical communications, SerDes systems, signal integrity, equalization, clock and data recovery, or system-level architecture. Experience developing models and simulations using MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar tools to evaluate complex system behavior and performance tradeoffs. Self-motivated, curious, and able to work effectively in a collaborative environment spanning DSP, analog, digital, photonics, firmware, and systems engineering disciplines. Expected Base Pay Range (CAD) 45 - 61, $ per hour. Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Interview Integrity To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). jobs.title: Undergraduate Engineering Intern - Innovation
jobs.body: This undergraduate internship is a full-time position Summer-Fall 2027 (May or June through December) on site in Rochester, Minnesota. Some interns have been able to maintain an on-line evening college course, but accepting this position requires the intern to not pursue any significant coursework for the summer or fall of 2027. The Division of Engineering is looking for an intern to assist our innovation project teams providing technical services to clinicians innovating to improve Mayo Clinic’s research and clinical practice. The primary purpose of the Engineering Internship is to provide students with relevant engineering experiences. The position offers a wide range of job responsibilities, including: assisting innovation engineers in interviewing clinician innovators to determine the technical services they need, determining clinical and human factors needs to determine project requirements, observing surgery and clinical procedures, partnering with engineers and technical staff to translate requirements into design strategy and a development plan, participate in brainstorming, and drafting product documentation (technical writing). The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; have strong technical writing skills and be able to author technical documents; work independently; understand the project development process; have proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Office, SharePoint, Teams, and Excel to manage data and create reports; be working toward a technical engineering degree; and have a desire to learn about medical device development. The candidate will be introduced to the processes and documentation requirements of medical device development; gain experience conducting clinician interviews to elicit needs and requirements, participate in engineering innovation sprint sessions, brainstorming, design consultation, and internal and externally outsourced proof of concept device fabrication projects. Mentors will be assigned to provide instruction, guidance and to assess performance. The intern is responsible for learning the procedures and processes of the Engineering team. The intern will be given work assignments to reinforce the learning experience and to provide benefit to the work unit as well as provided an opportunity to present their work accomplishments in an end of term presentation. The intern will be responsible for completing all internship-related assignments and reports for both Mayo Clinic and the participating educational facility (if applicable). The incumbent must be enrolled in a mechanical or biomedical engineering degree program from an accredited college or university and have completed a minimum of four semesters – or the equivalent – of instruction toward their Bachelors degree. To be considered for this position please attach the following to your application: 3.3 GPA requirement or higher undergraduate transcript Resume or CV Applicants are strongly encouraged to include a Cover Letter

jobs.title: System Application Engineer (RDSS Intern)
jobs.body: By submitting your resume, you’re expressing interest in our 2027 RDSS (Research and Development Substitute Services) program. Please confirm your eligibility with the local district office before applying the role. NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU & SOC acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. We're Application Engineering team and searching for System Engineer (RDSS) to support project development across ARM- and X86-based platforms integrating NVIDIA solutions. NVIDIA is shaping the future of computing and AI, and we are looking for passionate, dedicated, and forward-thinking individuals to join us in making that future a reality. This position offers recent graduates a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple phases of product development—from early design and system integration to manufacturing and production. Through real-world projects and mentorship, you will develop expertise in hardware engineering, system integration, and production processes, while strengthening your technical knowledge and problem-solving skills. What you’ll be doing: Assist with technical support during design development, integration, validation and production. Support partner design-in activities, system integration, validation, launch readiness, and production ramp. Participate in partner design review covering system architecture, schematics, PCB layout, thermal and validation plans. Work with experienced engineers and partners to troubleshoot technical issues, perform failure analysis, and identify root causes. Support coordination between partners and internal NVIDIA engineering teams. Flexible to jump in NVIDIA different system level products as required. Flexibility and willingness to take on different technical assignments based on project needs. Experience with CAD, schematic/layout, or engineering simulation tools. Knowledge of PC/server architecture, power delivery, signal integrity, or thermal design. Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese. Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and take on new challenges. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province. HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). jobs.title: Information Technology Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms. Job Overview We are seeking a talented and organized IT Intern who will support the tools and systems managed by IT Operations. This is a hands-on experience, which will allow you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world setting and contribute to the systems and infrastructure in a fast-paced defense technology environment. This internship is ideal for students pursuing information technology, computer science, computer engineering, management information systems, or a related field, and eager to make an impact in the defense tech industry. Responsibilities • Provide support for hardware, software, and network issues, including desktops, laptops, servers, printers, and mobile devices • Troubleshoot and resolve escalated technical issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions • Perform routine system maintenance, including software updates, security patches, and backups • Document and track support tickets using a helpdesk management system, ensuring resolutions are well-documented • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of emerging IT trends and technologies to provide innovative solutions • Collaborate with senior IT staff on complex technical projects, migrations, and system upgrades • Ensure adherence to security best practices, including data protection and access control Qualifications • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field • Basic ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues across desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices, with comfort in at least one operating system (Windows, macOS, or Linux) • Excellent communication with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users • A great customer experience mindset • Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and an ability to prioritize tasks • Familiarity with helpdesk or ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) is a plus • Exposure to endpoint or device management (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) is a plus • Familiarity with identity and directory services (Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta) is a plus • Familiarity with networking concepts: DNS, DHCP, VPN, ethernet, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting is a plus • Exposure to scripting or automation (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) is a plus • Exposure to security best practices, including data protection and access control • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment - jobs.title: Functional Structural Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! As a Technical Intern, you will participate in a comprehensive summer internship program designed to provide hands-on experience in a dynamic aerospace and defense environment. You will work alongside industry experts, contribute to real-world projects, and develop valuable technical and professional skills. This internship offers a unique opportunity for growth through mentoring, cross-functional workshops, and direct involvement in company projects. The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries. Responsibilities: Participate in actual technical projects and contribute to team objectives by completing assigned tasks. Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced industry professionals in your field. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, reports, and records as required. Assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to support engineering decisions. Attend planning meetings to understand project requirements, timelines, and team goals. Perform hands-on technical work assignments to gain practical experience and build technical skills. Work closely with team members, absorb and learn from their expertise, and apply that learning to ongoing projects. Identify opportunities for process improvements and support the implementation of best practices. Participate in workshops designed to provide a deeper understanding of the business and company culture. Qualifications You Must Have: Must be a Sophomore, Junior, or Senior in college or technical school, with at least 6 months until graduation after end of internship. Currently enrolled in a university or college program pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Strong organization skills and work ethic; detail oriented. Qualifications We Prefer: Prior internship or work experience in a technical or engineering role. Familiarity with the Aerospace and Defense industry. Basic knowledge of engineering software tools (e.g., CAD, MATLAB). Microsoft Access skills. Pursuing a degree in engineering or a related discipline. Essential Functions: Ability to sit at a computer for extended periods. Proficiency with computers and office equipment. Manual dexterity for handling tools and technical equipment. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally. Ability to work in a laboratory or workshop environment, which may involve exposure to loud noise levels or hazardous conditions. Ability to travel may be required. Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment. This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs. Estimated Starting Salary Range: $23.54 - $32.37. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors, such as candidates' key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more . IMPORTANT NOTICE: To conform to U.S. Government international trade regulations, applicant must be a U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce. Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances. SNC is a global leader in aerospace and national security committed to moving the American Dream forward. We’re known and respected for our mission and execution focus, agility, and disruptive and rapid innovation. If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team! jobs.title: Intern - Process Engineer
jobs.body: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today. We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level. Join us and let’s shape the future of data. Job Summary This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in plating process engineering within a manufacturing environment. The intern will support the engineering team in monitoring plating processes, collecting and analyzing process data, assisting with process improvement activities, and maintaining manufacturing documentation. The role will provide exposure to plating chemistry, process control, contamination control, manufacturing quality, and operational efficiency. The intern will work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to learn practical problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies in a manufacturing environment. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Support engineers in monitoring plating process parameters and identifying process trends. Assist with plating DI water, LPC, contamination, and other process-related data monitoring. Support plating chemical inventory tracking and basic planning activities. Assist with monitoring plating pretreatment, strip line, filter change, and related process conditions. Collect, organize, and analyze process and production data to support quality and yield improvement. Assist engineers in investigating process deviations and line-to-line variations. Participate in process improvement and optimization projects under the guidance of experienced engineers. Support contamination control activities and follow cleanroom and safety procedures. Assist with OEE data tracking and analysis to identify potential improvement opportunities. Participate in FMEA, risk assessment, and other engineering review activities as required. Support process parameter evaluation, documentation updates, and change implementation activities. Prepare basic reports, charts, presentations, and technical documentation to communicate findings and project progress. Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, equipment, and other engineering teams on assigned projects. Perform other engineering-related tasks and projects as assigned. jobs.title: Growth Internship (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: There was a time when all of America believed that the future of the physical world could be radically different. The engineers of the mid-1900s put a man on the moon in eight years, designed and built planes and submarines from scratch in under three, and conceived of building things we wouldn’t even be able to dream up today. Today, the last of the engineers who imagined and built these systems are retiring. As they go, we lose not only the engineering knowledge gained from their decades of imagination and trial-and-error, but also the spirit that made that imagination possible. Amca is working day-in and day-out to restore America’s ability to engineer anything that our critical systems depend on, and reinvigorate the cycle of creation that allows imagination to shape physical reality. We rapidly develop and manufacture new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. By restoring the capability of our antiquated supply chains, we increase the country’s capacity to imagine and realize new systems, and make a physical world that looks very different from today. Overview Growth at Amca takes on all 0-to-1 projects. These projects are broadly split into two categories. Special Projects is largely focused on new business initiatives and internal operations. It requires deep intellectual creativity, research rigor, and the ability to communicate complex ideas. Brand is largely focused on resonating an idea with a specific audience (e.g. talent, acquisitions, government). It requires deep creativity, intense empathy, and the ability to articulate aesthetic taste. Everyone on growth is extremely analytical, persuasive, moves quickly, and is unwilling to ever take no as an answer. You are probably a great fit if you're currently a serious humanities student. jobs.title: Field Service Representative Intern
jobs.body: Worker Type Supplemental Job Description Summary Field Service Representative Intern AV is seeking dedicated, customer-focused RF Technology Field Service Representative (FSR) interns to join our team. In this role, you will support system testing at AV facilities and travel to customer locations to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support advanced RF technology systems used in mission-critical applications. As an FSR, you will play an essential role in ensuring the operational readiness and reliability of systems that directly support national security. You will apply your technical expertise in the field while developing strong relationships with engineers, customers, end users, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge, hands-on experience across multiple disciplines, and exceptional attention to detail. You are skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex problems; communicating effectively with program managers, engineers, and customers; and working independently in dynamic, high-pressure environments. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys hands-on work, solving challenging technical issues, building lasting customer relationships, and delivering innovative solutions in support of critical missions. Position Responsibilities ·Install and Set Up Systems: Travel to customer locations to install RF technology systems, ensuring they are properly set up and operational. ·Perform Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct routine maintenance checks and troubleshoot issues to keep systems running efficiently. Address technical problems with clear communication and effective solutions. Configure and update hardware, software, and firmware as needed. ·Troubleshoot: Troubleshoot issues by analyzing data, logs, and diagnostic information. Work with engineering team to diagnose difficult issues as needed. ·Performance Test Systems: Participate in full-system tests on the production floor to ensure that systems are fully functional and performing as expected, using specialty RF equipment including, but not limited to: anechoic chamber, signal generator, receiver analyzer, spectrum analyzer. ·Train Customers: Aid in teaching clients how to operate and maintain their systems, providing easy-to-understand guidance and answering their questions. ·Provide Customer Support: Act as a point of contact for customers, helping to address their concerns, offer solutions, and ensure they are satisfied with our service. ·Document Work: Keep accurate records of service visits, including maintenance performed, issues resolved, and customer feedback. ·Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with engineering and support teams to resolve complex issues and improve system performance; take technical direction from the Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (SEIT) Lead; and align priorities and task execution with the Project Manager (PM). Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Competencies) ·Holds a U.S. Citizenship. ·Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Passport. ·Currently enrolled in an associate's degree program or technical certification. ·Capable of lifting and carrying equipment up to 30 lbs. ·Willingness to travel frequently and work in varied field conditions (outdoors, industrial sites, military bases, etc.). ·Flexible to accommodate occasional long workdays in harsh environments. ·Possesses aptitude for troubleshooting and a quick learner. Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies ·Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to various work locations. ·Strong time management, multitasking, and prioritization skills. ·Ability to stay calm and think clearly in stressful environments. ·A passion for problem-solving and on-the-job learning. ·Ability to work efficiently in diverse team environments. ·Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills. ·Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a firm grasp of technical concepts. ·Experience in customer service, technical support, or field service roles. Physical Demands & Work Environment ·Standing and walking for extended periods at customer or field sites. ·Lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling equipment, tools, and replacement parts; up to 30 lbs., depending on the job duty. ·Bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing ladders, and working in awkward positions. ·Operating or working around vehicles, ground support equipment, and technical systems. ·Performing repetitive hand movements and using hand/power tools. ·Working outdoors in varying weather conditions, dust, noise, and uneven terrain. ·Traveling frequently and occasionally working extended hours. ·Wearing required personal protective equipment, such as safety footwear, eye/ear protection, gloves, or a hard hat. jobs.title: ATR – Internship 2027  - Transformation méthodologique des SMS
jobs.body: Job Description: Envie de rejoindre l'aventure ATR ? Une offre de stage vient de s'ouvrir sur notre site à Blagnac & St Martin du Touch ! En 2025, ATR est labellisée Happy Trainees. 94.3% des étudiants recommandent notre entreprise à l’issue de leur alternance ou de leur stage. Ce que nous allons faire ensemble : Être stagiaire chez ATR, c’est être intégré au sein d’une équipe comme un membre à part entière avec un véritable périmètre d’intervention et des responsabilités. Au sein de l’organisation, plusieurs Systèmes de gestion de la sécurité (SMS) sont actuellement mis en œuvre pour soutenir différents agréments et activités, notamment : • Agrément d’organisme de production (POA) • Agrément d’organisme de conception (DOA) • Organisme de gestion du maintien de la navigabilité (CAMO) • Organisme de maintenance (Part-145) • Organisme de formation agréé (ATO) Dans le cadre d’une initiative en cours visant à harmoniser ces référentiels SMS, une revue des méthodologies actuelles d’évaluation des risques a mis en évidence de légères différences dans leur mise en application pratique. Parallèlement, l’organisation étudie l’adoption potentielle de méthodologies alternatives d’évaluation des risques de sécurité aérienne, telles que l’ARMS et l’ERCS, ou une combinaison de celles-ci. Une étude complète est donc nécessaire afin d’identifier l’approche la plus adaptée et la plus robuste pour l’organisation, et de soutenir le déploiement d’une méthodologie standardisée Descriptif des missions proposées : Le stage vise à contribuer à l’analyse, à la définition et à la conduite du changement associées à une méthodologie commune d’évaluation des risques pour l’ensemble des référentiels SMS de ’organisation. Examiner et analyser les méthodologies d’évaluation des risques actuellement utilisées dans les différents domaines SMS. Identifier les similitudes, les différences, les points forts et les limites des pratiques actuelles. Réaliser une analyse comparative des méthodologies d’évaluation des risques reconnues dans l’industrie aéronautique (par exemple : OACI, ARMS, ERCS et autres approches pertinentes). Évaluer l’applicabilité de ces méthodologies aux activités de l’organisation et aux exigences réglementaires associées. Recommander un référentiel harmonisé d’évaluation des risques, adapté à l’environnement opérationnel de l’organisation. Élaborer et documenter un processus structuré et opérationnel d’évaluation des risques, garantissant cohérence, rigueur et répétabilité. Dans le cadre du processus de conduite du changement, réaliser et documenter une analyse de conformité ainsi qu’une analyse des risques liés à ce changement, incluant la définition des mesures de maîtrise requises. Ce stage est fait pour vous : Étudiant en Master 2 (stage de fin d’études), de préférence issu d’une formation spécialisée dans l’un des domaines suivants : Systèmes de gestion de la sécurité Sécurité aérienne Gestion des risques Navigabilité Solides capacités d’analyse et de réflexion structurée. Intérêt pour la sécurité aérienne et les référentiels réglementaires. Capacité à synthétiser des sujets complexes et à élaborer des solutions opérationnelles. Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication en anglais. ******************************************************************************** Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Blagnac & St Martin du Touch ! In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship. What we will do together: Being an intern at ATR means being integrated into a team as a full member with a real scope of intervention and responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills and experience within a market leading company! Within the organization, several Safety Management Systems (SMS) are currently implemented to support different approvals and activities, including: Production Organisation Approval (POA) Design Organisation Approval (DOA) Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) Maintenance Organisation (Part-145) Approved Training Organisation (ATO) As part of an ongoing initiative to harmonize these SMS frameworks, a review of the current risk assessment methodologies has highlighted slight differences in their practical application. In parallel, the organization is considering the potential adoption of alternative aviation safety risk assessment methodologies such as ARMS and ERCS, or a combination thereof. A comprehensive study is therefore required to identify the most suitable and robust approach for the organization and to support the deployment of a standardized methodology. Detailed description of the mission The internship aims to contribute to the analysis, definition and change management activities associated with the implementation of a common risk assessment methodology across all the organization’s SMS frameworks. Review and analyze the existing risk assessment methodologies currently used within the different SMS domains. Identify similarities, differences, strengths and limitations of current practices. Perform a benchmark of industry-recognized aviation risk assessment methodologies (e.g. ICAO, ARMS, ERCS and other relevant approaches). Assess the applicability of these methodologies to the organization's activities and associated regulatory requirements. Recommend a harmonized risk assessment framework adapted to the organization's operational environment. Develop and document a structured and practical risk assessment process ensuring consistency, rigor and repeatability. In the frame of the change management process, a compliance analysis and a risk analysis of this change with the definition of the required barriers shall be conducted and documented. undefined This internship is designed for you Master's degree student (final-year internship), preferably from a specialized programme in: Safety Management Systems Aviation Safety Risk Management Airworthiness Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. Interest in aviation safety and regulatory frameworks. Ability to synthesize complex topics and develop practical solutions. Excellent writing and communication skills in English. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. jobs.title: College Intern
jobs.body: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Location: Singapore,SGP You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Traineeship Project Description: Hexagonal boron nitride（h-BN）is an emerging dielectric material with excellent thermal stability, high electrical resistivity, low dielectric constant, and strong potential as a thermal interface material（TIM）for advanced semiconductor packaging. This internship project focuses on the development and characterization of PECVD-grown h-BN thin films for thermal management applications in advanced packaging structures. The intern will first undergo structured laboratory training for approximately one month, including hands-on exposure to key thin-film characterization and processing tools such as FTIR, SEM, ellipsometry, XPS, electrical measurement tools, and the PECVD system. Under the guidance of senior researchers, the intern will support thin-film growth, process monitoring, and material characterization activities for h-BN films development. By the end of the internship, the intern is expected to summarize the key findings in a scientific report and present the results to the project team. The work will provide practical experience in thin-film deposition, semiconductor materials characterization, data analysis, and technical communication in an industrial R&D environment. Desired Skills Required: Basic knowledge of materials science, thin films, and semiconductor processing Basic understanding of dielectric materials and electrical characterization Basic knowledge of DOE（Design of Experiments）and data analysis Ability to summarize experimental results in written reports and presentations Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Intern / Student Travel: No Relocation Eligible: No Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
