jobs.title: Embedded Engineer - Summer 2027 Intern (US Person Required)
jobs.body: Honeywell Technologies: Build What Matters At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter, and more efficient. We are a global automation company focused on helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably, and efficiently, with about $17B in 2025 sales, 54,000 employees, roughly 600 sites, and headquarters in Charlotte, NC. Work on practical innovation. Honeywell Technologies is moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data, and domain expertise to help assets work harder, people work smarter, and processes run more efficiently. Grow with purpose. At Honeywell Technologies, you can grow your career and network by contributing to the company’s success. Join a customer obsessed culture built on respect, collaboration, diverse perspectives, continuous learning, individual well-being, and celebrating achievement. Be part of a culture that values people. Our people are at the heart of what we do, with an emphasis on impact, representing Honeywell with pride, bringing diverse perspectives, and solving problems with curiosity and resilience. Shape the future by making what matters better. ABOUT THE ROLE: At Honeywell Technologies, the Embedded Engineer develops and implements the software of embedded devices and systems. They are also responsible for the analysis and monitoring of the efficiency and stability of a system. They develop and implement embedded devices and systems and support software quality assurance while optimizing I/O performance. The Embedded Software Engineer develops codes, tests, and troubleshoots system software. They are the designers of the first layer of code that runs on a device and need a full comprehension of its hardware. Location: This position is available in multiple locations across the United States. The exact worksite location will be selected based on business requirements and the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications. The hourly base range for this position is $24.00/hr - $45.00/hr . Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar field Must graduate December 2027 or later Must continue enrollment in degree program upon completion of the internship Validated academic excellence (3.0 GPA and higher) Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident, or have asylum or refugee status in the U.S. Honeywell Technologies is currently unable to consider applicants who would require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization for this position. Candidates must be authorized to legally work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements. WE VALUE: Embedded systems development using C/C++, ADA, or similar language Knowledge of software configuration management Experience/knowledge of Matlab, Simulink, LabView, Python Interning at Honeywell Technologies provides hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, professional development, and mentorship within a global organization. Interns will receive relocation benefits and short-term housing if they are 50 miles or more from their assigned work location (excluding Puerto Rico and Canada). The application period for the intern position is estimated to be through the end of March 2027; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. #HoneywellURNAM

jobs.title: Purchasing Intern (Part-Time)
jobs.body: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Summary of Program Jabil’s Summer Internship Program was recognized as one of the Top 100 Internship Programs in the country for 2026 by WayUp. This is the result of a holistic and engaging experience that summer interns at Jabil experience. As a result, interns that are a part of this program for summer 2027 will get to engage with members of Jabil’s leadership team and participate in events related to professional development, networking & socializing, and community engagement. In addition, interns will have the opportunity to work with each other in committees, be assigned a mentor, tour some of Jabil’s facilities and much more! If this sounds like a program you want to be a part of and you want to work for a company that strives to make EVERYTHING BETTER and ANYTHING POSSIBLE, then apply today. JOB SUMMARY The Purchasing Intern will support Jabil's Supply Chain and Procurement teams by assisting with purchasing activities, supplier management, materials planning, and inventory analysis. This internship provides hands-on experience in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, allowing interns to gain exposure to procurement processes, supplier relationships, and cross-functional collaboration while contributing to real business objectives. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Support purchasing activities to ensure materials are available to meet production and business requirements. Assist with the creation and maintenance of purchase orders and supplier communications. Analyze inventory, material requirements, and supply chain data to support procurement decisions. Monitor supplier performance, including delivery, quality, and service metrics. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, and Business Unit teams on procurement-related projects. Assist with resolving material shortages, delivery challenges, and invoice discrepancies. Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on procurement, supplier management, and inventory control. Maintain purchasing and material master data within company systems. Follow company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines. Perform other duties as assigned. JOB REQUIRMENTS: Ability to work part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, during the internship period. Approximately Late November 2026/Early December 2026 to May 2027. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. EDUCATION REQUIRMENTS: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Supply Chain Management Operations Management Business Administration Industrial Engineering Logistics Manufacturing Engineering Or a related field Graduation dates: December 2026 May 2027 August 2027 Recent 2026 graduates may also be considered PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data analysis, and reporting. Familiarity with AI tools and emerging technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to organize and interpret data to support business decisions. Comfortable working with multiple projects and deadlines. Interest in procurement, purchasing, supply chain management, sourcing, or operations. Ability to build effective working relationships with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Experience with ERP systems, purchasing platforms, or data visualization tools is a plus. BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. jobs.title: Human Resource Intern
jobs.body: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The vision of KLA’s global human resources organization is to become a leader and partner to operating leadership in support of the company’s efforts to achieve its strategic growth, customer and operating objectives through strategic talent management. Our mission is to enable the business, and leverage human resources to achieve short and long-term business objectives. Our primary areas of strategic focus include talent acquisition, individual and organizational assessment and development, performance management, inclusion and engagement, and rewards. The global HR organization includes HR business partners, learning and development, talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee communications, and HR system operations. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Do you believe in the power of technology to make the world a better place? At KLA, we are a global technology leader advancing the semiconductor industry through innovative solutions that enable our customers to drive progress. We are seeking two highly motivated Human Resources Interns to join our team for the summer. This is an exciting opportunity for analytical, curious, and business-minded individuals who are interested in gaining hands-on HR experience while contributing to meaningful projects that support KLA's people and business strategies. As an HR Intern, you will partner with HR professionals and business leaders to lead or contribute to strategic HR initiatives. Through research, data analysis, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving, you will develop insights and recommendations that help drive organizational effectiveness and employee success. Key Responsibilities Lead or contribute to a significant HR project aligned with KLA's strategic priorities Collect, analyze, and interpret qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends and develop recommendations Conduct research on HR best practices, industry trends, and organizational effectiveness topics Partner with HR team members, managers, and employees to gather input and perspectives through interviews, focus groups, or surveys Develop and deliver presentations that communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to HR and business leaders Collaborate across functions and geographies to support project objectives and organizational priorities Preferred Qualifications Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights Excellent project management and organizational skills with strong attention to detail Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills Strong interpersonal, consultative, and relationship-building capabilities Ability to work collaboratively with teams across functions and regions Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and commitment to continuous learning Customer-focused mindset with a results-oriented approach Ability to apply academic concepts and frameworks to real-world business challenges Alignment with KLA's values, including perseverance, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement At KLA, you'll gain more than internship experience. You'll have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions while developing skills that will accelerate your career in Human Resources. Real Business Impact – Lead or contribute to strategic projects that address real organizational challenges and support key business priorities. Hands-On HR Experience – Apply classroom concepts to practical HR initiatives involving talent, organization effectiveness, employee experience, workforce planning, and data analytics. Exposure to Senior Leaders – Collaborate with HR professionals, managers, and business leaders while presenting recommendations and insights to stakeholders. Professional Development – Strengthen your analytical, consulting, project management, and communication skills through meaningful project work and mentorship. Global Perspective – Work with colleagues across functions, teams, and geographies within a leading global technology company. Innovation-Driven Environment – Experience firsthand how people strategies support innovation and business success in the semiconductor industry. Minimum Qualifications Requires less than 1 year of related experience. Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field Authorized to work in the country where the internship is located and able to complete the internship for the designated program duration Base Pay Range: $22.00 - $36.00 Base Pay Range: $0.00 - $0.00 Primary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation. Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA . Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

With our employees as our priority, we provide career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. This is a place for engineers, scientists, and problem-solvers who are ready to engage deeply, think critically, and build with purpose. You will not just launch a career. You will be part of something bigger. This is where the best are built. Lockheed Martin Rotary and Systems Mission in Mout Laurl, New Jersey is seeking a Systems Engineer Intern for Summer 2027. You will perform assignments in technical/engineering organizations (e.g., Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering) during vacations and short-term breaks from college attendance while enrolled in an accredited degree program. You will have the opportunity to design, integrate/test and conduct data analysis to assess system performance of the Command, Control and Communications (C3) systems. The C3 systems perform multiple critical functions such as radar and sensor management, track filtering, track management including correlation/association, control of multiple communication links, threat evaluation and prioritization, and command of weapon systems for target engagement or assignment. The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of systems engineering principles, algorithm development, and data analysis to troubleshoot and evaluate. Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance. This position is located at a facility that requires special access. Basic Qualifications Pursuing BS Degree in Engineering or related STEM field Strong organizational and time management abilities Team-based experience Able to work independently and handle confidential information appropriately Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance. This position is located at a facility that requires special access. Desired Skills Demonstrated analytical, applied mathematics and problem-solving skills Active security clearance Previous experience working in defense industry Previous experience in JIRA and/or Confluence Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $22.66 - $31.67 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability. Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: SEMN Summer Student Nurse Internship - SNI
jobs.body: Student Nurse Intern positions are available in Cannon Falls, Lake City and Red Wing. Interns may have the opportunity to rotate through multiple departments and locations, providing a diverse and well-rounded healthcare experience. More information will be provided at the time of offer. The Student Nurse Intern (SNI) performs delegated tasks of direct and indirect patient care with the supervision of a registered nurse (RN). The designated tasks are those which have been taught in the academic programs and/or orientation, and where the individual has demonstrated competence to a designated RN. Completion of two semesters in an Associate's in Nursing program, or completion of junior year in a Bachelor's in Nursing program required prior to start. Candidates must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Once accepted into the Summer Nursing Internship program, student interns will be required to enroll in a summer intern course at a university or college in Minnesota for the duration of the internship. Information will be provided to selected candidates upon offer acceptance. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required from American Red Cross or American Heart Association and must not expire during the internship. Reliable transportation is required. The internship will run for 10 weeks from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027. Applicants must be able to complete ten consecutive weeks of employment. The application deadline is December 31, 2026. Offers will begin going out the week of February 1, 2027. During the selection process you may participate in an OnDemand (pre-recorded) interview that you can complete at your convenience. During the OnDemand interview, a question will appear on your screen, and you will have time to consider each question before responding. You will have the opportunity to re-record your answer to each question – Mayo Clinic will only see the final recording. The complete interview will be reviewed by a Mayo Clinic staff member, and you will be notified of next steps. There will be a deadline to complete this interview. If you apply to more than one health system site, you will only need to complete the virtual interview once. Your interview responses will be reviewed for all health system locations to which you have applied. (Does not apply to Rochester). You are expected to provide the following application materials at the time you submit your application. Items cannot be uploaded once you hit the submit button. Do not submit your application unless you have attached all of the documents. Applications will be considered incomplete if all of the following items are not attached to your profile: 1. COVER LETTER 2. RESUME The resume should include degree, anticipated graduation date, and employment history. 3. BASIC LIFE SUPPORT (BLS) CERTIFICATION Applicants must attach proof of completion. We will only accept certificates of course completion from the following providers: American Heart Association (Title: BLS for Healthcare Providers) Red Cross (Title: CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers and Health Care Providers OR BLS for Healthcare Providers) Note: If your card is set to expire during the duration of the internship, you must renew your card prior to the first day of employment. It must remain valid throughout the full duration of the internship.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Simulation Intern
jobs.body: About JLG, an Oshkosh company JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world. Assist the Manufacturing Engineering department in successfully achieving manufacturing goals and contributing to simulation and continuous improvement efforts. The Manufacturing simulation Intern will receive assignments from the Manager of Manufacturing, or an assigned representative, and will be encouraged to contribute ideas and suggestions. YOUR IMPACT Collaborate directly with engineering to build discrete event simulation models aimed at identifying plant bottlenecks, evaluating staging capacities, and testing "what-if" production scenarios. Assist in developing and linking digital twins of manufacturing cells and robotics using tools like FlexSim, Emulate3D, and NVIDIA Omniverse. Analyze cycle times, station configurations, and operator movements to support assembly line balancing and optimize plant throughput. Work with real-time industrial sensor and PLC data to feed live operational inputs into your simulation models and custom Ignition dashboards. Use AutoCAD or similar CAD tools to create and revise 2D/3D plant layout drawings to support simulation setup and material flow planning. Research, test, and champion new digital factory tools and automation technologies to keep our manufacturing facility at the cutting edge. Participate in cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives, time studies, and other engineering projects as assigned. All other duties or projects as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Student working towards a bachelor’s degree in data analytics, Industrial engineering, Manufacturing or mechanical engineering or computer science Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS Working towards an advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) with a research focus or coursework directly related to Digital Twins, Industrial simulation, Controls Engineering, or Robotics. Experience or coursework in developing discrete event simulations, robotics simulations, (FlexSim, Emulate3D, Omniverse, etc.). Strong programming experience in Python (or other languages like C++ or C#), with a strong preference for experience in developing NVIDIA Omniverse Kit applications, extensions, or microservices. Basic understanding of controls engineering, PLC systems, or working with industrial sensor/IoT data. Familiar with lean manufacturing principles, six sigma or industrial process optimization. WORKING CONDITIONS The following represents general working conditions for this role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances. This role combines office-based administrative duties with physical activity in field or production environments. In the office setting, tasks may require extended computer use, sitting, and attending meetings. Field or floor work may involve walking across various terrains or shop floors, standing, moderate lifting (up to 50 pounds), climbing stairs, and exposure to varying temperatures or noise levels. Must be able to shift focus between detailed cognitive work and occasional physical tasks as needed. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities to support performance across both office and field responsibilities. WHY JLG, AN OSHKOSH COMPANY? Moving the future forward is our priority and this includes your future. We encourage professional development and champion our employees’ success through various skills and training opportunities. Named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies™ by Ethisphere Institute for six consecutive years, everything we do at Oshkosh is guided by our core values and the ~15k+ team members around the world who embody them. We put people first. We do the right thing. We persevere. We are better together Pay Range: $18.00 - $37.00 The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success. Oshkosh is committed to working with and offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to disability for any part of the employment process, please contact us at corporatetalentacquisition@oshkoshcorp.com. Oshkosh Corporation is a merit-based Equal Opportunity Employer. Job opportunities are open for application to all qualified individuals and selection decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristic. To the extent that information is provided or collected regarding categories as provided by law it will in no way affect the decision regarding an employment application. Oshkosh Corporation will not discharge or in any manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with Oshkosh Corporation's legal duty to furnish information. Certain positions with Oshkosh Corporation require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or the Export Administration Regulations. jobs.title: Operational Excellence Intern - HPM NAR
jobs.body: Job Title Operational Excellence Intern - HPM NAR Job Description Job Description Your role Support Operational Excellence initiatives within the HPM North America ISC organization, focusing on Backlog Management, Returns Management, and Unhealthy Inventory Management through data analysis, reporting, process documentation, and operational support activities. Support returns management reporting and follow-up activities. Assist with backlog management and backlog cleanup activities by maintaining trackers and analyzing open orders. Support unhealthy inventory management initiatives through data gathering, reporting, and analysis. Help maintain operational performance reports and dashboards. Collect, organize, and analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for process improvement. Assist in documenting processes, work instructions, and standard operating procedures. Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives. Collaborate with team members across Backlog, Returns, Inventory, and other operational functions. Participate in team meetings and support assigned improvement projects. You're the right fit if Currently enrolled in a degree program in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Operations Management, or a related field. Experience with Power BI or other data analysis tools is a plus. Ability to work effectively in a team environment. Strong communication skills in English. jobs.title: Research & Development Summer Internship 2027
jobs.body: Job Location READING TECH CENTER Job Description Ready to fuel the success of globally renowned brands like Gillette? Do you want to be part of the innovation and technological advancement of products used every day by millions of the world’s consumers? Want to work for a company consistently recognised as one of the UK’s leading graduate employers? We are offering summer internship opportunities in July 2027 at our Reading Innovation Centre . This specific role is focused on Master Data and Digital Transformation. About our Reading Innovation Centre This role is available in our Reading Innovation Centre which is home to over 200+ scientists and engineers responsible for innovating consumer products in several business areas including Personal Health Care (Vicks) Oral Care (Oral-B), Grooming (Gillette and Venus) and Beauty Care (Olay). The site is a specialist Healthcare & Grooming Research & Development Hub in Europe and supports our European Beauty Franchise business. The site is friendly, diverse and has a rich history in innovation in multiple business areas. Our site is located close to the town centre and is served by motorway networks of M4 and M25 as well as the A33. We’re within 20 mins of Reading Central and Green Park railway stations and are served by buses that run every 10 minutes. What To Expect: Research and Development (R&D) at P&G will help you to discover the essence behind crafting some of the world's most renowned brands. Delve into a realm where science takes centre stage. Some of the best scientists in the world go to work making our products just right for the billions of consumers who use them. We're talking cutting edge technology, "hands-on" labs and pilot plants, 41,000+ active patents and a team full of inventors. During your summer internship, you will get a first-hand experience of what a career in R&D with P&G involves, and if it is right for you. You will be working on live business R&D projects and expected to dive straight in and take the lead. Each intern receives a customized learning plan to ensure they get the right levels of coaching, mentoring, and training as they deliver their work. If you are looking for an exciting and challenging experience, have a passion for winning, strong leadership credentials and an interest in pursuing a career at P&G – this internship is for you! What You Will Gain: Responsibilities and Real Work from Day 1: You will be given specific projects and responsibilities working on real and live business challenges, just like a true P&Ger. Continuous training & coaching: You will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager. Competitive Compensation & Benefits: The monthly salary for this summer internship is £2,625. On top of this you’ll enjoy lots of benefits like the option to enroll in our pension, flexible working arrangements, and your very own ‘Flex4Me’ Fund which enables you to allocate a portion of your benefits package to the areas that matter most to you. Full Time Role: Successful interns have the potential to secure a full-time position with P&G after graduation. As a 'build from within' company, our people start at entry level and progress through the organization. When we make a job offer, it’s with the expectation that you will grow into one of our future leaders, and to help you get there, you will work closely with skilled P&G veterans for mentoring and coaching at every step. Job Qualifications What We Look For: University students pursuing a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (please note the additional detail below on required knowledge) graduating in 2027 or 2028. We also welcome applications from those who have already graduated who are able to complete a summer internship. Evidence of passion and achievements in academic and/or non-academic activities. Tell us what you’re proud of – be it playing a musical instrument or holding down a job alongside your studies. We want to get to know you during your application! Demonstrated leadership skills and a strong passion for research and innovation. Strong verbal and written English language skills. Knowledge of at least one of the following (the candidate is not expected to be knowledgeable in every area): Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL & data modeling, Data wrangling and ETL, Data visualization (Power BI/Tableau), Machine Learning fundamental, API integration, Generative AI & prompt engineering, AI application development, Workflow automation, Web application development (Streamlit/React/Flask), Cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Product thinking and user-centric design, System integration and APIs. Start date: The internship's duration is from July 5th, 2027, until September 24th, 2027. Right to Work: For our internship roles, you will need to provide your own right to work in the UK for the full duration of your internship without requiring sponsorship from P&G. Note, this will require your right to work permission to be valid between 5th July 2027 to 24th September 2027 for a minimum of 37.5 hours per week. P&G is legally required to ensure all candidates have the right to work in the UK from Day 1 of their employment. All applicants will therefore be asked to provide evidence of their right to work at the conclusion of the recruitment process as a condition of employment. Application Deadline: 1pm (GMT) December 2nd, 2026. You must apply by the deadline. We encourage you to apply and complete our online assessments as soon as possible , as we may close early if positions are filled. Application Process: Complete your Application (Deadline 1pm GMT 2nd December 2026) Complete our Online Assessments (Deadline 1pm GMT 9th December 2026) Virtual Interviews (These will run from October until our roles are filled) At P&G #weseeequal We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. At P&G we strive to build a culture where everyone feels welcome, included, and able to bring their full selves to work. We champion social mobility and believe socio-economic status should not be a barrier to accessing job opportunities. That’s why in addition to this internship being paid, we offer provision of all the necessary technology and electronic equipment, access to a range of benefits, and financial support if you need to relocate for your internship - such as covering the cost of travel to your internship location. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process. Please click here if you require an accommodation during the application process. Please make sure to wait to hear back from us regarding your accommodation before proceeding with the online assessment, we thank you in advance for your patience. jobs.title: Intern - Generative AI model personalization and efficient fine-tuning
jobs.body: Company: Qualcomm Korea YH Job Area: Interns Group, Interns Group > Interim Engineering Intern - SW Qualcomm Overview: Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. General Summary: We are making AI technology be around us at edge devices, attend and assist people and learn from interaction without many labels, together with other devices in a federated way. We are based in Seoul and work together with our other team members in San Diego, Amsterdam, and Beijing. We are looking for research interns interested in developing new theories and algorithms in the following areas, with a strong focus on Generative AI Models and its personalization: Generative foundation models : LLM, LVM, LMM, VLA, etc. Personalization and on-device adaptation of generative models Efficient fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, adapters, parameter-efficient tuning) Multi-modal generation (text-to-image, text-to-video, audio-visual) Diffusion / transformer models and their optimization Knowledge distillation and compression for generative models Quantization and low-bit processing for LLM/LMM Reinforcement Learning for Generative AI (RLHF, policy optimization, reward modeling) Unsupervised / semi-supervised / self-supervised learning Meta-Learning / few-shot learning / domain adaptation / knowledge transfer The developed technologies can be deployed on mobile device applications and have a worldwide impact on on-device learning algorithms using Qualcomm chips. Also, the research results are expected to be published in top-tier conferences and journals. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Ph.D. or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Strong knowledge of machine learning and deep learning Research experience in Generative AI (LLM, LVM, LMM, VLA) and/or personalization techniques Experience implementing ML algorithms using Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) Strong research and problem-solving skills demonstrated through publications or research projects. Publication requirement: At least 2 first-author papers , including at least 1 paper in a top-tier conference (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICCV, ICLR, ECCV, ACL) Preferred Qualifications Extensive and diverse experience with generative AI models, including LLMs, LVMs, LMMs, and multi-modal architectures Familiarity with efficient adaptation techniques such as LoRA, adapters, and other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods Hands-on experience with model optimization for edge deployment, including quantization, pruning, and low-bit inference/training Track record of publications at leading AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICCV, ICLR, ECCV, ACL) Applicants : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. jobs.title: Academic Internship in Industrial Engineering and Management (f/m/div.)
jobs.body: The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future. Bosch Car Multimedia, S.A. belongs to the Automotive Electronics division and is focused on making the vehicles our third living space. About 3.600 associates are committed to develop and produce high quality technology that shape change in mobility worldwide. The company' success lies in its highly specialized and innovative team, and on the technological know-how which makes Bosch the leading supplier in the automotive market. At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential. Your contribution to something big: - As part of your Master’s thesis, you will develop and implement innovative approaches to enqance the usage of production process data through the increased use of Digital Twin and Artificial Intelligence (AI); Your main responsibilities will include: -Assessing and diagnosing the current situation and existing leadership routines; -Evaluating current practices and identifying opportunities for improvement through digitalization and AI; -Developing new methods, processes, and standards; -Implementing, validating, and stabilizing the new solutions and standards; -Evaluating the impact of the proposed solutions on Value Stream workflows, operational efficiency, and associated financial benefits. - This project offers the opportunity to combine Artificial Intelligence, digitalization, continuous improvement, and leadership processes in a real manufacturing environment. What distinguishes you: - Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production/Manufacturing Engineering, Data Science, Digital Transformation, Business Engineering, or a comparable field; - Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, digitalization, process improvement, and operational excellence. Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, Lean Management, continuous improvement, or Value Stream concepts; - Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and translate them into practical solutions; - Interest in applying digital and AI technologies to improve leadership routines, decision-making, and operational efficiency; - Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with leadership, engineering, and operational teams. Good communication and presentation skills; - Fluent written and spoken English. Work #LikeABosch includes: 🔀 Hybrid work system 🌐 Exchange with colleagues around the world 🧑‍⚕️ Medical office (psychology and general clinic) & Social Services Office on site 📚 Training opportunities (p.e., technical training, foreign languages training) 📈 Continuous professional development 💲 Access to great discounts in partnerships and Bosch products 🏋️ Sports and health related activities 🚉 Great access to public transports 🚌 Free transport from Porto 🅿️ Free parking lot 🍽️ Canteen Success stories don´t just happen. They are made... Make it happen! We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.title: Undergraduate Placement Year 2027 – HSE Intern
jobs.body: We’re the nation’s favourite heating brand, here to warm up people’s homes, lives, and futures. From boilers, hybrids and heat pumps to solar thermal and smart controls, we’re giving our customers plenty of choice. With cutting-edge tech and research, we’re right in the thick of the drive for a better future of home heating. It’s not all tools and tech. People are the real heart of our company. We connect with our customers to deliver genuinely helpful support, and we care about our employees and give them enriching careers. We work hard, we work together, and we work with a cause – delivering brilliant customer support and exceptional engineering. As an organisation of more than 1,600 employees, we also take our role in the communities we serve seriously. From giving away free heating systems for community spaces, to our charity, education, and volunteer work – we’re no strangers to rolling our sleeves up, getting stuck in, and helping out. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, we’d love to meet you. Come and work #LikeABosch at Worcester Bosch. Join us for your placement year in summer 2027! Our internships are designed to give you an insight into what it's like to work for a world-renowned brand with a culture of support and community. The purpose of this role is to help the Health, Safety and Environmental Department in carrying out duties which ensure compliance with legislation and conformity to recognised standards. The HSE internship is a varied one, involving contact with every part of the business, and no day is the same in such a busy manufacturing environment. You will have a chance to learn about manufacturing, logistics, research and development, facilities management and service. Some of the department functions include conducting audits and inspections, data collection, assisting with investigations and providing help and advice for a wide variety of questions across the site. In this role, you will be responsible for: Developing safety and environmental initiatives with the HSE Officer and other working groups. Conducting HSE inspections and internal audits. Ensuring occupational health surveillance is carried out. Collating accident data and maintaining electronic and paper HSE records. Communicating key HSE information to management and employees. Assisting with the maintenance of the company management systems. Interested? Upload your CV and a Cover Letter today! Please note that to be eligible for this role, you must be an undergraduate student seeking a placement year as part of your degree - if you do not meet these criteria please consider applying for other positions. Our ideal candidate must have: An undergraduate student with a desire to complete a 12 month work placement as part of your degree studies Computer literate with a good knowledge of Microsoft Office packages Ability to communicate confidently with people Ability to plan and organise time effectively Good attention to detail (ability to analyse information) and a quality mind-set Ability to take initiative and be tenacious in achieving goals Our ideal candidate should have: Confident with the ability to approach and speak to other people with ease. Great organization and communication skills. A drive to develop and learn in the placement. Right To Work: please ensure you have a valid Right To Work in the UK status for the entirety of the placement year upon submitting an application. Deadline for Applications: November 27, 2026 Please note, we reserve the right to close this vacancy at any time so we encourage candidates to submit their applications as soon as possible. Expected Start Date: July 2027 Please note that this date is advisory and can be flexible within reason. Contract Duration: 1 year Working Hours : 39 hours per week – standard working pattern of 08:00 – 17:00 Monday to Thursday and 08:00 – 16:00 Friday with a 1-hour lunchbreak Working with us comes with the following benefits: 20 days annual leave per year plus bank holidays Access to the Perkbox Benefits platform Discounts on products from across the Bosch Group Enhanced pension contributions Access to Bosch Social Club membership offering you and up to 5 friends and family discounts on excursions and events Volunteering days Policy to support growing families Health & wellbeing support including: over 200 trained mental health first aid champions, free of charge employee assistance program And more!

jobs.title: Intern, Quality Management Mobility Aftermarket East Asia
jobs.body: 🏢 About Bosch Group The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 418,000 associates worldwide. The company generated sales of 90.3 billion euros in 2024. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. At 136 locations across the globe, Bosch employs some 87,000 associates in research and development. 🏢 About Robert Bosch (South East Asia) As the Bosch Group's regional headquarters in Singapore for Southeast Asia, Robert Bosch (South East Asia) Pte Ltd has represented the Group's interests across the region since 1923. With diversified businesses in Mobility Aftermarket, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Building Technology. Robert Bosch (SEA) Pte Ltd includes the Asia Pacific headquarters for Mobility Aftermarket, Building Technology, and Industrial Technology, as well as the Southeast Asia R&D setup for Corporate Research, Advance Engineering Centre, and Bosch Business Innovations, Bosch's in-house innovation and startup incubation network. At Bosch, we are committed through our EVP ensuring all our associates to GROW , ENJOY and INSPIRE during their journey with us 💼 Role Overview We are looking for an Intern, Quality Management Mobility Aftermarket East Asia to join our team in the Quality Management division. In this role, you will support the development of AI-driven solutions for warranty process enhancement while contributing to operational excellence through data analytics and reporting. You'll be part of a dynamic, collaborative team that thrives on innovation and delivering real business outcomes. 🎯 What you will do (Key Responsibilities) Drive the development and validation of AI image classification models to support our warranty process digitalization and enhance customer experience Collaborate with cross-functional teams including internal quality management specialists and external development partners on AI model development, testing, and deployment activities Analyze, report, and optimize data management workflows, dashboard performance, and business intelligence metrics to support data-driven decision-making Ensure compliance with quality management standards and best practices throughout all project phases and analytical processes Contribute to continuous jobs.body: Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province. HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As an Indirect Procurement Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Long Beach, California, you will have the opportunity to support the Supply Chain Team in conducting market analysis and identifying actionable solutions to optimize costs while maintaining service quality. GPA of 3.0 or above. 3+ months of corporate function experience within the areas of supply chain. jobs.title: Research Intern (Downstream Processing) - Marlborough, MA
jobs.location: Marlborough, MA, United States of America
jobs.body: We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled intern (PhD level) to support research and development activities in downstream processing of extracellular vesicles (EVs) and viral vectors. The successful candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary team to optimize and execute purification workflows using tangential flow filtration (TFF) and chromatography-based methods. This internship provides hands-on experience in biologics processing and analytical evaluation, contributing directly to process development for therapeutic nanoparticles. Onsite at our Marlborough, MA site, In the Research Intern role, you will serve as a critical contributor to the development and integration of Sartorius’ emerging technologies for characterization and purification of different types of nanoparticles such as extracellular vesicles and viral vectors. These leading-edge platforms will be utilized in basic research as well as the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. What you will accomplish together with us Execute Purification Protocols : Perform purification of EVs and viral vectors using TFF systems (hollow fiber and/or flat sheet) and various chromatography modalities (e.g., ion exchange, size exclusion, affinity). Optimize Unit Operations : Assist in the design and optimization of downstream steps to improve product yield , purity , and scalability . System Operation and Maintenance : Operate and maintain TFF and chromatography systems (e.g., AKTA or equivalent), including set-up, cleaning, and troubleshooting. Sample Handling and Quantification : Prepare and process samples following SOPs. Quantify particles using orthogonal methods such as NTA, qPCR, protein assays, and total RNA analysis. Process Monitoring and Data Recording : Monitor and document key parameters (e.g., transmembrane pressure, flux, recovery) during TFF runs. Maintain detailed lab notebooks and process logs. Analytical Support : Support integration of downstream data with analytical assays (e.g., flow cytometry, SEC-MALS, SDS-PAGE) for process characterization. Collaborative Work : Interact regularly with upstream, analytical, and formulation teams to align on process goals and transfer knowledge. Safety and Compliance : Follow laboratory safety protocols and ensure compliance with quality standards and experimental reproducibility. What will convince us Education: PhD candidate in Bioengineering, or closely related discipline with formal education and experience with extracellular vesicles characterization and purification. Experience: Hands-on experience with TFF systems (lab or pilot scale) for nanoparticle or biologics concentration and diafiltration. Practical knowledge of chromatography techniques such as SEC, IEX, or affinity purification. Familiarity with nanoparticle systems such as EVs, viral vectors (e.g., AAV, lentivirus), or LNPs. Comfortable working in a wet lab environment with complex biological samples. Strong documentation and organizational skills; experience with SOPs and batch records is a plus. Experience with analytical tools (e.g., NTA, BCA, qPCR, HPLC, or SEC-MALS) is highly desirable Identification with our core values: Sustainability, Openness, Enjoyment Compensation is up to $30 hr. jobs.title: PCB Layout Intern
jobs.body: Location: Burlington, ON, Canada Reporting to: Manager, Hardware Engineering Our Team: Semtech Corporation designs innovative semiconductor solutions and intellectual property cores for the world's most advanced consumer connectivity and data communications products. Within our Signal Integrity Products business unit, our Hardware Design team is currently looking for a student intern for a period of up to 16 months at our Burlington, ON Design Center. Job Summary: As a full member of our Hardware Design group, you will contribute by delivering innovative high-speed board design and assembly for the purpose of performance measurement of semiconductor products. You'll work alongside our product development and applications teams — both locally and remotely — developing internal and customer-facing hardware, and gain exposure to leading-edge design tools and technologies used across both our Applications and Hardware teams. This role offers a strong opportunity for growth and development in card design and electrical modeling, working in parallel with several cross-functional teams internally. Our approach to internship is to make you a full, integrated part of our team. We believe the best learning comes through direct involvement, so you'll start with tasks that let you learn and contribute at the same time — as your skills grow, so will the complexity of what you take on. Our internship program is an important part of our recruiting strategy. Please note that this is an on-site position, requiring you to be in the office Monday to Thursday for a 40-hour work week. Responsibilities: PCB Design & Layout Work with senior engineers to develop evaluation platforms using cutting-edge bills of material, design tools, and manufacturing design rules. Perform schematic capture, PCB layout, and system-level signal integrity analysis and optimization using platforms such as Cadence Allegro/OrCAD. Mechanical & Cross-Functional Support Support mechanical design of fixtures, housings, and thermal solutions using Autodesk Fusion. Interface in parallel with several cross-functional teams internally to support evaluation platform development. Minimum Qualifications: Strong debug skills. Experience with Cadence Allegro for PCB layout. Experience with Autodesk Fusion for mechanical design. Familiarity with RF and high-speed digital (>10Gbps) design. Knowledge of optical and high-speed test equipment. Excellent cross-functional team and leadership skills. Good communication and organizational skills. Team player with a customer-focused mindset. Highly motivated, goal-driven, self-starter. Semtech, an equal opportunity employer, values the diversity, knowledge and expertise of our workforce. Success, Ethics, Respect and Alignment are the foundational values of our business and guide our relationships with employees, shareholders, customers and other stakeholders. jobs.title: Process Development Engineer Intern - DLP
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is seeking a Process Development Engineering Intern within the DLP® Products MEMS Development group. We work to define and develop the next generation manufacturing processes for Digital Micromirror Devices (DMD) and Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS). Our team uses standard semiconductor wafer fabrication methods such as photolithography, etch, and thin film deposition for high volume MEMS manufacturing. The process development engineer works closely with design, characterization, and test teams to play a key role in ensuring the yield and reliability of new products. The role includes activities such as: Design of experiments to establish new manufacturing methods and process recipes, Use of process characterization tools such as scanning electron microscopy, ellipsometry, atomic force microscopy, and interferometry, Identification and characterization of new thin films materials, Data analysis for process and test yield improvement, Working within the team to drive the necessary actions to meet the yield and reliability needs for the technology. Minimum requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in areas such as Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Optoelectronics or related engineering degree. Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Strong background in semiconductor processing and characterization methods Basic understanding of operation and fabrication methods for MEMS Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

jobs.title: Utah: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Do you want to work for an organization that values your opinion? Do you want to work for an organization where you can play a pivotal role in several different areas? As a Texas Instruments Manufacturing Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work in a vibrant and dynamic team-oriented environment. TI’s Manufacturing Engineers are technical leaders who get to work in the world’s most advanced manufacturing facilities. We bring the company’s breakthrough innovations to life by manufacturing technologies that are literally changing the world. TI Process and Equipment Engineers are responsible for all aspects of a wafer fabrication process including tool selection and process definition. They assist with the installation, modification, upgrade and maintenance of the manufacturing equipment. This includes process setup and technician and operator training. This position will use data to make intelligent improvements to overall fabrication process and will be responsible for understanding all aspects of the process performed. This includes the interaction of the process to other fab processing, enabling accurate product dispositions of non-conforming product. Interaction normally requires the ability to gain cooperation of others and conducting presentations of technical information concerning specific projects/schedules. As a Manufacturing Product Engineer, you will interface with design, process, test, reliability and manufacturing engineering to solve product issues and production problems, as well as developing process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields. Manufacturing Product Engineers also manage new product introduction and production support engineering for a specific product or group of products after they have been transferred from design to in-house or outsourced production. In this semiconductor fab engineer role with TI’s worldwide manufacturing organization, you will be responsible for engineering process optimization efforts to achieve fab cycle time goals. You will interface with various modules, in addition to yield, product and integration teams, to resolve issues that limit yield performance. Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position. Minimum requirements: Pursuing a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical& Computer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Microelectronics or MET Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

jobs.title: Physics Engineering Internship: Supersonic Flow Visualization
jobs.body: Introduction The Contamination Control team at ASML develops solutions that help protect critical components inside advanced lithography systems. Even the smallest particles can affect highly sensitive optical surfaces, making contamination control an important area of research. In this internship, you will contribute to understanding the behavior of supersonic gas jets at extremely low ambient pressures using advanced optical diagnostics. Your work will help generate insights that support future contamination-control technologies for ASML systems. This Physics Engineering internship offers a unique opportunity to combine fluid dynamics, optics, and experimental research in a challenging high-tech environment. Your assignment During this internship, you will help develop and operate an advanced experimental setup for visualizing supersonic gas flows at low ambient pressures. You will work on improving measurement capabilities, performing experiments, and analyzing complex flow phenomena. The results of this project will contribute to future contamination-control concepts and provide recommendations for further technology development. Your main responsibilities will be: Upgrade an existing Schlieren imaging setup for low-pressure flow visualization Develop and implement automated flow and optical control methods Design and perform experiments across a wide range of pressure conditions Analyze flow structures, shock patterns, and jet expansion behavior Compare experimental results with theoretical models and simulation outcomes Document findings in a clear and structured manner Present recommendations for future experiments and potential applications This is a master thesis internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 36 hours per week (4 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of January or February 2027. Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in physics engineering, applied physics, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field Have knowledge of fluid dynamics, optics, or experimental physics Are analytical and enjoy investigating complex technical challenges Take initiative and are comfortable working in a pioneering research environment Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with others Have a structured and proactive approach to experimental work and data analysis This Physics Engineering internship is ideal for students who enjoy hands-on experimental research and want to explore flow phenomena in a pressure regime that remains largely unexplored. You will work with advanced optical diagnostic techniques, contribute to meaningful research, and gain experience in a multidisciplinary environment. The Physics Engineering internship provides the opportunity to combine theory and experimentation while developing technical and professional skills. Through this Physics Engineering internship, you will help advance knowledge that supports future innovations in contamination control for ASML's next-generation lithography systems. This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). jobs.title: Continuous Improvement - Intern / Co-op
jobs.body: What you’ll do: Why Join Eaton? At Eaton, we make what matters work. Our commitment to operational excellence, safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement helps us improve lives and the environment. As a Continuous Improvement Intern / Co-op, you will gain hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment while supporting improvement projects connected to the Eaton Business System, Lean principles, digital transformation, and operational excellence. Position Overview: This position is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. The selected candidate will be expected to work on-site a minimum of 20 hours per week during the academic term and collaborate directly with Continuous Improvement leaders, operations teams, and plant personnel. • Support Continuous Improvement projects aligned with the Eaton Business System and site business priorities. • Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret operational data to help identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities. • Participate in Kaizen events, Lean activities, and Continuous Improvement workshops focused on reducing waste, improving flow, and supporting safety, quality, delivery, and productivity goals. • Assist with development and updates to standard work, visual management tools, training aids, and process documentation. • Support Lean tools and methods such as 5S, value stream mapping, standard work, root cause analysis, and Total Productive Maintenance. • Assist with smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 initiatives, which may include digital dashboards, data visualization, real-time performance monitoring, or related approved technologies. • Partner with manufacturing, quality, engineering, EHS, maintenance, and operations teams to support process improvement activities. • Prepare and present project updates, findings, and recommendations to site leaders and project stakeholders. • Follow Eaton safety requirements, site procedures, and applicable policies while working in office and manufacturing areas. Qualifications: Basic Qualifications: • Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor's degree program in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Electrical Engineering; Operations Excellence; Continuous Improvement; or a closely related discipline. • Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0. • Must be entering junior year or higher, or have equivalent academic credit standing, at the start of the assignment. • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. . • Must reside within 50 miles of the Pinckneyville, IL facility. Relocation is not provided for this position. • Must be available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week on-site at Eaton's Pinckneyville, IL facility during the academic term. • Must be able to work full-time during designated school breaks, as business needs permit. Preferred Qualifications: • Coursework, project experience, or prior work experience related to Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, manufacturing, quality, operations, or engineering. • Familiarity with Lean tools such as 5S, standard work, process mapping, value stream mapping, root cause analysis, or Kaizen. • Interest or experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, data analytics, automation, IoT, dashboards, or digital manufacturing tools. • Experience using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization or reporting tools. • Experience working in a manufacturing, operations, distribution, laboratory, technical, or project-based environment. • Prior internship, co-op, student project, research project, or campus leadership experience related to engineering, manufacturing, operations, or process improvement. Skills: Position Criteria: • Work safely and follow established procedures in a manufacturing environment. • Communicate clearly and professionally with employees, peers, supervisors, and leaders. • Work effectively as part of a team and build positive working relationships across functions. • Organize information, manage project tasks, and follow through on assigned deliverables. • Use data and observation to help identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend practical improvements. • Learn new systems, tools, and processes in a hands-on environment. • Maintain attention to detail when collecting data, preparing documentation, and reporting project results. • Demonstrate curiosity, accountability, adaptability, and a willingness to learn. Additional Information: Work Environment and Physical Requirements: This role will include work in both office and manufacturing environments. The employee may be required to: • Stand for extended periods of time. • Walk frequently throughout the manufacturing facility. • Work in a manufacturing environment that may not be air conditioned. • Wear required personal protective equipment as designated by the site. • Occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds, with or without assistance, mechanical support, or reasonable accommodation. • Work near manufacturing equipment, production areas, materials, tools, and normal plant noise levels. • Follow all Eaton safety rules, Life Saving Rules, and site-specific procedures. What You'll Gain: • Practical experience in a global manufacturing environment. • Exposure to Eaton Business System practices and Continuous Improvement methods. • Hands-on project experience supporting safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and digital transformation initiatives. • Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams and site leadership. • Development through meaningful work, coaching, feedback, and project report-outs. • Experience that can support future career growth in engineering, operations, manufacturing, quality, Continuous Improvement, or related fields. Assignment Duration: 12-month, temporary assignment. Final duration and schedule to be confirmed based on business needs and school program requirements. Schedule Requirement: Minimum of 20 hours per week of on-site work during the academic term; up to 40 hours per week during summer, winter, and other academic breaks, as business needs permit.

Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions. Demonstrated leadership through coursework, student organizations, research, athletics, military service, or other extracurricular activities preferred. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. WHAT WE OFFER Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. jobs.title: Lean Manufacturing Intern-2
jobs.body: Job Description Summary Support the Lean team in identifying and implementing process improvements to improve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Productivity. The intern will gain hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing, process analysis, time study, waste identification, and continuous improvement activities within the manufacturing environment. Job Description Key Responsibilities Observe shop-floor processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and propose improvement ideas/projects to improve productivity, quality, safety, or process flow. Support the execution and follow-up of improvement projects. Conduct data collection, basic analysis, and time studies to support improvement initiatives. Help identify waste and inefficiencies using Lean principles. Assist with Lean activities such as 5S, Visual Management, and Kaizen. Prepare reports, charts, and presentations using Excel and PowerPoint. Document improvement projects, track progress, and summarize results. Work with operators, supervisors, engineers, and other team members to support continuous improvement activities. Perform other Lean / Continuous Improvement tasks as assigned. Qualifications Active undergraduate student pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Engineering. Strong interest in Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, or Continuous Improvement. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Available to do fulltime internship minimum 6-month internship. Willing to be based in Bandung for the duration of the internship. Comfortable working in a manufacturing / shop-floor environment. Good analytical, communication, and teamwork skills. Proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. Preferred Technical Skills Basic understanding of Lean concepts such as 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and 7 Wastes. a student who enjoys observing processes, identifying problems, and turning ideas into practical improvement projects Basic CAD knowledge is a plus Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No
