jobs.body: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. Responsible for the quality of the parts they produce and follow all necessary inspection requirements. Work as a team member to aid all shifts and support co-workers to operate to department expectations. Focus on safety and follow all safety rules and requirements. Perform other duties as assigned. jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Summer Intern 2027
jobs.body: Location: Bristol Duration: 12 weeks Salary: £2500 per month Start date: June 2027 Applications deadline: Midnight 29 th November We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. The Internship Programme at Graphcore Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence. What you’ll be doing Put your engineering foundations to work exploring how advanced AI hardware moves from design into manufacture. As a Manufacturing Operations Intern in Manufacturing Operations Team, you’ll contribute to a defined project or set of tasks supporting silicon packaging or printed circuit board assembly production in Taiwan. Depending on your project, your tasks could include analysing performance data, helping investigate hardware or software issues, or supporting quality planning and process checks. You could also help review component information or bills of materials. Your contribution will help the team understand manufacturing performance and identify improvements to quality, cost or delivery. Your team and support You’ll join Manufacturing Operations in Bristol, working alongside Product Test, Quality and Supply Chain. Colleagues across the UK, Taiwan and India collaborate with design teams and development partners to solve manufacturing challenges. Experienced engineers and operations specialists will guide you through your tasks and help you understand how data and customer requirements inform decisions. You can ask for help as you investigate a problem, share your findings and use feedback to improve your work. Decisions are shaped by evidence, engineering judgement and open discussion. As an intern, you’ll be encouraged to ask questions, speak up and try out ideas early, with support from experienced colleagues as you learn. How you’ll learn and grow Over the 12 weeks, you’ll explore how engineering decisions affect a finished product and its journey through a global supply chain. Working with manufacturing data and practical investigations will help you connect your studies with real production challenges. You’ll practise comparing approaches, organising your work and explaining your findings, gaining a clearer sense of where a career in manufacturing engineering could take you. Your internship is a chance to explore a future at Graphcore. Depending on your performance and the roles available, there may be an opportunity to join one of our graduate programmes once you’ve graduated. What we're looking for Currently studying towards a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related field A basic understanding of semiconductor or electronics design and manufacturing principles, gained through study, projects or practical work An interest in the process of taking new designs into production, and in the challenges of making high volume manufacturing a success The ability to analyse data, approach problems methodically and explain your findings clearly Previous industry experience is not required. Tell us what you built or investigated through coursework, laboratory work, personal or team projects or other relevant experience, how you approached it and what you learned. Benefits Flexible working: Find a balance between your internship and life outside work 5 days of annual leave: Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship Life in the office: Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista Learning and development: Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. Sponsorship Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities. Introduction to Graphcore At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: From semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. An internship at Graphcore gives you the chance to explore where your interests and skills could take you. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. Together, you’ll share ideas and solve challenging problems, building experience and confidence to help you decide what comes next. How to apply and what to expect To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring. Curious about where your skills could take you? Apply for a summer internship at Graphcore and help us build what comes next.

jobs.title: HP Store Benelux Intern
jobs.body: HP Store Benelux Intern Description - At HP, we believe the future of work is created by curious minds, bold ideas, and people who want to make a real impact. From our beginnings in a Palo Alto garage in 1939 to becoming a global technology leader, innovation and inclusion have always been at the heart of what we do. Within HP, HP Store Benelux is responsible for the online consumer webshop in Belgium and the Netherlands. Our team works at the intersection of technology, e-commerce, marketing and commercial strategy, bringing HP products directly to our customers. Our Internship Program at HP Store Benelux is designed to help students turn academic learning into real-world experience, while contributing to meaningful projects in a fast-paced, commercial environment. About the Internship Program The HP Store Benelux Internship Program offers students hands-on, practical experience within a global technology company, with a strong local and commercial focus. Interns work closely with experienced professionals in areas such as e-commerce operations, commercial planning, content, pricing, campaigns and customer experience. The internship is built as a developmental experience, designed to support learning, growth, early career exploration, and insight into how a consumer-focused online business operates within a global organization. It is important to note that this internship is purely a learning and development opportunity. There is no full-time role attached to the completion of this internship. The internship is available from May 2027 onwards, with opportunities throughout the remainder of 2027. We can be flexible on both the exact start date and duration, depending on the student’s academic requirements and availability. The minimum internship period is three months, although we have a preference for longer internships where possible. As an intern at HP Store Benelux, you will: Contribute to real, meaningful projects that directly impact the HP online consumer store Support ongoing commercial and e-commerce activities for the Benelux market Apply academic knowledge to real-world business and customer challenges Collaborate with a local Benelux team while being part of a global HP organization Work in a professional, fast-paced environment with clear ownership and responsibility Present or showcase your work at the end of the internship Through the program, you will receive: Hands-on experience within an international e-commerce environment Mentorship and day-to-day guidance from experienced HP Store team members Exposure to commercial decision-making, online retail and consumer business processes Access to HP’s learning and development opportunities The chance to connect with other interns across HP as part of a broader intern community We are looking for students who: Are eager to learn and motivated to contribute in a commercial, customer-focused environment Are currently enrolled in a university or higher education programme, preferably in a commercial, business or marketing-related field Show curiosity, ownership and a proactive mindset Are comfortable working with data, digital tools or online content Can work effectively in a team and communicate clearly Are open to feedback and personal development Have an interest in consumer electronics; this is considered a plus, but no specific product knowledge is required Have previous experience in e-commerce, retail, hospitality or another customer-focused environment; this is considered a plus, but is not required Why HP Store Benelux? At HP, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, people-first workplace. Within HP Store Benelux, you will work in a relatively small, hands-on team where your contribution is visible and valued. jobs.title: Intern - Compute System Compatibility Engineer
jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. We validate Micron memory products on current and next-generation computing platforms. As an Intern System Compatibility Engineer, you will join our System Enablement and Test Development teams and gain hands-on experience with platform bring-up, system configuration, memory validation, test development, automation, data analysis, and AI-enabled engineering workflows under the guidance of experienced engineers. We will provide technical mentorship, structured onboarding, and exposure to DRAM, BIOS and firmware interactions, computer architecture, laboratory workflows, responsible use of approved AI tools, and the memory product lifecycle from initial bring-up through qualification and readiness. Key Responsibilities Set up and support Intel, AMD, and ARM-based systems in Linux, Windows, and UEFI environments; document hardware, BIOS, firmware, operating system, memory, and test configurations for repeatable execution and traceability. Implement memory validation activities that assess compatibility, stability, reliability, performance, and platform readiness. Reproduce and triage failures, collect logs and diagnostic data, use issue-tracking systems, apply structured failure-analysis methods, and support validation of corrective actions. Build or refine automation using Python, PowerShell, C++, or related languages; use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate code development, test generation, log analysis, data summarization, technical research, documentation, and reporting while applying engineering judgment to verify accuracy and results. Apply responsible AI practices by protecting confidential information, using company-approved tools and data sources, documenting AI-assisted work where appropriate, identifying potential errors or bias, and independently validating generated code, analysis, and technical conclusions before use. Collaborate with System Enablement, Test Engineering, product, quality, and program teams on assigned validation and root-cause investigation activities. Communicate findings, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and recommended next steps through concise documentation and presentations. Internship Assignment - The intern will complete a bounded technical project or workstream with defined milestones, measurable deliverables, technical documentation, and a final presentation. The assignment will be selected to provide relevant business value while remaining achievable within a three-month summer internship! Required Qualifications Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field. Must be continuing education in the fall term following the internship; the expected graduation date must not be before September of the same year. Foundational knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, computer architecture, and structured problem-solving. Programming or scripting experience gained through coursework, projects, laboratories, student organizations, or other technical experience using Python, PowerShell, C++, or a comparable language. Basic proficiency using AI-enabled tools to research technical topics, develop or solve code, analyze data, summarize findings, or improve documentation, with the ability to review outputs critically and confirm accuracy. Ability to follow test procedures, maintain accurate configuration records, analyze data, and summarize technical results. Interest in hands-on laboratory validation, system debug, test development, or engineering automation. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with DRAM, memory systems, BIOS or UEFI, firmware, server or client platforms, or hardware interfaces. Familiarity with x86 or ARM architectures, Intel, AMD, ARM-based, or embedded platforms, and Linux, Windows, or UEFI environments. Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, power measurement equipment, or similar diagnostic tools. Experience applying generative AI, machine learning, automation, or data-analysis tools to an engineering or academic workflow—for example, developing code, generating tests, analyzing logs, identifying patterns, creating dashboards, improving documentation, or automating repetitive tasks. Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, adaptability, partnership, and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools and technologies. jobs.body: Overview English Text Follows French Nous recrutons pour plusieurs stages de 6 mois qui débuteront en janvier 2027 . jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineering Intern - Compute Performance
jobs.location: Germany, Munich; France, Courbevoie; Germany, Wuerselen
jobs.body: NVIDIA is hiring passionate, world-class computer science studetns to work in its Compute Developer Technology (Devtech) team. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working with us and our engineering teams are growing fast in some of the hottest and state of the art fields: Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Vehicles, Supercomputing and more. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a real passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. What you will be doing: In this role, you will research and develop techniques to GPU-accelerate leading applications in high performance computing fields within scientific computing, computational engineering, and data science. You will be performing in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current and next-generation GPU architectures. This involves: Working directly with key application developers to understand the current and future problems they are solving, crafting and optimizing core parallel algorithms and data structures to provide the best solutions using GPUs, through both library development and direct contribution to the applications. Collaborating closely with diverse groups at NVIDIA such as the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models, by investigating the impact on application performance and developer productivity. What we need to see: Pursuing a MSc or preferably PhD degree in an engineering or computer science related discipline. Programming fluency in C/C++ and/or Fortran with a deep understanding of software design, programming techniques, and algorithms. Strong mathematical fundamentals, including linear algebra and numerical methods. Experience with parallel programming, ideally CUDA C/C++ and OpenACC. Strong communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and task prioritization skills. jobs.body: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. The Isaac Loco-Manipulation team develops innovative robot learning technologies that enable humanoid and mobile robots for complex dexterous manipulation and loco-manipulation tasks. This internship combines ambitious applied research and thorough engineering across GR00T and Cosmos foundation models, Isaac Lab, Newton, synthetic data generation, simulation, and physical robot testing. What you’ll be doing: Develop novel robot learning methods for advancing performance in humanoids and mobile manipulators for whole-body dexterous tasks. Co-develop and advance GR00T and Cosmos robotics foundation models. Develop robot-learning technologies to enable large scale deployment of robot autonomy. Lead an applied research project from idea conception, prototype development, publication, and software open-source contribution. Proven strong robotics research or engineering experience through academic projects, publications, and real robot experience. Proficiency in Python and C++, with hands-on experience using deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. Experience with physics simulators like Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or MuJoCo and transferring data or behaviors between simulated and physical systems. Experience with world modeling and world action models. Project or research experience in robot learning, including imitation learning or reinforcement learning, and robotics foundation models. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Strong publication record in leading robotics, computer-vision, or machine-learning journals or conferences such as CoRL, RSS, Science Robotics, ICRA, and CVPR. Experience in learning robot behaviors from human videos or demonstrations. Research or project depth in dexterous bimanual manipulation, whole-body control, or humanoid robotics. jobs.body: With its five product lines of compact hydraulics Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA , with factories in the province of Modena and Reggio Emilia and over 1,300 employees, has been producing and marketing compact hydraulic components for multiple applications for over 40 years, from aerial platforms to cranes, earth-moving machinery, agricultural machinery, industrial applications. For this reason, the products of Bosch Rexroth Oil Control S.p.A. they are synonymous with quality and represent a guarantee for the global market. This opens up enormous potential for the easy and economical integration of machines and systems into modern industrial environments. Our R&D department based in Nonantola (MO) is a center of global competence for Compact Hydraulic products. We are looking for a proactive and curious intern to join our Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) team . In this role, you will gain hands-on, practical experience under the guidance of experienced mentors. You will not just learn the theory; you will actively support plant operations, participate in field activities, and contribute to fostering a strong safety culture across the entire plant. Assigned Project Enhancing Behavioral Safety & HSE Risk Control Review and map existing plant risk control checklists to identify areas for improvement and simplify field monitoring; Analyze historical near-miss data and safety observation trends to highlight the most common behavioral risks; Develop practical, visual guidelines and safe-work practices to assist shopfloor operators and team leaders; Collaborate with key plant functions (Operations, Logistics, and Quality) to gather feedback on daily safety practices and help align HSE procedures with operational needs. You will work on a wide variety of tasks and projects with a cross-functional team of professionals, including Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Manufacturing, Productivity, and Plant teams. Pursuing a degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Data Analytics, or a related field. Maintains strong academic credentials. Strong proficiency in Excel; Power BI experience is a plus. Comfortable pulling and analyzing data from dashboards and systems independently. Interest in AI tools and willingness to learn new platforms such as Zenlytic to help automate and simplify processes. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize complex work into structured templates, trackers, and process flows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working across teams and following up on deliverables. Detail-oriented and able to keep trackers, action items, and project updates current. Self-starter who learns by doing, asks questions, and brings new ideas and feedback to the table. Successfully manages strong academics alongside extracurricular activities. jobs.title: DoW SkillBridge | Equipment Technician Intern (Dallas/Richardson, TX)
jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. Texas Instruments is looking for highly skilled individuals transitioning from military service and eligible for the Department of War's SkillBridge Program to participate in a program opportunity as a Semiconductor Equipment Technician Intern. This is a fantastic opportunity to leverage your proven technical aptitude, problem-solving abilities, and commitment to operational excellence in a cutting-edge, high-tech environment. You will be crucial in maintaining, repairing, and optimizing complex semiconductor manufacturing equipment to ensure world-class production performance. Your experience in the military has prepared you for this opportunity. We value your ability to execute complex tasks under pressure, adhere to strict procedures, and maintain mission readiness. Responsibilities include: Perform preventative maintenance, equipment repairs, equipment improvements, equipment upgrades, and equipment installation Improve system performance to achieve process requirements and eliminate repetitive downs Monitor and analyze all related data to improve and maintain tool performance and address all tool related issues Interface and communicate with engineering and manufacturing groups across the fab to ensure all issues are solved appropriately and efficiently. jobs.title: Advanced Quality Engineering Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. What Will You Do? The Advanced Quality Engineering Intern will partner with the Advanced Quality Engineering Team located at our worldwide headquarters. This position will support product development teams, suppliers, & manufacturing plants on new and existing products. Primary job duties will include assisting in the development & deployment of new product advanced quality plans, processes and systems for the Toro Company. Assist in streamlining Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, including PPAP management, APQP dashboard development, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Engineering, Quality & Manufacturing teams to develop product design & manufacturing quality requirements. Engage in the New Product Development (NPD) process. Help collect, analyze, and report quality data to support decision-making and continuous improvements efforts. Assess product conformance by performing product validation audits. Pursue corrective actions with appropriate parties on non-conformances. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Actively enrolled in an accredited 4-year engineering program in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or related degree area. We require interns to be enrolled in an educational program during the duration of the internship program. Must have achieved Junior status (2 years completed), with a graduation date no sooner than December of 2027. Technology background/studies preferred. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative, team-oriented environment. Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills Proficiency with MS software (Excel, Word, & PowerPoint) We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $22–$28. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Inventory & Stock Management Analyst - Internship
jobs.body: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Inventory & Stock Management Analyst – Internship Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and analytical Inventory & Stock Management Analyst Intern to join our Warehouse Operations team. The successful candidate will support inventory management activities, material replenishment planning and data quality monitoring, contributing to the continuous improvement of warehouse processes within a regulated pharmaceutical environment. The role offers the opportunity to develop analytical skills, gain hands-on experience in supply chain operations and actively contribute to process optimization initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. Inventory Analysis & Stock Monitoring Support inventory data analysis to monitor stock levels, material availability and inventory accuracy. Develop and maintain reports and KPIs to identify inventory trends, discrepancies and opportunities for improvement. Support the identification of potential stock shortages and inventory inefficiencies. 2. Material Replenishment & Scheduling Optimization Work closely with the Warehouse Scheduler to support material replenishment planning from external storage facilities. Analyze and optimize existing scheduling tools and Excel-based planning files to improve efficiency, accuracy and visibility of material flows. Support the development of data-driven solutions to improve replenishment planning and material availability. Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize scheduling and reporting activities. 3.Incoming Material Data Quality & Documentation Analysis Analyze incoming material documentation to identify missing, incomplete or inconsistent information required for inventory registration. Monitor and categorize documentation anomalies, with particular attention to critical data such as material expiration dates, batch numbers and traceability information. Develop statistical reports and KPIs to track anomaly frequency, recurring issues and data quality trends. Support the identification of root causes and potential corrective or preventive improvements in collaboration with the relevant warehouse and quality functions. Contribute to improving data accuracy, documentation completeness and reliability of inventory records. 4. Continuous Improvement & Reporting Support process improvement initiatives through data analysis, reporting automation and optimization of existing tools. Develop dashboards and analytical reports to facilitate operational decision-making. Collaborate with warehouse and supply chain stakeholders to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements. Contribute to standardization and digitalization initiatives within warehouse operations. Qualifications & Skills Education - Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Economics, Statistics or related disciplines. Technical Skills Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, Pivot Tables and data analysis. Strong analytical mindset and ability to interpret operational data. Familiarity with Power BI, Power Query or other data visualization tools is considered a plus. Basic knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is an advantage. Good command of English. Soft Skills Strong attention to detail and data accuracy. Problem-solving attitude and continuous improvement mindset. Good organizational and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment. Proactive approach and willingness to learn. Learning Opportunities During the internship, the candidate will have the opportunity to: · Gain practical experience in inventory management and pharmaceutical warehouse operations. · Develop data analysis and reporting skills applied to real operational challenges. · Understand material replenishment planning and warehouse scheduling processes. · Learn the importance of data integrity, documentation accuracy and material traceability in a regulated environment. · Participate in continuous improvement initiatives with measurable operational impact.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Discover an Exceptional Opportunity Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of engineering and making a real-world impact? As a Mechatronics Intern at Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., you will have the chance to work on groundbreaking discoveries that tackle the world's toughest challenges. With our investment of over $1 billion annually in R&D, you will be part of a world-class team that strives for flawless execution and ambitious innovation. The department The Mechanical Engineering team is one of the Competence & Technology departments of TEM Solutions, the Research and Development organization for Transmission Electron Microscopes (TEM). This group is committed to develop breakthrough technologies, modules and software that enable us to deliver innovative TEM microscopes for our demanding markets and customers. With the ongoing developments in physics and industry the requirements for performance of these TEM microscopes are continuously growing. Aligning well with the Advanced Technology Department and several strategic collaboration partners, in our TEM Solutions department we are striving to convert the most promising technological concepts into real products - with the purpose to enable our customers to make the world cleaner, healthier and safer! The Position As Mechanical Intern Engineer you will join an enthusiastic and driven team responsible for the mechanical aspects of high-tech electron-microscope modules or sub-systems. In your project you can see your designs grow from a conceptual idea to a finished product for our customers. Your challenge will be to find solutions for technological sophisticated problems, meeting the needs of all relevant parties, combining short term goals with long term needs. The position will allow you to grow both in technical as in business skills! We will challenge you to get the best out of yourself. You will report directly to the group manager of the Mechanical team within the TEM Solution R&D organization. Key Responsibilities In this role you will have the following key responsibilities: Perform mechanical simulations and analysis on systems and subsystems Design, analyze and test mechanical systems, subsystems on mechatronic performance Collaborate with a team of engineers covering multiple competences (mechatronics, electrical, software, dynamics) Qualifications A successful candidate possesses the following combination of education and experience: University or HBO student in the field of mechanical engineering Additional work experience in this field is a plus. Experience in applied mechanics, FEM and material constitutive behavior is a plus Experience with software tools such as Matlab, Simulink, UX and ANSYS or equivalent experience You would characterize yourself as follows: You demonstrate a proactive approach, showcasing your ability to take initiative, be self-steering, and exhibit self-confidence. You take initiative, are self-steering and self-confident and have perseverance. You are eager to learn and flexible when circumstances change. You combine a strong analytical view with a pragmatic demeanor. You are an excellent communicator and a good teammate. You are value oriented and able to set and act according to priorities at the same time. You are not afraid to step outside of your safe zone and seek new opportunities Personal Diversity in our teams is an important element to build an effective and challenging working environment. Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement are key characteristics that we expect of all that are part of our community. Apply now! Thermo Fisher Scientific does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: 2027 Energy Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies , and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King , sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. Where is the work: On-Site (5 days) What’s in it for you: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, it’s our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference in building efficiency and sustainability through our Equipment, Service or Controls / Building Automation offerings. Trane Technologies, the global leader in innovative climate solutions, hands on summer internship allows participants to explore a career in Energy Engineering through the following: A 12-week Summer internship program that will challenge and develop your technical, business, leadership, and communication skills. Gain insight into an Energy Engineering Career with Trane Technologies, focusing on solutions that provide our customers with the most energy-efficient buildings. Work on a variety of engineering aspects, including energy analysis projects, completion of field energy audits, client interviews, completion of estimates, and development of energy conversation measures, and project management. This internship will provide you with the experience to pursue a career in Energy Engineering and creates the opportunity to join our industry leading Graduate Training Program (GTP) after graduation. What you will do: Our internship program provides you with the opportunity to learn more about us while you collaborate with peers across North America. As an Energy Engineer Intern, you may experience and assist in: Partnering with Account Managers and Energy Engineers to diagnose energy opportunities with customer’s facilities and provide small energy projects that solve customer issues/opportunities. Providing technical analysis/review for energy projects; providing project risk assessment. Shadowing and performing building “walk-throughs” and identifying energy conservation measures (architectural, mechanical, electrical, etc.) in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities. Collaborating on the development of existing reporting capabilities from a software standpoint and a usability perspective and investigate new technologies. Prescribing best methods for measurement and verification of system performance during the acquisition phase. Analyzing data outputs for trends and/or any deviations that need further investigating. Assisting with opportunity technical qualification including Preliminary Audits, Benchmarking, Site Surveys, and Interviews. Collecting, analyzing, and developing benchmark summary reports to illustrate the pertinent details of building and/or system performance. What you will bring: Actively enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, (preferred disciplines: Energy, Mechanical or Electrical) throughout the entire duration of the summer internship. Candidates must have completed at least their sophomore or 2nd year before the start of the summer internship to be eligible for internship positions. Be a U.S. citizen or have the legal right to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. This posting is for multiple opportunities. Some positions may be remote while others may require a hybrid or onsite assignment at one of our facilities across North America. Possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, ability to provide proof of insurance, and have no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 3 years Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless / Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. This role has been designated by the Company as Safety Sensitive. Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range: $22.50 - $31.00 Compensation Type: Hourly Incentive Eligible: No Sales Commission Eligible: No Disclaimer : We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. Thrive at work and at home: Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. Disclaimer: Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations Safety Sensitive Role: No The company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship
jobs.body: Build relationships. Be part of history. Have an impact… We are a hypersonic transportation company focused on doing what people once thought was impossible. And, we have a place for you if you want to be part of hypersonic history. We're looking for intern candidates with relevant academic, project, research, or hands-on experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Propulsion Systems Engineering Structures Engineering (Vehicle Engineering & Design) Manufacturing Engineering Software Engineering Test Operations Brands & Communications Business Strategy & Operations As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor, experienced engineers, and other teammates who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. What You Have: Must be able to meet U.S. Government space technology regulations, including ITAR. Ability to be onsite with us in Houston, TX. Cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher on a 4.0 scale Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have at least one semester of school remaining after the internship. Available to work full time for a minimum of 11 weeks and start in either May or June. Strong written, verbal, communication, and interpersonal skills – we work in a highly collaborative environment. Aerospace experience is not required - we are looking for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who enjoy solving tough problems and want to make an impact in hypersonic travel. Must be at least a rising junior (entering the third year of undergraduate study) by the start of the summer internship program. What Will Set You Apart: Relevant engineering internship/co-op and academic project experience that demonstrate development of both technical skills as well as leadership qualities. Relevant academic, hands-on project experience. Passion for hypersonic travel. Even if you have skill sets and experience that are outside of our current needs, we encourage you to apply. If you’ve demonstrated a commitment to academic success and motivation to apply your knowledge outside of the classroom, we may have a future opportunity for you! Salary will be within the range of $26/hour to $30/hour and based on current class standing and program i.e. junior, senior, undergraduate, master's, etc.

jobs.title: Product Material Compliance Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Job Summary: The Product Material Compliance Engineer Intern will be responsible for analyzing Vertiv’s products for compliance with material regulations (including RoHS, REACH, TSCA, PoP’s, PFAS and others) and customer requirements. The Material Compliance Engineer contributes to a range of responsibilities, including evaluating compliance for new products; recertification of existing products; evaluating the impact of regulations and customer requests; analyzing compliance and process related data and making recommendations; and executing projects to develop and improve related processes. This individual will also collaborate with the procurement and engineering teams to improve the data in Vertiv’s systems and the data collected from Vertiv’s suppliers. This role may also support other compliance, ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance), sustainability and engineering activities. Responsibilities: · Utilize the material compliance processes within Vertiv product development (VPD) to ensure that products are compliant and product introduction schedules are met. · Assist in driving improvement in the process of gathering and managing material compliance data between Vertiv’s product development system and its 3rd party compliance outreach provider. · Develop and maintain subject matter expertise on material compliance regulations and best practices. · Assist in improving the Product Material Compliance Team’s processes and protocols to improve efficiency and quality. · Manage data entry into the environmental compliance database on a daily basis. Requirements: · Background in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, or related discipline required. · MS Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. · Bill of Material management systems (ex. Oracle PD, Agile, TeamCenter) · Experience working with electronics hardware, components, assemblies is a plus. · Experience with product compliance databases. Previous experience with PLM and Assent Manager is a plus. · English, fluent written and spoken · Strong analytical skills; should have the ability to evaluate, analyze and present data · Empathetic collaborator whose style builds commitment and engagement. · Intellectual curiosity about determining root causes to solve complex problems. · Self-motivated, driven individual who is comfortable working in a global, matrixed, fast-paced environment · Continuously looks for improvements, owns/acts on problems, and seeks opportunities to increase effectiveness and efficiency. · Clearly exchanges thoughts, ideas and messages through written, verbal and non-verbal methods that promote an understanding with the target audience. Creates accurate and punctual reports, shares information and ideas with others in a timely manner. Listens carefully and attentively. #LI-RB1

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Intern - Brampton, ON (On-site)
jobs.body: Job Description VICTAULIC Manufacturing Engineer Intern Brampton, ON Full-Time Contract (May 2027 to August 2027) ABOUT VICTAULIC Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries. Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures. An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people. Let’s Build a Better World Together. Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars: We build from within. We stand behind our people. We foster an environment for constant learning. We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world. YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE We’re looking for a Manufacturing Engineer Intern to join our Manufacturing Team in Brampton, ON . In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting manufacturing processes, developing and updating production standards, analyzing operational data, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. You’ll work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Production, and Quality Assurance to support projects that improve productivity, quality, cost, and safety. This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge in a practical manufacturing environment while developing valuable technical and problem-solving skills. WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN Participate in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, cost, and safety. Create and update method sheets and standard operating procedures for new and existing manufacturing processes. Audit and update production standards within electronic databases. Create and maintain bills of materials. Support Manufacturing Supervisors and Engineers in sourcing tooling, fixtures, and gauges required for manufacturing operations. Assist Quality Assurance with identifying and addressing supplier-related issues. Support the implementation of engineering change notices. Assist the Manufacturing Engineer with machine setup, design activities, and new plant programming. Contribute to various Manufacturing Engineering and Quality Assurance projects. WHAT YOU BRING Preparing to enter your final year of study, currently enrolled in an Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related university degree or college diploma program. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a hands-on manufacturing environment. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications and working with electronic data and documentation. A strong interest in manufacturing processes, continuous improvement, and engineering operations. WHAT SETS YOU APART Previous experience in a manufacturing support role and/or shop floor experience. Previous hands-on technical, machining, or manufacturing experience. Exposure to CNC programming or Mastercam Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, production standards, or continuous improvement processes WHAT WE OFFER Build A Better Career Hands-on experience working on meaningful projects Mentorship and development opportunities with experienced professionals Exposure to multiple areas of the business and industry-leading practices Access to learning and development resources, including Victaulic University Opportunity to build your professional network and gain valuable career experience Build A Better Future Gain practical experience that supports your academic and career goals Develop technical, professional, and leadership skills Opportunity to be considered for future internship, co-op, or full-time opportunities based on performance and business needs Experience working for a global industry leader with a strong culture of growth and innovation Build A Better You Wellness Works Program (where applicable) Inclusive, collaborative, and team-oriented culture where people look out for one another Opportunities to connect with colleagues through employee engagement and community initiatives Build A Better World Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day. COMPENSATION $25/hr EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Victaulic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, welcoming applicants without discrimination based on age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. Victaulic is committed to providing equitable opportunities to all applicants and welcomes applications from all qualified persons. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please notify us at hr.canada@victaulic.com and we will work with you to meet your needs. AI-assisted tools may be used to support the review of applications as part of the hiring process. Let’s Build a Better World Together. victaulic.com/careers #LI-JL1

jobs.title: Summer Intern - Setpoint and Control Systems
jobs.body: > Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace. About the role: As a Setpoints and Control Systems Engineering intern, you will collaborate with experienced engineers and subject matter experts across a variety of nuclear subsystems. You will report to the Setpoint and Control Systems Manager and be located at our Warrendale and Cranberry facilities. This is a paid full-time hybrid position for the summer, May - August 2027. Key Responsibilities: You will support functional design of AP1000 digital control systems and legacy analog protection systems Maintain NSSS Control System Functional Requirements and Diagrams Maintain plant NSSS Design Transients for component qualification Analyze operational transients to test I&C logic and settings Analyze low‑temperature over‑pressurization scenarios and develop/maintain LTOPS configurations to ensure adequate protection Perform calculations to ensure reactor protection systems meet safety limits considering instrumentation and process uncertainties You will determine setpoints that govern daily plant operations Other responsibilities assigned by the Setpoint and Control Systems Manager Qualifications: Pursuing a bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or nuclear engineering Completed Sophomore year of college Coursework in statistics, data analysis, fluid mechanics, dynamic systems, and thermodynamics Coursework in Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR) design and operation We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. jobs.title: Nuclear Engineering Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.body: X-energy LLC conducts a thorough recruiting process and will never issue offers without interview to discuss qualifications and responsibilities. All applications will be submitted via our company career page, www.x-energy.com/careers/ . We will never ask you to provide payment information as part of the recruiting process. If anyone claiming to represent X-energy directs you in a manner otherwise, please contact us at www.x-energy.com/contact-us . Job Description This role is responsible for supporting professional employees working in an organizational function related to the Intern's area of study. Depending on the internship assignment, the intern may work alongside engineers, scientists, or industry professionals to contribute to various projects related to their area of study. Under guided supervision, interns will assist with various projects and tasks, contributing to the organization's goals while learning from experienced professionals in the field. Please note: This is a pipeline requisition for anticipated Summer 2027 internship openings. We accept and review applications on a rolling basis, and we extend offers as individual positions are finalized and specific team hiring needs are confirmed. Submitting an application places you in consideration for upcoming opportunities as they open. What You'll Do Support active engineering projects and analyses within your area of study, contributing to work that advances real reactor design and licensing efforts. Assist with the day-to-day technical and operational needs of your team. Conduct research, gather technical data, and synthesize findings to inform ongoing design and analysis initiatives. Help develop reports, technical documentation, and presentations that communicate results to internal stakeholders. Organize and maintain project files, technical records, and documentation to support traceability and quality. Participate actively in team meetings, design reviews, and brainstorming sessions — bringing ideas, asking questions, and offering perspective. What You'll Bring Current enrollment in — or recent completion of — a degree in nuclear engineering or a closely related field from an accredited institution. Academic or hands-on knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Reactor core design and analysis Radiation shielding design and analysis Nuclear fuel analysis and qualification Criticality safety Reactor multiphysics analysis, particularly transient analysis Nuclear materials and chemistry Nuclear analysis software development, verification, and validation Other areas of nuclear engineering or nuclear physics relevant to the design and analysis of small modular reactors, microreactors, and nuclear facilities Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Curiosity, initiative, and a collaborative mindset — you're eager to learn and ready to contribute. Application Requirements Along with your resume, please submit at least one letter of recommendation . Letters should come from a professor, academic advisor, employer, or professional mentor who can speak directly to your qualifications, work ethic, and potential. jobs.title: Psychology | Human Resources internship: Learning Enabling Functions Academy
jobs.body: Introduction The Enabling Functions & Sales Academy at ASML supports the development of learning and knowledge management solutions for employees and managers across departments such as Human Resources, Information Technology, Finance, and Sales. As an intern, you will help shape learning experiences that support employee growth and business performance. You will work closely with learning professionals, subject matter experts, and stakeholders across the organization to identify development needs and improve learning offerings. This internship provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Learning & Development (L&D), knowledge management, stakeholder engagement, and organizational development. Through this internship , you will contribute to creating impactful learning solutions within a global high-tech environment. Your assignment During this internship, you will be assigned to one specific project area based on your background, experience, and team needs. You will conduct research, analyze learning needs, engage with stakeholders, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Your work will help improve how learning and knowledge are developed, communicated, and utilized within the organization. Your main responsibilities will be: Analyze current learning offerings and identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct learning needs assessments and gap analyses for specific target groups. Gather and structure information from stakeholders and subject matter experts. Develop recommendations to enhance learning effectiveness and employee development. Support knowledge management initiatives and professional learning communities. Create proposals to improve communication and promotion of learning offerings. Present findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders. This is a bachelor or master internship (non thesis) for minimum 6 months , minimum 4 days per week (hybrid) . The start date of this internship is as of February 2027 . Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in psychology, educational sciences, human resource management, learning sciences, organizational studies, or a related field. Have a strong interest in learning and development, talent development, and knowledge management. Are analytical and able to translate information into practical recommendations. Communicate effectively in English and feel comfortable interacting with different stakeholders. Are proactive, solution-oriented, and enjoy working in a collaborative environment. Have an interest in AI and are eager to use AI-powered tools to support learning, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. The internship offers a broad introduction to Learning & Development within a global organization. You will gain experience in stakeholder management, needs analysis, learning strategy, and organizational effectiveness while working alongside experienced learning professionals. Other requirements you need to meet: You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. Inclusion and diversity ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Do you want to know more about the internship allowance, visa support and applying for an internship at ASML? Read this page .

jobs.title: ATR – Internship 2027  - Supplier Performance & KPI management
jobs.body: Job Description: Envie de rejoindre l'aventure ATR ? Une offre de stage vient de s'ouvrir sur notre site à Blagnac! En 2025, ATR est labellisée Happy Trainees. 94.3% des étudiants recommandent notre entreprise à l’issue de leur alternance ou de leur stage. Ce que nous allons faire ensemble : Être stagiaire chez ATR, c’est être intégré au sein d’une équipe comme un membre à part entière avec un véritable périmètre d’intervention et des responsabilités. Descriptif des missions proposées 1. Développement des KPI et pilotage de la performance de l’équipe Afin d’améliorer le suivi de la performance globale du département, le/la stagiaire sera en charge de : Identifier les besoins du management en matière de suivi de la performance de l’équipe et des collaborateurs. Développer et structurer des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) permettant de suivre l’activité, les résultats et l’atteinte des objectifs. Concevoir des tableaux de bord et des supports de reporting permettant de visualiser les performances, d’identifier les écarts et de suivre les tendances. Automatiser et optimiser les outils de suivi existants afin de fiabiliser les données et de faciliter leur exploitation. Accompagner le manager dans l’analyse des résultats et l’identification des axes d’amélioration. 2. Création et déploiement des Supplier Scorecards Afin de renforcer la visibilité sur la performance des fournisseurs et de faciliter le partage d’informations en interne, le/la stagiaire contribuera à la création et au déploiement de scorecards fournisseurs. Ses principales missions seront les suivantes : Collecter, consolider et analyser les données de performance fournisseurs à partir des différentes sources disponibles. Définir et structurer les indicateurs pertinents pour évaluer la performance des fournisseurs. Développer des scorecards synthétiques présentant les principaux résultats, les tendances et les points d’attention pour chaque fournisseur. Identifier les messages clés à communiquer en interne : performances remarquables, écarts significatifs, risques potentiels et axes d’amélioration. Préparer des supports de communication clairs et visuels destinés aux équipes internes et au management. Contribuer à la standardisation et à la diffusion régulière des scorecards afin d’assurer un suivi homogène de la performance fournisseurs. 3. Développement d’outils d’aide au pilotage pour les Supplier Account Managers Afin d’accompagner les Supplier Account Managers dans la gestion et le pilotage de leur portefeuille fournisseurs, le/la stagiaire recherchera et développera des supports adaptés à leurs besoins opérationnels. Dans ce cadre, il/elle sera amené(e) à : Recueillir les besoins des Supplier Account Managers afin d’identifier les difficultés rencontrées dans le suivi de leurs fournisseurs. Concevoir des outils de pilotage simples, pratiques et adaptés à leurs activités quotidiennes. Centraliser les informations clés relatives à chaque fournisseur : indicateurs de performance, points de vigilance, actions en cours et priorités. Faciliter l’identification des fournisseurs nécessitant une attention particulière et le suivi des plans d’action associés. Proposer des méthodes de travail et des supports standardisés pour améliorer la préparation des revues fournisseurs et le suivi des actions. Recueillir les retours des utilisateurs et proposer des améliorations continues des outils développés. Ce stage est fait pour vous : Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en Supply Chain, Achats, Business Analytics, Gestion de la performance, Management ou dans un domaine équivalent. Compétences techniques : ▪ Très bonne maîtrise d’Excel, notamment pour l’analyse, la consolidation et la visualisation des données. ▪ Bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint pour la création de présentations synthétiques et percutantes. ▪ Une connaissance de SAP serait appréciable ▪ Une connaissance de Power BI ou d’un autre outil de visualisation de données serait un plus. ▪ Un intérêt pour les KPI, le reporting, l’analyse de données et les outils de pilotage de la performance. Qualités personnelles : ▪ Esprit analytique et capacité de synthèse. ▪ Rigueur et attention portée à la fiabilité des données. ▪ Curiosité et proactivité. ▪ Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs. ▪ Créativité et force de proposition. ▪ Esprit d’équipe et sens de l’organisation. Langues : ▪ Anglais courant. ▪ Français courant. Calendrier Démarrage janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité - février/mars/avril) Durée de 6 mois Comment se passe le processus de recrutement ? Le processus de recrutement se passe en deux étapes après la réception de votre candidature : Analyse des CV Entretien technique Manager : Le responsable du stage vous contactera pour un entretien de recrutement Want to join the ATR adventure? An internship opportunity has just opened on our site in Blagnac! In 2025, ATR has been awarded the Happy Trainees label. 94.3% of students recommend our company after their work-study or internship. What we will do together: Being an intern at ATR means being integrated into a team as a full member with a real scope of intervention and responsibilities. You will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills and experience within a market leading company! Detailed description of the mission 1. KPI Development and Team Performance Management To improve the monitoring of the department’s overall performance, the intern will be responsible for: Identifying management’s needs in terms of monitoring team and individual performance. Developing and structuring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track activity, results and achievement of objectives. Designing dashboards and reporting tools to visualize performance, identify gaps and monitor trends. Automating and optimizing existing monitoring tools to ensure data reliability and facilitate data analysis. Supporting the manager in analyzing results and identifying areas for improvement. 2. Supplier Scorecard Creation and Deployment To strengthen visibility on supplier performance and facilitate internal information sharing, the intern will contribute to the creation and deployment of supplier scorecards. Their main responsibilities will include: Collecting, consolidating and analyzing supplier performance data from the various available sources. Defining and structuring relevant indicators to assess supplier performance. Developing concise supplier scorecards presenting key results, trends and areas of concern for each supplier. Identifying key messages to communicate internally, including outstanding performance, significant gaps, potential risks and areas for improvement. Preparing clear and visually appealing communication materials for internal teams and management. Contributing to the standardization and regular distribution of scorecards to ensure consistent supplier performance monitoring. 3. Development of Supplier Account Manager Support Tools To support Supplier Account Managers in managing and monitoring their supplier portfolios, the intern will identify and develop tools tailored to their operational needs. In this context, they will be expected to: Gather feedback from Supplier Account Managers to identify challenges encountered when monitoring their suppliers. Design simple, practical management tools adapted to their day-to-day activities. Centralize key information for each supplier, including performance indicators, areas of concern, ongoing actions and priorities. Facilitate the identification of suppliers requiring particular attention and the monitoring of associated action plans. Propose working methods and standardized tools to improve the preparation of supplier reviews and the follow-up of actions. Gather user feedback and continuously improve the tools developed. This internship is designed for you You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree (Bac+5 level) in Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, Business Analytics, Performance Management, Business Administration or an equivalent field. Technical skills: ▪ Strong proficiency in Excel, particularly for data analysis, consolidation and visualization. ▪ Good command of PowerPoint to create clear, concise and impactful presentations. ▪ Knowledge of SAP will be a plus ▪ Knowledge of Power BI or another data visualization tool would be an advantage. ▪ Interest in KPIs, reporting, data analysis and performance management tools. Languages: ▪ Fluent English. ▪ Fluent French. Calendar Starting date: January 2027 (date subject to flexibility – February/March/April) Duration of 6 months How does the recruitment process work? jobs.body: Student Engineer Aptiv Gothenburg Student Engineer Initiative Each year, we welcome several Student Engineers to join our team in Gothenburg. Our long-term goal is to support your development and transition into a permanent role. Here's how the journey typically looks: Part-Time during Semesters : You’ll be employed on a part-time basis during the academic year, with a recommended workload of 1–2 days per week. Full-Time during Summer : We offer full-time contracts over the summer period, while ensuring you have the flexibility to take vacation. Ongoing Collaboration : We aim to extend your contract for as long as it’s mutually beneficial and you're interested in continuing. Master’s Thesis : You’ll have the opportunity to complete your master’s thesis (or equivalent project) with us. Permanent Employment : Our ambition is to offer you a permanent position after graduation. Note however that this is dependent on current needs and is not a guarantee. Working as a student engineer at Aptiv is far more than a part-time job. Here, you will have the opportunity to tailor your role in the organization according to your interest areas and expertise. We believe this creates the stellar combination of learning, having fun, and together; developing the next generation of ADAS. You will be working alongside fellow students as well as seasoned professionals in a broad range of areas such as: Scripting in python and/or Matlab Data analysis Development of new algorithms for our products Validation and testing of ADAS systems, including test drives Instrumentation and maintenance of test vehicles CI/CD At APTIV’s Gothenburg site we value autonomy, responsibility and our community. You will be trusted to work in interesting projects ranging from internal R&D to customer facing projects. As a person, we believe you to be positive, an avid solutions seeker, and a strong team player. In return, we promise you the opportunity to drive the automotive industry beyond the future in a global and responsible organization. Your Background Current engineering student located in Gothenburg (mandatory) with a background in Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Mathematics, Automation and Mechatronics or similar. Since our intention is that you work with us for a while before your master’s thesis, we are only hiring students who are currently enrolled in a bachelor’s programme or in the first year of a master’s programme. Experience in the following key areas is merited: programming in general and particularly in the languages: Python, Matlab, C/C++ We believe you are A positive person with good interpersonal and communicative skills. Responsible and professional. Structured and analytical. Driven and self-motivated. Apply today, and together let’s change tomorrow!
