jobs.title: Project Management Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Project Management Intern (Summer 2027) The Company Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation is a thriving, values-driven company focused on doing the right things. We’re a fast growing, publicly traded company (NYSE: ZWS), with an enduring reputation for integrity, giving back, and providing an engaging, inclusive environment where careers flourish and grow. Named by Newsweek as One of America’s Most Responsible Companies and an Energage USA Top Workplace, at Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation, we never forget that our people are at the center of what makes us successful. They are the driving force behind our superior quality, product ingenuity, and exceptional customer experience. Our commitment to our people and their professional development is a recipe for success that has fueled our growth for over 100 years, as one of today’s leading international suppliers of plumbing and water delivery solutions. Headquartered in Milwaukee, WI, Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation employs over 2800 employees worldwide, working from 24 locations across the U.S., China, Canada, Dubai, and Mexico, with sales offices available around the globe. We hope you’ll visit our website and learn more about Zurn Elkay at zurnelkay.com. If you’re ready to join a company where what you do makes a difference and you have pride in the work you are doing, talk to us about joining the Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation family! If you are a current employee, please navigate here to apply internally. The Project Manager Intern will play a key role in supporting and leading a strategic product innovation initiative within Zurn Elkay's Drinking Water or Filtration business. This internship is designed to provide hands-on experience in new product development, cross-functional project leadership, and continuous process improvement. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Supply Chain teams, the intern will lead a defined innovation project from concept through key development milestones while gaining exposure to the company's Stage-Gate product development process. The intern will also evaluate the effectiveness of the current innovation process and recommend improvements that enhance speed, efficiency, collaboration, and execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful business impact while developing project management, leadership, analytical, and product development skills. Reports to: Director, Filtration Product Management & Drinking Water Project Management Key Focus Areas Lead a strategic innovation project within the Drinking Water or Filtration business unit. Define project objectives, deliverables, timelines, risks, and success metrics. Coordinate activities across Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Quality, Operations, and Supply Chain teams. Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders and leadership. Identify risks, obstacles, and opportunities and develop mitigation plans. Present project recommendations, business cases, and outcomes to leadership teams. Learn and actively participate in the company's Stage-Gate product development process. Attend gate reviews, project meetings, and innovation planning sessions. Document process observations, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Analyze project workflows, decision points, and team interactions. Benchmark best practices and recommend enhancements to improve project execution, speed to market, and cross-functional alignment. Support the implementation and testing of approved process improvements. Build project management capabilities through real-world project ownership. Develop executive presentation and communication skills. Gain exposure to product strategy, innovation management, and business operations. Partner with mentors and business leaders for coaching and career development. Learning & Development Opportunities Successful leadership of a defined product innovation project. Executive presentation summarizing project outcomes and recommendations. Assessment of the current Stage-Gate process. Identification and recommendation of process improvement opportunities. Implementation plan for one or more Stage-Gate enhancements. Final business impact report highlighting project results, lessons learned, and future opportunities. Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, engineering, project management, or other related field. Strong academic performance and demonstrated leadership experience. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to lead projects and influence stakeholders without direct authority. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint. jobs.body: Product Delivery & Forecast Transformation Intern Description - Before applying please note that, to be eligible for this position, you must be currently enrolled at a university in Spain, remain enrolled until the end of the internship, and be eligible to sign an internship agreement with your university. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027 and continue participating in the program until June–July 2027. About HP Barcelona At HP Barcelona, we are committed to reshaping the future of work through technology. As one of the world’s largest R&D centers, we bring together more than 800 engineers and deliver over 150 inventions annually. Our site serves as the global headquarters for the Large Format Printing and 3D Printing Business Units, driving innovation across software, firmware, and hardware development. Beyond engineering, our Sales, Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Customer Support, and Finance teams work collaboratively to deliver exceptional customer experiences and continuously optimize processes. This ensures that HP remains agile and prepared to meet future challenges. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining how technology transforms work. 3PO Product Delivery & Forecast Transformation Intern – Getac TAT Improvement The 3PO Product Delivery & Forecast Transformation Intern will support a cross-functional improvement project to reduce order-to-delivery turnaround time (TAT) for third-party offering (3PO) products, with an initial focus on Getac. The role will work with 3PO business, Getac, Foxconn, Planning, Logistics, Sales Operations, and order-management stakeholders to map the end-to-end delivery flow, analyze delivery-date accuracy and lead-time drivers, identify process and data gaps, and recommend practical actions that improve delivery predictability and customer visibility. A key part of the assignment will be to assess the current lack of a structured demand-forecast process for 3PO products and develop recommendations for a repeatable forecast, capacity-planning, and supplier-commitment model that can shorten TAT and improve first-plan reliability. Key responsibilities: Delivery TAT Analysis & Baseline Development Consolidate order, planned-date, shipment, logistics ETA, and proof-of-delivery data into a reliable baseline for Getac and other priority 3PO products. Measure end-to-end TAT and key stages such as order entry to final ship and final ship to customer delivery. Analyze first-plan and revised-plan accuracy, country or lane differences, volume concentration, exceptions, and recurring delay patterns. Forecast Process Assessment & Recommendation Document how demand signals, pipeline information, customer requirements, and order forecasts are currently shared across HP, Getac, and fulfillment partners. Identify gaps caused by the absence of a standard forecast cadence, clear ownership, common data definitions, and feedback loops. Recommend a practical forecasting model covering horizon, granularity, cadence, ownership, supplier acknowledgment, capacity checks, and forecast-versus-actual tracking. End-to-End Process & Root-Cause Improvement Map the physical product flow and related order-status updates from supplier readiness through fulfillment, logistics, customer delivery, and customer-visible systems. Facilitate root-cause reviews for inaccurate commitments, long lead times, late system updates, and delivery-date deviations. Develop prioritized recommendations, pilots, and standard work to improve supplier readiness, planning accuracy, logistics handoffs, and customer communication. Governance, Reporting & Digital Enablement Create a KPI framework and dashboard covering forecast accuracy, first-plan accuracy, ship TAT, delivery TAT, exception aging, and on-time action closure. Support a weekly operating cadence with clear owners, actions, escalation paths, decision logs, and measurable completion criteria. Use Microsoft 365, Copilot, Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, or workflow tools to simplify analysis, reporting, and knowledge reuse. Prepare concise updates and recommendations for operational, supplier, and leadership reviews. Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, Information Systems, Data/Business Analytics, or a related field. Analytical and structured problem-solving approach, with the ability to convert data into practical recommendations. Interest in supply chain, forecasting, order fulfillment, partner management, and customer delivery experience. Good written communication, process-documentation, and presentation skills. jobs.title: HPC AI Systems Administrator Intern
jobs.location: Bloomington, Minnesota, United States of America
jobs.body: HPC AI Systems Administrator Intern This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. Job Description: About the role Hewlett Packard Enterprise is looking for a systems administration intern to join the HPC and AI Data Center Administration team. Our administrators operate the high-performance computing and AI laboratory systems used across HPE engineering, and this intern works alongside them on the security, monitoring, and visibility side of that work. The intern will help identify where lab systems lack expected monitoring, logging, and vulnerability scanning coverage, build repeatable reports, document hardening expectations, and improve the team's ability to track remediation work. Over the term, the intern produces a system visibility baseline and a set of tools and documentation the team continues to use after the internship ends. This is a strong opportunity for a student interested in Linux systems administration, cybersecurity operations, infrastructure automation, observability, or large-scale compute environments. It is also a direct look at the day-to-day work of an HPC systems administrator, which is the career track this team hires into. Job Responsibilities Assist with inventory validation for HPC and AI lab systems. Review monitoring, logging, and vulnerability scanning coverage across a heterogeneous system fleet. Identify gaps in agent deployment, log forwarding, scan inclusion, and system ownership records. Build scripts, reports, or dashboards that summarize security visibility. Document hardening expectations and practical checklists for lab systems. Work with system administrators to validate findings and prioritize follow-up work. Present project results and recommendations at the end of the internship. Required qualifications Linux is the working environment for this role, not a nice-to-have. We are looking for a candidate who is already comfortable operating without a graphical interface. Currently enrolled in a degree program in cybersecurity, computer science, software engineering, information systems, computer engineering, network administration, or a related technical field. Working comfort on the Linux command line. Able to navigate a filesystem, read and edit configuration files, inspect running services and logs, manage users and permissions, and troubleshoot without a GUI. Demonstrated hands-on Linux exposure through at least one of the following: a Linux or Unix systems administration course, a personal or home lab Linux environment, a prior internship or job with Linux responsibilities, or substantive coursework in a Linux-based environment. Interest in cybersecurity, infrastructure, monitoring, or automation. Ability to organize technical findings clearly in writing. Willingness to learn from experienced administrators and ask questions early. Able to work fully onsite in Chippewa Falls, WI for the duration of the internship. Preferred qualifications Scripting ability in Python or Bash sufficient to automate a repetitive data-gathering task. Experience with SSH key management, sudo and privilege boundaries, system services, or package management. Familiarity with logging, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, or SIEM concepts such as syslog, rsyslog orjournald, log forwarding, and agent-based collection. Exposure to Git or GitHub in a collaborative workflow. Working understanding of TCP/IP networking, firewalls, DNS, and Linux permissions. Any hands-on security or monitoring tooling exposure: Zabbix, Nessus, OpenSCAP, Wazuh, Splunk, Elastic, Nmap, or similar. Configuration management or automation exposure: Ansible, Puppet, Salt, or similar. Interest in HPC, AI infrastructure, lab systems, or large-scale compute environments. Security coursework, security club or competition background such as CCDC or CTF, or a foundational certification such as Security+ or Linux+. What you will learn as an HPE Intern How HPC and AI lab systems are operated in a real engineering environment. How infrastructure teams track security coverage across heterogeneous systems. Practical monitoring, logging, and vulnerability management workflows. How to turn messy operational data into useful dashboards and action plans. How to work with system administrators on security hardening without disrupting active engineering work. Personal & Professional Development We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. jobs.title: Co-Op
jobs.body: With our strong investment in research and development and our culture of continuous improvement, Hexcel is the industry leader in the manufacturing of advanced lightweight composite materials, including carbon fiber, woven reinforcements, resins, prepregs, honeycombs and engineered core and composite structures. We invite you to join the Hexcel team at various manufacturing sites, sales offices, and R&D centers around the globe. Become a part of the “strength within.” Hexcel is currently seeking a Continuous Improvement Co-Op for our Pottsville, PA, USA location. The selected individual will be responsible for but not limited to the following obligations: Utilize Lean Manufacturing Tools to increase productivity. (6S, Visual Workplace, VSM, Kanban, Kaizen, SMED, Mistake Proofing, etc.) Create Value Stream Maps (VSMs) and identify areas of improvement. (8 Wastes) Work closely with production, engineering, and quality to identify, create, and implement Mistake Proofing (Poka Yoke) devices. Solid verbal and written communication skills are required, PC and AutoCAD / Visio skills preferred. Candidate must have ability to work with teams to define problems and solve problems. Eligible candidates must be a: U.S. citizen, U.S. national, person lawfully admitted for permanent residence, temporary resident under sections 210(a) or 245(A) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, person admitted in refugee status, or person granted asylum. jobs.title: Summer Surgical Tech Intern
jobs.body: The Summer Surgical Technologist student (Summer ST) provides delegated care to the surgical patient under the direct supervision of the registered nurse and in collaboration with the surgical team. The designated tasks are those which have been taught in the academic programs and/or orientation, and where the individual has demonstrated competence to a designated RN or CST. The functions are those limited by law to unlicensed personnel. The Summer ST performs primarily in the surgical scrub role preparing, selecting and maintaining equipment, instruments, and supplies. Summer ST Experience (June 7, 2027 - August 13, 2027) Rochester, MN site only Objectives Apply the principles of aseptic technique while in the sterile role. Further develop the practical skills required to work as a competent surgical technologist in the perioperative environment. Attain the professional skills of interpersonal communication with all patients and interdisciplinary health care team members. Applications must be received by December 31, 2026. Qualifications: Student must be in good standing in a CAAHEP or ABHES accredited surgical technology program, having completed a minimum of one-semester of surgical technology program curriculum. Student must possess basic knowledge and hands-on skills related to aseptic surgical techniques used in the preparation of instrumentation, supplies, and equipment for various surgical procedures. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required from American Red Cross or American Heart Association and must not expire during internship. Candidates must be able to work from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027. Additional Qualifications : Strong preference for at least 100 clinical hours by internship start date. Adapts to unpredictable situations within the perioperative setting. Proven ability to communicate with a variety of people in a direct, empathetic, and articulate manner. Comprehensive understanding of surgical processes and procedures preferred. Candidates should not graduate prior to September 1, 2027. Applications must be received by December 31, 2026. Application Must Include: BLS/CPR certification RESUME. The resume (can be longer than one page) should highlight the following: educational background (degree and anticipated graduation date), cumulative GPA, paid employment history, awards/honors, and volunteer activities including community involvement, committee involvement, student nurse association, and/or professional organizations. TRANSCRIPTS are required. Transcripts can be unofficial or official scanned and uploaded to documents. Please make sure your name is somewhere on the document. SURGICAL INTEREST AREAS. Create a one-page word document numbered 1-7, using the below list of specialty options and place each area next to your preference number. Number 1 being your highest preference. Include any additional comments that would assist us in determining your preferred areas. TCGS Cardiac Vascular Thoracic Gynecology Ear, Nose, Throat Urology Transplant Please upload each document to your application. License or Certification : Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers certification required from American Red Cross or American Heart Association and must not expire during internship.

jobs.title: Summer III Student Nurse Internship
jobs.body: The Mayo Clinic Rochester Summer III (SIII) Nursing Internship is one of the longest-running student nurse internships in the nation. Students from across the U.S. take part in the Summer III Program. The Summer III Student Nurse Internship is a skill based paid 10-week full time program, providing opportunities to gain valuable clinical skills and experience. Rochester, MN campus has over 60 specialties, two hospitals, 10 ICUs, and around 130 operating rooms. Summer III Nurse Interns will perform delegated tasks of direct and indirect patient care under the supervision of a registered nurse (RN) and in accordance with the Minnesota Board of Nursing. The designated tasks are those which have been taught in the academic programs and/or orientation, and where the individual has demonstrated competence. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING DETAILS CAREFULLY. INCOMPLETE/INELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED. By June 7th, 2027, applicants must have successfully completed one of the following: 1. The Junior Year of an accredited baccalaureate nursing program, as recognized by the Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE). 2. Three semesters of an accredited associate degree nursing program. Candidates must NOT be eligible for the NCLEX during the program. Candidates must have an anticipated RN graduation date between August 14th 2027 and June 1st 2028. 2026 SIII PROGRAM DATES: June 7th, 2027 – August 13th 2027. Candidates must be available for the entirety of the 10-week program. SCOPE OF PRACTICE: Please visit the Minnesota Board of Nursing (MN BON) website for current information regarding the scope of practice for a professional nursing program student who is employed and performing patient care: https://mn.gov/boards/assets/FAQ_Stdent_Nurse_Wk_Exp_12-2019_tcm21-354921.pdf In accordance with the MN BON, Summer III interns will be required to enroll in a 1-credit Summer Intern Course at a University or College within Minnesota for the duration of the program. Information will be provided following offer acceptance. HOUSING: For employees who choose to utilize the housing option, there is a nominal cost deducted from payroll. Parking is offered for an additional upfront charge. Additional information will be provided during the offer process. SIII APPLICATION DEADLINE: December 31, 2026 OFFERS WILL BE EXTENDED no sooner than: February 2nd, 2027 APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED: 1. RESUME. Resumes can be longer than 1 page. Please include the following information: permanent address, email, phone, academic program (s), anticipated degree and graduation month/year, cumulative GPA, paid employment history, unpaid clinical experiences, volunteer experiences, awards/honors. Other pertinent information. 2. BLS/CPR CERTIFICATION. Please attach proof of completion for one of the following accepted providers: • American Heart Association: Course title ‘BLS for Healthcare Providers’ • Red Cross: Course title CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers and Health Care Providers or BLS for Healthcare Providers • Military Training Network NOTE: If your certification is set to expire between June 7th and August 1st 2026, please renew PRIOR to the first day of employment. 3. DO NOT ATTACH: Cover letters, letters of reference, publications, transcripts, etc. These documents are not required and will not be included in the screening process. QUALIFIED CANDIDATES WILL BE PROMPTED TO COMPLETE PHASE II of the Screening process, which is a pre-recorded interview to be completed at your convenience. You will receive an email with a link to our HireVue OnDemand system. There will be a series of questions for you to respond to, some will require a video recorded response. You will have multiple chances to record your responses. Please consider this a professional interview. THERE WILL BE A DEADLINE TO COMPLETE THIS APPLICATION PHASE.

jobs.title: Graduate Engineering Intern - Quality
jobs.body: This graduate internship is a full-time position Summer-Fall 2027 (May or June through December) on site in Rochester, Minnesota. Join a team where development engineering intersects with world-class healthcare delivery and research. The Division of Engineering designs and implements innovative solutions for a wide variety of priorities at Mayo Clinic. We are a unique resource for a healthcare institution, and one that helps Mayo Clinic maintain its #1 rating in the country for healthcare delivery. We seek a highly qualified graduate student in engineering or a quality related field to assist our quality engineer with tasks such as: maintaining our current quality management system (QMS), writing QMS documents for patient-matched 3D printed titanium implants, design verification and validation activities, process validation, and acceptance testing. The primary purpose of the Graduate Engineer Internship is to provide a graduate engineering student with relevant engineering experiences. One or more mentors will be assigned to the intern to provide instruction and guidance and to assess performance. The intern is responsible for learning the procedures and processes of the Division of Engineering and the assigned work unit. In addition, the intern will be given selected engineering work assignments to reinforce the learning experience and to provide benefit to the work unit. The engineering assignments may include gathering user needs, documenting requirements and specifications, performing design verification and design validation activities, troubleshooting, and participating in design reviews. All assignments are within the context of the Division of Engineering Quality Management System (including safety risk management) and are performed in a multi-disciplinary development environment. The intern will be responsible for completing all internship-related assignments and reports for both Mayo Clinic and the participating educational institution (if applicable). The incumbent must have received a bachelor of science in engineering from an accredited college or university and be enrolled in or intending to enroll in a graduate degree program. Additional Qualifications The successful candidate will have excellent communication and time management skills. They will have interest in medical device development. They will have interest/exposure to areas of device safety, quality management, and FDA medical device regulation. The candidate must be able to work independently. They should be able to discuss past successes in an environment where work was ambiguous and day-to-day tasks not always well-defined. ***To be considered for this position please attach the following to your application: Undergraduate Transcript Current Transcript Resume or CV Applicants are strongly encouraged to include a Cover Letter

Assist with the development, testing, and troubleshooting of software used in vehicle electrification systems and engineering applications. Support software development activities, including writing and modifying code, developing scripts or tools, analyzing data, and documenting software changes. Assist engineers with vehicle electrification system design, integration, and validation activities for new and existing vehicles. Support compliance with applicable regulations, engineering standards, and requirements across multiple regions and markets. jobs.title: Data Engineer Internship (m/f/x)
jobs.body: Job Location LISBON GENERAL OFFICE Job Description Are you passionate about turning complex data into clear, trusted, and actionable insights? Do you enjoy combining analytical thinking with strong visualization and user experience design? If so, consider joining P&G as a Data Engineer Intern in Lisbon. This role is for individuals eager to develop business-facing analytics solutions, with a strong focus on Power BI, data modelling, data cleaning, and data quality. As a Data Engineer Intern , you will help develop end-to-end analytics solutions that transform business needs into reliable and user-friendly reporting. You will build Power BI reports, semantic data models, and visualizations; connect to data sources in Databricks and other platforms; and use SQL and Python to clean, prepare, and validate data. With guidance from experienced colleagues, you will combine strong analytical and design skills with selected data engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Translate business requirements into end-to-end data and business intelligence solutions. Develop Power BI reports, visualizations, and intuitive UI/UX experiences. Design and maintain scalable Power BI semantic data models and measures. Connect Power BI solutions to Databricks and other business data sources. Clean, transform, and prepare data using SQL and Python, including creating reusable views. Monitor and improve data quality, accuracy, consistency, and reporting reliability. What We Offer Responsibility from Day 1 - Contribute to real analytics work that supports business decisions from the start. Development Opportunities - Build hands-on experience in Power BI, data modelling, visualization, UI/UX, SQL, Python, and Databricks-connected analytics. Meaningful Work - Turn data into clear insights while strengthening data quality and reporting reliability. Coaching and Mentorship - Receive ongoing guidance from experienced analytics and data professionals. Collaborative Environment - Work with multifunctional and multinational teams that value curiosity, user focus, and practical business impact. Join Us Embark on a 12-month journey in Data Engineering, where your contributions will help turn trusted data into clear insights and better business decisions. If you are ready to learn, build, and grow through Power BI, data visualization, modelling, and practical data preparation, we invite you to apply online in English via the link below. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor. Job Qualifications Current enrollment in, or recent completion of, a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. Foundational skills with Power BI, including report development, visualizations, and data modelling. Good understanding of data visualization principles and the ability to create clear, intuitive, and user-friendly reports. Foundational skills in SQL and Python for data cleaning, transformation, validation, and analysis. Understanding data quality concepts and attention to accuracy, consistency, and detail. Fluency in Portuguese and strong communication skills in English. A collaborative mindset, and the ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions. Awareness of Git/GitHub, data pipelines, or other basic data engineering practices is valued. Valued: hands-on experience with connecting Power BI to Databricks or other cloud and enterprise data sources. Availability for 12 months internship. Job Schedule Full time Job Number R000161204 Job Segmentation Internships Starting Pay / Salary Range €1.200,00 / month

jobs.title: OMICS Laboratory Intern
jobs.body: Job Title OMICS Laboratory Intern Location(s) Duluth About Us Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health. Find your future at Revvity Position Summary Revvity is seeking a highly motivated Part-Time OMICS Laboratory Intern with a strong interest in clinical genetics and genomics. This internship is specifically designed for individuals pursuing or planning to pursue ABMGG Laboratory Genetics & Genomics (LGG) fellowship training. The role provides hands-on experience in clinical molecular diagnostics, cytogenetics, and genomic technologies while building competencies aligned with ABMGG-accredited training program requirements. Interns will participate in real-world laboratory projects, gain exposure to regulatory and quality frameworks, and experience the technical and analytical skills essential for a career in clinical genetics. Key Responsibilities Variant Interpretation & Bioinformatics Exposure Data Analysis: Learn about bioinformatics tools for variant calling, annotation, and filtering (e.g., IGV, VarSeq, ClinVar, HGMD) Variant Classification: Observe and assist with variant interpretation using ACMG/AMP guidelines; participate in case review discussions Literature Review: Research published literature and databases to support variant classification and clinical correlation Report Generation: Shadow senior staff in preparing clinical laboratory reports and understanding result communication Project Participation & Research Method Validation: Contribute to validation studies for new assays, technologies, or workflows Research Projects: Participate in OMICS research initiatives, including assay optimization and technology evaluation Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with bioinformaticians, genetic counselors, clinical geneticists, and laboratory scientists on multidisciplinary projects Professional Development Mentorship: Receive guidance from ABMGG-certified laboratory directors and senior geneticists Career Planning: Engage in discussions about ABMGG fellowship pathways, application processes, and career development in clinical genetics Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or other Life Sciences field Preferred Qualifications Previous laboratory experience (academic research, clinical internship, or industry) Coursework or training in human genetics, genomics, or molecular diagnostics Familiarity with bioinformatics tools (e.g., BLAST, IGV, Galaxy) Knowledge of ACMG/AMP variant interpretation guidelines Experience with LIMS or electronic health record (EHR) systems Technical Skills: Basic laboratory techniques (pipetting, solution preparation, aseptic technique) Familiarity with molecular biology concepts (DNA structure, PCR, sequencing) Proficiency in Microsoft Office and data management tools Attributes: Strong commitment to pursuing a career in clinical genetics and/or the ABMGG Laboratory Genetics & Genomics (LGG) fellowship Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills Strong written and verbal communication abilities Work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment Competencies for Success Analytical Mindset: Ability to interpret complex data and troubleshoot technical issues Ethical Integrity: Commitment to patient confidentiality, data accuracy, and regulatory compliance Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and adjusting to evolving project needs Collaboration: Works effectively with multidisciplinary teams and seeks mentorship Work Environment & Schedule Location: Duluth, GA, with the possibility for some travel to clinical laboratory in Pittsburgh, PA Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for extended periods, handle laboratory equipment, and work with biological specimens and chemical reagents Safety: Adherence to biosafety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and laboratory safety training Compensation The base salary range for this part-time position is $18.00 - 19.00/hour . This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for a new hire in this position. The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account internal equity, work location, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that base pay is only one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This range allows for the successful candidate to have an opportunity to progress within the position and develop at our company. This base pay range does not take into account bonuses, equity, or other benefits which may be applicable and are dependent on the level and position offered. What do we offer? We provide competitive and comprehensive benefits to our employees. Below are some highlights of our benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Options Life and Disability Insurance Paid Time-Off Parental Benefits Compassionate Care Leave 401k with Company Match Employee Stock Purchase Plan Learn more about Revvity’s benefits by visiting our Bswift page. Log-In instructions are provided towards the bottom of the Bswift page. *For benefit-eligible roles only. Part-time and temporary roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed. Please reach out to your recruiter for more information. Revvity is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic or status protected by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability—or unable to use—the online application system and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact OpenJobs@revvity.com .

You will be responsible for managing their own projects at once with varying milestones. You will be collaborating with Sales, Commercial Engineering, Development Engineering, Manufacturing, and Tech Support to listen to our customers, understand their application, and combine our technical and domain knowledge to solve problems and simplify our customer's experience. This includes completing sales orders and electrical and mechanical design, as well as the providing the bill of material (BOM) for manufacturing. You will report to the Senior Application Engineering Lead, and have a hybrid schedule working in Milwaukee, WI (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday in-person at the Milwaukee Headquarters location) Your Responsibilities: Assist on any productivity or tools enhancement projects Review and understand customer specifications and drawings. Interface with the customer on technical and commercial aspects of the order. Resolve and document exceptions and questions. Develop a knowledge of Rockwell products and be able to speak to the benefits of them in certain applications. Create and/or modify electrical schematics. Create and/or modify mechanical models of electrical component assembly. Provide final factory build documents including Bill of Material (BOM). Collaborate with manufacturing to provide build instructions and resolve technical issues. Support manufacturing for issues encountered during build process. The Essentials - You Will Have: Pursuing a Bachelor's degree at an accredited college or university. Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Pursuing a mechanical, electrical, biomedical, or similar degree from an accredited college or university Must be enrolled for at least one more semester of school after the internship concludes (graduation date of December 2027 or later) Local or attending school in the greater Milwaukee area (within 50 miles from the Headquarter location) Potential to stay on part-time throughout the school year (in-person) Enjoy researching different ways to make our customers lives easier. Desire to see the impact of the decisions you make and addressing potential roadblocks. Desire to work or comfort with working in a customer-facing role Experience with PLCs, CAD, schematic design, Ladder Logic, SolidWorks, and Studio 5000 Experience communicating engineering support, updates, and resolutions to customers and other partners. Enjoy learning new processes and products and are willing to extend beyond your job scope to help issues get resolved. Are willing to learn both electrical and mechanical disciplines to provide a complete solution for our customers.) What We Offer: Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision 401k Paid Time off Parental and Caregiver Leave Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www. raquickfind.com . You may be just the right person for this or other roles. This position is part of a job family. jobs.title: Systems Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! As a Technical Intern, you will participate in a comprehensive summer internship program designed to provide hands-on experience in a dynamic aerospace and defense environment. You will work alongside industry experts, contribute to real-world projects, and develop valuable technical and professional skills. This internship offers a unique opportunity for growth through mentoring, cross-functional workshops, and direct involvement in company projects. The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries. Responsibilities: Participate in actual technical projects and contribute to team objectives by completing assigned tasks. Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced industry professionals in your field. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, reports, and records as required. Assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to support engineering decisions. Attend planning meetings to understand project requirements, timelines, and team goals. Perform hands-on technical work assignments to gain practical experience and build technical skills. Work closely with team members, absorb and learn from their expertise, and apply that learning to ongoing projects. Identify opportunities for process improvements and support the implementation of best practices. Participate in workshops designed to provide a deeper understanding of the business and company culture. Qualifications You Must Have: Must be a Sophomore, Junior, or Senior in college or technical school, with at least 6 months until graduation after end of internship. Currently enrolled in a university or college program pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Strong organization skills and work ethic; detail oriented. Qualifications We Prefer: Prior internship or work experience in a technical or engineering role. Familiarity with the Aerospace and Defense industry. Basic knowledge of engineering software tools (e.g., CAD, MATLAB). Microsoft Access skills. Pursuing a degree in engineering or a related discipline. Essential Functions: Ability to sit at a computer for extended periods. Proficiency with computers and office equipment. Manual dexterity for handling tools and technical equipment. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally. Ability to work in a laboratory or workshop environment, which may involve exposure to loud noise levels or hazardous conditions. Ability to travel may be required. Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment. This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs. Estimated Starting Salary Range: $23.54 - $32.37. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors, such as candidates' key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more . IMPORTANT NOTICE: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use. Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances. SNC is a global leader in aerospace and national security committed to moving the American Dream forward. We’re known and respected for our mission and execution focus, agility, and disruptive and rapid innovation. We provide leading edge technologies and transformative solutions that support our nation’s most critical security needs. If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team! SNC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an environment free of discrimination. Employment decisions are made based on merit without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or other characteristics protected by law.

Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. Support data and metadata entry, review, and maintenance within databases, document management systems, or other electronic repositories. jobs.title: Intern - Autonomous Lab Concept Development for an Electron Microscope
jobs.body: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description How you can make a difference to our business? Join Thermo Fisher Scientific in Eindhoven, where your work will have a global impact. You will collaborate with an ambitious team to develop world-class customer solutions for our Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) portfolio, working within the applications development team and closely with product management, engineering, and R&D. During this six-month internship, you will develop an autonomous-lab concept for our Phenom XL Desktop SEM. The core assignment is to create an autoloader that can load a sample holder into the electron microscope. This base assignment is designed to stand on its own. If you complete the core work and want to take the concept further, you can choose one or more optional stretch assignments. These can be completed separately or combined, depending on the agreed scope and available time. You will learn how to understand laboratory workflows and customer application needs, translate them into practical requirements, and communicate a technical concept to a multidisciplinary team. If you are curious about microscopy, automation, and solving challenging technical problems, this internship will help you build on your existing skills and develop new ones. What will you be doing? Core assignment Learn about the electron microscope workflow, sample handling, and the constraints that matter when loading a sample into the instrument. Describe the requirements and workflow for an autoloader concept that can load a sample holder into the electron microscope. Develop and document the concept, including its main components, interfaces, assumptions, and important design trade-offs. Present your concept and recommendations to colleagues in applications, product management, and R&D. Optional stretch assignments After the core assignment is on track, you may take on one or more of these additional topics: Competitive analysis and product USPs: research relevant markets and high-growth verticals, compare automation or microscopy solutions, identify customer-facing differentiators and unique selling propositions, and explain where the proposed concept could add value. Sample handling and preparation: explore how samples could be prepared, identified, transferred, and presented to the instrument as part of an automated workflow. Multimodal techniques: develop a workflow concept that combines SEM with an optical microscope or another complementary technique, including how samples and information could move between steps. Electron microscope UI and automated software integration: explore how the autoloader could be configured, started, monitored, and integrated with the electron microscope user interface or a wider automated-lab workflow. Translate user and system needs into functional requirements, map key workflow states and information exchange, and consider notifications, errors, and recovery. Develop interface mock-ups or a software workflow proof of concept, depending on scope and available tools. Document the interfaces, assumptions, and limitations, then present the concept to the project team. The experience we are looking for You bring relevant coursework or project experience in at least one area of the assignment. You do not need experience across every area; the optional stretch assignments can be matched to your interests and background. Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, materials science, physics, computer science, software engineering, or a related field. Available for a six-month internship. Relevant coursework and experience Interest in laboratory automation, robotics, scanning electron microscopy, or microscopy workflows. Hands-on SEM experience is useful, but not required. Relevant coursework or project experience in software development or scripting, automation software, UI/UX design, human-computer interaction, or system integration is useful for the UI and workflow stretch assignment. Relevant coursework or project experience in CAD, mechanical design, robotics, controls, or systems engineering is useful for the autoloader assignment. Coursework or experience in sample preparation, materials science, optical microscopy, or market and competitor analysis can support the optional stretch assignments. Internship details Duration: six months. Location: Eindhoven, The Netherlands. The specific stretch topics and deliverables will be agreed with the intern and supervisor. Apply today!

jobs.body: We are looking for students who want to move and improve the world! When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. Who are we? Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. jobs.body: Position EMC Engineering Intern (Year-Round) Location Kokomo, Indiana About Us BorgWarner is a global product leader in delivering innovative and sustainable mobility solutions. Job Purpose BorgWarner PowerDrive Systems is currently looking for “dynamic, results driven” individual to join as an EMC Engineer Intern. This is a fully onsite internship. The EMC Engineer Intern will support electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) design, simulation, testing, and analysis activities for advanced automotive power electronics products. Working alongside experienced EMC engineers and cross-functional product development teams, the intern will gain hands-on experience applying EMC principles to real-world engineering challenges while contributing to the development and continuous improvement of EMC design methodologies, simulation capabilities, and engineering guidelines. Key Responsibilities Support EMC simulation and analysis activities to identify potential electromagnetic interference risks and evaluate design improvements for automotive power electronics products. Assist with EMC design reviews and investigations, including analysis of grounding, shielding, filtering, PCB design, cabling, and common-mode/differential-mode noise mitigation techniques. Support EMC laboratory testing and development activities, including test setup, measurements, data collection, troubleshooting, and correlation of simulation results with measured results. Analyze EMC test and simulation data, document findings, and provide technical recommendations to engineering teams. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of EMC design guidelines, simulation methodologies, engineering tools, and best practices. Collaborate with EMC, electrical, mechanical, systems, and other engineering teams to support EMC performance throughout the product development process. Prepare technical documentation and communicate results through engineering reports and presentations. What We Are Looking For Currently enrolled in an accredited college/university GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale, or B average, upon initial hire date Pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electromagnetic Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Coursework, research, or practical experience related to electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), electromagnetics, power electronics, circuit design, signal integrity, or electrical systems. Familiarity with engineering simulation and analysis tools such as electromagnetic, circuit, or system-level simulation software is preferred. Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, or other electrical measurement equipment is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in EMC, automotive electronics, electrification, and power electronics. Ability to analyze technical data, document results, and clearly communicate engineering findings. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional engineering team. jobs.title: Cryptography Intern
jobs.location: Bristol, Bristol, City of, United Kingdom
jobs.body: Cryptography Intern Description - We are looking for students with an interest in cryptography to join a 6-month internship with HP’s cryptography engineering strategy team, based in Bristol with the company’s Security Lab that researches the future of security technologies and techniques to make computing devices and data more secure for users and enterprises. This internship is an exciting opportunity to apply your cryptographic expertise to the development of cutting-edge products, to contribute to HP strategy and increase the effectiveness of cryptographic engineering, and to do it all within the collaborative culture at HP. As a company and cryptography team we are dedicated to attracting diverse talent from all backgrounds. Please speak to us to find out more. The successful candidate would work with HP cryptographers to ensure the secure deployment of cryptography, advising on product design and choice of cryptographic primitives, and prototyping and investigating the use of new cryptographic capabilities. The team's responsibility extends across HP, creating opportunities for the candidate to work with a wide range of technologists and have influence in varied fields, from new security and privacy paradigms to massive public key infrastructures and constrained processing environments. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to scale the team's reach by contributing to decisions, guidance, tools and training that empower engineers across the company to build products with world-leading security. Join us in our office in the heart of the bustling Bristol city centre, within walking distance of the old town cafes and restaurants, in the middle of the city’s thriving startup and academic tech ecosystem. We are looking for curious and creative individuals who enjoy teamwork, have an excellent grounding in cryptography, and are relentlessly excited to have impact solving real world challenges. This is a paid internship position. Responsibilities During the internship you will be given a project to explore approaches, designs or techniques to achieve outcomes. The specific project will be defined with your interests and skillsets in mind, with possible topic areas including, but not limited to, quantum resistance, secure protocol design, and cryptographic security assessment. You will receive supervision, help, advice and direction from members of the cryptography team and have access to the support of a broad range of security experts from the HP Security Lab. You will be expected to learn about new areas associated with the project, to work with the team and also independently as required, and to discuss your approaches and results with the team. During the internship you will be expected to write up your work and present the work to the team and the rest of the Security Lab. Mandatory skills and experience required Studying towards a Doctoral, Master’s, or possibly a Bachelor’s university degree in a relevant topic Expertise in theoretical or applied cryptography Excellent written and verbal communication skills Keen to learn and able to progress on live projects as part of a team or independently Additional desirable skills and experience Practical experience of cryptographic libraries Familiarity with cryptographic protocols Awareness of system security analysis concepts Ability to be innovative in the area of cryptography or its application Cryptography questions As part of the application process, candidates are expected to submit a covering letter including answers to the following two questions: Please describe, in your own words, how to send a message from Alice to Bob that has confidentiality, authenticity, and integrity. You should justify cryptography choices you make, and comment on practical aspects of cryptography required to ensure security (maximum 2000 characters including spaces). Please tell us about a topic within cryptography that interests you (maximum 1500 characters including spaces). Using AI tools to help answer these questions is acceptable, provided the ideas and reasoning are entirely your own. You are required to state whether AI was used, and, if it was, to note briefly how it was used (e.g., for proofreading or clarity). If your application progresses to the next stage, we’ll discuss your answers in more detail, so ensure you can confidently explain the reasoning behind them. About HP At HP, you’ll have a chance to create tools, technology, and solutions that reshape the way the world works in the future. If you’re looking to join a company that allows you to connect with a network of professionals eager to support you in doing your best work, we want to talk to you. Our legendary culture guides every employee toward success—fostering collaboration and driving innovation. Operating in over 170 countries, HP is always creating new services, products, and capabilities giving you more opportunities to advance your career. Here, innovation is the key to professional development and career mobility. When you join HP, you’re joining a company that believes every voice matters and that we all deserve a seat at the table. From the boardroom to factory floor, we create a culture where everyone is respected and where people can be themselves. You will be part of a global laboratory where different perspectives and experiences will help you solve problems in new ways. This is where you can build a long and wide-ranging career. jobs.title: Operations Engineering Co-Op/Intern
jobs.body: INFICON is a leading provider of innovative instrumentation, critical sensor technologies, and Smart Manufacturing/Industry 4.0 software solutions that enhance productivity and quality of tools, processes, and complete factories. These analysis, measurement and control products are essential for gas leak detection in air conditioning/refrigeration and automotive manufacturing. They are vital to equipment manufacturers and end-users in the complex fabrication of semiconductors and thin film coatings for optics, flat panel displays, solar cells and industrial vacuum coating applications. Other users of our vacuum-based processes include the life sciences, research, aerospace, packaging, heat treatment, laser cutting and many other industrial processes. We also leverage our expertise in vacuum technology to provide unique, toxic chemical analysis products for emergency response, security, and environmental health and safety. The co-op/intern will assist the Operations Engineering Team with creating clear and detailed procedure documents for usage by production technicians, helping engineers with identifying the root-cause of an issue while also being able to develop robust solutions to prevent recurrence. Assist engineers with identifying inefficiencies in production processes and be able to propose & implement solutions that will lead to improvements. Available blocks include the spring and/or summer and/or fall 2027 semesters. The position will report into and support the assigned Operations Engineering Team. The intern position will be working collaboratively with Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering and Quality Engineering, In this role the main responsibilities will be: Work with Cross Functional Teams to help solve production engineering issues. Assist with troubleshooting and failure isolation. Implement and update manufacturing process documents. Assist with returning failed products to suppliers through our RTV process. Participate in data collection failure analysis studies. Our emphasis on innovation and its source - dedicated employees - keeps us looking for talented individuals who are ready to meet aggressive goals in a high-technology company constantly developing new marketing-leading products. Good people are critical to our success and, in return, we offer opportunities for personal and professional growth, competitive compensation, and excellent benefits for our diverse, global workforce. Required Qualifications: High School Diploma or Equivalent Pursuing a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering/Engineering Technology or Manufacturing Engineering/Engineering Technology Preferred Qualifications: Strong Organizational Skills Statistical analysis tools Excellent Communication Skills Passion for Manufacturing Engineering Process Previous Co-Op/Internship Experience or Previous Work Experience is beneficial but not required The expected salary range for this position is between $18 and $26 per hour. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. jobs.title: Information Technology Intern, Service Delivery (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: As an Information Technology Intern, Service Delivery , you will work directly with the IT Service Delivery team to support day-to-day operations across the company — from user support and hardware deployment to network troubleshooting and infrastructure projects. This role is ideal for someone pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field who wants to gain real-world, practical experience in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. This is a hands-on internship designed for students who are passionate about technology, infrastructure, and operational support. *This internship is 12 weeks from May/June through August/September 2027 Assist in the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of end-user systems including laptops, desktops, peripherals, and mobile devices. Support onboarding and offboarding processes by preparing, imaging, and configuring hardware for new and departing employees. Participate in network troubleshooting, including testing connectivity, validating VLAN assignments, and assisting with switch and access point deployments under supervision. Help document and improve IT operational processes, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Provide technical support to end users, including hardware and software issue resolution, account access, and peripheral setup. Assist with low-voltage tasks such as patching cables, labeling ports, and organizing network infrastructure. Support the Service Delivery team in scheduled maintenance, equipment inventory, and asset lifecycle management. Participate in special projects, such as system upgrades, process automation, or hardware refresh initiatives, with mentorship from full-time team members. Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. Strong interest in IT operations, service delivery, and infrastructure support. Basic understanding of networking concepts (IP addressing, VLANs, DHCP, DNS) and operating systems (Windows, macOS). Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a willingness to learn in a hands-on environment. Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team setting. Must be detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and procedures accurately. Experience with ticketing systems or service desk platforms. Familiarity with endpoint management tools (Intune, JAMF, etc.). Exposure to scripting or automation tools is a plus. Additional Requirements: Willing and able to work on-site in Redondo Beach, CA for the duration of the internship This position may require overtime hours; interns are eligible for overtime pay. jobs.title: Developer Technology Engineering Intern - Compute Performance
jobs.body: NVIDIA is hiring passionate, world-class computer science studetns to work in its Compute Developer Technology (Devtech) team. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology industry's most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working with us and our engineering teams are growing fast in some of the hottest and state of the art fields: Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Vehicles, Supercomputing and more. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a real passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. What you will be doing: In this role, you will research and develop techniques to GPU-accelerate leading applications in high performance computing fields within scientific computing, computational engineering, and data science. You will be performing in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current and next-generation GPU architectures. This involves: Working directly with key application developers to understand the current and future problems they are solving, crafting and optimizing core parallel algorithms and data structures to provide the best solutions using GPUs, through both library development and direct contribution to the applications. Collaborating closely with diverse groups at NVIDIA such as the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models, by investigating the impact on application performance and developer productivity. What we need to see: Pursuing a MSc or preferably PhD degree in an engineering or computer science related discipline. While not a requirement, domain expertise in telecommunications, medical imaging, machine learning, deep learning, or natural sciences is helpful. Programming fluency in C/C++ and/or Fortran with a deep understanding of software design, programming techniques, and algorithms. Strong mathematical fundamentals, including linear algebra and numerical methods. Experience with parallel programming, ideally CUDA C/C++ and OpenACC. Strong communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and task prioritization skills. NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.​

jobs.title: Intern, HVAC AI Research
jobs.body: 🏢 About Bosch Group The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 418,000 associates worldwide. The company generated sales of 90.3 billion euros in 2024. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. At 136 locations across the globe, Bosch employs some 87,000 associates in research and development. 🏢 About Robert Bosch (South East Asia) As the Bosch Group's regional headquarters in Singapore for Southeast Asia, Robert Bosch (South East Asia) Pte Ltd has represented the Group's interests across the region since 1923. With diversified businesses in Mobility Aftermarket, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Building Technology. Robert Bosch (SEA) Pte Ltd includes the Asia Pacific headquarters for Mobility Aftermarket, Building Technology, and Industrial Technology, as well as the Southeast Asia R&D setup for Corporate Research, Advance Engineering Centre, and Bosch Business Innovations, Bosch's in-house innovation and startup incubation network. At Bosch, we are committed through our EVP ensuring all our associates to GROW , ENJOY and INSPIRE during their journey with us. 💼 Role Overview At Bosch Corporate Research, we develop, examine and enhance new systems, components and technologies. Our aim is simple - improving lives. Around 1700 researchers and engineers work at Bosch worldwide to develop new materials, methods and technologies as well as new systems, components and production processes. We are seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic student to join our team as an intern in the field of sustainable HVAC/ thermal systems. This internship focuses on both domain-specific and intelligence development tasks, particularly in data analytics and AI algorithms. The core areas include system-level energy management and system reliability, leveraging AI/ML techniques for data analysis, visualization, and validation. Successful candidate will be responsible for the following duties within corporate research center in Singapore: 🎯 What you will do (Key Responsibilities) Conduct literature research to scout AI and GenAI applications in HVAC systems, with emphasis on enhancing energy efficiency, fault diagnosis, and developing advanced control strategies through data-driven insights. Develop intelligent functions using AI/ML techniques to analyze and interpret data, enhance system diagnostics, and optimize control strategies for improved energy efficiency and reliability. Integrate software-hardware modules for field testing and validation of developed solutions. Collaborate with a diverse team of international researchers, engineers, and fellow interns to advance project goals and translate findings into practical applications. Participate in team meetings, discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions to contribute insights and stay aligned with project objectives. Prepare and present project updates, technical documentation, and findings to the team and stakeholders. 👤 What We're Looking For (Qualifications & Skills) Essential Requirements Commitment to a full-time internship of four to six months. Currently pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Proficiency in Python, with working knowledge of data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). Demonstrated competency in exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis, and machine learning techniques applied to real-world datasets. Practical experience with time-series and sensor data, including data cleaning, feature engineering, anomaly detection, forecasting, and classification tasks. Ability to develop, validate, and interpret data-driven models using appropriate statistical and machine-learning metrics. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with proficiency in troubleshooting data-quality issues and optimising algorithm performance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce technical documentation, visualisations, and presentations. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary, international research team. Preferred Experience Proficiency in C or C++. Familiarity with Internet of Things technologies, including connected sensors, device telemetry, data acquisition, and cloud or edge-based data processing. Basic understanding of HVAC systems, room air-conditioning, VRF systems, thermodynamics, heat transfer, or building energy systems. Exposure to multimodal sensing technologies (temperature, humidity, pressure, occupancy, power, acoustic, or visual sensing). Experience with data visualisation tools, dashboards, databases, APIs, or version-control systems.

jobs.title: Applications Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Location: Burlington, ON, Canada Our Team: Semtech’s Signal Integrity Products Applications team is a group of passionate and talented engineers tasked to develop and deliver industry-leading integrated circuits for module transceiver solutions supplying the Data Center and 5G Wireless space. We enable our customers and partners to achieve a new standard product performance and we have a versatile and exceptionally talented team of individuals to make this vision a reality! Job Summary: This position will expose the student to activities associated with the development and support of signal integrity devices to support the high-speed data communications and video broadcast markets. This individual will be primarily involved with evaluation and lab testing of evaluation platforms for our devices. Please note that this is an entirely on-site position, requiring you to be in the office from Monday to Friday for a 40-hour work week. Responsibilities: R&D Lab Testing and Evaluation of Products for Global Customers Conduct testing, measurement, and troubleshooting of advanced high-speed signal integrity devices using high-speed laboratory equipment such as BERTs, VNAs, WFMs, and oscilloscopes. Support the applications team by performing lab measurements and preparing shipments for customer samples. Provide technical lab support to Applications Engineers. Develop and evaluate documentation for both new and existing test platforms. Assemble and verify evaluation boards for customer use. Process and Logistics Oversee and manage inventory for evaluation platforms. Utilize SAP to collaborate with internal teams for the procurement and reservation of essential components and items to meet project requirements. Organize and package customer samples for shipment. Lab Support Collaborate with multiple internal departments to plan and arrange the installation of lab benches, ensuring the necessary cables and equipment are in place. Coordinate with external vendors for the procurement of equipment and lab peripherals. Arrange for equipment calibration. Minimum Qualifications: Demonstrated self-motivation and ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Proficient in analogue and digital circuit theory. Experience in troubleshooting PCBs and systems is preferred. Skilled in soldering techniques. Strong written and oral communication skills. Excellent organizational abilities. Familiarity with CAD tools. Highly adaptable and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment. To put it simply, whenever you use your computer to browse the web or use your smartphone to make a video call, most likely, your data is passing through one of many high-speed component from Semtech.
