jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Join our dynamic and innovative Team at Micron site in Vimercate, Italy! Department intro: Process and Device Technology Development (PDTD) is a core R&D organization within Micron’s Technology Development group responsible for developing the next generation of semiconductor memory technologies. The team drives innovation in process integration, device architecture, materials, characterization, modeling, and reliability for NAND products. Working closely with design, manufacturing, product engineering, and research partners, PDTD enables the technologies that become Micron’s future memory products. Position overview The mission of a device engineer working in Process and Device Technology Development team at Micron Technology Inc. is analyzing, modeling and improving the device electrical characteristics for the next generation NAND technologies in order to meet the performance and reliability specs required for NAND products within project timelines. Responsibilities: Contribute to device characterization and modeling for next generation NAND technologies. Define and execute new test flows to measure critical array electrical characteristics and define automatic electrical monitors for volume production. Understand NAND cell physics and array-devices operations algorithms, performance and reliability requirements. Build physical models of new cells array electrical evidence collaborating with TCAD team. Have cross-functional interactions to address device/array deficiencies with design/process/device teams. Contribute to performance projections for next generation NAND technologies, based on data modeling, to grant competitiveness. Generate detailed reports and documentation of the activity with structured summaries for engineer review. Solid understanding of semiconductor device physics and processes. Good understanding of simple CMOS circuits. Good understanding of statistics. A strong attitude to work on cross-functional teams Solid communication and reporting abilities. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge of or experience with NAND memories. We are home to iconic, trusted brands that touch 5 billion consumers worldwide and make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. Our people are our greatest asset: with our philosophy of promotion from within, we place strong emphasis on employee development and are committed to finding and fostering world-class talent. Learn from our inspiring leaders, shape our supportive and welcoming culture, and place your personal development at the core of your work! With 8 manufacturing sites, 3 European Process & Engineering hubs and the German Innovation Center our sites in Germany are at the center of breakthrough technologies behind our products. In Germany, we have a strong manufacturing presence with leading brands such as Gillette, Braun, Oral-B, Pampers, Always and Wick. We offer exciting internships and thesis projects at these vibrant locations: Crailsheim, Euskirchen (near Cologne/Bonn), Gross-Gerau (near Frankfurt), Worms, Berlin, Marktheidenfeld/Altfeld, Walldürn and Kronberg (near Frankfurt). Developing concepts for raw material handling. Collaboration and teamwork with colleagues to explore and establish solutions. Reducing resource usage in processes. Improving packaging efficiency. jobs.body: Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! Contribute to instrumentation-focused projects supporting water-treatment new product development. Assist with regulatory and product qualification projects, as needed. Analyze and process project data to support technical evaluation and reporting. Document testing procedures, experimental results, and technical findings to support product development activities. Maintain accurate testing records, communicate findings transparently, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the New Product Development Manager or Company management. Responsibility directly tied to Watts Value (Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, Transparency) Required Qualifications Current student (sophomore, junior or senior status). Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related scientific field. Interest in product development, water-treatment technologies, and related applications. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Preferred Qualifications Coursework, projects, or prior experience in Chemical or Industrial Engineering. Previous laboratory experience. Experience with experimental design or test-method development. Experience with basic statistical analysis and technical data analysis. Coursework or prior experience related to regulatory requirements. Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation and testing equipment. Experience with technical data analysis, processing, and documentation. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. You will be required to work in the office at the Fort Worth, TX location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods. jobs.body: Introduction Are you a curious and creative design student eager to explore new opportunities? Do you have a passion for technology and love collaborating in a diverse, multidisciplinary team? Would you enjoy contributing to a variety of projects across industries such as Healthcare, Industrial, Consumer, Energy, and Defence? We’re looking for designers with a strong understanding of user-centered (or patient-centred) design processes, exceptional 2D graphical presentation skills, proficiency in 3D design and rendering, and excellent verbal communication and visual storytelling abilities. Successful candidates can join us for between 6-12 months. There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Your role Our designers undertake the development of products and services from concept to manufacture whilst addressing considerable technical and design problems. You will be involved in activities such as front-end concept generation through creative workshops; graphics and packaging design; digital design, including user interface design; foam prototyping for testing; creating storyboards to communicate ideas; and attending user studies to research user/patient needs and evaluate your designs. We combine user centred design, innovative mechanical engineering, a rigorous analytical approach to problem solving and a broad base of industry experience to form a powerful development team. Our work ranges from undertaking complete product developments from concept to market, to providing consulting services for our clients on their technology, strategy or development processes. Some examples of our recent exciting and challenging projects we have worked on include: Midi: User centred design of a novel ‘device plus chemistry’ approach to Women’s shaving. Alma: a portable cooling case which gives the patient more social flexibility through their IVF process. Development of “Pebble”, a product which provides drug-free relief from menopausal hot flushes. Check-out our Behance portfolio for more examples of our work: https://www.behance.net/cambconsultants What you'll be doing This is a fantastic opportunity for a design student with the passion and skills to excel in dynamic industries, where commercial and time challenges are a key part of the process. You’ll be applying your design expertise to contribute to development projects, with the support and guidance of our collaborative team, from concept generation to delivery and manufacturing support for market-ready products. This may include: Carrying out and presenting user research to multidisciplinary teams Participating in and leading concept generation and problem-solving workshops Designing graphics and visual communications to improve understanding and engagement Preparing designs at a range of fidelities i.e., from analogue sketch to a detailed 3D render Manufacturing of prototypes, hands-on or by liaising with suppliers Evaluating ideas and prototypes with feedback from users and stakeholders What you can bring A successful design intern will have: Demonstrate an excellent academic record, studying for a relevant Industrial Design, Product Design or relevant degree Confidence and demonstrable experience with a range of graphical presentation tools e.g. Creative Cloud, hand sketching, 3D rendering Evidence of the ability to use CAD tools to design attractive, functional and manufacturable designs An understanding of human/user centred design processes Excellent storytelling/ idea communication skills Evidence of having been flexible when working with other disciplines Practical experience in UI/UX design is advantageous. Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules. Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity. We can only accept applications that include a portfolio. By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

jobs.title: University Internship
jobs.body: If you are a university student looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson invites you to be part of our Learn and Grow Program in Costa Rica. This internship opportunity is designed for active university students who want to gain hands-on experience, strengthen professional skills, and contribute to meaningful projects while learning in a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive environment. Through real-world exposure, mentorship, and development opportunities, you will build the foundation for a successful transition into the professional world. This internship program is designed for active university students who have not yet completed their degree and are looking to apply their academic knowledge in a dynamic, collaborative, and learning-focused environment. Program Information: Program start date: January 11th, 2027 Internship duration: 8 months Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Hybrid model: 2 work-from-home days per week Monthly student allowance Transportation benefit within the Greater Metropolitan Area (GAM) In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Support business projects and daily operations within your assigned department. Collaborate with team members across functions to contribute to business objectives. Apply academic knowledge to real-world challenges and projects. Participate in training, development activities, and continuous learning opportunities. Analyze information, prepare reports, and provide recommendations when applicable. Build professional competencies and gain exposure to a global business environment. Demonstrate accountability, professionalism, and a growth mindset throughout the internship experience. Who You Are: You consistently seek opportunities to learn and develop new capabilities. You work effectively with others and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive environment. You adapt to changing priorities and remain focused on achieving meaningful results. You use critical thinking and sound judgment to solve problems while maintaining a commitment to continuous improvement. For This Role, You Will Need: Active university student status throughout the entire internship period. Completion of at least 70% of the degree program in one of the following fields: Business Administration Business Intelligence Industrial Engineering Human Resources Graphic Design Law Accounting and Finance Computer Engineering/ Computer Science / Information Technology Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering Industrial Chemical Engineering International Trade and Customs Supply Chain Management Intermediate to Advanced English proficiency. Availability to participate full-time, Monday through Friday, from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Currently not employed. Strong interest in learning, professional development, and gaining practical workplace experience. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Portuguese language proficiency for selected opportunities. Experience participating in academic projects, student organizations, competitions, or volunteer activities. Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in diverse and collaborative teams. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. Our Culture and Commitment To You: At Emerson, we are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and help us create better solutions for our customers and communities. Through the Learn and Grow Internship Program, you will have access to meaningful work, mentorship, professional development opportunities, and exposure to a global organization dedicated to helping people reach their full potential. If you are ready to grow, learn, and begin building your professional future, we encourage you to apply and join our next generation of talent.

jobs.title: Application Engineering Intern
jobs.body: The Emerson Test & Measurement (T&M) Portfolio Business Unit is seeking an Application Engineering Intern to support customer-focused technical initiatives, product demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept using NI hardware and software platforms. This hands-on engineering internship combines technical problem-solving, customer engagement, and solution development. In this role, you will work closely with Application Engineers, Sales teams, Product Marketing, and R&D organizations to help customers solve complex engineering challenges. You will gain exposure to industries such as Life Sciences, Semiconductor, Energy, Industrial Equipment, and Academia while developing practical experience with test, measurement, automation, FPGA, and data acquisition technologies. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Assist in designing, building, and optimizing customer-facing demonstrations and Proofs of Concept that showcase Emerson Test & Measurement solutions. Support Application Engineers in evaluating customer requirements and identifying appropriate hardware and software solutions. Develop and enhance demonstration systems using NI software and hardware platforms. Research emerging technologies, customer applications, and industry trends to support new business opportunities. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues within demonstrations, Proofs of Concept, and application examples. Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, and Engineering teams on customer opportunities and technical initiatives. Participate in customer meetings, product demonstrations, technical workshops, and training activities. Document solutions, architectures, findings, and best practices to support future customer engagements and internal knowledge sharing. Who You Are: Curious, motivated, and passionate about solving technical challenges. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and learning new technologies quickly. Strong communicator who can explain technical concepts to different audiences. Self-driven with the ability to take initiative and contribute to project outcomes. Open to feedback and continuous improvement. For This Role, You Will Need: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. Experience with test and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, function generators, power supplies, or data acquisition hardware Familiarity with one or more programming environments such as LabVIEW, Python, C, C++, or C#. Basic understanding of engineering measurement systems and instrumentation. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to work effectively in collaborative team environments. Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Knowledge of software architecture, design principles, or automated test systems. Exposure to one or more technical areas such as Data Acquisition and Instrument Control, FPGA-based systems, Embedded Systems, Automation and Control, Power Electronics, Mixed Signal Measurements, Wireless and RF Technologies, Machine Learning, or Data Analytics. Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we foster a culture that values innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning. We invest in the development of future engineers and provide opportunities to work on technologies that help customers engineer ambitious solutions across industries.

jobs.body: Job Description Summary You will be joining our newly set-up Engine Module Shop to support process improvement initiatives for engine module disassembly and assembly operations. This internship offers a cross-functional and hands-on experience in problem solving and continuous improvement to enhance Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost in the business. Job Description Company Overview: Are you ready to see your career take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. From automating processes to leveraging smart factory technologies, robotics, and additive manufacturing, GE Aerospace is shaping the future of aviation at GE Aerospace Engine Services Singapore (GEAESS). GEAESS is our largest site for engine component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO), responsible for more than 60% of our global repair volume. Role Overview: Learn, understand and adopt FLIGHT DECK fundamentals in helping the team to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost objectives. Observe first-hand the engine module disassembly and assembly operations to help engineers map out current state, analyse data, identify process improvement opportunities, and implement practical solutions, such as ergonomics, mistake-proofing, cycle-time reduction, visual management, and digitization etc. Ideal Candidate: Hands-on and analytically minded candidates who likes problem solving and eager to work in a shop operations environment. Strong communicators and collaborative team players with an interest in lean and process improvement. Required Qualifications Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering/Mechanical Engineering or related field Basic analytical and problem-solving skills Basic proficiency in standard office productivity software Hands-on mindset and comfort working in a manufacturing shop/operations environment (with appropriate safety training). Preferred Qualifications Strong written and verbal communication Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, quality, or process improvement concepts At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. jobs.title: GE Vernova Advanced Research Fellow Intern - Power Systems, Electric Machines & High Voltage - Summer 2027
jobs.body: Job Description Summary GE Vernova Advanced Research is the central innovation engine for GE Vernova’s portfolio of energy businesses. The research organization is comprised of researchers who are experts in their fields globally - representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline. Collectively, they are driving major research programs and initiatives to decarbonize power, accelerate renewables, and promote electrification and the creation of a 21st century grid fit to power a zero-carbon energy future. As a Fellow Intern in the Electrical Power Systems, Electric Machines & High Voltage Team, you will have the opportunity to develop new technologies for any one of the following technical domains: electrical power system or electric machines or high voltage engineering (including dielectrics and insulation). Assignments are typically for 12-14 weeks; working side by side with experts in the field of Electrical, Control Engineering as well as data science and machine learning teams completing challenging technical projects, applying theoretical knowledge to real-life technical problems, and developing skills in a cutting edge global industrial research environment. This program includes seminars on cross-center technology and soft skills development as well as opportunities for networking and showcasing project accomplishments. Are you ready to join our team of technology enthusiasts to help make GE Vernova’s industrial assets safer and more secure to protect our world’s most critical infrastructure? Job Description Roles and Responsibilities: Work with industry leading experts to execute design, analysis, modeling, simulation and testing/validation of innovative power systems or electric machines or high voltage engineering (including dielectrics and insulation). Strong background in any of those above domains Collaborate with Engineers and Scientists from across the GE Vernova Advanced Research Center and business segments, to advance the energy transition. Required Qualifications: Current enrollment in a full-time Ph.D. degree program in Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines at an ABET accredited university. Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Must have the ability to work in the United States for an unlimited amount of time without sponsorship. Preferred Qualifications: Strong dedication to a career in technology and passion for supporting and leading the energy transition. Excitement and enthusiasm for growing technical skills in any one or more technical areas listed above. Experience with simulation software such as PSCAD, PSS/E, PSLF, MAPS, OpenDSS, COMSOL, ANSYS etc. Experience with implementation of control algorithms and analytics in control hardware or energy/distribution management systems in a field or lab hardware in the loop environment using RTDS, Opal-RT etc. Effective presentation and technical communication skills; ability to articulate technical problems in clear and simple terms. Minimum of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or a 4.0 on a 5.0 scale cumulative GPA (without rounding) Employment Dates: May or June 2027 to August 2027 (Summer). In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce. jobs.body: At a Glance Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Industrial Engineering Intern to join the Electrical Infrastructure division in Mississauga, ON. The Industrial Engineering Intern will support the development and implementation of key industrialization initiatives at Power Busway. This role will assist with process mapping, time studies, production data analysis, routing development, and standard work documentation to help improve operational efficiency and support future growth. Education • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or similar areas Qualifications • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or similar areas • Previous internships, co-op, or project experience in a manufacturing or production environment are preferred. Hands-on experience applying Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles, specifically conducting time studies, process analysis, and workflow improvement initiatives, is beneficial. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with a high attention to detail. • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with production employees, supervisors, and engineering teams. • Ability to collect, organize, and analyze large sets of production and operational data. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. • Understanding of Industrial Engineering principles, including time studies, process mapping, labor standards, and Lean Manufacturing. • Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar CAD software. • Familiarity with ERP systems and data visualization tools such as Odoo and Power BI.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Simulation Intern
jobs.body: About JLG, an Oshkosh company JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world. Assist the Manufacturing Engineering department in successfully achieving manufacturing goals and contributing to simulation and continuous improvement efforts. The Manufacturing simulation Intern will receive assignments from the Manager of Manufacturing, or an assigned representative, and will be encouraged to contribute ideas and suggestions. YOUR IMPACT Collaborate directly with engineering to build discrete event simulation models aimed at identifying plant bottlenecks, evaluating staging capacities, and testing "what-if" production scenarios. Assist in developing and linking digital twins of manufacturing cells and robotics using tools like FlexSim, Emulate3D, and NVIDIA Omniverse. Analyze cycle times, station configurations, and operator movements to support assembly line balancing and optimize plant throughput. Work with real-time industrial sensor and PLC data to feed live operational inputs into your simulation models and custom Ignition dashboards. Use AutoCAD or similar CAD tools to create and revise 2D/3D plant layout drawings to support simulation setup and material flow planning. Research, test, and champion new digital factory tools and automation technologies to keep our manufacturing facility at the cutting edge. Participate in cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives, time studies, and other engineering projects as assigned. All other duties or projects as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Student working towards a bachelor’s degree in data analytics, Industrial engineering, Manufacturing or mechanical engineering or computer science Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS Working towards an advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) with a research focus or coursework directly related to Digital Twins, Industrial simulation, Controls Engineering, or Robotics. Experience or coursework in developing discrete event simulations, robotics simulations, (FlexSim, Emulate3D, Omniverse, etc.). Strong programming experience in Python (or other languages like C++ or C#), with a strong preference for experience in developing NVIDIA Omniverse Kit applications, extensions, or microservices. Basic understanding of controls engineering, PLC systems, or working with industrial sensor/IoT data. Familiar with lean manufacturing principles, six sigma or industrial process optimization. WORKING CONDITIONS The following represents general working conditions for this role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances. This role combines office-based administrative duties with physical activity in field or production environments. In the office setting, tasks may require extended computer use, sitting, and attending meetings. Field or floor work may involve walking across various terrains or shop floors, standing, moderate lifting (up to 50 pounds), climbing stairs, and exposure to varying temperatures or noise levels. Must be able to shift focus between detailed cognitive work and occasional physical tasks as needed. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities to support performance across both office and field responsibilities. jobs.body: At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to Think Outside. Company Overview Polaris Inc. is a global leader in powersports and known to millions of people around the world as we offer a diverse portfolio of products and services including boats, off-road vehicles, motorcycles, commercial vehicles, and more . Polaris pioneers’ product breakthroughs and enriching experiences and services, that have invited people to discover the joy of being outdoors since our founding in 1954. At Polaris, we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are and help create incredible products and experiences that empower us to Think Outside. Internship Program Overview The Polaris Engineering Internship is a tailored 12-week paid summer internship designed for emerging juniors, and seniors who are interested in pursuing a career in a leading global powersports industry. This program is for future leaders who seek a culture built on innovat ion , passion, and collaboration . As a n Engineering Intern , you will be given impactful, project-based assignments that allow you to have exposure to multiple facets of engineering so you will experience both larger ongoing projects as well as shorter-scale projects throughout the summer that align with our business objectives. You will be placed into a specific team based on interest and business need s . These teams could include, but are not limited to: Design Engineering Project Engineering Systems Engineering Test or Development Engineering Potential Placement Locations Could Include : Roseau, MN; Wyoming, MN; Huntsville, A L; or San Angelo, TX , Novi, MI As a Polaris intern it is important that you embrace the adventure and remain open to any placement opportunity. By being adaptable, you will gain diverse experiences and develop a broader skill set, which are essential for your professional development and success within Polaris. Our internship program is crafted to build the foundational skills and experiences essential for your career success. Upon completing the internship, those who demonstrate exceptional performance and a strong passion for learning may be offered a returning internship or a position in our rotational leadership development program. In addition to meaningful project work, you will participate in intentional programming and professional development offerings such as: Mentorship : you are paired with one of our DP associates for mentor support throughout your 12-weeks. Programming Hours : weekly functional and centralized learning sessions to broaden your knowledge base, both within and beyond your program. Networking : intentional time with peers and leaders at Polaris to build your professional network. Intern Innovation Challenge : internal case study designed to promote cross functional development where you and your team will present creative and practical solutions to a real ‘Polaris’ problem to our executive leadership. Early Talent Summit Week : participate in our 3-day event in our Wyoming, MN office. This immersive experience brings together all US interns and DPs for professional development, structured networking, a DP graduation event, inspiring executive speakers, and a thrilling team ride on some of your favorite Polaris vehicles. Community Engagement : opportunity to get involved in your local community. Final Presentations : present to our senior level leaders to showcase your career aspirations and recap your internship experience. The Selection Process: Applications are open from August -November each year. Applications will be reviewed and shortlisted candidates will typically be contacted for an initial phone screen by the end of November. Candidates selected to move forward will be invited to participate in a virtual panel interview with an identified HR business partner and functional leader. Successful candidates would move forward to an offer. jobs.title: Government Operations Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a state and local Government Operations Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Littleton, Colorado you will have the opportunity to learn about the internal priorities of Rocket Lab and understand the processes by which the Government Operations team implements a strategy to achieve these priorities with state and local governments. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate program in Business Administration, Public Policy, Political Science or related field and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship. GPA of 3.0 or above. 3+ months of corporate function experience within the areas of state and local government, elections, policy or corporate Government Operations. THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE GPA of 3.5 or above. 6+ months of corporate function experience within the areas of Government Operations. Knowledge of legislative process. Knowledge of space policy. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027 COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS Pay Range CO: $22.00 USD Hourly You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience. Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation , holidays , and sick leave ; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks. Base Pay Range (CO Only) $22 — $22 USD WHAT TO EXPECT We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. Important information: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here . Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days. FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY: For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

jobs.title: Innovation Enablement Graduate Intern
jobs.body: Join a multibillion-dollar global company that brings together amazing technology, people, and operational scale to become a powerhouse in the memory industry. Headquartered in Rancho Cordova, California, Solidigm combines elements of an established, successful technology company with the spirit, agility, and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up. In addition to the U.S. headquarters and other facilities in the U.S., the company has international presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Solidigm will continue to lead the world in innovating new Memory technologies with aspirations to be the #1 NAND memory company in the world. At Solidigm, we view problems as opportunities to define innovative solutions that hold the power to change the world and unleash the potential technological needs that the future holds. At Solidigm, we are One Team that fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture that embraces individual uniqueness and empowers us to bring our best selves to deliver excellence in support of Solidigm's vision and mission to be the go-to partner for optimized data storage solutions. You can be part of the takeoff of an innovative business that develops cutting-edge products, delivers strong business value for customers, provides an engaging workplace for its employees, and serves a greater impact on the world. This is a golden opportunity for the right applicant to join us and help design, build, and lead Solidigm. We want a diverse team of dedicated professionals who will not just be Solidigm team members but contribute to how we shape the future of the organization. We are seeking applicants who will grow and thrive in our culture; be customer inspired, trusting, innovative, team-oriented, inclusive, results driven, collaborative, passionate, and flexible. What this role does: Supporting the creation of processes to evaluate internal engineering work for papers, white papers, and patents The successful candidate will work closely with cross‑functional teams including engineering, research, operations, and business stakeholders to help establish the foundational processes of the Innovation Project Management Office (PMO). This office is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and structuring projects and ideas that can become intellectual capital such as technical publications, white papers, trade secrets, or patents. Using gathered technical, market, and internal data, the intern will support the creation of frameworks to capture, assess, and track innovation initiatives across the organization. The role includes researching emerging technologies, documenting innovation opportunities, supporting idea intake processes, and helping define governance models for intellectual property and knowledge creation. In addition to innovation management activities, this internship offers exposure to project management methodologies, technology scouting, competitive intelligence, and technical writing. The internship’s goal is to provide hands‑on experience in building an innovation PMO from the ground up, with a strong emphasis on structured thinking, research, documentation, and collaboration across technical and non‑technical teams. What you will work on during your internship: Review requirements and standards for technical publications, white papers, and patents. Define classification criteria to assess whether internal projects are publishable or patentable Create step‑by‑step documentation and manuals for engineers and researchers. Analyze existing internal research and map it to publication/IP pathways. Support the setup of intake and review processes for innovation projects. Education Candidate must be actively enrolled in and pursuing a Master' s Degree program for the full 6 months of the internship . Recommended majors include (but are not limited to): Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, Mechatronics) Innovation Engineering Applied Sciences or Technology-related fields Required Qualifications Must be able to work in our Guadalajara site Strong communication skills in both English and Spanish Strong research, analytical, and technical writing skills Experience authoring, co-authoring, or contributing in at least one technical or academic publications, including participation in the preparation and submission of papers to recognized scientific, engineering, or industry conferences, journals, or professional organizations. Ability to synthesize complex technical information into structured documentation Experience with technical frameworks (Agile, Design Thinking, Technical Writing, Project Management, intellectual property) Intellectual Property concepts (patents, publications, trade secrets) Familiarity with collaborative tools and document repositories Self‑motivated and able to work with minimal supervision Interest in innovation, intellectual property, and technology trends Preferred Qualifications 6‑month experience or academic exposure in one or more of the following areas: Project Management or PMO support Innovation management Technology scouting or competitive analysis Technical or academic writing Process definition and documentation Data analysis Experience in research and intellectual property programs Powered by SmartRecruiters - Candidate Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Information Technology Unified Communications Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. What Will You Do? In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: Build, configure and support the various unified communications solutions including IP telephony, voice mail, video conferencing, web conferencing. Run routine tests on UC, A/V and PBX systems to ensure that all components are functioning at optimal levels. Perform diagnostic testing on problematic UC, A/V and PBX systems to identify and resolve various technical issues. Identify opportunities, provide recommendations and alternative methods to enhance user experience. Document procedures, processes and update knowledge articles for users to follow. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Majoring in Information Technology, Computer Information Systems, Network Engineering, Telecommunications. Completed junior-level courses preferred. Strong desire to learn, collaborate, and effectively communicate in a team setting while achieving a common goal. Strong attention to detail. Bonus skills include: Audio/Video Conference Room Technology, Microsoft Teams, Teams Phone, Call Routing Technology. What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. jobs.title: Communication | Media internship: learning content creation
jobs.body: Introduction Join ASML’s Sourcing & Supply Chain Academy in Veldhoven and help make learning engaging, accessible, and effective. The team develops training programs and onboarding experiences that support employees in building knowledge and skills across the organization. In this Communication | Media internship: learning content creation, you will create written, visual, and video content that helps transform complex information into easy-to-understand learning materials. If you enjoy creating content that informs and inspires, this internship could be the right opportunity for you. Your assignment As an intern, you will support the Academy team in developing communication and learning materials for onboarding and training initiatives. You will work with stakeholders to translate information into engaging content and contribute to video production projects from concept to delivery. You will also help improve communication formats that support knowledge sharing across the organization. Your main responsibilities will be: Develop written and visual content for onboarding and training programs. Create communication materials such as newsletters, FAQs, and email campaigns. Brainstorm, record, edit, and publish engaging learning videos. Design presentations, visual templates, and communication formats. Translate complex information into clear and accessible learning content. Collaborate with subject matter experts to improve learning experiences. This is a bachelor/master non-thesis internship for a duration of minimum 6 months, 4–5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027. Your profile To be suitable for the internship, you: Are currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree in communication, media and communication, creative business, communication and multimedia design, ICT and media design, digital media and visual design, business communication and digital media, or a related field. Have strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have experience/knowledge with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop Are creative and able to develop engaging visual and written content. Demonstrate a proactive and structured approach to your work. Have strong affinity with communication, media, and storytelling. This internship is ideal for students who want hands-on experience in content creation, learning communication, and video production within a global technology organization. Through this internship, you will strengthen your communication skills, build your portfolio, and contribute to impactful learning experiences across ASML. Other requirements you need to meet: You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. jobs.title: AI Researcher (AV) Internship (PhD Student)
jobs.body: Job Description GM Israel (Herzliya) takes a significant part in introducing sophisticated software features into car in many domains like connected cars, advanced camera technologies and research. We shape the face of the future vehicles in diverse fields by developing cutting edge technologies that define how drivers experience safety, awareness, and confidence on the road. GM is committed to Zero Emission, Zero Crashes and Zero Congestion vision. About the Group: At the autonomous vehicles Foundational AI Research team in Israel, which is part of the GM AV AI Research organization , we are shaping next-generation autonomous driving, L3 and beyond . The AI Research organization is dedicated to advancing the state-of-the-art in AI for autonomous vehicles. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking group of researchers and engineers tackling some of the most complex challenges in autonomy and machine learning. The mission of the AI Research group based in the US, is to create groundbreaking technologies for next-generation autonomous vehicles by combining cutting-edge research with real-world innovation and technology incubation. Among several initiatives , we are building multimodal foundation models (vision–language–action) over fleet- and internet-scale data, and we are building controllable world models that generate realistic, multi-sensor driving data (camera, radar, LiDAR) to strengthen coverage and accelerate long-tail reduction for our L3 autonomy product. About the Role This position is limited to the three-month . Students are expected to work full-time in a hybrid setup, including at least three onsite days per week. As an AI/ML Research Intern on the AI Research team, you’ll work on cutting-edge projects advancing vehicle autonomy, developing algorithms and models that shape the future of self-driving technology. This internship provides experience with real-world AI/ML systems, collaboration with leading researchers and engineers, and mentorship from experienced AV researchers to grow your skills in the autonomous vehicle industry. What will YOU do? Lead research and prototyping of advanced machine learning methods, such as foundation models, vision-language architectures, diffusion models, image/video generation, self-supervised learning, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning. Prototype ML models that improve perception, prediction, or decision-making for autonomous driving. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including perception, robotics, and systems engineering. Participate in technical discussions, share insights, and work towards publishing results. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) Currently pursuing or in the process of obtaining a Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related technical field Able to work fulltime during the academic summer break Solid understanding of modern machine learning techniques, especially deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, generative models, multimodal learning) Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow Research experience in AI/ML, demonstrated through coursework, academic projects, or publications What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Intent to return to degree program after the completion of the internship Familiarity with autonomous vehicles or advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) Experience working with large-scale datasets and training ML models in high-performance computing environments. Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, ECCV, RSS, ICRA, CoRL, or similar. Demonstrated experience and self-driven motivation in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches Experience building systems based on machine learning, reinforcement learning and/or deep learning methods About GM Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. Why Join Us We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. jobs.title: Compiler Engineering Intern
jobs.body: Job Details: Job Description: Join Us in Shaping the Future At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. As an intern, you will contribute to an open ecosystem that advances performance, scalability, reliability, and developer productivity for AI, HPC, and other demanding workloads, while supporting Intel's commitment to contributing to and collaborating with open-source communities. The Team The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered. Position Overview We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. You will work with experienced compiler and hardware architecture engineers on a scoped project that may involve compiler features, MLIR-based intermediate representations, Triton or other Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), optimization, code generation, runtime or offload support, debug information, testing infrastructure, performance analysis, or developer tools. Projects may involve connecting software capabilities to AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. You will investigate technical problems, implement and test solutions, analyze results, and communicate findings to the team. This opportunity is designed for an undergraduate student who wants to build practical compiler-engineering experience and apply foundational computer science concepts to production software. Responsibilities • Contribute to the design, implementation, testing, or analysis of compiler and runtime technologies. • Develop and debug software in C or C++ within a large, collaborative codebase. • Create or improve tests, reproduce defects, analyze failures, and help deliver reliable solutions. • Evaluate functional correctness, compile-time behavior, runtime performance, or code quality, as applicable to the project. • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and team members. • Document designs, experiments, results, and lessons learned, and present project outcomes to the team. • Contribute to open-source projects when aligned with the assigned work. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or a Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Informatics, or a related technical discipline (able to maintain student status for at least 1 year). • Coursework or project experience in data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, programming languages, or compiler construction. • Experience programming in C or C++ through coursework, research, personal projects, or prior internships. • Experience using software development and debugging tools in a Linux or similar development environment. Preferred Qualifications • Compiler-related coursework or project experience, including parsing, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, or runtimes. • Familiarity with LLVM, MLIR, Clang, Flang, SYCL/DPC++, Triton, OpenMP, CUDA, or another compiler or parallel-programming ecosystem. • Knowledge of CPU or GPU architecture, heterogeneous computing, or systems programming. • Familiarity with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and machine-learning model ecosystems such as DeepSeek, Hugging Face, and Qimi. • Tile-base programming model knowledge • GPU Compute kernel writing experience • Experience with Git, automated testing, continuous integration, performance analysis, or open-source development. • Technical contributions such as code, patches, reviews, research, publications, or substantial academic projects. Success in This Role • Curiosity and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. • Clear written and verbal communication. • Ability to work independently on scoped tasks while seeking guidance when needed. • Collaborative mindset and commitment to high-quality engineering. Bring your passion, curiosity, and your engineering drive to Intel, and help shape how the next generation of AI workloads runs on Intel hardware. jobs.body: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com . As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit. Job Function: Career Programs Job Sub Function: Non-LDP Intern/Co-Op Job Category: Career Program All Job Posting Locations: La Louviere, Hainaut, Belgium Job Description: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we work to deliver healthcare innovations that can profoundly impact health for humanity. Our European Distribution Center in La Louvière (DC LAL) plays an important role in the J&J supply chain. The site supports the distribution of Innovative Medicine products through direct, replenishment and affiliate shipments, as well as Value Added Services. The site operates in an environment where digitalization, technology and operational excellence are key areas of focus. We are looking for a motivated Bachelor's or Master's student who is eager to gain practical experience within an international supply-chain environment and contribute to the continuous improvement of our operations. Your internship will be structured around two main pillars: 1. Digitalization & Data Analytics You will help us turn operational data into useful insights and identify opportunities to further digitalize our processes. Depending on the projects and your interests, activities may include: Collecting, structuring and analyzing operational data Developing or improving dashboards and performance indicators Identifying opportunities to automate or digitalize existing processes Translating operational needs into practical data solutions Supporting data-driven decision making within the DC Exploring tools and approaches that can improve visibility and efficiency This directly supports DC LAL's ambition to use data analytics and digital solutions to enable timely, data-driven insights and increase efficiency, agility and resilience. 2. Operational Excellence Alongside the digital component, you will work directly with our operational teams to understand how a distribution center functions and identify opportunities for improvement. Potential activities include: Analyzing existing operational processes and workflows Identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks or improvement opportunities Supporting continuous-improvement initiatives Helping define or monitor operational KPIs Participating in process standardization and optimization Supporting projects from analysis through implementation and follow-up Operational Excellence is a strategic focus for DC LAL, including lean maturity, process confirmation, project governance and creating a performance-driven culture. We are looking for a student currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in areas such as: Supply Chain Management Business Engineering / Management Engineering Data Analytics / Data Science Business Management Logistics You are someone who: Has an analytical mindset and enjoys solving problems Is curious about how operational processes work Communicates confidently in English, with fluency in French being a strong advantage Has an interest in data, digitalization and continuous improvement Can work independently while collaborating with different stakeholders Is proactive, structured and willing to take initiative Is comfortable working with data and interested in visualization/dashboarding tools What can you expect? This internship is an opportunity to work on real operational challenges within a J&J European distribution environment. You will have the opportunity to: Apply your academic knowledge in a real supply-chain setting Develop practical skills in data analytics and dashboarding Learn about Operational Excellence and continuous improvement Work with experienced professionals across operations, projects and supporting functions See how digital solutions can translate into tangible operational improvements Contribute to projects with a direct connection to the day-to-day operation of DC La Louvière Please note: You must remain enrolled as a student throughout the internship. Graduates who are no longer enrolled are unfortunately not eligible for this internship. The internship can only start if your school agrees to sign the standardized Johnson & Johnson Belgium internship agreement. External agreements cannot be accepted. Launch your career with us and help shape the future of healthcare. We look forward to receiving your application! jobs.body: Leidos, a leading defense, intelligence, and technology company, is seeking motivated and aspiring technology students for our Summer 2027 Internship Program (Starts May 2027). As a Migration Execution Intern , you will join our Digital Sector supporting the Migration Execution team on the Defense Enclave Services (DES) contract. This position is 100% remote (with a primary focus on U.S. Eastern time zones), offering a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience understanding network and endpoint migration best practices during DODNet discovery, planning and design, and migration execution, and contributing to real-world engineering challenges within a massive, $600M+ global defense organization. Are you passionate about Information Technology, Computer Science, and Project Management? As an intern on the MES team, you will support the team through multiple network and endpoint migration projects. In this internship, you will rotate through migration execution support duties to fully understand the scope of work from start to finish. Primary Responsibilities: Support project manager in DAFA migration efforts across multiple task orders. Assist with travel support and invoicing review across multiple task orders. Assist with network Point Of Contact (POC) coordination. Provide Bill Of Materials (BOM) support across migration efforts. Assist the Subject Matter Expert (SME) teams with Contract Deliverables (CDRLs) preparation and uploads. Organize and support the Migration Queue and triage issues for the SME teams. Assist with the coordination and communication for migration testing activities. Rotate through migration support duties to fully understand the phases of discovery, planning and design and migration execution. Basic Qualifications: Currently pursuing an Associate's, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree (Business Management, Project Management, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred). A strong interest in project management, information technology, or computer science, with familiarity using Microsoft tools such as SharePoint, Excel, Teams, or the Power Platform (academic or personal experience is acceptable). Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively in a virtual team environment and manage multiple technical tasks simultaneously. Must be a U.S. citizen. A security clearance is required to start. Leidos will sponsor if necessary. Location: This internship is 100% remote. jobs.body: Virtu is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. Our cutting edge, proprietary technology is core to everything we do. We trade in over 35 countries, across 235 financial exchanges and over 25% of retail order flow in the US. is serviced by Virtu. Our team is a dedicated group of traders, quants and developers that are inspired by the unique and exciting challenges we solve every day. Our culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up, with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We are a flat organization and encourage our people to innovate and lean on their teammates for support and collaboration. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do. Core Operations Engineer Internship (Singapore) Virtu's internship program offers students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have built a thoughtful and challenging curriculum that introduces students to all aspects of Virtu's business through a company-curated global training week, real world development projects to complete and engaging social events to get to know our team and culture. Location: Singapore Dates: 10 week program, starting June 7th 2027- August 13th 2027 (with some flexibility if needed). Training: Ongoing training throughout the summer and a training week held in Singapore. Projects: Real problems to solve throughout the program. Interns will work from a list of projects and have several senior mentors throughout the summer program. Perks : Daily Breakfast, Lunch Allowance, Transport Allowance, Onsite Gym & Workout Classes, Massage Sessions, Social Events Our Site Reliability/Core Operations Engineers operate at a high-level in a Linux environment to solve complex technical problems and work with traders and exchanges to understand market micro-structure. A strong interest in technology and the markets is a must. This is a unique internship opportunity to become an integral part of a fast-paced electronic trading environment. As an intern, you will complete a variety of challenging Core Operations projects. You'll work alongside our senior team in managing the deployment, maintenance, and enhancement of a sophisticated electronic trading system operating on hundreds of venues around the world. jobs.title: 2027 Term 1 Internship – AI-Driven BOM Generation & Management
jobs.body: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. As an AMD intern, you’ll be placed at the epicenter of the AI ecosystem, working alongside experts and industry pioneers. You’ll do important work, learn new skills, expand your network, and gain real-world experience on projects that impact millions of end-users worldwide. Whether you’re an undergrad or a PhD student, your contributions matter—and your experience here will be a launchpad for what comes next. JOB TITLE: 2027 Term 1 Internship – AI-Driven BOM Generation & Management LOCATION: Singapore ONSITE/HYBRID REQUIREMENT: This role requires the student to work full time (40 hours a week), in either a hybrid or onsite work structure throughout the duration of the intern term. CRITERIA: Current students studying in universities based in Singapore and able to provide a placement/support letter from their school covering the entire internship period. INTERNSHIP DURATION: Term 1 Internship Start Date: 4 Jan 2027, End Date: 28 May 2027 or 6 Aug 2027. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO LEARN: As an AI-Driven BOM Generation & Management Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in developing AI-driven solutions to automate Bill of Materials (BOM) management for AMD's Microprocessor Unit (MPU) and Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) product lines. You will work with real-world semiconductor product data supporting Server, Client, Desktop, Embedded, Gaming, and Data Center products, to improve data quality, operational efficiency, and product release readiness. Throughout the internship, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Product Engineering, Design, Packaging, Test, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, and Business Unit to apply AI in enhancing engineering workflows and business operations. You will have the opportunity to – Develop AI-powered automation solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Gain practical experience in PDM, Master Data governance, and intelligent process automation. Build and deploy AI applications that improve Bill of Materials (BOM) creation, validation, and lifecycle management. Receive mentorship from experienced technical leaders in AI, data science, automation, and semiconductor product lifecycle management. PROJECT OVERVIEW: The project focuses on designing and developing a unified AI platform that combines: Enterprise Knowledge Management, Business Intelligence and automated Bill of Materials (BOM) Execution. The platform will provide conversational AI capabilities in creating, validating, maintaining, and releasing Bill of Materials (BOMs) for AMD’s complex Microprocessor Unit (MPU)/ Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) products. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop AI-driven solutions to automate repetitive engineering tasks associated with BOM creation, validation, and release to improve product data quality while reducing manual effort and release cycle times. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders from multiple product lines to implement intelligent BOM automation solutions. Design and develop an internal Product Data Management (PDM) Copilot agent, integrating Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) requests, Bill of Materials (BOM) reporting, data dictionary, PDM dashboards, and Confluence documentation.
