We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit. Job Function: Career Programs Job Sub Function: Non-LDP Intern/Co-Op Job Category: Career Program All Job Posting Locations: Neuss, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany Job Description: 12-month fixed-term position Introducing ESO Marketing Oncology J&J has been researching and developing innovative medicines for decades. Oncology is one of our key therapeutic areas, with a strong focus on prostate cancer, lung cancer and bladder cancer. We are committed to transforming the treatment of cancer and improving outcomes for patients. ESO Stands for EMEA Strategy and Operations and is responsible for developing regional strategy across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). Summary As a Working Student (f/m/d) - EMEA Brand Associate, you will support our EMEA Oncology Marketing team in its day-to-day operational and administrative work for the J&J prostate cancer brands. You will work closely with Product Managers and Brand Leads, helping them coordinate marketing activities, develop materials, prepare analyses and reports, and collaborate with cross-functional colleagues across EMEA. The role provides first-hand exposure to international pharmaceutical marketing and, depending on your experience and interests, the opportunity to take ownership of selected projects and workstreams with increasing responsibility. Tasks Assist with the development and adaptation of product-related and disease-awareness materials for healthcare professionals and patients across print and digital channels. Support the planning, coordination and execution of international marketing campaigns across different channels. Prepare presentations, analyses, reports and meeting materials using tools such as Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and digital analytics platforms, and present results to the team where appropriate. Support Product Managers and Brand Leads with operational and administrative day-to-day marketing activities and cross-functional coordination. Support the development and coordination of digital content across channels, including websites, newsletters, email and other digital media. Actively contribute to the adoption of AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve marketing processes, content development and ways of working, in line with applicable J&J policies and guidance. Contribute to international marketing projects and collaborate with colleagues and cross-functional teams across different EMEA markets. Opportunity to take ownership of individual projects and workstreams, with increasing responsibility based on experience and interests. Qualifications Currently enrolled as a university student throughout the duration of the position. A Bachelor’s degree or advanced stage of studies, ideally in natural sciences, business administration, marketing or a related field, is an advantage. Strong interest in healthcare, oncology and marketing. First practical experience in marketing, healthcare, pharmaceuticals or a related field is an advantage, but not required. Curious, reliable and proactive, with a willingness to learn and contribute in a hands-on role. Good analytical and conceptual thinking skills, attention to detail and a structured approach to work. Good communication and presentation skills and enjoyment of working in cross-functional teams. Strong digital mindset and interest in AI, new technologies and their application in marketing. Very good English skills, both written and spoken. What you can expect First-hand insight into international pharmaceutical marketing at EMEA level. Practical experience supporting real marketing activities and projects with visible business relevance. Collaboration in an international, cross-functional and virtual environment. Exposure to modern marketing approaches, digital technologies and AI-enabled ways of working. Opportunity to take ownership of selected projects and workstreams as your experience grows. jobs.title: Research Scientist Student
jobs.body: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Optical Metrology Division products are used for optical overlay metrology. The portfolio of products includes unique solution packages which are based on hardware and software systems to enhance yield and effectiveness. As a world leader in its field of expertise, the division's products are the most advanced in performance (measurement accuracy of nanometers and below), reliability, ease of use and compatibility with other KLA's products. KLA (Israel) controls over 80% of the world market sales in its field, and its products are used by every major semiconductor manufacturer around the world. KLA Israel is located in the Migdal Haemek Industrial Park. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Proposing novel concepts and developing creative theoretical approaches to challenging problems in optical metrology Formulating analytical models and running numerical simulations to explore and demonstrate proof-of-concept for new ideas Bridging theory and experiment: developing models, comparing against experimental data, and iterating to refine the theoretical framework Rigorous analysis and interpretation of simulation results and experimental data Exploring and evaluating new technologies and concepts from the scientific literature Formulating conclusions and recommendations to guide next-generation products and roadmap Collaborating closely within the team and across functions in the organization Minimum Qualifications BSc / MSc / PhD student in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Proven analytical and modeling skills — formulating analytical models and/or building numerical simulations is the core of the role Strong mathematical foundations Scientific curiosity and critical thinking, with a drive to question assumptions, explore alternatives, and refine ideas Excellent scientific communication skills, both written and verbal Independent, creative, out-of-the-box thinker with strong scientific rigor Team player, comfortable working in a multidisciplinary R&D environment Advantages: Prior research experience in industry or academia (e.g., thesis project, lab rotation, internship) Experience comparing theoretical models against experimental data Solid theoretical background in optics and the physics of light–matter interaction We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. Your Team, Your Impact The Broadband Analog group designs physical layer ICs for high-speed fiber optic data communication, such as Transimpedance Amplifiers (TIAs), and drivers for Silicon Photonic (SiPho), discrete Electro-absorption Modulators (EAMs), and Mach-Zehnder Interferometer Modulators (MZMs). This group is the market leader in delivering TIAs and Drivers that support 10Gbps to 1.6Tbps systems. We address the bandwidth, capacity, and power issues faced by cloud computing and mega data center networks. Our world-class group leverages our core competencies in advanced circuit design to solve the world’s ever-increasing desire to transmit more data for less power with fewer errors. We are continually first to market in Data Center, Metro, and Long-Haul applications. What You Can Expect We are seeking a motivated Design Verification (DV) Intern to join our team. The successful candidate will assist in the development and implementation of mixed-signal verification for broadband amplifiers. This role offers an excellent opportunity to learn from industry experts and gain hands-on experience with cutting edge technology and industry-standard tools. Develop and implement mixed signal verification (DV) plans for broadband amplifiers based on design architecture and specifications. Design and develop verification testbenches using industry-standard verification languages and methodologies. Write and execute test cases to verify mixed-signal circuits for functionality, performance, and reliability. Review and analyze verification results and provide feedback to design teams. Maintain detailed documentation of verification plans, test results, and design changes. Collaborate with design and layout teams to identify and resolve design issues. Work with various technologies and process nodes, including SiGe BiCMOS and CMOS. What We're Looking For BS EE/MSc (preferred) in the areas of high-performance analog/mixed-signal design and verification principles. Strong understanding of analog and mixed-signal circuit design and verification principles. Solid experience with EDA CAD tools such as Cadence Virtuoso or Sim-vision. Understanding of fundamentals, including: Detailed transistor level design Control/Feedback loop stability analysis. AGC loop design High precision analog circuits (including linear regulators, current sensors, bandgaps, DAC, and ADC) RF/High-Speed broadband techniques Project experience in using different technologies (SiGe BiCMOS is a plus). Have good programming skills and can write efficient programs or scripts in Python, Verilog/Verilog-A is a plus. Excellent debugging, problem- solving and analytical skills. Strong communication , presentation, and documentation skills . Ability to work effectively in a team environment. Eagerness to learn and adapt to new challenges. jobs.title: Sculpting Intern
jobs.body: At Polaris Inc., we have fun doing what we love by driving change and innovation. We empower employees to take on challenging assignments and roles with an elevated level of responsibility in our agile working environment. Our people make us who we are, and we create incredible products and experiences that empower us to Think Outside. Job Summary As a Sculpting Intern, you will play an integral role in the creative development of future powersports vehicles. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in both digital and clay sculpting within a fast-paced, collaborative design studio environment. Working alongside designers, digital modelers, clay sculptors, and engineers, you will help transform concept sketches and design themes into digital and physical models to bring innovative concepts to life. Essential Duties Collaborate with digital modelers, clay sculptors and designers to interpret concept sketches and translate them into digital and physical models that communicate future vehicle themes and design direction. Utilize digital and clay sculpting techniques to develop sketch models, concept models, and production-representative surfaces that reflect design intent while considering engineering and manufacturing requirements. Support studio model development activities by ensuring accuracy, craftsmanship, and timely delivery of models for design reviews, stakeholder evaluations, and program milestones. Participate in design reviews, present work progress, and incorporate feedback to continuously refine digital and physical models. Assist with model preparation, studio organization, and other sculpting-related activities that support the vehicle development process. Skills, Knowledge & Education Currently pursuing an Associate of Applied Science (AAS), Bachelor's, or Master's degree in Transportation Design, Industrial Design, Model Design, Clay Sculpting, Digital Modeling, Digital Sculpting or Fine Arts. Demonstrates clay sculpting and digital modeling capabilities through a curated portfolio showcasing three-dimensional form development, craftsmanship, and design problem-solving. Portfolio submissions will only be accepted in PDF format. Demonstrates an understanding of design principles, surface development, proportion, and three-dimensional form creation. Experience with digital modeling software such as Alias, Blender, Gravity Sketch, Maya, Rhino, Fusion, NX, or similar 3D modeling tools is required. Strong interest in vehicle and industrial design with a passion for creativity, craftsmanship, and model-making. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn within a professional design studio environment. Able to work onsite and full-time (40 hours per week) during the internship period. The salary range for this position is $19.50 to $30.75 per hour. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. Important Note: This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. All applicants must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee) and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future. The starting pay range for Minnesota is $19.50 to $30.75 per hour, plus eligibility for overtime. Individual pay and positioning within the range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography. While individual pay could fall anywhere in the range based on these factors, it is not common to start at the high end or top of the range. To qualify for this position, former employees must be eligible for rehire, and current employees must be in good standing. We are an ambitious, resourceful, and driven workforce, which empowers us to Think Outside. Apply today! About Polaris As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) pioneers product breakthroughs and enriching experiences and services that have invited people to discover the joy of being outdoors since our founding in 1954. Polaris' high-quality product line-up includes the Polaris RANGER®, RZR® and Polaris GENERAL™ side-by-side off-road vehicles; Sportsman® all-terrain off-road vehicles; military and commercial off-road vehicles; snowmobiles; Slingshot® moto-roadsters; Aixam quadricycles; Goupil electric vehicles; and pontoon and deck boats, including industry-leading Bennington pontoons. jobs.title: Internship: 6G Wireless Communications Prototyping
jobs.body: The deployment of 5G is ongoing, and the focus of researchers in academia and industry is already shifting to the 6th generation of wireless communications. The focus is on new upcoming technologies like Extreme MIMO, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), non-terrestrial communication, and/or machine learning techniques as part of the wireless transmission system. As with 5G, NI wants to be on the leading edge and is preparing for the next technology wave. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Working on a prototyping system for 6G Wireless Communications Research Plan, set up, and conduct measurement campaigns and experiments Implement compelling demonstrators and Proof of Concepts for 6G communication systems to be showcased at conferences Who You Are: You work effectively in a group environment, solve problems, diagnose technical issues and propose reasonable solutions. You prepare content for communication that is impactful and reach out to mentors with questions to help drive progress and completion of goals and tasks. You are passionate about wireless technology and like to learn and work with the latest test and measurement techniques and equipment. For This Role, You Will Need: Ongoing academic studies in electrical engineering or computer science with a focus on communication systems (from 5th semester) Good knowledge in Linux, Python, and C programming Digital signal processing (e.g., OFDM) Wireless Communications Interest in hands-on experimentation and prototyping Self-organized and structured working style Good command of spoken and written English and/or German Availability for 6 months starting in April 2027 This internship must be a mandatory part of your studies Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Basic knowledge in Machine Learning, or ISAC, or non-terrestrial communication, or MIMO Our Culture & Commitment to You: We attach great importance to your development, so we want to make sure that you not only find a challenging job with us, but also a workplace that is supportive and rewarding. You'll receive structured onboarding as well as dedicated support from professional mentors. Practical expertise imparted: Experience in improving technology day by day Get insight into how day-to-day business looks like for an engineer Work in an international R&D team In addition, you can expect a variety of attractive employee benefits : Fair compensation Flexible working hours Team events and free drinks, fruits, and veggies We are committed to providing an inclusive, open, and welcoming workplace environment for people, helping all to make the most of their professional potential. Are you interested? If so, we look forward to receiving your application via our application portal, including motivation letter, CV, compulsory internship certificate from your university’s internship or examination office, most recent certificates and grade transcripts. National Instruments Dresden GmbH Ms. Nataliia Verbylo Am Waldschloesschen 2 01099 Dresden Germany

jobs.title: MLIR Compiler Engineering Undergraduate Intern (f/m/d)
jobs.body: Job Details: Job Description: The Role and Impact As a Development Tools Software Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will actively contribute to Intel's cutting-edge compiler technology, supporting the performance and functionality of Intel's processor platforms across CPUs and GPUs. In this role, you will analyze applications, develop features, resolve software defects, and collaborate across geographies to ensure product quality. Your hands-on contributions will play a vital role in refining Intel's industry-leading development tools while building your own technical expertise. Business group You will be joining the Data Center Group (DCG), which focuses on delivering innovative solutions that drive data processing, scalability, and efficiency for the world's most critical industries. The DAP Data Frames Product team is central to these efforts, working on foundational software tools that empower developers to maximize the performance and capabilities of Intel's hardware technologies. Key Responsibilities - Collaborate with the team to design, implement, and test compiler and runtime technologies, focusing on areas such as optimization, code generation, or intermediate representations. - Write, debug, and optimize code in C or C++ within a large-scale codebase. - Create or improve tests to ensure functional correctness and reliability of compiler features, including reproducing defects and analyzing failures. - Conduct performance evaluations and analyze compiled code quality for runtime efficiency and scalability. - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning with mentors and cross-functional teams. - Document designs, experiments, and findings, presenting project outcomes to team members. - Engage in open-source collaborations under team guidance where aligned with project scope. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications - Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Informatics, or a related technical discipline (able to keep student status for at least 1 year). - Proficiency in C or C++ programming through academic projects, personal initiatives, or internships. - Coursework or project experience with data structures, algorithms, operating systems, computer architecture, or compiler-related topics. - Familiarity with software development and debugging tools in Linux or similar environments. Preferred Qualifications - Coursework or project experience specific to compiler construction, including parsing, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, or runtimes. - Familiarity with compiler technologies such as LLVM, MLIR, Clang, Triton, or SYCL/DPC++. - Knowledge of CPU and GPU architecture, heterogeneous computing, or systems programming. - Experience in Git, automated testing, continuous integration, or open-source development. jobs.body: Location: ​Richmond, BC​ Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 4 days on site (Monday to Thursday) Job Summary: ​​Semtech is building the next generation of AI-powered commercial workflows across its global sales organization. You will work directly with the Senior Director of Global Sales Operations to design, test, and document AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and insight across real sales processes. This is not a research role — your work will be used by sellers, distributors, and sales leadership. The ideal candidate is curious, operationally minded, and has a genuine interest in applying AI to solve business problems. ​ ​This role is best suited for students who enjoy figuring out how things work and making them work better. You don’t need to be a software engineer — but you do need to be comfortable with data, curious about AI, and motivated by operational impact. If you’ve ever built a workflow to automate something in your own life, used AI tools to solve a real problem, or found yourself thinking ‘there has to be a better way to do this’ — this is for you. enrichment, meeting prep, follow-up summaries) ​Test and validate workflows across edge cases to ensure accuracy, reliability, and repeatability before deployment ​Configure AI-assisted summarization, data processing, and exception-based logic steps within approved operational frameworks ​Support prompt engineering and iteration for tools including Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Vinton AI ​Document cross-functionally with Sales Enablement, Salesforce Admins, and commercial team members to gather requirements and validate solutions ​Present findings, workflow designs, and test results to the Sales Operations and AI Ambassador teams and relevant stakeholders ​Contribute to documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guides for deployed AI workflows ​Participate in the AI Ambassador program and support broader AI adoption initiatives across the commercial team ​ ​What You’ll Gain: ​Direct exposure to how AI is applied within a real enterprise sales environment — not academic simulations ​Hands-on experience with leading AI tools: Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Vinton AI, and Salesforce-integrated AI agents ​Practical skills in workflow design, operational analytics, and stakeholder communication ​Experience that translates directly into careers in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, AI Strategy, or Digital Transformation ​Mentorship from a Sales Operations Leader with active jobs.title: Spatial Data R&D Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. What Will You Do? In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: Develop tools to ingest, curate, model, and visualize spatial data collections. Conduct customer site assessments using spatial data in support of improved machine performance and sustainability. Perform literature reviews and identify potential applications for relevant models, algorithms, and methods. Collaborate with other team members and external partners to develop and manage experiments which simulate the requirements of the customer. Assist in development, testing, maintenance, and operation of sensing systems for landscape applications. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Undergraduate Junior or Senior or Masters candidate in GIS, Computer or Data Science, or relevant Science and Engineering discipline Proficiency with ArcGIS, QGIS, or programmatic spatial data analysis tools (e.g. GDAL, GeoPandas, Shapely, Leaflet, etc.) required Experience with MySQL, PHP, HTML, and JavaScript preferred Must be motivated, self-directed, and able to communicate efficiently with team members What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $22–$28. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.body: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description mRNA Project Manager intern Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD. jobs.title: Technical Writing Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: TECHNICAL WRITING INTERN Brief Job Description: The Technical Writing Intern is responsible for researching, writing, and editing customer-facing documentation, including user manuals and quick installation guides. The intern will support Senior Writers across various business units, with a particular focus on the Thermal Business Unit. This role requires building and maintaining positive relationships with global business units, product lines, other departments, and OEM customers with specific needs. Under guided supervision and sometimes with limited product specifications, the intern will manage both local and remote documentation projects from start to finish. Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time Investment Needed on Each: The Technical Writing Intern will perform the following functions with guided supervision: Write and edit various product documentation for advanced technology products according to established standards, styles, and guidelines. Proactively research and gather technical information by interviewing engineers and other technical personnel to ensure clarity, completeness, accuracy, and quality of the documents. Assemble documentation in the correct Vertiv or OEM format, maintaining consistent structure, content, and organization in accordance with established standards and styles. Manage complex project schedules while meeting all assigned documentation deadlines. Undertake other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Required/ Minimum Qualifications: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree (or higher) in technical writing, professional writing, digital communications, journalism, or English. Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite. Familiarity with AI technology in the technical writing field. Strong interpersonal, communication, and editing skills with a high attention to detail. Self-motivated, with the desire to be a team player and support team goals and mission. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, international team environment with multiple deadlines, multiple time zones, limited resources, and constant change. Additional / Preferred Qualifications: Experience with style sheets, style guides, and editing processes. Experience with the following programs: Adobe Acrobat Pro DC, Adobe InDesign, and Madcap Flare (or equivalent experience with another single-source desktop publishing tool). Physical & Environmental Requirements: Standard office environment Time Travel Needed: 0% #LI-RB

jobs.title: Service Technology Engineering Intern - Graduate Level (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: JOB SUMMARY Vertiv is seeking a Service Technology Research Intern to support and accelerate the development of next-generation service technologies for cooling and power systems used in high-performance computing and AI-driven data center environments. This role is open to graduate students, including master's students, doctoral students, and PhD candidates pursuing advanced study in engineering, applied data science, computer science, digital systems, or a related technical field. The position is intended for candidates who can translate academic research, analysis, and technical problem solving into practical service concepts, pilots, and deployable service technologies. The intern will work as a technical contributor and research partner to the Services Technology leadership team, helping evaluate emerging technologies and convert research opportunities into actionable service use cases. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Conduct applied research into emerging service technologies related to condition-based maintenance, digital services, IoT-enabled diagnostics, reliability engineering, and service analytics. · Translate academic research, coursework, or thesis-related concepts into practical service use cases, pilots, proofs of concept, or technology recommendations. · Evaluate algorithms, models, architectures, tools, or analytical methods that may improve service efficiency, asset reliability, field diagnostics, or maintenance decision-making. · Support technology readiness assessments, maturity planning, and pilot planning for new service concepts. · Collaborate with service, engineering, product, and regional teams to support pilot execution and collect technical feedback. · Author technical documentation, internal research briefs, white papers, test summaries, and recommendations that can be used by service and engineering stakeholders. · Provide recommendations on future research directions, partnership opportunities, and investment priorities for service technology development. REQUIREMENTS · Currently enrolled in a graduate degree program, including a master's degree, doctoral degree, or PhD program, in Engineering, Applied Sciences, Computer Science, Data Science, Reliability Engineering, Controls, Digital Systems, or a related technical discipline. · Graduate students with research, thesis, capstone, laboratory, or applied project experience relevant to service technology are encouraged to apply. · Interest or experience in predictive maintenance, data analytics, machine learning, IoT systems, controls, sensors, diagnostics, thermal systems, power systems, or reliability engineering. · Ability to connect technical theory with applied engineering, service operations, field use cases, and business impact. · Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize technical findings for both technical and non-technical audiences. · Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams in a professional business environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS · Experience using data analysis, simulation, modeling, programming, laboratory testing, or instrumentation tools to solve technical problems. · Exposure to industrial equipment, data center infrastructure, HVAC/thermal systems, power systems, embedded systems, controls, or connected products. · Demonstrated ability to develop research questions, evaluate technical alternatives, and communicate findings through reports, presentations, or prototypes. · For doctoral or PhD candidates: experience translating advanced research into applied technology concepts is preferred but not required. WHY JOIN VERTIV? This role offers a practical opportunity for a graduate student to apply research and technical problem solving to mission-critical data center infrastructure challenges at global scale. The intern will contribute to Vertiv's long-term digital service strategy by helping identify, evaluate, and mature technologies that can improve serviceability, reliability, and customer outcomes. #LI-RB

jobs.body: Virtu Financial is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. Our unique culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up, with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do. Virtu Execution Services (VES) comprises of the firm's client-facing business encompassing, Brokerage, Analytics and Workflow technology. The primarily client support focused roles under VES include Sales,Trading, Electronic Coverage, and Workflow Technology. Roles within VES client support teams offer the opportunity to: Become a multi-faceted Financial Services professional, joining a global team engaging with a wide range of vendors and institutional and retail clients Receive an in-depth education on global financial markets and apply knowledge to a spectrum of Virtu's products and services- combining technology with business needs Interact directly with a global client base, supporting trade execution workflow queries in real-time Drive product development based on client needs and feedback, working both internally and across vendors to increase client connectivity Location: London, United Kingdom (onsite) for openings in London & Dublin Dates : 10 week programme, starting 21 June 2027 - 27 August 2027 Virtu is looking for top performers with below qualifications: Entering final year of school, or students expected to be ready for full time employment between December 2027 - June 2028 Excellent academic background (all subjects welcome) with a passion for financial markets Highly motivated and tenacious individual, with a proven ability to take initiative and work independently and within a team Fearless networker, comfortable stepping out of their comfort zone to connect with new people Able to navigate dynamic, unscripted client interactions, connecting the dots quickly and problem-solving on the fly Team player: authentic, genuine person capable of working towards collective goals Excellent written and verbal communication skills and can easily build new interpersonal relationships Basic programming skills beneficial but not required YOU’RE JUST RIGHT FOR VIRTU IF YOU WANT To work in a organisationally flat structure with an entrepreneurial environment. Be part of a single team of professionals committed to excellence, passionate about continually learning, improving and raising the bar A firm committed to create an inclusive, equitable, and supportive environment to individuals from all backgrounds A community that values hard work as well as work-life balance and provides comprehensive benefits. An open environment to explore and implement new ideas, and take ownership of team initiatives from the start THE SELECTION PROCESS After passing an initial resume screening, select applicants may receive an online programming test, which will be emailed to you via Hackerrank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you! Closing Date: 15 November 2026 Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Intern, Summer 2027
jobs.body: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you! Scope of Position As a valued member of the Manufacturing Engineering team, the Manufacturing Quality Intern will contribute to impactful projects that support factory transformation, product line optimization, and production floor redesign. This internship offers hands-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing environment, providing exposure to real-world engineering challenges and opportunities to collaborate across teams. This position reports to the Quality and Sustaining Engineer Supervisor and is onsite in Fort Myers, FL. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Collaborate with the Manufacturing Engineering team on the factory transformation initiative, focusing on modernizing workflows, integrating new technologies, and driving process improvements. Support efforts to optimize the MCX/MCX2 product line, a key component of our business, through data analysis, process mapping, and continuous improvement strategies. Assist in the redesign of the production floor layout to enhance operational efficiency, reduce waste, and improve safety and ergonomics. Provide ongoing support for cross-functional engineering projects, including documentation, testing, and implementation activities. Participate in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and project reviews, gaining exposure to engineering decision-making and project management. Deliver a final presentation summarizing internship learnings, contributions, and outcomes to the leadership team. Required Qualifications Current student (junior or senior status). Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Engineering. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to learning. Effective communication and collaboration skills. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Preferably pursuing a degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Process, or Manufacturing Engineering. Exposure to Lean Manufacturing principles and Continuous Improvement methodologies. Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma tools and techniques. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in nearly 60 countries. jobs.body: Si vous êtes à la recherche d’une opportunité pour développer votre carrière dans le domaine de la communication et de la digitalisation, cette opportunité au sein d’Emerson, à Cernay (France), vous permettra de contribuer à une initiative stratégique de transformation numérique portée par l’équipe Qualité Nucléaire. Soutenir les initiatives de conduite du changement en préparant des campagnes de sensibilisation et d’information. Vous créez de nouvelles connexions et établissez des relations de collaboration avec différentes équipes et fonctions afin de favoriser l’atteinte d’objectifs communs. jobs.title: iCenter Co-op (June-Dec)
jobs.body: If you are an engineering student looking for an opportunity to grow, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in our St. Louis, MO location, you will get the opportunity to work as an iCenter Co-Op (June- Dec) . This is a full-time (40 hours per week) Co-Op rotation . Emerson’s Process Systems and Solutions business develops automation software to streamline manufacturing processes. We are looking for students who are interested in gaining real-world experience in this dynamic environment. As a team member, you’ll share in the satisfaction of delivering industry-leading products and solutions that help provide our customers with safer, more environmentally efficient manufacturing processes. We’ve revolutionized the control industry by extending digital information technologies to the plant floor of process manufacturers, including oil and gas, refining, chemical, life sciences, and alternative energy companies. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Support project technical analysis and manufacturing activities to ensure efficient project execution. Collaborate with engineering and design teams to address questions related to the constructability, manufacturability, and assembly of specific designs and drawings. Assist with project execution activities, including preparing technical submittals and responding to customer technical inquiries. Develop Bills of Material (BOMs) within the MRP system based on engineering drawings, estimates, and customer documentation. Support the creation and maintenance of kits and subassemblies for standard product lines. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives focused on process efficiency, quality, and operational effectiveness. Provide support to project managers and production managers in executing manufacturing and project-related activities. Maintain accurate technical documentation and support communication among engineering, manufacturing, and project teams. Contribute to cross-functional problem solving and process improvement efforts throughout the project lifecycle. Who You Are: You readily take on new opportunities and challenges with a sense of enthusiasm and curiosity. You communicate clearly and effectively in a variety of settings, tailoring your message to different audiences. You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You seek out information, learn from new experiences, and adapt your approach to support successful outcomes. For This Role, You Will Need: Currently enrolled in an accredited college/university and pursing a Bachelor of Science or Master of Science degree in an engineering, technical, business discipline Commitment to full-time (40 hour) Summer/Fall (June 2027-December 2027) Co-op experience in St. Louis, MO Legal authorization to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this position. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Previous co-op or intern experience a plus Demonstrated leadership skills (served in leadership role in student organization) Previous coursework involving automation, PLC, process controls, or simulation Technical curiosity and an eagerness to understand how products, systems, and processes work. Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, profit sharing retirement, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave. Our training programs and initiatives focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership. We provide a wide range of development opportunities, including face-to-face and virtual training, mentorship and coaching, project management, and on-the-job training. jobs.title: CNC Machine Mechanic Intern
jobs.body: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? Well, we pump peanut butter into your jar, and the oil in your car. We glue the soles of your shoes, the glass in your windows and the screen on your phone. We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. Assist in performing preventative maintenance and simple repairs of all company-owned machine tools, assembly equipment, and Graco-owned manufacturing assets. Assist in performing simple testing and repair in the area of hydraulics, mechanical elements, electrical, and electronics. Assist in troubleshoot issues to determine the course of action. Assist in keeping accurate maintenance records. Assist in meeting operational requirements and expectations for accuracy of work, while minimizing waste by caring for product, equipment, and facilities. Maintain a productive and efficient work environment. Follow all required safety guidelines and utilize the proper personal protective equipment (PPE). Perform other duties as assigned. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H-1B, TN, F-1 OPT). At Graco, you truly make a difference. Your unique talents contribute to our organizational growth and future. Not only do you make a difference, but Graco’s culture empowers employees to create their own career path. Whether you choose to advance within your current department or explore new opportunities in different divisions, you have the ability to build your future. Our managers are here to provide support and guidance as you continue to grow within your career. Graco has excellent opportunities available to individuals who want to be part of a fast-moving, growing company that is committed to quality, innovation and solving fluid handling problems for our customers. Graco is proud to be named a Best Place to Work by Fortune Magazine in 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021 & 2022. Graco offers attractive compensation, benefits and career development opportunities. Graco’s comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, stock purchase plan, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and more. Our company uses E-Verify to confirm the employment and eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify . jobs.title: Master's Intern Solution Engineer Smart Cities JD
jobs.body: As a Master's Intern Solution Engineer Smart Cities here at Honeywell Technologies, you will have the exciting opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions that enhance urban living through smart city technologies. This internship role offers hands-on experience in developing and implementing cutting-edge solutions that address the challenges faced by modern cities, helping to improve infrastructure, sustainability, and quality of life. You will report directly to our Global Smart Cities Director, and you’ll work out of our Bracknell, United Kingdom Office on an On-site/Hybrid work schedule. In this role, you will impact the development and deployment of smart city solutions by collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, test, and refine technologies that support urban innovation and efficiency. Key Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of smart city solutions that integrate various technologies to improve urban infrastructure and services. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to test and validate solution components and ensure alignment with project goals. Support data analysis and reporting efforts to evaluate the performance and impact of implemented solutions. YOU MUST HAVE Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as computer science, technology, engineering, mathematics Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with focus on AI/ML, Data Management, Software Development & Applications Familiarity with smart city technologies, IoT platforms, Digital Twins, and urban infrastructure systems Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, or similar for solution development and data analysis Knowledge of data analytics tools and cloud computing platforms relevant to smart city applications WE VALUE Advanced coursework or projects in smart city systems, urban planning technology, or related areas Internship or project experience in technology solution development or engineering Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eagerness to learn and innovate Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively Interest in sustainability and improving urban living through technology ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more (https://www.honeywell.com/us/en) THE BUSINESS UNIT Our Smart Cities Division is part of Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) and is focused on delivering innovative technology solutions that transform urban environments into safer, more efficient, and sustainable places to live and work. By leveraging advanced automation, data analytics, and connectivity, we help cities optimize infrastructure, enhance public safety, and improve quality of life for their citizens worldwide. jobs.body: As a Human Resources Intern – Cultural Transformation at Honeywell, you will have the opportunity to support key initiatives aimed at enhancing employee engagement, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and promoting professional development and upskilling throughout the organization. Support the implementation of cultural transformation programs aimed at enhancing employee engagement and fostering collaboration across functions. Proactive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic environment. Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify opportunities for improvement through data and employee feedback. Interest in professional development, employee engagement, organizational culture, and change management initiatives. #LI-Onsite #LI-Hybrid

jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. jobs.title: AI Developer Technology Engineer Intern, AI - 2027
jobs.body: We are now looking for an AI Developer Technology Engineer Interns. Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. This is truly an extraordinary time — the era of AI has begun. Image recognition and speech recognition — GPU Deep Learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human creativity, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human creativity and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” Come join a team full of world-class computer scientists to work in its Compute Developer Technology team as an AI Developer Technology Engineer. What you will be doing: Work and develop state of the art techniques in LLM/AIGX/GR, and perform in-depth analysis and optimization to ensure the best possible performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures You will provide the best AI solutions using GPUs working directly with key customers Collaborate closely with the architecture, research, libraries, tools, and system software teams to influence the design of next-generation architectures, software platforms, and programming models What we need to see: Available to work as intern for at least 3 months, 3 days per week Pursuing MS or PhD from a leading University in an engineering or Computer Science related discipline and will graduate in 2028 Strong knowledge of programming techniques, AI algorithms (LLM, AIGX, or GR). Experience with parallel programming, ideally CUDA C/C++ Good communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, time management, and task prioritization skills ​​NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. #deeplearning

jobs.body: Job Title: Automation Engineering Intern Location: Burlingame, CA Department: Manufacturing Engineering Reports to: Luke Anderson Position Type: Internship (3, 6, or 9 months available) Start Date: Fall/Winter 2026 Compensation: $30–$35/hour About the Company Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven Sodium-Ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. Sodium-Ion is cheap, readily available and safe, making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, SunPower, Fluence, and Enovix. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners such as TDK Ventures and Eclipse Ventures. We are a team of engineers, technicians, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience. About the Job Peak Energy is seeking a motivated Automation Engineering Intern to join our Manufacturing Engineering team supporting Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) manufacturing automation. This is a hands-on internship focused on gaining direct exposure to the PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems that keep our production lines running safely and efficiently. You will work closely with senior Controls Engineers, Equipment Engineers, and Process Engineers, contributing to real automation projects that support Peak Energy's work scaling ESS production toward 1 GWh/year capacity by 2027. One day you might be helping commission a PLC program on the pilot line; another, you could be out on the production floor troubleshooting a control system fault alongside a senior engineer, or documenting a new HMI screen for operators. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects and build real, hands-on experience with the tools and systems used in industrial automation. If you want to actually contribute as part of the team, not just observe from the sidelines, we'd love for you to apply. Responsibilities: Support the programming, testing, and commissioning of PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems for BESS manufacturing equipment, under the guidance of senior Controls Engineers. Partner with Equipment Engineers to help integrate automation solutions into new and existing manufacturing equipment. Help analyze production processes and identify opportunities for automation and control improvements. Support the implementation and upkeep of data acquisition systems, helping collect and organize production data for Process and Automation Engineers to analyze. Assist in maintaining safety systems, such as emergency shutdown procedures and safety interlocks. Help troubleshoot control system issues on the manufacturing floor alongside senior engineers, and support routine maintenance of automation systems. Collaborate with Process Engineers, Equipment Engineers, and Maintenance to ensure control systems support production needs. Contribute to documentation of control system designs, revisions, and updates, and support operator and maintenance training materials. Participate in hands-on testing and validation of automation equipment and control system changes. Minimum Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls/Automation Engineering, or a related engineering field. Foundational knowledge of PLC programming, SCADA systems, and HMI design principles, gained through coursework, capstone projects, or hands-on experience. Hands-on experience building, testing, troubleshooting, or modifying automation or control systems through coursework, student projects, internships, research, or personal projects. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a willingness to learn and take direction from senior engineers. Clear communicator who works well in cross-functional teams. Available to work onsite in Burlingame, CA for a 3-, 6-, or 9-month internship term. Eligible to work in the U.S. Preferred Qualifications: Exposure to industrial automation platforms (e.g., Beckhoff TwinCAT, Allen-Bradley, or Siemens) through coursework or hands-on projects. Familiarity with data acquisition or historian platforms, such as Ignition by Inductive Automation. Previous automation, controls, or manufacturing engineering internship or project experience. Basic understanding of environmental and safety regulations relevant to controls and automation in manufacturing. Eagerness to adapt to new technologies and grow technical skills in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Peak Energy Core Values Speed Through Focus: Prioritize what matters most and execute quickly without distractions. Mission Over Self: Put the company's mission and team success ahead of individual interests. Face the Brutal Truth: Embrace honesty, even when it's uncomfortable, to make informed decisions. Be a Good Person: Treat everyone with respect and integrity, fostering a positive and ethical work environment. Compensation and Benefits The pay for this role is $30–$35/hour. You'll gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge energy storage technology and mentorship from experienced controls and automation engineers while contributing directly to Peak Energy's mission to scale sustainable battery manufacturing. At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, aiming to reach our company's full potential by cultivating an inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.body: Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! As a Project Coordinator Intern, you will participate in a comprehensive summer internship program designed to provide hands-on experience in a dynamic aerospace and defense environment. You will work alongside industry experts, contribute to real-world projects, and develop valuable technical and professional skills. This internship offers a unique opportunity for growth through mentoring, cross-functional workshops, and direct involvement in company projects. The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries. Responsibilities: Participate in actual technical projects and contribute to team objectives by completing assigned tasks. Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced industry professionals in your field. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, reports, and records as required. Assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to support engineering decisions. Attend planning meetings to understand project requirements, timelines, and team goals. Perform hands-on technical work assignments to gain practical experience and build technical skills. Work closely with team members, absorb and learn from their expertise, and apply that learning to ongoing projects. Identify opportunities for process improvements and support the implementation of best practices. Participate in workshops designed to provide a deeper understanding of the business and company culture. Qualifications You Must Have: Must be a Sophomore, Junior, or Senior in college or technical school, with at least 6 months until graduation after end of internship. Currently enrolled in a university or college program pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Strong organization skills and work ethic; detail oriented. The ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required Qualifications We Prefer: Prior internship or work experience in a technical or engineering role. Familiarity with the Aerospace and Defense industry. Basic knowledge of engineering software tools (e.g., CAD, MATLAB). Microsoft Access skills. Pursuing a degree in engineering or a related discipline. Essential Functions: Ability to sit at a computer for extended periods. Proficiency with computers and office equipment. Manual dexterity for handling tools and technical equipment. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally. Ability to work in a laboratory or workshop environment, which may involve exposure to loud noise levels or hazardous conditions. Ability to travel may be required. This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs. SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more . IMPORTANT NOTICE: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. jobs.body: Change the world. Love your job. jobs.title: Social Community Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. As a Social Community Intern, you’ll help bring Toro’s brand to life across social media by supporting content creation, engaging with online communities, and monitoring social media activity. You’ll use research, customer feedback, and performance metrics to identify trends, share insights, and help strengthen Toro’s social presence while ensuring content aligns with Toro and RLC brand guidelines. What Will You Do? In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: Coordinate social media calendar, programming and (platform) content publishing. Follow the content and messaging hierarchy, content types, tone, voice and creative interpretation of content to ensure alignment with brand marketing and business objectives. Create and monitor social listening and reporting dashboards. Respond to comments and customer queries in a timely manner. Collaborate with marketing, sales, and customer service teams to craft. Engage in online conversations with prospective and existing customers about our topics in our industry, products, and brand. Monitor social media campaigns, analyze web traffic from the online community using key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide insights and recommendations based on sentiments, traffic data, follower trends, and more. Provide community feedback to the management and stakeholders. Provide insights to our marketing team about industry, competitors, and relevant topics found online. Stay up to date with digital technology/social media trends. Align with content matrices and (editorial) calendars to track and manage content updates. Support efforts to ensure Toro RLC content is usable, findable, targeted by audience, aligned with best practices and business goals, and is developed with consideration of competitive analysis and research. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Enrollment in a degree program in Communications, Marketing or similar field preferred. Familiarity with customer engagement software, including Sprinklr and Bazaarvoice preferred. Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite programs including Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and XD preferred. Mastery of the major social media platforms including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Twitter. Clear, concise communicator with the ability to flex communication to audience. Ability to discern, communicate, and uphold online community guidelines. Must be extremely well-organized, capable of handling multiple details simultaneously, and able to easily move between strategic and tactical work. Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills. Proficient with Microsoft Office suite. What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $20–$24. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.
