jobs.title: Systems Engineer Intern Summer 2027
jobs.body: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you! Scope of Position This motivated and detail-oriented individual, as part of the Systems Engineering team, will support training initiatives by updating internal and external training materials. The Applications Engineering Intern will develop presentation templates and refresh existing documents to improve consistency, align with branding guidelines, and support effective training. This position reports to the Senior Manager of Systems Engineering. This role is onsite and is based in Blauvelt, NY. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Learn and apply the branding guidelines for four Watts entities. Create presentation templates for branded and generic training materials. Update outdated presentations and other training documents to align with current branding guidelines. Support Watts’ goals for quality and customer focus by developing clear, consistent training materials and contributing as a functional team member. Demonstrate respect for coworkers through daily interactions and collaboration. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the Senior Manager of Systems Engineering or Company management. Responsibility directly tied to Watts Value (Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, Transparency) Required Qualifications Current student (sophomore, junior or senior status). Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in an Engineering Concentration, or any relevant major. Strong time management skills, with the ability to organize tasks and manage multiple priorities. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks, including required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Experience creating presentation templates or training materials through coursework, projects, or previous internships. Familiarity with branding guidelines, visual consistency, and document formatting. Experience organizing technical information into clear, accessible content for different audiences. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions While performing the job duties, you will be working onsite at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor or in the Engineering Test Facility and will be required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment. You will work at the Blauvelt, NY location Monday–Friday. Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Physical Requirements : Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to: Ability to sit, stand, and walk while performing assigned duties. Ability to physically move around the office, manufacturing floor, and Engineering Test Facility. Ability to use hands to handle objects, tools, and other materials. Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with management and coworkers. Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers. Ability to occasionally lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds. Visual abilities necessary to perform assigned duties, including close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Ability to wear appropriate personal protective equipment, which may include safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses. Pay Range : $22–$26 The expected hourly range for this position is $22–$26 hourly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. What’s In It for You People-First Culture – Enriching and caring for people is at the core of who we are; this includes executing our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategy, and providing you with meaningful career growth opportunities, a positive and safe work environment, and affirmation that you are heard, valued, and respected. Flexible PTO Policy – Work-life balance is important at Watts and our interns receive one (1) hour of flexible PTO for every thirty (30) hours worked. Your flexible PTO can be utilized for any type of absence. Paid Holidays – Celebrate the holidays with your loved ones and still get paid! You will receive paid holidays off during your time as an Intern with Watts. Where a holiday falls during the weekend, it will be observed on an adjacent weekday. Lunch and Learns – Throughout your internship, there will be opportunities for you to sign up to learn and network with some of the key strategic leaders and thought partners within our core operating model! Sustainability – For five years in a row, Watts has been named one of “America’s Most Responsible Companies” by Newsweek. Join our journey as we continue to distinguish Watts as a responsible and committed corporate citizen. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. #LI (Onsite) Watts in it for you : Please note that the following benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles. Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ How we work: At Watts, our culture is team-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Under guided supervision, interns will assist with various projects and tasks, contributing to the organization's goals while learning from experienced professionals in the field. jobs.title: Intern - Quantum EM Solver
jobs.body: Overview In this role, you will be an intern in a R&D team developing simulation and design solutions for the emerging quantum technology market. The work combines microwave circuit design, computational electromagnetics, quantum-device modeling, and scientific software development. Working within an Agile development team and with guidance from experienced engineers, you will contribute to EM solver software. The ideal intern takes a proactive approach, learns quickly, and is willing to "roll up their sleeves" to solve challenging technical problems. Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities Develop computational EM workflows that connect layout, electromagnetic simulation, microwave circuit simulation, and system-level analysis using tools such as ADS, RFPro, EMPro, HFSS, CST, COMSOL, Momentum, or Sonnet. Apply graduate-level knowledge of electromagnetic field theory and numerical methods to investigate modeling challenges involving Maxwell's equations, meshing, boundary conditions, eigenmodes, parameter extraction, or multi-scale structures. Evaluate simulation accuracy by comparing results with analytical models, published results, measurement data, or results from established simulation tools. Collaborate with computational EM, quantum, RF/microwave, circuit simulation, and software engineering teams to translate research ideas and workflow needs into reusable capabilities. Produce clear technical documentation, validation examples, and presentations that communicate methods, results, assumptions, and limitations. Qualifications Required Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. Graduate coursework, research, or project experience in one or more of the following: computational electromagnetics, electromagnetic simulation, numerical methods, RF/microwave engineering, quantum engineering, or scientific computing. Experience modeling electromagnetic structures or microwave circuits with at least one relevant simulation environment, such as ADS, EMPro, RFPro, Momentum, HFSS, CST, COMSOL, or Sonnet. Working knowledge of electromagnetic field theory and familiarity with numerical simulation concepts such as FEM, MoM, FDTD, eigenvalue or eigenmode analysis, meshing, sparse linear algebra, or boundary conditions. Experience using Python for scientific computing, data analysis, automation, or software development. Ability to formulate a technical problem, evaluate results critically, and document conclusions with appropriate validation. Ability to work effectively in a multi-site, multidisciplinary, and multicultural team environment. Ability to quickly learn new technologies and contribute within an Agile software development process. Desired Research or project experience applying computational EM to superconducting circuits, quantum processors, resonators, couplers, cryogenic microwave systems, advanced packaging, or high-frequency interconnects. Experience developing or validating workflows that span layout, EM simulation, circuit simulation, and system-level analysis. Experience with C++ and an understanding of software development practices, testing, version control, and software architecture. Exposure to parallel computing, HPC environments, sparse matrix solvers, reduced-order modeling, surrogate modeling, parameter extraction, or model generation. Familiarity with multi-physics simulation involving thermal, mechanical, material, or quantum effects. Basic understanding of electronic design automation products, engineering test solutions, and the needs of research or commercial engineering users. Exposure to parallel computing, HPC environments, sparse matrix solvers, reduced-order modeling, surrogate modeling, parameter extraction, or model generation. Knowledge of the basics of power system protection & control. Self-starter with excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work independently as well within a team environment. Fast-learner with an aptitude for learning company-specific software. Proficient with Microsoft software, specifically Excel, Word and MS Project. Physical Effort: Normal or frequent minor physical effort required for the day-to-day activity in the workplace. May involve standing, sitting, walking, climbing stairs and lifting/moving/using objects or equipment up to 20lbs. Work Environment: Acceptable working environment with minor or almost no disagreeable or challenging working conditions as part of everyday expected levels (all jobs will occasionally experience undesirable or disagreeable events). Why Work for S&C Electric Canada Ltd With over 70 years of innovation in Canada and a century globally, S&C Electric is a trusted leader in power reliability. We foster a collaborative, safety-focused environment where achievements are celebrated and growth is encouraged. jobs.title: Summer Internship - Cyber / AI Consultant - 2027
jobs.body: TTP is an employee-owned technology and product development consultancy, with a 40-year track record of helping ambitious clients solve complex challenges and bring innovative, commercially successful solutions to market. We support clients to invent, design, and manufacture impactful products and technologies across a wide range of industries – such as health tech, life science, energy, and communications – and at the intersection of engineering, physical science, and biology. During your summer internship, your expertise and creativity will be appreciated and nurtured from day one. You’ll dive straight into contributing to technical projects, solving complex real-world problems, working with clients and being a trusted and integral member of the team. As a Summer Intern at TTP, your work over 10 weeks will see you working alongside consultants from a range of academic backgrounds, from engineers and computer scientists to physicists and biologists – experiencing technology consulting first hand. Over the course of your placement, you will contribute directly to live client and internal projects, applying your own knowledge to solve problems, build prototypes in the lab, and explore new areas of technology. You’ll combine using your engineering skillset to support multi-disciplinary project teams inventing new products and technologies, with learning more about the commercial acumen that drives projects forward. You’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with stakeholders and ultimately work towards understanding the industries and disciplines we work across. We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – our non-hierarchical culture gives you the freedom to explore projects that reflect your own interest. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and encouragement to take ownership of your work. By the end of the internship, you will have first-hand experience of how engineering and science are applied in a commercial context, as well as a clear sense of what it’s like to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment like ours. Our internships are also a great pathway into a career, as we consider all our interns for graduate roles. Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in AI/ML, Engineering or Physics, or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications). Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact. Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen. Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background. Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused. We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so. We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your internship begins, so students at the beginning of second year are welcome to apply. The length of this internship can be flexible, but we ask for minimum commitment of 8 weeks and recommend 10, starting in July 2027. TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge. This is a paid internship with generous benefits, including free accommodation in Cambridge (subject to availability) and free lunch, as well as a wide range of clubs to join covering sports and social activities. jobs.body: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you! Scope of Position This innovative and detail-oriented individual, as part of the Operations team, will support the identification and implementation of shop floor process improvements aimed at increasing efficiency, reducing costs, and enhancing production output. The Manufacturing Engineering Intern will work with cross-functional teams to support continuous improvement initiatives and gain hands-on experience with manufacturing processes. This position reports to the Senior Manager of Advanced Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement. This role is onsite and is based in St. Pauls, NC. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Help create and maintain shop floor work instructions, including specifications, engineering changes, process controls, and tooling requirements. Participate in lean manufacturing initiatives that support continuous process improvement. Collaborate with hourly employees and teams across Quality, Safety, Sourcing, and other functions on manufacturing projects. Support the scoping, planning, and execution of manufacturing engineering requests under the guidance of the Manufacturing Engineering team, including improving manufacturing efficiency, implementing engineering changes, improving product quality, and addressing production line technical issues. Analyze and document existing manufacturing processes to identify improvement opportunities. Support Watts’ commitment to continuous improvement by identifying process inefficiencies, communicating findings transparently, and taking accountability for assigned project deliverables. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the Manufacturing Engineer Manager or Company management. Required Qualifications Current student (sophomore, junior or senior status). Pursuing a degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. Ability to present complex data effectively through charts, tables, graphs, and pivot tables. Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks with appropriate guidance. Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with colleagues across departments and levels of the organization. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks, including required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles. Familiarity with quality standards and process improvement methodologies, such as Six Sigma. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions While performing the job duties, you will be working on-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the St. Pauls, NC location (Monday–Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Physical Requirements Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to: Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials. Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks. Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls. Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers. Ability to stand for long periods of time. Ability to lift and carry up to 20 pounds. Ability to push and pull up to 20 pounds. Ability to physically move around the manufacturing floor. Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers. Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses. Pay Range: $21-27 The expected hourly range for this position is $21–27 hourly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. Support the troubleshooting of Layer 2 and basic Layer 3 connectivity issues. Assist with the analysis of issues involving: VLANs and trunking. Spanning Tree Protocol. Link aggregation. Layer 3 interfaces. Routing and switching behavior. DHCP and DNS connectivity. Authentication and access control. Network performance and device health. Follow established Technical Assistance Center processes and quality standards. Maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction and timely case progression. Complete assigned technical learning activities and projects. Work collaboratively with engineers, peers, and cross-functional teams. Education and Experience Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in: Computer Science. Computer Engineering. Electrical or Electronics Engineering. Information Technology. Telecommunications. Networking or a related technical field. Basic academic or practical knowledge of computer networking. Previous professional technical support experience is not required. Experience through university laboratories, personal projects, internships, or technical certifications is desirable. Required Knowledge and Skills Basic understanding of networking concepts, including: Ethernet. TCP/IP. IPv4 and IPv6 fundamentals. Subnetting. ARP, ICMP, TCP, and UDP. DNS and DHCP. VLANs and trunking. Basic Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting. Introductory understanding of switching technologies, including: Spanning Tree Protocol and its variants. Link Aggregation Control Protocol. Access and trunk ports. MAC address learning. Basic routing and default gateways. Familiarity with basic network troubleshooting tools, such as: ping. traceroute. arp. nslookup or dig. Basic packet-capture concepts. Basic ability to read network diagrams and technical documentation. Basic scripting or programming knowledge, preferably Python, is desirable. English proficiency at B2 level or higher , particularly in written and spoken technical communication. Strong logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to organize technical information and follow troubleshooting procedures. Strong communication, collaboration, and time-management skills. Willingness to learn new networking technologies and support methodologies. Customer-focused and solution-oriented mindset. Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when appropriate. Preferred Qualifications Coursework or projects involving data communications, network design, routing and switching, cybersecurity, or telecommunications. Familiarity with enterprise switching platforms or network operating systems. Basic knowledge of the following technologies: STP, RSTP, MSTP, or similar protocols. LACP. VRRP. QoS and CoS concepts. 802.1X and RADIUS. OSPF or BGP fundamentals. Multicast, IGMP, or IGMP snooping. Familiarity with Wireshark or other packet-analysis tools. Basic Linux or Unix command-line experience. Exposure to Python, Perl, Shell scripting, REST APIs, or network automation. Entry-level networking certifications, such as Network+, CCNA, JNCIA, or equivalent, are desirable but not required. jobs.title: Engineering (Manufacturing) Summer Internship 2027
jobs.body: Job Location LONDON PLANT-W THURROCK Job Description Ready to fuel the success of globally renowned brands like Ariel, Lenor and Fairy that millions of consumers can’t live without? Do you want to be part of the innovation and technological advancement of products used every day by millions of the world’s consumers? Want to work for a company consistently recognised as one of the UK’s leading graduate employers? Then apply for a summer internship in Engineering (Manufacturing) at our London Plant where our best ideas and innovations are transformed into reality in our world-class manufacturing operating facilities. Our technical, innovative environment is one that embraces fast-paced change and cultivates a sense of leadership and commitment amongst our employees. Our aim is to ignite your potential and equip you to enhance the capability, safety and productivity of all our systems while reducing cost and boosting sustainability. We offer industry leading learning and development opportunities to allow you to excel in your career and take on new challenges - expanding your knowledge and expertise across a range of different areas. About our London Plant: From raw materials to finished products, our production facility is where innovation meets execution. Engineers and plant technicians work together to maintain efficiency, uphold safety, and ensure every product meets P&G’s exacting quality standards - all whilst contributing to the bigger picture of delivering some of the most iconic P&G products like Fairy, Bold and Ariel that delight consumers worldwide. The site offers easy access to the city while being situated in a well-connected industrial hub. Chafford Hundred and Grays mainline stations (C2C train line) are nearest to the site besides several bus routes. On site there is free on-site parking, a subsidized restaurant, free on-site gym, occupational health support and local events! What To Expect: During your summer internship, you will get a first-hand experience of what a career in Engineering with P&G involves, and if it is right for you. You will be working on live business Engineering projects and expected to dive straight in and take the lead. Each intern receives a customized learning plan to ensure they get the right levels of coaching, mentoring, and training as they deliver their work. If you are looking for an exciting and challenging experience, have a passion for winning, strong leadership credentials and an interest in pursuing a career at P&G – this internship is for you! What You Will Gain: Responsibilities and Real Work from Day 1: You will be given specific projects and responsibilities working on real and live business challenges, just like a true P&Ger. Continuous training & coaching: You will work with passionate people and receive both formal training as well as day-to-day mentoring from your manager. Competitive Compensation & Benefits: The monthly salary for this summer internship is £2,625. On top of this you’ll enjoy the option of a range of benefits including a competitive double-matched pension scheme, private health insurance, participation in a stock ownership scheme, and your very own ‘Flex4Me’ Fund which enables you to allocate a portion of your benefits package to the areas that matter most to you. Full Time Role: Successful interns have the potential to secure a full-time position with P&G after graduation. As a 'build from within' company, our people start at entry level and progress through the organization. When we make a job offer, it’s with the expectation that you will grow into one of our future leaders, and to help you get there, you will work closely with skilled P&G veterans for mentoring and coaching at every step. Job Qualifications What We Look For: University students graduating in 2027 or 2028. We also welcome applications from those who have already recently graduated. Evidence of passion and achievements in academic and/or non-academic activities. Tell us what you’re proud of – be it playing a musical instrument or holding down a job alongside your studies. We want to get to know you during your application! Strong foundational understanding of engineering principles within your chosen field, as well as problem-solving and leadership skills. Strong verbal and written English language skills. Start date: The summer internship is available from 5th July 2027 until 24th September 2027. We expect you to be available for the full duration. Right to work: For our internship roles, you will need to provide your own right to work in the UK for the full duration of your internship without requiring sponsorship from P&G. Note, this will require your right to work permission to be valid between 5th July 2027 until 24th September 2027 for a minimum of 37.5 hours per week. P&G is legally required to ensure all candidates have the right to work in the UK from Day 1 of their employment. All applicants will therefore be asked to provide evidence of their right to work at the conclusion of the recruitment process as a condition of employment Application Deadline: 1pm (GMT) November 13th, 2026. You must apply by the deadline. We encourage you to apply and complete our online assessments as soon as possible , as we may close early if positions are filled. Application Process: Complete your Application (Deadline 1pm GMT 13th November 2026) Complete our Online Assessments (Deadline 1pm GMT 20th November 2026) Virtual Interviews (These will run from October until our roles are filled) At P&G #weseeequal We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. At P&G we strive to build a culture where everyone feels welcome, included, and able to bring their full selves to work. We champion social mobility and believe socio-economic status should not be a barrier to accessing job opportunities. That’s why in addition to this internship being paid, we offer provision of all the necessary technology and electronic equipment, access to a range of benefits, and financial support if you need to relocate for your internship - such as covering the cost of travel to your internship location. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process. Please click here if you require an accommodation during the application process. Please make sure to wait to hear back from us regarding your accommodation before proceeding with the online assessment, we thank you in advance for your patience. Job Schedule Full time Job Number R000160388 Job Segmentation Internships Starting Pay / Salary Range £2.625,00 / month

jobs.title: Product Supply Management Intern (6 months)
jobs.body: Job Location SINGAPORE PIONEER PLANT Job Description Internship Applications is now open! Apply now to send in your applications and we will contact shortlisted candidates only starting September! How would you like to use your engineering/science/business operations background and join a globally recognized company? If you are passionate about inventing, developing, reapplying, and delivering processes and technologies, then this role is perfect for you. P&G is the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world. We have operations in over 75 countries, with 65 trusted brands that improve lives for 5 billion consumers worldwide. This brings many advantages, including the opportunity for our employees to enjoy a diverse and rewarding lifelong career filled with new and exciting challenges. Here at P&G Product Supply (Supply Chain), we go beyond sourcing, moving materials and reducing costs. For a consumer goods company, the supply chain is central to delivering the business and you’ll be at the heart of some of the most challenging (and fulfilling) business and supply chain problems. From increasing customer expectations and new technologies, to emerging competitors, channels and growing uncertainty in the world, the entire supply chain system is transforming at an unprecedented pace and you’ll certainly be in the thick of things. At P&G, we believe in giving interns the same real-life business problems to work on as our full-time colleagues. To give you a flavour, these are some of the key tasks for this Internship at our Manufacturing Plant Eliminate process variability and losses through data analysis and technical mastery Design, implement and maintain systems to collect and analyze data for critical product and process parameters Eliminate or reduce (prioritized) losses through implementing making/packing process or work system changes Use Reliability Engineering tools to drive center-line improvement and loss elimination Share and reapply learning across processes, modules and plants What we offer: Responsibilities from Day 1 – You will start of working on key brands from the beginning. Over time, as you expand your impact on the business, your responsibility and ownership of a brand will quickly grow. Work on impactful projects that will enable better inventory management, lower costs & excellent service to customers, across various PS functions such as Supply Network, Purchasing, Manufacturing & more. Continuous coaching & mentorship – We are passionate about our work. Formal training and regular mentorship from your manager and others. Dynamic and respectful work environment – We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily. We value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance. Friendly and supportive atmosphere at work. We love talented people; you will have the opportunity to become full-time following successful completion of your Internship. Job Qualifications Working towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree Excellent visionary, strategic and courageous leadership skills Problem solving via innovation creativity Strong thinking/analytical skills which can be applied to business processes with a "can-do" attitude Ability to collaborate effectively within a multicultural environment You are a penultimate year student graduating between December 2027 to July 2028 Job Schedule Full time Job Number R000158598 Job Segmentation Internships

jobs.body: About Marvell Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. Your Team, Your Impact Marvell Technology, Inc. is principally engaged in delivering the data infrastructure technology that connects the world. A critical IP in these market is high speed serial data transmission (SerDes), through both electrical and optical media, generally referred as PHYs when considered within the Ethernet protocol stack. PHY speed at low level is evolving towards 400Gb/s but as physical limits are getting closer, new architectural solutions are needed to continue the growth process. This includes circuits, DSP, modulation, and coding as well as optical components, contributing to the creation of a very challenging and exciting work that involves multidisciplinary teams. We are looking for a young talented engineer to join the system architecture team and work on next generation PHY design. The duration of the thesis/internship will be about five months, with flexibility. What You Can Expect You will be part of the Architecture team. You will be introduced to state-of-the-art PHY design. You will familiarize with different modeling approaches for system design and simulation. You will work on link budgeting, non-ideality modeling and system simulation. You will analyze DSP challenges and opportunities, explore and compare different optimization directions, and generate tradeoff curves of performance and cost. You will be supervised in all the phases of your work with a reference person that will help you having a fast-learning experience. You will participate to meetings, discussions, and brain storming sessions. You will also work with other teams, including analog and digital designers, enriching and expanding your background. You will be exposed to an international environment, interacting with teams from multiple locations around the world. jobs.body: The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future. With more than 1400 employees, focused on innovation, sustainability and collaboration, Bosch Aveiro joins together experts in diverse areas, from mechanical engineering to connectivity and software solutions, as well as industrialization and quality. At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential. Are you ready to make a significant impact in a dynamic, cross-functional product development team? As a Design for Environment Engineer at Bosch, you will ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and material compliance. jobs.body: The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 394,500 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2020). Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 440 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 60 countries. Able to provide a university recommendation or introduction letter for the internship Solid foundation in programming with at least one of: JavaScript (including modern ES6+), Java, or basic understanding of ABAP Strong enthusiasm to learn SAP-specific technologies including SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, ABAP, Java extensions, and SAP BTP Basic knowledge of web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) Analytical mindset with good problem-solving skills and attention to detail Effective communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach Good English communication skills Nice to Have (But Not Required): Any prior exposure to SAP technologies (e.g., SAPUI5, Fiori, ABAP, S/4HANA, BTP, CAP, or RAP) Familiarity with RESTful APIs, OData protocol, MVC/MV* patterns, or cloud concepts Experience with version control (e.g., Git), basic testing frameworks, or agile methodologies Knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring Boot) or Node.js basics Because we do not just follow trends, we create them. jobs.title: ISC Analytics Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. We are seeking a motivated and talented undergraduate intern to join our Sourcing Division within the Integrated Supply Chain for the summer of 2025. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data analysis, visualization, and storytelling within a dynamic and supportive environment. What Will You Do? In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: Develop and maintain SQL and DAX queries to support data analysis and analytics needs. Utilize SQL Server and Snowflake for data storage, retrieval, and management. Design and implement ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy. Create and manage data visualizations using Power BI to provide actionable insights. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather, document and analyze data requirements. Assist in the preparation of data-driven presentations and analytical solutions to communicate findings effectively. Assist in developing decision-making tools within Toro’s Integrated Supply Chain. Participate in sourcing and supply chain projects, contributing to process improvements and strategic initiatives. Support the team in ad-hoc data analysis and analytics tasks as needed. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or other quantitative field. Proficiency in SQL and DAX for data querying and manipulation. Experience with SQL Server and Snowflake. Experience with ETL processes. Experience with data visualization tools, particularly Power BI. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tell compelling stories with data. Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality. What Will You Gain? Hands-on experience in a leading global company. Mentorship and professional development opportunities. Exposure to real-world supply chain and sourcing challenges. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Competitive internship compensation. What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $20–$24. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.title: PhD Autonomy Engineer Intern - Computer Vision / Deep Learning Summer 2027
jobs.body: Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions. About the role: The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. You will architect and implement the algorithms that run on every drone powered by Skydio as part of a world class computer vision and deep learning team with researchers who have pushed the state of the art in academia and industry. As a Research Intern, you will be paired up with one or more members of our core software development team, assuming direct ownership of a project that meaningfully advances the capabilities of our team and products. If you have a strong foundation in math, theory, and software development and you are interested in directly contributing to the development of the next generation of autonomy algorithms and pushing them into real products, we would love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact: - Enable rapid research and development of intelligent systems with advanced autonomous capabilities beyond anything that exists in the world today - Research, prototype, and generally assess the feasibility of new approaches - Imagine and then implement new features that unlock magic for our users - Characterize and quantify the performance of core components of the software and hardware stack What makes you a good fit: - High proficiency in C++ and/or Python and PyTorch - Demonstrated enthusiasm for one or more of the following: computer vision, deep learning, motion planning, dynamics and controls, 3D graphics, distributed systems, and tools/infrastructure - Solid software engineering foundation and a commitment to writing clean, well-architected code - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, small team environment #LI-DK1 At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws. For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

jobs.title: Summer Internship - Electronic Engineering Consultant - 2027
jobs.body: TTP is an employee-owned technology and product development consultancy, with a 40-year track record of helping ambitious clients solve complex challenges and bring innovative, commercially successful solutions to market. We support clients to invent, design, and manufacture impactful products and technologies across a wide range of industries – such as health tech, life science, energy, and communications – and at the intersection of engineering, physical science, and biology. During your summer internship, your expertise and creativity will be appreciated and nurtured from day one. You’ll dive straight into contributing to technical projects, solving complex real-world problems, working with clients and being a trusted and integral member of the team. As a Summer Intern at TTP, your work over 10 weeks will see you working alongside consultants from a range of academic backgrounds, from engineers and computer scientists to physicists and biologists – experiencing technology consulting first hand. Over the course of your placement, you will contribute directly to live client and internal projects, applying your own knowledge to solve problems, build prototypes in the lab, and explore new areas of technology. You’ll combine using your engineering skillset to support multi-disciplinary project teams inventing new products and technologies, with learning more about the commercial acumen that drives projects forward. You’ll demonstrate leadership, build collaborative relationships with stakeholders and ultimately work towards understanding the industries and disciplines we work across. We believe growth happens best in a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared freely and curiosity is encouraged – our non-hierarchical culture gives you the freedom to explore projects that reflect your own interest. You'll receive mentorship and guidance when needed, but also the space and encouragement to take ownership of your work. By the end of the internship, you will have first-hand experience of how engineering and science are applied in a commercial context, as well as a clear sense of what it’s like to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment like ours. Our internships are also a great pathway into a career, as we consider all our interns for graduate roles. Deep intellectual curiosity and inventiveness, with a desire to understand how things work at a fundamental level. You should have an academic record that reflects your capacity for rigorous, first-principles thinking - being on track for a minimum 2:1 in Electronic Engineering or a closely related discipline, with strong accompanying A-Levels (or equivalent, i.e. IB qualifications). Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, excited by the opportunity to turn breakthrough technologies into real-world products, ventures, and impact. Proactive and self-starting, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and a drive to make things happen. Collaborative and emotionally intelligent, able to build trust, influence stakeholders, energise those around you, and communicate complex technical ideas with clarity, empathy, and precision, regardless of your audience's background. Strategic and systems-minded, able to see the bigger picture, anticipate challenges and opportunities while considering the commercial aspects of technology product development, and navigate ambiguity while keeping priorities sharp and focused. We're looking for candidates who want to impact the industry both commercially and technically; those who don't just solve problems - but who seek them out, thrive on them, and elevate those around them while doing so. We recruit on a rolling basis, so although there is no application deadline, the advert will close once all spaces have been filled. We recommend applying early for the best chance. You must have completed at least 2 years of your degree when your internship begins, so students at the beginning of second year are welcome to apply. The length of this internship can be flexible, but we ask for minimum commitment of 8 weeks and recommend 10, starting in July 2027. TTP operates from an award-winning campus in green surroundings, just south of Cambridge. This is a paid internship with generous benefits, including free accommodation in Cambridge (subject to availability) and free lunch, as well as a wide range of clubs to join covering sports and social activities. jobs.title: Product Specialist Intern, Summer 2027
jobs.body: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you! Scope of Position This innovative individual, as part of the Product Management team, will be responsible for providing daily and ongoing product and project support, including new product development coordination, product documentation, and collateral and label development. The Product Specialist Intern will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product launches, organize product information, and assist with product-related issues. This position reports to the Senior Product Manager. This role is onsite and is based in Fort Myers, Florida. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Assist the Product Management team with product documentation, label creation, and marketing collateral updates. Support cross-functional teams during new product development by tracking tasks and maintaining project timelines. Collaborate with Engineering and Product Development to support new product launches and help keep projects on schedule and within budget. Gather and organize product data, including specifications, product requirements, and feedback from internal teams. Update databases and collect information to support the development of business cases. Help identify and report product-related issues, working closely with Engineering and Customer Support. Create product documentation and sales collateral for sales and technical presentations. Support dashboard development and data analysis to help the team monitor product performance. Learn and apply foundational product management principles under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by the Senior Product Manager or Company management. Demonstrate integrity, accountability, continuous improvement, and transparency by maintaining accurate product information, taking ownership of assigned tasks, identifying process improvements, and clearly communicating project updates. Required Qualifications Current student (sophomore, junior or senior status). Pursuing a degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. Technical competency in understanding and preparing documentation for technical systems. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact. Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Engineering focus with a minor in Marketing or Business. Interest in gaining experience in Product Management. Familiarity with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint. Experience with or exposure to Power BI, dashboard development, and data analysis through coursework, academic projects, or previous internships. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions: While performing the job duties, you will be working on-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Fort Myers location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Physical Requirements : Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to: Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials. Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks. Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls. Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers. Ability to stand for long periods of time. Ability to lift and carry up to 20 pounds. Ability to push and pull up to 20 pounds. Ability to physically move around manufacturing floor. Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers. Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses. Pay Range : $21-27 The expected hourly range for this position is $21-27. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. What's In It for You People-First Culture – Enriching and caring for people is at the core of who we are; this includes executing our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategy, and providing you with meaningful career growth opportunities, a positive and safe work environment, and affirmation that you are heard, valued, and respected. Flexible PTO Policy – Work-life balance is important at Watts and our interns receive one (1) hour of flexible PTO for every thirty (30) hours worked. Your flexible PTO can be utilized for any type of absence. Paid Holidays – Celebrate the holidays with your loved ones and still get paid! You will receive the following paid holidays off during your time as an Intern with Watts. Where a holiday falls during the weekend, it will be observed on an adjacent weekday. Lunch and Learns – Throughout your internship, there will be opportunities for you to sign up to learn and network with some of the key strategic leaders and thought partners within our core operating model! Sustainability – For five years in a row, Watts has been named one of "America's Most Responsible Companies" by Newsweek. Join our journey as we continue to distinguish Watts as a responsible and committed corporate citizen. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. #LI (Onsite) Watts in it for you : Please note that the following benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles. Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ How we work: At Watts, our culture is team-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Watts is committed to equal employment opportunity. We follow a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic disposition or carrier status, marital status, military or veteran status, minorities, or any other category protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the obligations of state and federal law, Watts will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Any employee who needs a reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources.

jobs.title: Neurodivergent Interns Program
jobs.body: Introduction At our global headquarters in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, we welcome students of all backgrounds to apply for our internships and graduation assignments. Worldwide, we h ave around 600 interns learning and contributing at ASML every year . In Veldhoven, our Neurodivergent Interns Program provides the support that students with a form of neurodiversity (such as autism, ADHD, dyslexia and giftedness) need to succeed . You are invited to apply for targeted internship assignments. To do so we will keep you abreast of available opportunities within the program. If your internship application is successful, you’ll be matched with a mentor in your team who knows how to help bring out the best in a person with a neurodivergent brain . Mentors are aware of the strengths and weaknesses associated with different forms of neurodivergence and are motivated to see you grow professionally and personally and contribut e to solving a particular challenge that the team faces. Your assignment You’ll get to explore your capabilities and develop your skills within a close-knit community of interns. Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems. Internship s tart dates are February 1 and September 1 and the duration of each internship is 6–9 months. You’ll receive a full-time monthly allowance depending on your education level , and ASML will pay for public transport ation (second class) between your home address and work location (u nless you have a week or weekend student travel product ) . Your profile We welcome students in all fields of study who are pursuing associate’s, bachelor’s and master’s degree. To thrive as an intern at ASML , you’ll need the following skills: Fluency in English Dedication to your work A professional and responsible attitude Curiosity and a willingness to learn as part of a team Other requirements you need to meet To participate in the Neurodivergent Interns Program, you need to be enrolled at an officially recognized academic institution in the Netherlands (such as an accredited school, college or university). Please add a motivation letter with your reasonable accommodation requests or additional support needs. This so we can match you to the right mentor and team. This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. Inclusion and diversity ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

jobs.title: CoOp/Intern Operations
jobs.body: Role Summary: A Operations Intern supports the Planning and Material Management teams with day-to-day activities related to production planning, material availability, reporting, and process follow-up. The role is designed to provide hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment while developing a strong understanding of production processes, planning methodologies, and material management. The intern will work closely with a team of 4 Planning and 4 Material Management professionals, as well as Production and Technical teams. This is a new role within the organization, offering the opportunity to learn, contribute, and develop practical skills across different areas of the operation. Your role: The candidate will support the Planning team with production planning, follow-up, reporting, and material-related activities. The intern will assist with monitoring production plans, organizing information, preparing reports, and supporting the team in identifying potential gaps or opportunities for improvement. The candidate will also have the opportunity to work closely with Production and Technical teams, gaining exposure to manufacturing processes and developing both technical and operational knowledge. As part of the role, the candidate will learn and use tools and methodologies such as: SAP Power BI Microsoft Office 365 Production Planning Material Management Reporting & Data Analysis Kaizen Six Sigma Continuous Improvement Your profile: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Fluency in written and spoken English and Spanish is required. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Structured, systematic, and detail-oriented, with strong follow-up skills. Analytical mindset and ability to work with data and reports. Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proactive and willing to learn about production and manufacturing processes. Flexible and open to change. Growth mindset, with an interest in continuously improving processes and developing professionally. Interest in learning and working with tools such as SAP, Power BI, and Microsoft Office 365. Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with different teams. Availability to work on-site with flexible working hours. What we offer: Paid internship Internship contract, full-time or part-timeMinimum commitment of 6 months Free canteen Flexible working hours

jobs.title: Intern Bachelors Field Service Technician, Markham Ontario
jobs.body: As an Intern Bachelors Field Service Engineer here at Honeywell, you will gain hands-on experience and exposure to field service operations. You will have the opportunity to work on real projects, providing technical support and learning from experienced engineers. This role will help you develop your problem-solving skills and technical expertise in a practical setting. In this role, you will impact the success of our field service operations by supporting the team in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, assisting in project execution, and contributing to customer satisfaction. At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. Help to build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying, and developing successors, driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture. You will report directly to our Senior Field Service Supervisor and you’ll work on-site out of our Markham, Ontario location on a full-time basis. This is a an internship beginning May 3rd and ending August 27th. KEY RESPONSABILITIES Assist field service engineers with troubleshooting technical issues Support installations and repairs of equipment Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to ensure customer satisfaction Learn and apply technical knowledge to provide effective solutions Follow company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines YOU MUST HAVE Enrolled in post-secondary degree or diploma program in Building Sciences, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field. Basic understanding of technical concepts and principles. WE VALUE Pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment The hourly base salary range for this position is $22-$25/hour in Markham, ON, Canada. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
